<script id="derbyOpeningLogic">
(function(){
  // The welcome screen is the first screen on EVERY page load.
  // The opening's "ゲーム開始" action goes directly to the farm; no second welcome.
  const welcome=document.getElementById('dfV42Welcome');
  let requested=false, leaving=false;
  const screen=()=>document.getElementById('derbyOpening');
  const startButton=()=>document.getElementById('derbyOpeningStart');
  const farmFrame=()=>document.getElementById('standaloneFarmV62Frame');

  // Ver.121: do not fade the first screen onto an unpainted opening image.
  // This is strictly a display readiness guard; it does not alter game data.
  let welcomeDismissStarted=false;
  async function leaveWelcome(){
    if(!welcome||welcome.hidden||welcomeDismissStarted)return;
    welcomeDismissStarted=true;
    welcome.classList.remove('is-ready');
    const image=screen()?.querySelector('.opening-base');
    if(image){
      try{
        if(!image.complete || image.naturalWidth===0){
          // Keep welcome visible while the large opening image is decoding.
          await Promise.race([
            image.decode(),
            new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,5000))
          ]);
        }
      }catch(_){/* Retain the original opening even if decode is unavailable. */}
    }
    // Give the underlying opening a full paint before beginning the fade.
    await new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve)));
    welcome.classList.add('is-leaving');
    setTimeout(()=>{
      welcome.hidden=true;
      welcome.remove();
      window.scrollTo(0,0);
      startButton()?.focus({preventScroll:true});
    },1750);
  }
  if(welcome){
    // The first screen is visible and interactive immediately, without RAF delays.
    welcome.addEventListener('click',leaveWelcome);
    welcome.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
      if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();leaveWelcome();}
    });
  }

  function showFarmIfReady(){
    if(!requested||leaving)return;
    const frame=farmFrame();
    let image=null;
    try{image=frame?.contentDocument?.getElementById('exactSceneImage');}catch(_){}
    if(!image)return;
    if(!(image.complete&&image.naturalWidth>0)){
      if(!image.__dfWatch){
        image.__dfWatch=true;
        image.addEventListener('load',showFarmIfReady,{once:true});
      }
      return;
    }
    leaving=true;
    document.body.classList.remove('boot-farm');
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      // Ver.147: fade the opening over the fully painted farm, without a light burst.
      document.body.classList.add('df-v2-opening-fade');
      screen()?.classList.add('df-leaving');
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const opener=screen();
        if(opener){opener.hidden=true;opener.style.pointerEvents='none';}
        document.body.classList.remove('df-v2-opening-fade');
        window.scrollTo(0,0);
      },2300);
    }));
  }
  window.__derbyMaybeEnterFarm=showFarmIfReady;
  function attachFarmLoadListener(){
    const frame=farmFrame();
    if(!frame||frame.__dfOpeningLoadAttached)return;
    frame.__dfOpeningLoadAttached=true;
    frame.addEventListener('load',showFarmIfReady);
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(event){
    const button=event.target.closest?.('#derbyOpeningStart');
    if(!button||requested||(welcome&&!welcome.hidden))return;
    requested=true;
    button.classList.add('is-locked');
    button.setAttribute('aria-disabled','true');
    attachFarmLoadListener();
    // The existing farm loader observes barn-mode and loads its own srcdoc.
    document.body.classList.add('barn-mode');
    document.body.classList.remove('stable-mode');
    document.body.dataset.gameScreen='farm';
    showFarmIfReady();
  });
})();
</script>

<script id="dfV6RestoreRecovery">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const prefix='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.';
  const meta=prefix+'v6.';
  const recovery=meta+'restore_recovery';
  try{
    const saved=localStorage.getItem(recovery);
    if(!saved)return;
    const previous=JSON.parse(saved);
    if(!previous||previous.format!=='df-v6-recovery'||typeof previous.keys!=='object'||!previous.keys)throw Error('invalid recovery');
    const entries=Object.entries(previous.keys);
    if(entries.some(([k,v])=>!k.startsWith(prefix)||k.startsWith(meta)||k.length>=170||typeof v!=='string'))throw Error('invalid recovery key');
    const existing=[];
    for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){const k=localStorage.key(i);if(k&&k.startsWith(prefix)&&!k.startsWith(meta))existing.push(k);}
    for(const k of existing)localStorage.removeItem(k);
    for(const [k,v] of entries)localStorage.setItem(k,v);
    localStorage.removeItem(recovery);
    console.warn('前回中断されたロード操作を元のデータへ復旧しました');
  }catch(err){console.error('セーブデータの自動復旧に失敗しました。復旧情報は保持されています。',err);}
})();
</script>

<script id="df116-bgm-fade-controller">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const audio=document.getElementById('derbyOpeningBgm');
  if(!audio)return;
  // Normal-speed playback for the original opening song.
  audio.defaultPlaybackRate=1.0;
  audio.playbackRate=1.0;
  const DURATION=2000, TARGET_VOLUME=0.44;
  let frame=0, generation=0, stopping=false;
  function cancel(){generation++;if(frame){cancelAnimationFrame(frame);frame=0;}}
  function animate(to,then){
    const from=Number.isFinite(audio.volume)?audio.volume:0;
    const mark=generation;let start=null;
    const tick=(now)=>{
      if(generation!==mark)return;
      if(start===null)start=now;
      const t=Math.min(1,(now-start)/DURATION);
      audio.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,from+(to-from)*(t*t*(3-2*t))));
      if(t<1)frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      else{frame=0;if(then)then();}
    };
    frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  function play(options={}){
    cancel();stopping=false;
    if(options.restart){try{audio.currentTime=0;}catch(_){}}
    const wasPaused=audio.paused;
    if(wasPaused||options.restart)audio.volume=0;
    audio.loop=true;
    audio.playbackRate=1.0;
    const mark=generation;
    try{
      const promise=audio.play();
      if(promise&&typeof promise.then==='function'){
        promise.then(()=>{if(generation===mark)animate(TARGET_VOLUME);})
         .catch(()=>{if(generation===mark){stopping=false;audio.volume=0;}});
      }else animate(TARGET_VOLUME);
    }catch(_){audio.volume=0;}
  }
  function fadeOut(options={}){
    cancel();stopping=true;
    if(audio.paused){audio.volume=0;
      if(options.reset){try{audio.currentTime=0;}catch(_){}}
      return;
    }
    animate(0,()=>{
      audio.pause();
      if(options.reset){try{audio.currentTime=0;}catch(_){}}
    });
  }
  // When a tab is hidden, the browser suspends animation frames: stop promptly
  // to prevent background music. Foreground screen changes use the 2s fade.
  function suspend(){cancel();stopping=true;audio.volume=0;audio.pause();}
  window.DF116Bgm=Object.freeze({play,fadeOut,suspend,isStopping:()=>stopping,
    targetVolume:TARGET_VOLUME,fadeDuration:DURATION});
})();
</script>
<script id="derbyOpeningMusicLogic">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const opening=document.getElementById('derbyOpening');
  const audio=document.getElementById('derbyOpeningBgm');
  const bgm=window.DF116Bgm;
  if(!opening||!audio||!bgm)return;
  let leaving=false;
  // Attempt from first page paint. Android Chrome commonly blocks sound until the
  // first real touch; that touch retries from within the user activation itself.
  function start(){
    if(leaving||opening.hidden||document.hidden||!audio.paused)return;
    bgm.play();
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown',start,{capture:true,passive:true});
  // Keyboards and browsers without Pointer Events also support a first interaction.
  document.addEventListener('keydown',start,{capture:true,passive:true});
  document.addEventListener('click',start,{capture:true,passive:true});
  function stop(){
    if(leaving)return;
    leaving=true;
    bgm.fadeOut({reset:true});
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(e.target.closest?.('#derbyOpeningStart'))stop();
  },true);
  new MutationObserver(()=>{if(opening.hidden)stop();})
    .observe(opening,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['hidden']});
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)bgm.suspend();});
  window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>bgm.suspend());
  document.addEventListener('freeze',()=>bgm.suspend());
  start();
})();
</script>

<p class="foot">独自制作の試作。ゲーム内の馬名は架空の名前です。馬体の形状はこのファイル内で生成します（3D表示には通信が必要）。既存競馬ゲームの映像・ロゴは使用していません。<br/>実在馬の能力値と騎手能力はゲーム用換算値で、公式レーティングではありません。競馬場と周囲の建物・景観はJRA公表資料を参考にした高精細3D再現です。写真のような見た目を目指していますが、スマホで動くよう一部は簡略化しています。別定・ハンデ重量はゲーム用計算で、公式の出馬表と異なります。騎手は史実の騎乗経験を優先しますが、その他は実在騎手によるゲーム上の配役です。レース結果もシミュレーションです。</p>

  function growthFraction(h,calendarYear,calendarMonth){
    const age=Math.max(0,calendarYear-h.birthGameYear)+(calendarMonth-1)/12;
    const phase=growthPhases[h.growth]||growthPhases['普通'];
    return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(age-phase[0])/(phase[1]-phase[0])));
  }

  const pointKeys=Object.freeze(['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability']);
  function birthHash(input){let h=2166136261;for(const c of String(input)){h=Math.imul(h^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;}return h>>>0;}
  // Ver.92 original 100-horse SS/S ranks only. Saved foals are never edited.
  const dfV92SS=new Set(["ディープインパクト", "イクイノックス", "アーモンドアイ"]);
  const dfV92S=new Set(["ナリタブライアン", "タイキシャトル", "エルコンドルパサー", "グラスワンダー", "スペシャルウィーク", "テイエムオペラオー", "アグネスデジタル", "シンボリクリスエス", "ダイワメジャー", "オルフェーヴル", "ロードカナロア", "モーリス", "キタサンブラック", "コントレイル", "ドウデュース", "フォーエバーヤング", "ジャンタルマンタル", "クロワデュノール", "エアグルーヴ", "メジロドーベル", "ダイワスカーレット", "ウオッカ", "ブエナビスタ", "アパパネ", "ジェンティルドンナ", "リスグラシュー", "ラッキーライラック", "クロノジェネシス", "グランアレグリア", "ラヴズオンリーユー", "リバティアイランド", "ソングライン"]);
  // Ver.93: custom 4-ability totals take precedence over Ver.92 S bonuses.
  const dfV93Custom=Object.freeze({"キングカメハメハ":120,"オグリキャップ":120,"オルフェーヴル":120,"サイレンススズカ":120,"ナリタブライアン":115,"エルコンドルパサー":120,"サクラローレル":120,"マヤノトップガン":120,"グラスワンダー":120,"シンボリルドルフ":120,"スペシャルウィーク":120,"トウカイテイオー":120,"ウオッカ":120,"ヒシアマゾン":105,"エアグルーヴ":105,"ヒシアケボノ":105,"マイネルラヴ":105,"グランアレグリア":120,"ライスシャワー":115,"メジロマックイーン":110,"キタサンブラック":120,"テイエムオペラオー":120,"タイキシャトル":120});
  const dfV93NewSProfiles=Object.freeze({"シンボリルドルフ":[120,120,120,96,101,120,99],"ヒシアケボノ":[105,105,105,96,96,105,89],"マイネルラヴ":[105,105,105,97,94,105,93]});
  function breedingParentPoints(name, catalogId){
    const original=String(name||'');
    const row=registeredAbilityPoints[original]||dfV93NewSProfiles[original];
    const custom=Number(dfV93Custom[original])||0;
    const max={}, unique={};
    const top=row&&dfV92S.has(original)?[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].sort((a,b)=>Number(row[b])-Number(row[a])||a-b).slice(0,2):[];
    for(let i=0;i<pointKeys.length;i++){
      const key=pointKeys[i];
      const bonus=row?(dfV92SS.has(original)&&[0,1,2,5].includes(i)?10:top.includes(i)?5:0):0;
      const points=row?(custom&&[0,1,2,5].includes(i)?custom:Number(row[i])+bonus):80+birthHash('sale-parent|'+catalogId+'|'+key)%41;
      max[key]=Math.round(points*.80);
      unique[key]=points-max[key];
    }
    return {baseMaximum:max,uniquePts:unique};
  }
  function inheritPointSets(sire,dam,famous=false,random=Math.random){
    const baseInitial={},baseMaximum={},uniquePts={};
    for(const key of pointKeys){
      const sBase=Number(sire?.baseMaximum?.[key])||0;
      const dBase=Number(dam?.baseMaximum?.[key])||0;
      const sUnique=Number(sire?.uniquePts?.[key])||0;
      const dUnique=Number(dam?.uniquePts?.[key])||0;
      // Parent effective breeding points: basic potential + innate points.
      const parentMean=((sBase+sUnique)+(dBase+dUnique))/2;
      const variation=Math.round((random()-.5)*38);
      // Ver.9: shift BOTH newborn base-Pt ranges down by exactly 10.
      // Calculate using the existing Ver.8 inheritance first; never alter saved horses.
      const priorMaximum=Math.min(180,Math.round(Math.max(famous?90:48,parentMean+variation)));
      baseMaximum[key]=priorMaximum-10;
      baseInitial[key]=Math.round(priorMaximum*.60)-10;
      // Both parents' innate points affect the newborn's unique Pt draw.
      uniquePts[key]=Math.max(0,Math.min(50,Math.round((sUnique+dUnique)*.35/2+random()*42)));
    }
    return {baseInitial,baseMaximum,uniquePts};
  }

  // Ver.91: the projected seven-ability total is 50% parental potential,
  // 40% actual mating compatibility and 10% bounded individual variation.
  // Used at birth only. Never recalculate or migrate saved horses.
  // A good mating helps; strong parents alone cannot guarantee exceptional foals.
  function balancedPointSets(sire,dam,match={},random=Math.random){
    const clamp=(n,low,high)=>Math.max(low,Math.min(high,n));
    const val=(parent,key,field)=>{
      const n=Number(parent?.[field]?.[key]);
      return Number.isFinite(n)?n:0;
    };
    const effective=(parent,key)=>val(parent,key,'baseMaximum')+val(parent,key,'uniquePts');
    const avg=parent=>pointKeys.reduce((sum,key)=>sum+effective(parent,key),0)/pointKeys.length;
    const sireMean=avg(sire),damMean=avg(dam);
    const out={baseInitial:{},baseMaximum:{},uniquePts:{}};
    const pedigreePart=70+(match.nick?16:0)+(match.thin?10:0)+
      (match.special?24:0)+(match.famous?14:0)+(match.honors?Math.min(10,match.honors*4):0)-
      (match.close?34:0);
    for(const key of pointKeys){
      const s=effective(sire,key),d=effective(dam,key);
      const parental=(s+d)*.5;
      // Trait-by-trait matching rewards shared strengths, but also checks whether
      // a parent's standout ability actually fits the other parent's profile.
      const aligned=clamp((s-sireMean)*(d-damMean)/65,-10,12);
      const dualStrength=clamp((Math.min(s,d)-95)*.19,0,8);
      const complementary=clamp((Math.max(s,d)-Math.min(s,d))/22,0,4);
      const matchScore=clamp(pedigreePart+aligned+dualStrength+complementary,28,160);
      const individualScore=20+random()*140; // 10% component: at most ~7 Pt either side
      const projected=Math.round(clamp(parental*.50+matchScore*.40+individualScore*.10,42,185));
      // The breeding draw is stored separately as unique Pt (100% at birth).
      // Basic Pt stays on its growth curve; combine only for racing snapshots.
      const innateParent=(val(sire,key,'uniquePts')+val(dam,key,'uniquePts'))*.5;
      const uniqueRaw=Math.round(clamp(innateParent*.65+8+(random()-.5)*10,0,50));
      const fullUnique=uniqueRaw;
      const finalBase=Math.round(clamp(projected-fullUnique,24,200));
      out.baseMaximum[key]=finalBase;
      out.baseInitial[key]=Math.round(clamp(finalBase*.68-7,16,finalBase));
      out.uniquePts[key]=uniqueRaw;
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Ver.10: one birth-time calculation for non-Pt racing traits. The farm
  // saves the result; the race engine reads that exact saved object.
  function inheritRaceTraits(sire,dam,aptitude,random=Math.random){
    const clamp=(n,min,max)=>Math.max(min,Math.min(max,n));
    const value=(p,key,fallback)=>Number.isFinite(Number(p?.[key]))?Number(p[key]):fallback;
    const draw=(key,low=35,high=100)=>Math.round(clamp(value(sire,key,80)*.40+value(dam,key,80)*.40+(55+random()*40)*.20+(random()-.5)*16,low,high));
    const surface=random()<.5?(sire?.surface||'芝'):(dam?.surface||'芝');
    const tactic=random()<.5?(sire?.tactic||'先行'):(dam?.tactic||'先行');
    const [lo,hi]=Array.isArray(aptitude)&&aptitude.length===2?aptitude:[600,3600];
    const sireDist=value(sire,'bestDistance',1800),damDist=value(dam,'bestDistance',1800);
    const desired=(sireDist+damDist)/2+(random()-.5)*560;
    const bestDistance=clamp(Math.round(desired/200)*200,lo,hi);
    const goingAptitude={};
    for(const key of ['良','稍重','重','不良']){
      const sGo=value(sire?.goingAptitude,key,100),dGo=value(dam?.goingAptitude,key,100);
      goingAptitude[key]=Math.round(clamp(sGo*.4+dGo*.4+(79+random()*29)*.2+(random()-.5)*10,72,114));
    }
    return {surface,tactic,bestDistance,goingAptitude,
      temperament:draw('temperament'),health:draw('health'),
      constitution:draw('constitution'),recovery:draw('recovery'),formStability:draw('formStability')};
  }
  function foalSalePrice(h){
    const basic=Number(h?.baseMaximum?.sp),unique=Number(h?.uniquePts?.sp);
    if(!Number.isFinite(basic)||!Number.isFinite(unique))return null;
    const amount=(Math.max(0,Math.floor(basic))+Math.max(0,Math.floor(unique)))*1000000;
    return Number.isSafeInteger(amount)?amount:null;
  }
  window.DFSharedRules=Object.freeze({growthFraction,lastActiveAge,pedigree5Gen,funnyHorseNames,breedingParentPoints,inheritPointSets,balancedPointSets,inheritRaceTraits,foalSalePrice});
})();

<script>
/* DF80: one pure effect engine for both active breeding entry points.
   Input is immutable pedigree match positions; callers retain their own
   parent-data, birth scheduling, health random draw and save format. */
window.DFBreedingEffects=Object.freeze({
 profile(crosses){
  const list=Array.isArray(crosses)?crosses:[];
  let intensity=0,valid=0,special34=false,strongest='',nearest=Infinity;
  for(const c of list){
   let contribution=0;
   const pairs=c.positions||c.patterns||[];
   for(const pair of pairs){
    const values=Array.isArray(pair)?pair:String(pair).split('×');
    const a=Number(values[0]),b=Number(values[1]);
    if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b)||a<2||b<2)continue;
    contribution+=(Math.pow(.5,a)+Math.pow(.5,b))*100;
    if((a===3&&b===4)||(a===4&&b===3))special34=true;
    if(a+b<nearest){nearest=a+b;strongest=`${a}×${b}`;}
   }
   if(contribution>0){valid++;intensity+=contribution;}
  }
  intensity=Math.min(100,intensity);
  const risk=intensity>=25?3:intensity>=18.75?2:intensity>=12.5?1:0;
  const tier=intensity>=25?'濃い':intensity>=18.75?'やや濃い':intensity>=12.5?'薄い':'ごく薄い';
  const bonus=valid?Math.min(5,Math.max(1,Math.round(intensity/7))):0;
  return {intensity,valid,tier,risk,bonus,special34,strongest,
    label:valid?`${tier}（血量目安${Number(intensity.toFixed(2))}%）`:'なし'};
 },
 // V85: individual ancestor traits. Registered horses use their original seven
 // game stats; pedigree-only ancestors use explicit historically-inspired profiles
 // where known, otherwise a stable name-based game profile (not a historical claim).
 // V86: homebred ancestor traits are frozen at conception from seven innate stats.
 homebredTraits(h){
  const keys=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
  const saved=h?.inbreedAncestorTraits;
  if(Array.isArray(saved)&&saved.length===2&&saved.every(k=>keys.includes(k))&&saved[0]!==saved[1])return [...saved];
  const scores=keys.map((k,i)=>({k,i,v:(Number(h?.baseMaximum?.[k])||0)+(Number(h?.uniquePts?.[k])||0)}));
  scores.sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v||a.i-b.i);
  return scores.slice(0,2).map(x=>x.k);
 },
 ancestorTraits(name){
  const canonical=String(name||'').replace(/\((USA|GB|IRE|CAN|FR|ARG|ITY|GER|AUS|JPN)\)/gi,'').replace(/^サラ\s*/,'').trim();
  const keys=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
  const known={
   'サンデーサイレンス':['sp','kick'],'ノーザンダンサー':['kick','sustain'],
   'ミスタープロスペクター':['sp','early'],'ロベルト':['sta','grit'],
   'トニービン':['sta','sustain'],'ヘイロー':['sp','kick'],
   'ダンジグ':['sp','early'],'ストームキャット':['sp','early'],
   'ネイティヴダンサー':['kick','early'],'ナスルーラ':['sp','kick'],
   'リボー':['sta','grit'],'ハイペリオン':['sta','sustain'],
   'セントサイモン':['sta','stability'],'バックパサー':['grit','stability'],
   'グレイソヴリン':['sp','sustain'],'ブライアンズタイム':['sta','grit'],
   'キングマンボ':['sp','kick'],'サドラーズウェルズ':['sta','sustain']
  };
  if(known[canonical])return known[canonical];
  const rows=window.DFInbreedAncestorStatRows||[];
  const row=rows.find(r=>r[0]===canonical||String(r[0]).replace(/\((USA|GB|IRE|CAN|FR|ARG|ITY|GER|AUS|JPN)\)/gi,'').trim()===canonical);
  if(row){
   const scores=keys.map((k,i)=>({k,v:Number(row[i+3])||0,i}));
   scores.sort((a,b)=>b.v-a.v||a.i-b.i);
   return scores.slice(0,2).map(x=>x.k);
  }
  // Every pedigree-only ancestor has a stable, individual in-game profile.
  let h=2166136261;
  for(const ch of canonical){h=Math.imul(h^ch.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;}
  const a=h%keys.length,b=(a+1+(Math.floor(h/7)%(keys.length-1)))%keys.length;
  return [keys[a],keys[b]];
 },
 ancestorEffects(crosses){
  const keys=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
  const totals=Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k=>[k,0]));
  const entries=[];
  for(const cross of Array.isArray(crosses)?crosses:[]){
   const name=String(cross?.ancestor||cross?.name||'').trim();
   if(!name)continue;
   const positions=cross.positions||cross.patterns||[];
   let strength=0;
   for(const p of positions){
    const v=Array.isArray(p)?p:String(p).split('×');
    const a=Number(v[0]),b=Number(v[1]);
    if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b)||a<2||b<2)continue;
    strength+=Math.pow(.5,a)+Math.pow(.5,b);
   }
   if(strength<=0)continue;
   const gain=Math.min(3,Math.max(1,Math.round(strength*8)));
   const traits=cross.custom?.customBred?this.homebredTraits(cross.custom):this.ancestorTraits(name);
   entries.push({ancestor:name,traits,gain});
   for(const k of traits)totals[k]=Math.min(6,totals[k]+gain);
  }
  return {entries,totals};
 },
 awardAncestorEffects(foal,crosses,keys){
  if(foal.__df85AncestorAwarded)return this.ancestorEffects(crosses);
  Object.defineProperty(foal,'__df85AncestorAwarded',{value:true,configurable:true});
  const result=this.ancestorEffects(crosses);
  for(const key of keys){
   const old=Number(foal.baseMaximum?.[key])||0;
   const delta=Math.max(0,Math.min(400-old,Number(result.totals[key])||0));
   foal.baseMaximum[key]=old+delta;
   foal.baseInitial[key]=Math.min(old+delta,(Number(foal.baseInitial?.[key])||0)+Math.round(delta*.6));
  }
  return result;
 },
 healthLoss(profile,random=Math.random){
  if(!profile?.valid)return 0;
  const r=profile.risk;
  const min=r===3?10:r===2?4:r===1?1:0,max=r===3?25:r===2?12:r===1?6:2;
  return min+Math.floor(Math.max(0,Math.min(.999999,Number(random())||0))*(max-min+1));
 },
 temperLoss(profile,random=Math.random){
  if(!profile?.valid||profile.risk===0)return 0;
  const max=profile.risk===3?12:profile.risk===2?6:3;
  return Math.floor(Math.max(0,Math.min(.999999,Number(random())||0))*(max+1));
 },
 nickGain(details){const n=Math.min(4,Math.max(0,Number(details?.count)||0));return n?1+2*n:0;},
 awardNick(foal,details,keys){
  if(foal.__dfBreedNickAwarded)return 0;
  Object.defineProperty(foal,'__dfBreedNickAwarded',{value:true,configurable:true});
  const gain=this.nickGain(details);
  if(gain)for(const key of keys)foal.uniquePts[key]=(Number(foal.uniquePts[key])||0)+gain;
  return gain;
 },
 awardInbreed(foal,profile,keys){
  if(foal.__dfBreedInbreedAwarded)return;
  Object.defineProperty(foal,'__dfBreedInbreedAwarded',{value:true,configurable:true});
  if(!profile?.valid)return;
  for(const key of keys){
   const old=Number(foal.baseMaximum?.[key])||0;
   const delta=Math.max(0,Math.min(400-old,profile.bonus));
   foal.baseMaximum[key]=old+delta;
   foal.baseInitial[key]=Math.min(old+delta,(Number(foal.baseInitial?.[key])||0)+Math.round(delta*.6));
  }
 }
});

/* Ver.82: Registered-horse nicks are available BEFORE the farm iframe loads.
   Uses the same 221-pedigree source and same canonical lineage tables as the farm. */
(function(){
 const GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN=window.DFSharedRules.pedigree5Gen;
 function breedCanonical(s){return String(s||'').replace(/\((USA|GB|IRE|CAN|FR|ARG|ITY|GER|AUS|JPN)\)/gi,'').replace(/^サラ\s*/,'').trim()}
 function saleLineageKey(name){return breedCanonical(name).toLocaleLowerCase('en-US').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
 function pedigreeRows(name){
  const saved=GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN[name]||GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN[breedCanonical(name)];
  if(!Array.isArray(saved)||saved.length!==62)return null;
  const rows=[];let offset=0;
  for(let g=1;g<=5;g++){const n=1<<g;rows.push(saved.slice(offset,offset+n));offset+=n;}
  return rows;
 }
 const SALE_221_FATHER_LINKS=(()=>{
  const found=new Map(),ambiguous=new Set();
  for(const [name,ped] of Object.entries(GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN)){
   if(!Array.isArray(ped)||ped.length!==62)continue;
   const paternal=[name,ped[0],ped[2],ped[6],ped[14],ped[30]];
   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const child=saleLineageKey(paternal[i]),parent=saleLineageKey(paternal[i+1]);
    if(!child||!parent||child===parent)continue;
    if(found.has(child)&&saleLineageKey(found.get(child))!==parent)ambiguous.add(child);
    else if(!found.has(child))found.set(child,paternal[i+1]);
   }
  }
  for(const name of ambiguous)found.delete(name);
  return found;
 })();
const SALE_LINEAGE_ANCESTORS=[
 ['サンデーサイレンス','サンデーサイレンス'],['Roberto','ロベルト'],
 ['Mr. Prospector','ミスタープロスペクター'],['Northern Dancer','ノーザンダンサー'],
 ['Grey Sovereign','グレイソヴリン'],['Blushing Groom','ブラッシンググルーム'],
 ['Never Bend','ネヴァーベンド'],['パーソロン','パーソロン'],

 ['Hail to Reason','ヘイルトゥリーズン'],['Turn-to','ターントゥー'],

 ['Hyperion','ハイペリオン'],['Ribot','リボー'],
 ['In Reality','インリアリティ'],['Royal Charger','ロイヤルチャージャー'],
 ['Nearco','ネアルコ']

function df53LineageAlias(family){
 const f=String(family||'');
 if(!f||f==='系統未確認')return '系統未確認';
 const root=f.replace(/系$/,'');
 // 系統名だけを元の名前から必ず1文字置換する。馬名や系統判定は変更しない。
 const chars=Array.from(root);
 const kana={'ス':'ズ','ト':'ド','タ':'ダ','カ':'ガ','サ':'ザ','シ':'ジ','テ':'デ','ハ':'バ','ヒ':'ビ','フ':'ブ','ヘ':'ベ','ホ':'ボ','ク':'グ','チ':'ヂ','ツ':'ヅ','キ':'ギ','コ':'ゴ','セ':'ゼ','ソ':'ゾ','ナ':'ニ','ニ':'ヌ','ヌ':'ネ','ネ':'ノ','ノ':'ナ','ラ':'リ','リ':'ル','ル':'レ','レ':'ロ','ロ':'ラ','ン':'ム','ム':'ン','ー':'ッ'};
 let i=chars.length-1;
 while(i>=0&&!/[ァ-ヶA-Za-z]/.test(chars[i]))i--;
 if(i<0)return root+'系';
 const c=chars[i];
 chars[i]=kana[c]||(/[A-Za-z]/.test(c)?(c==='a'?'b':c==='A'?'B':'a'):'ア');
 return chars.join('')+'系';
}
const DF75_NICKS_FAMILY_PAIRS=[
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ミスタープロスペクター系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ノーザンダンサー系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ロベルト系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','グレイソヴリン系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ダンジグ系'],
 ['サンデーサイレンス系','ストームキャット系'],
 ['ミスタープロスペクター系','ロベルト系'],
 ['ミスタープロスペクター系','ノーザンダンサー系']
];

 const cache=new Map();
 function salePaternalFamily(real){
  const key=saleLineageKey(real);
  if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);
  const rows=pedigreeRows(real);
  const chain=[real,...(rows||[]).map(row=>row[0]).filter(Boolean)];
  const seen=new Set(chain.map(saleLineageKey));
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
   const last=chain[chain.length-1],father=SALE_221_FATHER_LINKS.get(saleLineageKey(last));
   if(!father||seen.has(saleLineageKey(father)))break;
   chain.push(father);seen.add(saleLineageKey(father));
  }
  const keys=new Set(chain.map(saleLineageKey));
  let family='';
  for(const [ancestor,label] of SALE_LINEAGE_ANCESTORS){
   if(keys.has(saleLineageKey(ancestor))){family=label+'系';break;}
  }
  if(!family&&chain.length>1)family=breedCanonical(chain[Math.min(3,chain.length-1)])+'系';
  const result={family:df53LineageAlias(family),verified:!!family};
  cache.set(key,result);return result;
 }
 window.DF75NicksDetails=function(sireReal,mareReal){
  const sire=salePaternalFamily(sireReal),rows=pedigreeRows(mareReal);
  if(!rows) return {count:0,hits:[],label:'未判定（血統データなし）',bonus:0,uniqueGain:0,unverified:true};
  const names=[rows[0]?.[0],rows[1]?.[1],rows[2]?.[3],rows[3]?.[7]],hits=[];
  if(!sire.verified)return {count:0,hits:[],label:'なし',bonus:0,uniqueGain:0};
  for(let i=0;i<names.length;i++){
   if(!names[i])continue;
   const dam=salePaternalFamily(names[i]);
   if(!dam.verified||dam.family===sire.family)continue;
   const matched=DF75_NICKS_FAMILY_PAIRS.some(([a,b])=>{
    const x=df53LineageAlias(a),y=df53LineageAlias(b);
    return (sire.family===x&&dam.family===y)||(sire.family===y&&dam.family===x);
   });
   if(matched)hits.push({generation:i+1,sireFamily:sire.family,maternalFamily:dam.family});
  }
  const count=hits.length;
  const label=count>=4?'フォースニックス':count===3?'トリプルニックス':count===2?'ダブルニックス':count===1?(hits[0].generation===1?'シングルニックス':hits[0].generation+'次ニックス'):'なし';
  return {count,hits,label,bonus:count?Math.min(4,count):0,uniqueGain:window.DFBreedingEffects.nickGain({count})};
 };
})();

function createGoingAptitude(name){
 const hash=horseGoingHash(name),favorite=hash%GOING_TYPES.length;
 // Ratings 68..111: >100 means relatively good going, <90 relatively poor.
 // Nearby conditions are more similar, but all four grades are calculated separately.

function ageGrowthFactor(type,age){
 const curve=GROWTH_BY_AGE[type]||GROWTH_BY_AGE['普通'];
 return curve[Math.max(0,Math.min(curve.length-1,age-2))];
}

 const m=BREEDING_MASTER_BY_ORIGINAL.get(originalName);
 if(!m||m['ゲーム用馬名']!==GAME_NAMES_BY_ORIGINAL[originalName]||
    Number(m['速度'])!==sp||Number(m['スタミナ'])!==sta||Number(m['瞬発力'])!==kick||
    Number(m['先行力'])!==early||Number(m['持続力'])!==sustain||Number(m['勝負根性'])!==grit||
    Number(m['安定性'])!==stability||m['脚質']!==tactic||m['性別']!==sex||m['馬場']!==surface)
  throw new Error('マスターVer.2の基本能力が一致しません: '+originalName);
 const aptMin=Math.max(600,DISTANCE_RESULTS[originalName][0]-200);
 const aptMax=DISTANCE_RESULTS[originalName][1]+200;
 if(aptMin!==Number(m['ゲーム適性下限m'])||aptMax!==Number(m['ゲーム適性上限m']))
  throw new Error('マスターVer.2の距離適性が一致しません: '+originalName);
  // Ver.92: only three SS + the original 32 S ranking entries gain Pt.
  // Keep master verification and the historical source rows unchanged.
  const v92Stats=[sp,sta,kick,early,sustain,grit,stability];
  if(m['総合ランク']==='SS')for(const pos of [0,1,2,5])v92Stats[pos]=130;
  else if(m['総合ランク']==='S'){
    const top=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].sort((a,b)=>v92Stats[b]-v92Stats[a]||a-b).slice(0,2);
    for(const pos of top)v92Stats[pos]+=5;
  }
  const goingAptitude=createGoingAptitude(originalName);
  m['馬場適性']={...goingAptitude}; // independent hidden game parameter for each state
  m['得意馬場']=GOING_TYPES.reduce((a,b)=>goingAptitude[b]>goingAptitude[a]?b:a);
  m['不得意馬場']=GOING_TYPES.reduce((a,b)=>goingAptitude[b]<goingAptitude[a]?b:a);
  const growth=DF_V13_REGISTRY_GROWTH[originalName]||'普通';
  m['成長']=growth; // available to the embedded breeding master without making it visible
  const verifiedAges=HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V15[originalName]||HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V14[originalName]||HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V19[originalName];
  const startAge=verifiedAges?verifiedAges[0]:2+([...originalName].reduce((sum,ch)=>sum+ch.charCodeAt(0),index)%4);
  return {
   name:m['ゲーム用馬名'],originalName,sex,tactic,sp:v92Stats[0],sta:v92Stats[1],kick:v92Stats[2],early:v92Stats[3],sustain:v92Stats[4],grit:v92Stats[5],stability:v92Stats[6],bestDistance,surface,growth,startAge,goingAptitude,
  coreMin:DISTANCE_RESULTS[originalName][0],coreMax:DISTANCE_RESULTS[originalName][1],aptMin,aptMax,
  coatType:m['毛色'],
  g1Wins:Number(m['G1勝利数']),g1WinsStatus:m['G1勝利数_確度'],
  g1AverageTimeGap:m['G1勝利時平均タイム差_秒']===''?null:Number(m['G1勝利時平均タイム差_秒']),

  g1MarginStatus:m['平均着差_確度'],g1MarginType:m['育成用着差の種類'],

  overallScore:Number(m['総合点_ゲーム評価']),overallRank:m['総合ランク'],
  masterV2:m
 };
});

  if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
  if(!DF116_FOUR_BOOSTED_ORIGINALS.has(h.originalName))return true;
  return h.originalName==='マイネルラヴ'
    ? (card?.grade==='GⅠ'||card?.grade==='GⅡ'||card?.grade==='GⅢ')
    : card?.grade==='GⅠ';
}

const SPECIAL_SKILL_REWARDS=Object.freeze({
 'アーモンドアイ':Object.freeze({key:'kick',label:'瞬発力'}),
 'イクイノックス':Object.freeze({key:'sta',label:'スタミナ'}),
 'ディープインパクト':Object.freeze({key:'sp',label:'スピード'})
});
const freshSkillRewards=()=>({sp:0,sta:0,kick:0});
function normalizeSkillRewards(h){
 const b=h.eliteSkillBonuses||{};
 h.eliteSkillBonuses=Object.fromEntries(['sp','sta','kick'].map(k=>{
  const n=Number(b[k]);return [k,Number.isFinite(n)?Math.max(0,n):0];
 }));
 return h.eliteSkillBonuses;
}
function skillRewardValue(h,key){
  // Ver.106: all bonus points are added to uniquePts at award time; no extra race-time addition.
  if(h.owner&&h.uniquePts)return 0;
  if(!h.owner||!['sp','sta','kick'].includes(key))return 0;
  const n=Number(h.eliteSkillBonuses?.[key]);return Number.isFinite(n)?Math.max(0,n):0;
 }
 function skillAdjustedStat(h,key){return h[key]+skillRewardValue(h,key);}

function isSpecial125(h){return !!h&&!h.owner&&SPECIAL_125_ORIGINALS.has(h.originalName);}
function originalPointBasis(h){
 return h.sp*.27+h.sta*.13+h.kick*.23+h.early*.07+h.sustain*.16+h.grit*.10+h.stability*.04;
}
function rivalPointRating(h){
 const points=90+(originalPointBasis(h)-90)*2.1+Math.min(9,(h.g1Wins||0)*1.4)+({SS:3,S:1,A:0,B:-1}[h.overallRank]??0);
 return Math.round(Math.max(80,points));
}
function racePointRating(h){
 if(h.owner)return Number.isFinite(h.abilityPoints)?h.abilityPoints:90;
 // Lower classes are intentionally weaker game fields; graded races use each historical rating.
 return h.gameClassAdjusted&&Number.isFinite(h.abilityPoints)?h.abilityPoints:rivalPointRating(h);
}
function raceStabilityFactor(h){const min=Number.isFinite(h.stability)?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(h.stability))):100;return (min+Math.floor(Math.random()*(101-min)))/100;}
function powerMultiplier(h){return h.owner&&h.uniquePts?1:racePointRating(h)/Math.max(35,originalPointBasis(h));}
// Fixed 125-point champions always realise their full intrinsic ability, regardless of fatigue,

// Birth-fixed luck (1–99): weaker overall abilities tend to yield higher luck.
// Race movement / outcome code intentionally does NOT use this new parameter.
const HORSE_LUCK_STATS=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
function calculateHorseLuck(ability,variation=0){
 const values=HORSE_LUCK_STATS.map(k=>Number(ability?.[k])).filter(Number.isFinite);
 const average=values.length?values.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/values.length:85;
 return Math.max(1,Math.min(99,Math.round(100-(average-50)*1.12+variation)));
}
function horseLuckVariation(identifier){
 let hash=2166136261;
 for(const c of String(identifier||'')){hash=Math.imul(hash^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;}
 return (hash%1801)/100-9;
}
for(const horse of HORSE_DB){
 horse.luck=calculateHorseLuck(horse,horseLuckVariation(horse.originalName||horse.name));
}

function courseFromRace(card){
 const v=VENUES_V78[card.venue],straightOnly=card.layout==='直線',outer=card.layout==='外';
 const lap=card.surface==='ダート'?v.dirtLap:outer?(v.outerLap||v.lap):v.lap;
 const straight=card.surface==='ダート'?v.dirtStraight:outer?(v.outerStraight||v.straight):v.straight;
 return {venue:card.venue,direction:v.direction,layout:card.layout,surface:card.surface,
  straightOnly,lap,straight,gradient:card.surface==='ダート'?v.dirtSlope:outer?(v.outerSlope||v.slope):v.slope,
  turnFactor:v.trackFactor,turnSign:v.direction==='左'?-1:1,
  // One visual metre is scaled down, but the actual course ratios are retained.
  R:(lap-2*straight)*LENGTH/(2*Math.PI),S:straight*LENGTH};
}
// Ver.16: grade gates apply only to the 221 registered rivals, never to an owner's horse.
function df16RegistryRankAllowed(h,card){
  if(!h||h.owner)return true;
  if(!df116BoostGradeAllowed(h,card))return false;
  // The sole G3/G2 exception is not denied by the former G3 A-only ranking gate.
  if(h.originalName==='マイネルラヴ'&&DF116_FOUR_BOOSTED_ORIGINALS.has(h.originalName))return true;
  const rank=h.overallRank;
 if(card.classType!=='graded')return rank==='A'||rank==='B';
 if(card.grade==='GⅢ')return rank==='A';
 if(card.grade==='GⅡ')return rank==='A'||rank==='S';
 if(card.grade==='GⅠ')return rank==='S'||rank==='SS';
 return false;
}
function ageForRace(h,card){return calendarHorseAge(h);}
function raceEligible(h,card){return calendarRaceEligible(h,card);}
function ageWeightAllowance(age,distance,month){
 if(age>=5)return 0;
 if(age===4)return month<=3?1:0;
 const band=distance<1400?0:distance<=1600?1:distance<2200?2:3;
 const table=[[7,6,5,4,4,3,3,2,2,1,1,1],[8,7,6,5,4,4,3,3,2,2,1,1],
              [9,8,7,6,5,4,4,3,3,2,2,1],[10,9,8,7,6,5,4,4,3,3,2,2]];
 return table[band][month-1];
}
// Prize-weight rule: grade II +1kg per 300 million yen, grade III +1kg
// per 200 million yen, open races +1kg per 100 million yen. No bonus cap.
// G1 is fixed by age/sex: prize money never affects G1 weight.
function dfWeightLifetimePrize(h){
 const finitePrize=value=>Number.isFinite(Number(value))?Math.max(0,Number(value)):0;
 const owned=h.owner&&stableState?.horses?.find(own=>own.id===h.ownId||own.name===h.name);
 const career=calendarCareers.get(h.name);
 return Math.max(finitePrize(h.prize),finitePrize(h.earnedPrize),
  finitePrize(owned?.prize),finitePrize(career?.prize));
}
function weightForRace(h,card,age){
 const female=h.sex==='牝';
 const ageWeight=age===2?(female?54:55):(female?55:57);
 const base=58-(female?2:0)-ageWeightAllowance(age,card.distance,card.month);
 const grade=String(card.grade||'');
 if(['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(grade)){
  return card.weightRule==='馬齢'?ageWeight:clamp(base,49,60);
 }
 const yenPerKg=({'GⅡ':300000000,'GII':300000000,'G2':300000000,
  'GⅢ':200000000,'GIII':200000000,'G3':200000000,
  'OP':100000000})[grade];
 if(yenPerKg){
  const baseKg=card.weightRule==='馬齢'?ageWeight:
    grade==='OP'?clamp(base,49,60):Math.max(49,base-1);
  return baseKg+Math.floor(dfWeightLifetimePrize(h)/yenPerKg);
 }
 // Keep non-G1/G2/G3/OP race classes unchanged.
 if(card.weightRule==='馬齢')return ageWeight;
 if(card.weightRule==='定量')return clamp(base,49,60);
 if(card.weightRule==='別定')return clamp(base-1+Math.min(2,Math.max(0,h.g1Wins||0)),49,61);
 const strength=(h.sp*.33+h.sta*.18+h.kick*.23+h.sustain*.16+h.grit*.10);
 return Math.round(clamp(base-2.0+(strength-90)*.27+Math.min(1.7,(h.g1Wins||0)*.23),48,62)*2)/2;
}
function assignRaceRiders(chosen,card){
 const ordered=[...chosen].sort((a,b)=>racePaperRating(b)-racePaperRating(a));
 const used=new Set();
 for(const horse of ordered){
  const history=(DOCUMENTED_RIDES_V78[horse.originalName]||[]).filter(n=>RIDERS_BY_NAME.has(n));
  let rider=history.find(n=>!used.has(n)),historical=!!rider;
  if(!rider){
   const options=JOCKEYS_V78.filter(j=>!used.has(j.name));
   if(!options.length)throw new Error('rider shortage');
   // Ver.34: unpaired jockeys are freshly drawn for each new race, not fixed by horse/race hash.
   rider=options[Math.floor(Math.random()*options.length)].name;
  }
  used.add(rider);horse.jockey=rider;horse.jockeyHistory=historical;
  horse.jockeySkills=RIDERS_BY_NAME.get(rider);
 }
 if(used.size!==chosen.length)throw new Error('rider conflict');
}
function jockeyRaceBoost(h,p){
 const j=h.jockeySkills;if(!j)return 0;
 const ability=(j.overall-1)*.9;
 const start=(j.start-1)*.75*(p<.20?1:0);
 const conserve=(j.pace-1)*.65*(p>.30&&p<.83?1:0);
 const position=(j.position-1)*.85*(p<.75?1:.3);
 const finish=(j.finish-1)*.95*clamp((p-.66)/.34,0,1);
 return ability+start+conserve+position+finish;
}
// Derby Fantasy: maintain a minimum field of five without changing master horse entries.
// Each extra runner is an age-appropriate race-only instance of one unused
// registered horse. No duplicate originalName may start the same race.
function completeFiveHorseField(card, selected, usedOriginals){
 const minimum=Math.min(5,fieldSizeLimit(card));
 if(selected.length>=minimum)return;
 const age=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:3;
 const conditionHistory={new:[0,0],maiden:[0,1],class1:[1,2],class2:[2,4],class3:[3,5],open:[4,6]};
 const [wins,starts]=conditionHistory[card.classType]||[1,3];
 // Prefer aptitude-perfect entries, then horses still within the normal
 // distance allowance; never override sex, real final start age, or history.
 const templates=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>
   !usedOriginals.has(h.originalName) && !isSpecial125(h) && df116BoostGradeAllowed(h,card) &&
   (!card.female||h.sex==='牝') && age<=gameHorseLastStartAge(h) &&
   (!VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name] || h.sex!=='牝' ||
     VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name].includes(h.originalName)) &&
   entryDistanceEligible(h,card)
 )).sort((a,b)=>Number(entryDistancePerfect(b,card))-Number(entryDistancePerfect(a,card)));
 for(const template of templates){
  if(selected.length>=minimum)break;
  if(usedOriginals.has(template.originalName))continue;
  const name=template.name+'・'+calendarYear+'年目補充';
  const h={...template,name,birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-age,startAge:age};
  // A game-only career appropriate to the selected class. Stored by the
  // generated entrant's unique ID, never against the template horse.
  const prior=calendarCareers.get(name);
  if(!prior)calendarCareers.set(name,{wins,starts});
  const eligible=calendarRaceEligible(h,card);
  if(!prior)calendarCareers.delete(name);
  if(!eligible)continue;
  HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,h);
  // Preserve the newly admitted entrant's class until the race ends.
  if(!prior)calendarCareers.set(name,{wins,starts});
  selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(template.originalName);
 }
}
// Fictional non-graded COM entrants. The 224 historical master records are NOT used.
// They exist only as temporary race entrants, never as new registered/breeding stock.
const DF131_NON_GRADED=new Set(['new','maiden','class1','class2','class3','open']);
const DF131_COM_BANDS=Object.freeze({new:[60,75],maiden:[65,80],class1:[72,85],class2:[78,90],class3:[82,96],open:[88,102]});
const DF131_COM_PREFIX=['アオノ','ハルノ','ユキノ','ミナト','アサヒ','ホシノ','ツキノ','カゼノ','ヒカリ','ソラノ','シロイ','アカネ','ミドリ','トキノ','キリノ','ナギサ','カナデ','サクラ','アマネ','コハル','ルリノ','ナナイロ','クモノ','ヒバリ','イロハ','シズク','キララ','ユウヒ','カスミ','モモノ'];
const DF131_COM_SUFFIX=['カゼ','ツバサ','キセキ','ホシ','ミライ','ナミ','ユメ','タクト','リズム','ヒカル','アーチ','オト','ハヤテ','ココロ','ソング','ヒビキ','オーロラ','コダマ','ランナー','シルク','ビート','リーフ','ミスト','フレア','ステラ','スプリント','パルス','ブリーズ','ワルツ','フライト'];
function df131NonGraded(card){return !!card&&DF131_NON_GRADED.has(card.classType);}
function df131ComAge(card){return card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:Math.random()<.45?3:4+Math.floor(Math.random()*4);}
function df131FictionalField(card,count){
 const owner=selectedOwnedHorseFor(card);
 const total=Math.min(fieldSizeLimit(card),Math.max(10,Number(count)||10));
 const rivals=total-(owner?1:0);
 const [lo,hi]=DF131_COM_BANDS[card.classType];
 const names=new Set((owner?[owner]:[]).map(h=>h.name));
 const entrants=[];
 const usedDisplays=new Set((owner?[owner]:[]).map(h=>h.name));
 const safeInt=(a,b)=>a+Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1));
 const stats=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
 const winHistory={new:[0,0],maiden:[0,2],class1:[1,3],class2:[2,6],class3:[3,9],open:[4,12]};
 const coatTypes=['鹿毛','栗毛','黒鹿毛','青鹿毛','芦毛','青毛','栃栗毛'];
 const tactics=['逃げ','先行','差し','追込'];
 for(let i=0;i<rivals;i++){
  let displayName='';
  for(let retry=0;retry<200;retry++){
   const candidate=DF131_COM_PREFIX[safeInt(0,DF131_COM_PREFIX.length-1)]+DF131_COM_SUFFIX[safeInt(0,DF131_COM_SUFFIX.length-1)];
   if(!usedDisplays.has(candidate)&&!HORSE_BY_NAME.has(candidate)&&!stableState.horses.some(h=>h.name===candidate)){
    displayName=candidate;break;
   }
  }
  if(!displayName)displayName='アオノホシ'+String(i+1); // unique fall-back
  usedDisplays.add(displayName);
  // Distinct invisible key prevents shared careers/forms across repeated drawings.
  let token;
  do{token=Math.floor(Math.random()*0x100000000).toString(36)+Math.floor(Math.random()*0x100000000).toString(36);}while(names.has(displayName+'・架空COM'+token));
  const name=displayName+'・架空COM'+token;
  names.add(name);
  const age=df131ComAge(card),kind=safeInt(0,4);
  const numbers={};
  const midpoint=safeInt(lo,hi);
  for(const stat of stats){numbers[stat]=Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,midpoint+safeInt(-6,6)));}
  // Distinct specialties, balanced in the same overall class band.
  const bonus={0:['sp','early'],1:['sta','sustain'],2:['kick','grit'],3:['early','sustain'],4:['stability','grit']}[kind];
  for(const key of bonus)numbers[key]=Math.min(hi,numbers[key]+safeInt(2,5));
  const sex=card.female?'牝':Math.random()<.43?'牝':'牡';
  const bestDistance=Math.max(1000,Math.min(3200,card.distance+safeInt(-2,2)*200));
  const aptMin=Math.max(600,Math.min(card.distance,bestDistance)-safeInt(300,600));
  const aptMax=Math.max(card.distance,bestDistance)+safeInt(300,600);
  const horse={name,displayName,originalName:'__DF131_COM__'+token,df131FictionalCom:true,
   owner:false,sex,tactic:tactics[safeInt(0,tactics.length-1)],...numbers,
   growth:['早熟','普通','晩成','持続'][safeInt(0,3)],
   surface:card.surface||'芝',bestDistance,aptMin,aptMax,coreMin:aptMin+200,coreMax:aptMax-200,
   goingAptitude:createGoingAptitude(name),coatType:coatTypes[safeInt(0,coatTypes.length-1)],
   startAge:age,birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-age,
   temperament:safeInt(72,96),health:safeInt(75,100),
   g1Wins:0,g1WinsStatus:'架空COM',g1AverageMarginMeasured:null,g1AverageMarginForGame:0,
   overallRank:'B',overallScore:midpoint,abilityPoints:Math.round(stats.reduce((n,k)=>n+numbers[k],0)/7),gameClassAdjusted:true};
  // Keep existing career/condition and result routines working; no roster changes.
  HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,horse);
  calendarCareers.set(name,{wins:winHistory[card.classType][0],starts:winHistory[card.classType][1]});
  entrants.push(horse);
 }
 if(owner)entrants.push(owner);
 return shuffled(entrants);
}
// Graded-race gate guarantee. Existing historic/priority entrants are selected FIRST.
// Temporary supplemental COM runners are race-only; master horse records,
// historic winners, breeding data and race calculations are not changed.
function dfGateGradedMinimum(card){
 if(card?.grade==='GⅠ'||card?.grade==='GⅡ')return fieldSizeLimit(card);
 if(card?.grade==='GⅢ')return Math.min(10,fieldSizeLimit(card));
 return 0;
}
function dfGateFillGraded(card,selected,usedOriginals){
 const target=dfGateGradedMinimum(card);
 if(!target||selected.length>=target)return;
 const age=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:3;
 // First try unique real registered horses at the correct age, sex, rank and distance.
 const originals=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)&&
   !isSpecial125(h)&&df116BoostGradeAllowed(h,card)&&
   (!card.female||h.sex==='牝')&&
   (card.ages!=='2'||age===2)&&
   !(h.sex==='牝'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES,card.name)&&
     !VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name].includes(h.originalName))&&
   entryDistanceEligible(h,card)));
 for(const template of originals){
  if(selected.length>=target)break;
  const name=template.name+'・'+calendarYear+'年目補充';
  const horse={...template,name,birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-age,startAge:age};
  // Use existing eligibility, including graded-rank and historical-sex restrictions.
  if(!calendarRaceEligible(horse,card))continue;
  selected.push(horse);usedOriginals.add(template.originalName);
  HORSE_BY_NAME.set(horse.name,horse);
 }
 if(selected.length>=target)return;
 // Not enough historical entries: use distinct game-only COM horses, never a duplicate
 // of a registered original in the SAME field. They inherit suitable grade-level
 // attributes but do not become registered horses or breeding stock.
 const tiers=card.grade==='GⅠ'?['S','A']:card.grade==='GⅡ'?['A','S']:['A','B'];
 const templates=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>!isSpecial125(h)&&
  !DF116_FOUR_BOOSTED_ORIGINALS.has(h.originalName)&&
  (!card.female||h.sex==='牝')&&
  (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES,card.name)||h.sex!=='牝')&&
  entryDistanceEligible(h,card))).sort((a,b)=>tiers.indexOf(a.overallRank)-tiers.indexOf(b.overallRank));
 // A shortage in the data for one exact trip must not leave GⅠ/GⅡ gates empty.
 const fallback=templates.length?templates:shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>
  !isSpecial125(h)&&!DF116_FOUR_BOOSTED_ORIGINALS.has(h.originalName)&&
  (!card.female||h.sex==='牝')&&
  (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES,card.name)||h.sex!=='牝')));
 if(!fallback.length)throw Error('重賞COMの補充元がありません');
 let i=0;
 while(selected.length<target){
  const t=fallback[i%fallback.length],serial=i+1;i++;
  const displayName=DF131_COM_PREFIX[(serial*7)%DF131_COM_PREFIX.length]+DF131_COM_SUFFIX[(serial*11)%DF131_COM_SUFFIX.length]+serial;
  const token=Date.now().toString(36)+Math.floor(Math.random()*1e9).toString(36)+serial.toString(36);
  const horse={...t,
   name:displayName+'・架空COM'+token,displayName,
   originalName:'__DF_GRADED_COM__'+token,df131FictionalCom:true,owner:false,
   startAge:age,birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-age,
   aptMin:Math.min(t.aptMin,card.distance),aptMax:Math.max(t.aptMax,card.distance),
   overallRank:card.grade==='GⅠ'?'S':'A',abilityPoints:Math.round(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.reduce((sum,k)=>sum+Number(t[k]||0),0)/HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.length),
   gameClassAdjusted:true,g1Wins:0
  };
  HORSE_BY_NAME.set(horse.name,horse);
  calendarCareers.set(horse.name,{wins:1,starts:2});
  selected.push(horse);
 }
}
function fieldForRace(card,count){
 if(df131NonGraded(card))return df131FictionalField(card,count);
 const owner=selectedOwnedHorseFor(card);
 const rivalSlots=owner?Math.max(0,count-1):count;
 // Reserve the historical Classic winner(s) before random draws; they can lose
 // via the original untouched race engine. Never create duplicate runners.
  const forceCandidate=df16ForcedEliteFor(card);
 const forcedElite=forceCandidate&&df145MonthlyAllowed(forceCandidate,card)&&df145AnnualEntryAllowed(forceCandidate,card)&&entryDistanceEligible(forceCandidate,card)?forceCandidate:null;
  const forcedTriples=df17ForcedTripleFor(card).filter(h=>df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card)&&df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card)&&entryDistanceEligible(h,card));
  const featured=shuffled(classicEntriesFor(card).filter(h=>!isSpecial125(h)&&df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card)&&df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card)&&df16RegistryRankAllowed(h,card)&&entryDistanceEligible(h,card)));
  const classic100=df100Classic(card);
  const selected=df202GuaranteedStarters(card).slice(0,rivalSlots);
  for(const h of df145GuaranteedOsakaStarters(card)){
   if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
   if(!selected.some(x=>x.originalName===h.originalName))selected.push(h);
  }
  if(!classic100&&forcedElite&&selected.length<rivalSlots&&!selected.some(h=>h.originalName===forcedElite.originalName))selected.push(forcedElite);
  const usedOriginals=new Set(selected.map(h=>h.originalName));
  if(classic100){
   // Previously locked horses of both sexes take precedence over new draws.
   for(const h of df100LockedFor(card)){
    if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
    if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
   }
   df100ClassicInitial(card,selected,usedOriginals,rivalSlots);
  } else {
   for(const h of df100LockedFor(card)){
    if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
    if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
   }
  }
 if(!classic100){
  for(const h of forcedTriples){
   if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
   if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
  }
  for(const h of featured){
   if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
   if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
  }
 // Priority-qualified starters are admitted before non-priority draws.
 const rights=shuffled(calendarPool().filter(h=>!h.owner&&!isSpecial125(h)&&raceEligible(h,card)&&earnedPriorityFor(h,card)))
  .sort((a,b)=>Number(entryDistancePerfect(b,card))-Number(entryDistancePerfect(a,card)));
 for(const h of rights){
  if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
  if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
 }
 // Ver.17: S winners first, then A winners only when needed to reach five.
 if(!classic100)df17EnsureFiveG1Winners(card,selected,usedOriginals,rivalSlots);
 const candidates=shuffled(calendarPool().filter(h=>!h.owner&&!isSpecial125(h)&&raceEligible(h,card)&&!selected.includes(h)&&!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)));
 const fit=shuffled(candidates.filter(h=>entryDistanceEligible(h,card)));
 while(selected.length<rivalSlots&&fit.length){
  const h=fit.pop();if(!selected.includes(h)&&!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
 }
 // Some G1 cards (e.g. the 2yo fillies' G1 or the 3200m spring G1)
 // lack enough age-qualified horses in the game's ordinary rolling cohort.
 // Fill remaining gates only with templates already among the 221 registered horses,
 // generating a G1-local instance of the correct age, sex and distance eligibility.
 // This is a field entry instance: it does not alter the registered horse data.
 if(selected.length<rivalSlots){
  const age=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:3;
  const supplement=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)&&!isSpecial125(h)&&(!card.female||h.sex==='牝'))
   .map(h=>({...h,name:h.name+'・'+calendarYear+'年目GⅠ',birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-age,startAge:age}))
   .filter(h=>calendarRaceEligible(h,card)));
  for(const h of supplement){
   if(selected.length>=rivalSlots)break;
   if(!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);}
  }
 }
 }
 // G1 final quota: A substitutes first, then distance-relaxed A (and B for non-Classics).
 df100FinishG1(card,selected,usedOriginals,rivalSlots);
 if(owner){
  const existing=selected.findIndex(h=>h.name===owner.name);
  if(existing<0){
   if(selected.length>=count){
    const quota=card.grade==='GⅠ'?Math.min(5,count):0;
    const protectedWinners=df17WinnerCount(selected)<=quota;
    const removeAt=selected.findLastIndex(h=>!df202IsControlledOriginal(h)&&!isSpecial125(h)&&
      !forcedTriples.some(locked=>locked.originalName===h.originalName)&&!df145GuaranteedTarget(h,card)&&!df100IsProtected(h,card)&&
      (!protectedWinners||!df17IsHistoricG1Winner(h))&&
      !h.classicTitles?.includes(card.name)&&!earnedPriorityFor(h,card));
    if(removeAt>=0)selected.splice(removeAt,1);
   }
   if(selected.length<count)selected.push(owner);
  }
 }
  // Final calendar-only guard: every historical/priority route is covered.
  // Keep the owner's existing entry and two-start allowance unchanged.
  for(let i=selected.length-1;i>=0;i--){
   const h=selected[i];
   if(!h.owner&&(!df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card)||!df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card))){
    selected.splice(i,1);usedOriginals.delete(h.originalName);
   }
  }
  // The existing emergency field fillers will replace unavailable rivals with fresh entries.
  completeFiveHorseField(card,selected,usedOriginals);
  dfGateFillGraded(card,selected,usedOriginals);
  // DF202: no priority/filler may replace a mandated two-year challenger.
  for(const required of df202GuaranteedStarters(card)){
   if(selected.some(h=>h.originalName===required.originalName))continue;
   const removable=selected.findLastIndex(h=>!h.owner&&!df202IsControlledOriginal(h));
   if(selected.length>=rivalSlots+(owner?1:0)&&removable>=0)selected.splice(removable,1);
   if(selected.length<rivalSlots+(owner?1:0))selected.push(required);
  }
  // Ver.145: an SS original may occur only once per actual race field.
  const df145SeenSS=new Set();
  for(let i=0;i<selected.length;){
   const h=selected[i];
   if(!h.owner&&(h.overallRank==='SS'||isSpecial125(h))){
    if(df145SeenSS.has(h.originalName)){selected.splice(i,1);continue;}
    df145SeenSS.add(h.originalName);
   }
   i++;
  }
  completeFiveHorseField(card,selected,usedOriginals);
  dfGateFillGraded(card,selected,usedOriginals);
  df16SaveEliteClassicAppearance(card,selected);
  df17SaveTripleClassicAppearance(card,selected);
  // Ver.34: a new field and a fresh complete draw order for each newly prepared race.
  // Keep owner and guaranteed Classic entrants, but do not reserve their gate numbers.
  return shuffled(selected).map(h=>balancedRivalFor(h,card));
}

window.keibaV79Reference={venues:VENUES_V78,races:GRADED_RACES_V78,jockeys:JOCKEYS_V78,history:DOCUMENTED_RIDES_V78};
window.keibaV80Reference={venues:VENUES_V78,turfRaces:GRADED_RACES_V78,landscapes:['東京','中山','京都','阪神','新潟']};
window.keibaV81Reference={venues:VENUES_V78,turfRaces:GRADED_RACES_V78,visualMode:'photo-real-ish procedural scenery'};

// ===== Ver.91 source section: 06b_month_calendar.js | 年月・各月の番組・世代・戦績 =====
// The calendar starts at game year 1 (not a real calendar year). All additional
// non-graded races below are simplified fictional race cards, NOT official entries.
const CALENDAR_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.calendar';
const MONTH_VENUES=Object.freeze({
 1:['中山','京都'],2:['東京','京都'],3:['中山','阪神'],4:['中山','阪神','東京','京都'],
 5:['東京','京都','新潟'],6:['東京','阪神'],7:['新潟'],8:['新潟'],
 9:['中山','阪神'],10:['東京','京都','新潟'],11:['東京','京都'],12:['中山','阪神']
});
const MONTH_LABEL=Object.freeze(['1月','2月','3月','4月','5月','6月','7月','8月','9月','10月','11月','12月']);
const JUNIOR_GRADED=Object.freeze([
 {name:'新潟2歳ステークス',venue:'新潟',grade:'GⅢ',distance:1600,month:8,ages:'2',layout:'外'},
 {name:'サウジアラビアロイヤルカップ',venue:'東京',grade:'GⅢ',distance:1600,month:10,ages:'2',layout:'本'},
 {name:'京王杯2歳ステークス',venue:'東京',grade:'GⅡ',distance:1400,month:11,ages:'2',layout:'本'},

// Ver.100: historical-Classic entries, two-season locks, and guaranteed G1 gates.
// A recorded WIN is proof of an actual start; non-winner starts require explicit evidence.
// A race at the wrong historic generation is not claimed as an actual start in this game year:
// the records here describe genuine real-world starts, while game seasons remain fictional.
const DF100_CLASSICS=new Set(['皐月賞','日本ダービー','菊花賞','桜花賞','オークス','秋華賞']);
const DF100_BOOSTED=new Set([...DF_V93_FOUR_POINTS.keys(),...SPECIAL_125_ORIGINALS]);
const DF100_EXTRA_VERIFIED_CLASSIC_STARTS=Object.freeze({
 '皐月賞':['シンボリルドルフ','ナリタブライアン','オルフェーヴル','スペシャルウィーク','トウカイテイオー','ライスシャワー','レガレイラ'],
 '日本ダービー':['ウオッカ','レガレイラ','サイレンススズカ','スペシャルウィーク'],
 '菊花賞':['ダンスパートナー','スペシャルウィーク'],
 '桜花賞':['ウオッカ','グランアレグリア']
});
const DF100_REAL_STARTS=new Map([...DF100_CLASSICS].map(name=>[name,new Set(DF100_EXTRA_VERIFIED_CLASSIC_STARTS[name]||[])]));
for(const races of Object.values(HISTORIC_CLASSIC_WINNERS_V92)){
 for(const [race,names] of Object.entries(races)){
  const starts=DF100_REAL_STARTS.get(race);
  if(starts)for(const name of names)starts.add(name); // Winner necessarily started.
 }
}
// Save only new locks, using the pre-existing calendar save key/version.
const df100ClassicLocks=new Map();
// Ver.145: one annual route per boosted registered original horse. A provisional
// newspaper lineup never records a start; only a completed race does.
const df145AnnualStarts=new Map();
const DF145_POST_OSAKA_G1=new Set(['天皇賞（春）','宝塚記念','天皇賞（秋）','ジャパンカップ','有馬記念']);
function df145YearRecord(year=calendarYear){
 let record=df145AnnualStarts.get(year);
 if(!record){record={osaka:{},classic:{}};df145AnnualStarts.set(year,record);}
 return record;
}
function df145IsBoosted(h){return !!h&&!h.owner&&DF100_BOOSTED.has(h.originalName);}
function df145OsakaStarted(h){return df145IsBoosted(h)&&!!df145AnnualStarts.get(calendarYear)?.osaka?.[h.originalName];}
function df145ClassicStarted(h){return df145IsBoosted(h)&&!!df145AnnualStarts.get(calendarYear)?.classic?.[h.originalName];}
function df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card){
 if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
 if(!df145IsBoosted(h)||card?.ages!=='3'||calendarMonth<4)return true;
 // An Osaka Hai starter cannot enter three-year-old-only races that year.
 if(df145OsakaStarted(h))return false;
 // Once the opening Classic has passed, the horse must actually have STARTED it.
 if(df16OpeningClassic(card)&&calendarMonth===4)return true;
 return df145ClassicStarted(h);
}
function df145GuaranteedTarget(h,card){
 return df145OsakaStarted(h)&&card?.grade==='GⅠ'&&DF145_POST_OSAKA_G1.has(card.name);
}
function df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card){
 if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
 // These five required starts override only the one-start-per-month RIVAL gate.
 // All age, sex, distance and rank gates are still checked separately.
 return !df133RivalAlreadyStarted(h)||df145GuaranteedTarget(h,card);
}
function df145GuaranteedOsakaStarters(card){
 if(card?.grade!=='GⅠ'||!DF145_POST_OSAKA_G1.has(card.name))return [];
 const records=df145AnnualStarts.get(calendarYear)?.osaka||{};
 const pool=calendarPool(),result=[];
 for(const [originalName,details] of Object.entries(records)){
  const rememberedName=typeof details==='string'?details:details?.name;
  const template=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===originalName);
  if(!template||!DF100_BOOSTED.has(originalName))continue;
  // Reuse the SAME registered horse/instance that actually ran Osaka Hai.
  const existing=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(rememberedName);
  const remembered=existing?.originalName===originalName?existing:null;
  const reconstructed=details&&typeof details==='object'&&
    Number.isInteger(details.birthGameYear)&&Number.isInteger(details.startAge)
    ?{...template,name:rememberedName,birthGameYear:details.birthGameYear,startAge:details.startAge}:null;
  const horse=pool.find(h=>!h.owner&&h.originalName===originalName&&h.name===rememberedName)
    ||remembered||reconstructed||(template.name===rememberedName?template:null);
  if(horse&&reconstructed&&!remembered)HORSE_BY_NAME.set(horse.name,horse);
  if(!horse||!entryDistanceEligible(horse,card)||!calendarRaceEligible(horse,card))continue;
  if(!result.some(h=>h.originalName===originalName))result.push(horse);
 }
 return result;
}
function df145RecordActualStarts(card,starters){
 if(!card||!['大阪杯','皐月賞','桜花賞'].includes(card.name))return;
 const target=card.name==='大阪杯'?'osaka':'classic';
 const records=df145YearRecord()[target];
 for(const h of starters){
  if(!df145IsBoosted(h))continue;
  if(target==='classic'&&calendarHorseAge(h)!==3)continue;
  records[h.originalName]=target==='osaka'?
   {name:h.name,birthGameYear:Number.isInteger(h.birthGameYear)?h.birthGameYear:null,startAge:h.startAge}:h.name;
 }
}
function df100LockKey(year,route){return year+'|'+route;}
function df100HistoricStart(h,card){return DF100_REAL_STARTS.get(card.name)?.has(h.originalName)===true;}
function df100Classic(card){return card?.grade==='GⅠ'&&DF100_CLASSICS.has(card.name);}
function df100AgeForCard(h,card){
 const [first,last]=registryAgeLimits(h);
 const min=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:3;
 const max=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:9;
 const age=Math.max(min,first);
 return age<=max&&age<=last?age:null;
}
function df100LocalEntry(template,card,nameOverride,birthOverride){
 const age=df100AgeForCard(template,card);
 if(age===null)return null;
 const birthYear=birthOverride??(calendarYear+2-age);
 const name=nameOverride||template.name+'・'+calendarYear+'年目GⅠ';
 return {...template,name,birthGameYear:birthYear,startAge:age};
}
function df100Legal(h,card,relaxDistance=false){
 if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
  if(Number(card?.distance)<=1600&&h?.originalName&&DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[h.originalName])return false;
  if(!h||h.owner||!df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card)||!df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card)||!df116BoostGradeAllowed(h,card))return false;
 const age=calendarHorseAge(h),last=gameHorseLastStartAge(h),first=registryAgeLimits(h)[0];
 if(age<first||age>last)return false;
 if(card.ages==='2'&&age!==2||card.ages==='3'&&age!==3||card.ages==='4+'&&age<4||card.ages==='3+'&&age<3)return false;
 if(card.female&&h.sex!=='牝')return false;
 if(h.sex==='牝'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES,card.name)&&
    !VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name].includes(h.originalName))return false;
 if(!relaxDistance&&!entryDistanceEligible(h,card))return false;
 return true;
}
function df100GetFixedHorse(lock,card){
 const template=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===lock.originalName);
 if(!template)return null;
 const h={...template,name:lock.name,birthGameYear:lock.season-1,startAge:2};
 // Cohort identity is kept for both years, without touching the stored template.
 HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,h);
 return df100Legal(h,card,true)?h:null;
}
function df100LockedFor(card){
 if(card?.grade!=='GⅠ')return [];
 const route=DF16_CLASSIC_ROUTES[card.name];
 const isFinale=DF16_FINALE_RACES.has(card.name);
 const nextYear=['天皇賞（春）','宝塚記念','天皇賞（秋）','ジャパンカップ','有馬記念'].includes(card.name);
 const records=[];
 for(const [key,locks] of df100ClassicLocks){
  for(const lock of locks){
   const sameYear=lock.season===calendarYear&&(route===lock.route||isFinale);
   const following=lock.season+1===calendarYear&&nextYear;
   if(sameYear||following)records.push(lock);
  }
 }
 return records.map(lock=>df100GetFixedHorse(lock,card)).filter(Boolean);
}
function df100IsProtected(h,card){
 return df100LockedFor(card).some(lock=>lock.originalName===h.originalName);
}
function df100ClassicInitial(card,selected,used,limit){
 const first=df16OpeningClassic(card),route=card.name==='桜花賞'?'牝':'牡';
 const lockKey=df100LockKey(calendarYear,route);
 // The same registered original cannot represent two overlapping guaranteed cohorts.
 const previousLocked=new Set((df100ClassicLocks.get(df100LockKey(calendarYear-1,route))||[]).map(x=>x.originalName));
 const candidates=[];
 // Build the cohort once per race rather than rebuilding it for every horse.
 const currentCohort=calendarPool();
 // Use the existing eligible game cohort when possible; otherwise a race-local
 // age-three instance of an existing registered horse, not a new horse record.
 for(const template of HORSE_DB){
  if(!df100HistoricStart(template,card)||used.has(template.originalName)||
     (first&&previousLocked.has(template.originalName)))continue;
  if(template.sex==='牝'&&route==='牡'&&!VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name]?.includes(template.originalName))continue;
  if(route==='牝'&&template.sex!=='牝')continue;
  const available=currentCohort.find(h=>!h.owner&&h.originalName===template.originalName&&calendarHorseAge(h)===3);
  const h=available||df100LocalEntry(template,card);
  if(h&&df100Legal(h,card,true))candidates.push(h);
 }
 // The yearly historical winner is retained as a preferred genuine starter.
 const yearly=HISTORIC_CLASSIC_WINNERS_V92[historicSourceYearFor(calendarYear)]?.[card.name]||[];
 const priority=h=>(yearly.includes(h.originalName)?100:0)+
   (DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[h.originalName]===route?20:0);
 const historical=shuffled(candidates).sort((a,b)=>priority(b)-priority(a));
 if(first){
  let locks=df100ClassicLocks.get(lockKey);
  if(!locks){
   const triple=historical.filter(h=>DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[h.originalName]===route);
   const boosted=historical.filter(h=>DF100_BOOSTED.has(h.originalName)&&!triple.some(t=>t.originalName===h.originalName));
   // Up to two boosted entries besides the independently protected Triple Crown group.
   // Protect one historical triple champion plus up to two other boosted horses
   // per Classic route. This leaves room for both overlapping seasons at 16-runner G1s.
   const champion=triple.slice(0,1);
   const boostedSlots=Math.max(0,2-champion.filter(h=>DF100_BOOSTED.has(h.originalName)).length);
   const chosen=champion.concat(boosted.slice(0,boostedSlots));
   locks=chosen.map(h=>({originalName:h.originalName,name:h.name,season:calendarYear,route}));
   df100ClassicLocks.set(lockKey,locks);
   saveCalendarData();
  }
  for(const lock of locks){
   if(selected.length>=limit)break;
   const h=df100GetFixedHorse(lock,card);
   if(h&&!used.has(h.originalName)){selected.push(h);used.add(h.originalName);}
  }
 }
 for(const h of historical){
  if(selected.length>=limit)break;
  if(used.has(h.originalName))continue;
  // No more than two boosted non-triple horses in this opening race.
  if(first&&(DF100_BOOSTED.has(h.originalName)||
     DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[h.originalName]===route))continue;
  selected.push(h);used.add(h.originalName);
 }
}
function df100FinishG1(card,selected,used,limit){
 if(card.grade!=='GⅠ'||selected.length>=limit)return;
 const classic=df100Classic(card);
 // At a Classic, non-historical unprotected runners MUST be A rank.
 // At other G1s, the usual S/SS selection above precedes A then B substitutes.
 const ranks=classic?['A']:['A','B'];
 for(const relax of [false,true]){
  for(const rank of ranks){
   const live=shuffled(calendarPool().filter(h=>!h.owner&&h.overallRank===rank&&
      !used.has(h.originalName)&&df100Legal(h,card,relax)));
   const local=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>h.overallRank===rank&&!used.has(h.originalName))
    .map(t=>df100LocalEntry(t,card))
    .filter(h=>h&&df100Legal(h,card,relax)));
   for(const h of [...live,...local]){
    if(selected.length>=limit)break;
    if(used.has(h.originalName))continue;
    selected.push(h);used.add(h.originalName);HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,h);
   }
   if(selected.length>=limit)return;
  }
 }
 // Last resort for non-classic G1s only: S templates if A/B are exhausted.
 if(!classic){
  for(const t of shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>!used.has(h.originalName)&&h.overallRank==='S'))){
   if(selected.length>=limit)break;
   const h=df100LocalEntry(t,card);if(!h||!df100Legal(h,card,true))continue;
   selected.push(h);used.add(h.originalName);HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,h);
  }
 }
}
const HISTORIC_CLASSIC_YEARS_V92=Object.freeze(Object.keys(HISTORIC_CLASSIC_WINNERS_V92).map(Number).sort((a,b)=>a-b));
const CLASSIC_RACE_TITLES_V92=Object.freeze(['桜花賞','皐月賞','オークス','日本ダービー','菊花賞','秋華賞']);
const CLASSIC_RACE_MONTH_V92=Object.freeze({'桜花賞':4,'皐月賞':4,'オークス':5,'日本ダービー':5,'菊花賞':10,'秋華賞':10});

// The first 5 historical years had a 3-year-old Queen Elizabeth Cup, not Shuka Sho.
function historicSourceYearFor(gameYear){
 // Mix historical generations instead of silently treating game year 1 as 1990.
 const index=(((gameYear-1)*5+8)%HISTORIC_CLASSIC_YEARS_V92.length);
 return HISTORIC_CLASSIC_YEARS_V92[index];
}
function classicWinnersForGameYear(gameYear){
 const year=historicSourceYearFor(gameYear),names=new Map();
 for(const [race,originals] of Object.entries(HISTORIC_CLASSIC_WINNERS_V92[year]||{})){
  for(const original of originals){
   if(!names.has(original))names.set(original,[]);
   names.get(original).push(race);
  }
 }
 return names;
}
// The classic winner's named 3-year-old races have strict priority. Between
// them they may be entered in an eligible trial, and late in the year one
// suitable all-age graded event. No winner is placed in every graded race.
function classicRaceIsPlanned(h,card,df17AllowG1WinnerA=false){
 if(!h.classicSeasonYear||h.classicSeasonYear!==calendarYear||calendarHorseAge(h)!==3)return false;
 if(card.classType!=='graded'||card.surface!=='芝'||!calendarRaceEligible(h,card,true,df17AllowG1WinnerA))return false;
 if(h.classicTitles.includes(card.name))return true;
 // Historical champions can only enter non-title races in their planned month.
 const titleMonths=h.classicTitles.map(title=>CLASSIC_RACE_MONTH_V92[title]).filter(Number.isInteger);
 if(titleMonths.includes(calendarMonth))return false;
 const firstTitle=Math.min(...titleMonths);
 const trialMonths=[2,3,6,8,9,11,12];
 if(card.ages==='3'&&trialMonths.includes(calendarMonth)&&calendarMonth<=10){
  if(calendarMonth>=firstTitle&&calendarMonth<=firstTitle+1)return false;
  const cards=monthlyRaceCards().filter(c=>c.classType==='graded'&&c.ages==='3'&&
   !CLASSIC_RACE_TITLES_V92.includes(c.name)&&(!c.female||h.sex==='牝')&&
   entryDistanceEligible(h,c));
  cards.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.distance-h.bestDistance)-Math.abs(b.distance-h.bestDistance)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return cards.length>0&&card.calendarId===cards[0].calendarId;
 }
 if((calendarMonth===11||calendarMonth===12)&&card.ages==='3+'&&
    calendarMonth>firstTitle&&card.grade==='GⅠ'&&entryDistanceEligible(h,card)){
  const cards=monthlyRaceCards().filter(c=>c.classType==='graded'&&c.ages==='3+'&&c.grade==='GⅠ'&&
   entryDistanceEligible(h,c));
  cards.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.distance-h.bestDistance)-Math.abs(b.distance-h.bestDistance)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return cards.length>0&&card.calendarId===cards[0].calendarId;
 }
 return false;
}
function classicStartAllowed(h,card){
 const prev=calendarLastClassicStarts.get(h.name);
 if(!prev||h.classicSeasonYear!==calendarYear||calendarHorseAge(h)!==3)return true;
 if(prev.gameYear!==calendarYear)return true;
 if(prev.month===calendarMonth)return false;
 // Permit historically adjacent spring Classics (April -> May), otherwise
 // require at least one full month between races.
 const core=h.classicTitles.includes(card.name);
 return core || (calendarMonth-prev.month>=2);
}
function classicEntriesFor(card){
 return calendarPool().filter(h=>h.classicSeasonYear===calendarYear&&
    classicRaceIsPlanned(h,card)&&classicStartAllowed(h,card));
}

 const champions=[...classicWinnersForGameYear(calendarYear).keys()];
 return `${calendarYear}年目の3歳クラシック世代（史実優勝馬）：${champions.join('、')}`;
}

function dfV96RegisteredDistance(h,d){
 if(h?.df131FictionalCom)return null;

function entryDistanceEligible(h,card){
 if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
 // Ver.154: owner's distance aptitude affects performance only, never entry permission.
 if(h?.owner)return true;
 // Ver.134: historic classic triple-crown winners never start in a 1600m-or-shorter race.
 // All normal, fixed, protected and graded field selection paths use this gate.
 if(Number(card?.distance)<=1600&&h?.originalName&&DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[h.originalName])return false;
 const registered=dfV96RegisteredDistance(h,Number(card?.distance));
 if(registered!==null)return registered;
 return Number.isFinite(h?.aptMin)&&Number.isFinite(h?.aptMax)&&
 card.distance>=h.aptMin-ENTRY_DISTANCE_MARGIN&&card.distance<=h.aptMax+ENTRY_DISTANCE_MARGIN;
}
function entryDistancePerfect(h,card){
 const registered=dfV96RegisteredDistance(h,Number(card?.distance));

}

let calendarYear=1,calendarMonth=1,calendarCompleted=new Set(),calendarCareers=new Map();

const DF202_S_ORIGINALS=Object.freeze([

 'シンボリルドルフ','スペシャルウィーク','トウカイテイオー',

let df202Plans=null;

function df202Shuffle(list){
 const out=[...list];
 for(let i=out.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[out[i],out[j]]=[out[j],out[i]];}
 return out;
}
function df202ReadPlans(raw){
 if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||raw.version!==1)return null;
 const validGroup=(value,allowed,max)=>{
  if(!value||!Number.isInteger(value.startYear)||value.startYear<1||value.startYear>9999||
     !Array.isArray(value.originals)||value.originals.length>max)return null;
  const originals=value.originals;
  if(new Set(originals).size!==originals.length||originals.some(n=>!allowed.has(n))||
     (max===2&&originals.length!==2))return null;
  return {startYear:value.startYear,originals:[...originals]};
 };
 const ss=raw.ss==null?null:validGroup(raw.ss,SPECIAL_125_ORIGINALS,3);
 const s=raw.s==null?null:validGroup(raw.s,DF202_S_SET,2);
 if((raw.ss&&!ss)||(raw.s&&!s)||!Number.isInteger(raw.ssLastLotteryYear)||
    raw.ssLastLotteryYear<0||raw.ssLastLotteryYear>9999||
    !Number.isInteger(raw.sNextLotteryYear)||raw.sNextLotteryYear<1||raw.sNextLotteryYear>9999)return null;
 return {version:1,ss,s,ssLastLotteryYear:raw.ssLastLotteryYear,sNextLotteryYear:raw.sNextLotteryYear};
}
function df202EnsurePlans(initial=false){
 if(!df202Plans){
  // An old save opened after March must not retroactively draw a new season.
  // A game opened in January/February will draw normally on reaching March.
  df202Plans={version:1,ss:null,s:null,
   ssLastLotteryYear:calendarMonth>3?calendarYear:Math.max(0,calendarYear-1),
   sNextLotteryYear:calendarMonth>3?calendarYear+1:calendarYear};
  if(initial&&calendarMonth>3){saveCalendarData();return;}
 }
 if(calendarMonth<3){
  // On January/February, the previous year's chosen horses remain active as 4yos.
  // If multiple years were skipped, advance the S cycle anchor without rerolling.
  while(df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear<calendarYear){
   df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear+=2;
  }
  return;
 }
 let changed=false;
 // SS: 10% once in March, except that a 3yo selection automatically continues at 4.
 if(df202Plans.ssLastLotteryYear<calendarYear){
  if(df202Plans.ss?.startYear===calendarYear-1&&df202Plans.ss.originals.length){
   df202Plans.ssLastLotteryYear=calendarYear;
  }else{
   const chosen=Math.random()<.10;
   const number=!chosen?0:(r=>r<.95?1:r<.98?2:3)(Math.random());
   df202Plans.ss={startYear:calendarYear,originals:chosen?df202Shuffle([...SPECIAL_125_ORIGINALS]).slice(0,number):[]};
   df202Plans.ssLastLotteryYear=calendarYear;
  }
  changed=true;
 }
 // S: select exactly two distinct horses every other March; no 10% gate.
 if(df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear<=calendarYear){
  while(df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear+2<=calendarYear)df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear+=2;
  if(df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear===calendarYear){
   df202Plans.s={startYear:calendarYear,originals:df202Shuffle(DF202_S_ORIGINALS).slice(0,2)};
   df202Plans.sNextLotteryYear=calendarYear+2;
   changed=true;
  }
 }
 if(changed)saveCalendarData();
}

function df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card){
 if(!df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return true;
 if(!card||card.grade!=='GⅠ'||card.classType!=='graded')return false;
 const group=df202CurrentSelected(h.originalName);
 if(!group||h.df202SpecialSeason!==group.startYear)return false;

  return classics.has(card.name)||card.name==='ジャパンカップ'||card.name==='有馬記念';
 }
 return age===4&&DF202_FOUR_YEAR.has(card.name)&&
   !(h.originalName==='アーモンドアイ'&&card.name==='天皇賞（春）');
}
function df202ActiveHorses(){
 const result=[];
 for(const group of [df202Plans?.ss,df202Plans?.s]){
  if(!group||!(calendarYear===group.startYear||calendarYear===group.startYear+1))continue;
  for(const originalName of group.originals){
   const template=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===originalName);
   if(!template)throw Error('DF202: 抽選対象の馬が見つかりません: '+originalName);
   const name=template.name+'・'+group.startYear+'年目DF202';
   let h=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(name);
   if(!h||h.originalName!==originalName||h.df202SpecialSeason!==group.startYear){
    h={...template,name,birthGameYear:group.startYear-1,startAge:2,
       df202SpecialSeason:group.startYear};
    HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,h);
   }
   result.push(h);
  }
 }
 return result;
}

// Only registered G1-winning horses qualify. An A-ranked champion may be used
// solely to reach five, not as an ordinary G1 entrant. SS is never added here.
function df17IsHistoricG1Winner(h){return !!h&&!h.owner&&Number(h.g1Wins)>0;}
function df17EligibleG1Winner(h,card,allowA=false){
 if(!df17IsHistoricG1Winner(h)||card?.grade!=='GⅠ'||isSpecial125(h))return false;
