function df17WinnerCount(selected){return selected.filter(df17IsHistoricG1Winner).length;}
function df17EnsureFiveG1Winners(card,selected,usedOriginals,count){
 if(card?.grade!=='GⅠ')return;
 const quota=Math.min(5,count);
 if(df17WinnerCount(selected)>=quota)return;
 const tryAdd=(horses,allowA)=>{
  for(const h of horses){
   if(df17WinnerCount(selected)>=quota)break;
   if(usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)||!df17EligibleG1Winner(h,card,allowA))continue;
   if(selected.length>=count){
    const removeAt=selected.findLastIndex(other=>!df202IsControlledOriginal(other)&&!df17IsHistoricG1Winner(other)&&
     !isSpecial125(other)&&!df145GuaranteedTarget(other,card)&&!df100IsProtected(other,card)&&!other.classicTitles?.includes(card.name)&&!earnedPriorityFor(other,card));
    if(removeAt<0)break;
    usedOriginals.delete(selected[removeAt].originalName);
    selected.splice(removeAt,1);
   }
   selected.push(h);usedOriginals.add(h.originalName);
   // Preserve the same horse identity for the existing race and career lookups.
   if(h.name.includes('年目GⅠ勝利馬'))HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,h);
  }
 };
 const live=calendarPool().filter(h=>!h.owner&&!isSpecial125(h)&&!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName));
 const rankOrder=['S','A'];
 for(const rank of rankOrder){
  if(df17WinnerCount(selected)>=quota)break;
  const allowA=rank==='A';
  const rankLive=shuffled(live.filter(h=>h.overallRank===rank))
   .sort((a,b)=>Number(entryDistancePerfect(b,card))-Number(entryDistancePerfect(a,card)));
  tryAdd(rankLive,allowA);
  if(df17WinnerCount(selected)>=quota)break;
  // Use existing registered horse templates to fill age-specific cohort shortages.
  // Do not invent a new breed or exceed a horse's verified debut/final age.
  const requiredAge=card.ages==='2'?2:card.ages==='3'?3:card.ages==='4+'?4:3;
  const templates=shuffled(HORSE_DB.filter(h=>h.overallRank===rank&&!usedOriginals.has(h.originalName)));
  const aged=templates.map(h=>({...h,name:h.name+'・'+calendarYear+'年目GⅠ勝利馬',
    birthGameYear:calendarYear+2-requiredAge,startAge:requiredAge}));
  tryAdd(aged,allowA);
 }
}

function df16OpeningClassic(card){return card?.name==='皐月賞'||card?.name==='桜花賞';}
function df16ForcedEliteFor(card){
 const lock=df16AnnualEliteClassic.get(calendarYear);
 if(!lock||card?.grade!=='GⅠ')return null;
 const matchedRoute=DF16_CLASSIC_ROUTES[card.name]===lock.route;
 if(!matchedRoute&&!DF16_FINALE_RACES.has(card.name))return null;
 // The same exact registered horse that appeared in the first classic is reserved.
 const pool=calendarPool();
 const horse=pool.find(h=>h.name===lock.name&&h.originalName===lock.originalName&&isSpecial125(h));
 return horse||null;
}
function df16SaveEliteClassicAppearance(card,selected){
 if(!df16OpeningClassic(card)||df16AnnualEliteClassic.has(calendarYear))return;
 const elite=selected.find(h=>isSpecial125(h)&&!df202IsControlledOriginal(h));
 if(!elite)return;
 df16AnnualEliteClassic.set(calendarYear,{
  originalName:elite.originalName,name:elite.name,
  route:card.name==='皐月賞'?'牡':'牝'
 });
 saveCalendarData();
}
let calendarCohorts=[];
let activeCalendarCard=null;
function loadCalendarData(){
 try{
  const raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALENDAR_KEY)||'null');
  if(!raw||raw.version!==1)return;
  if(!Number.isInteger(raw.year)||raw.year<1||raw.year>9999||!Number.isInteger(raw.month)||raw.month<1||raw.month>12)return;
  calendarYear=raw.year;calendarMonth=raw.month;
  df202Plans=df202ReadPlans(raw.df202Plans);
  // The register is only valid for exactly this saved month.
  if(raw.df133RivalStarts?.year===calendarYear&&raw.df133RivalStarts?.month===calendarMonth){
   for(const name of (Array.isArray(raw.df133RivalStarts.names)?raw.df133RivalStarts.names:[]).slice(0,500))
    if(typeof name==='string'&&name.length<180)df133RivalStartedNames.add(name);
   for(const name of (Array.isArray(raw.df133RivalStarts.originals)?raw.df133RivalStarts.originals:[]).slice(0,500))
    if(typeof name==='string'&&name.length<180)df133RivalStartedOriginals.add(name);
  }
  if(Array.isArray(raw.completed))calendarCompleted=new Set(raw.completed.filter(k=>typeof k==='string'&&k.startsWith(`${calendarYear}-${calendarMonth}-`)&&/^\d+-\d+-\d+$/.test(k)).slice(-500));
   if(raw.df16AnnualEliteClassic&&typeof raw.df16AnnualEliteClassic==='object')
    for(const [year,lock] of Object.entries(raw.df16AnnualEliteClassic)){
     if(/^\d{1,4}$/.test(year)&&lock&&SPECIAL_125_ORIGINALS.has(lock.originalName)&&
        typeof lock.name==='string'&&lock.name.length<100&&['牡','牝'].includes(lock.route))
       df16AnnualEliteClassic.set(Number(year),{
        originalName:lock.originalName,name:lock.name,route:lock.route
       });
    }
  if(raw.df17AnnualTripleClassics&&typeof raw.df17AnnualTripleClassics==='object')
   for(const [year,records] of Object.entries(raw.df17AnnualTripleClassics)){
    if(!/^\d{1,4}$/.test(year)||!Array.isArray(records))continue;
    const valid=records.filter(lock=>lock&&
      DF17_TRIPLE_CROWN_BY_ORIGINAL[lock.originalName]===lock.route&&
      typeof lock.name==='string'&&lock.name.length>0&&lock.name.length<100).slice(0,18);
    if(valid.length)df17AnnualTripleClassics.set(Number(year),valid.map(lock=>({
      originalName:lock.originalName,name:lock.name,route:lock.route
    })));
   }
  if(raw.df145AnnualStarts&&typeof raw.df145AnnualStarts==='object'){
   for(const [year,text] of Object.entries(raw.df145AnnualStarts)){
    if(!/^\d{1,4}$/.test(year)||!text||typeof text!=='object')continue;
    const restored={osaka:{},classic:{}};
    for(const type of ['osaka','classic'])for(const [original,name] of Object.entries(text[type]||{})){
     if(!DF100_BOOSTED.has(original))continue;
     if(typeof name==='string'&&name.length<150)restored[type][original]=name;
     else if(name&&typeof name.name==='string'&&name.name.length<150&&
       (name.birthGameYear===null||Number.isInteger(name.birthGameYear))&&Number.isInteger(name.startAge))
      restored[type][original]={name:name.name,birthGameYear:name.birthGameYear,startAge:name.startAge};
    }
    df145AnnualStarts.set(Number(year),restored);
   }
  }
  if(raw.df100ClassicLocks&&typeof raw.df100ClassicLocks==='object'){
   for(const [key,records] of Object.entries(raw.df100ClassicLocks)){
    if(!/^\d{1,4}\|[牡牝]$/.test(key)||!Array.isArray(records))continue;
    const verified=records.filter(x=>x&&typeof x.originalName==='string'&&x.originalName.length<100&&
      typeof x.name==='string'&&x.name.length<120&&Number.isInteger(x.season)&&x.season>0&&
      ['牡','牝'].includes(x.route)&&HORSE_DB.some(h=>h.originalName===x.originalName)).slice(0,5);
    if(verified.length)df100ClassicLocks.set(key,verified);
   }
  }
  if(raw.lastClassicStarts&&typeof raw.lastClassicStarts==='object')for(const [key,last] of Object.entries(raw.lastClassicStarts)){
   if(last&&Number.isInteger(last.gameYear)&&last.gameYear>=1&&Number.isInteger(last.month)&&last.month>=1&&last.month<=12)
    calendarLastClassicStarts.set(key,{gameYear:last.gameYear,month:last.month});
  }
  if(raw.trialRights&&typeof raw.trialRights==='object')for(const [key,record] of Object.entries(raw.trialRights)){
    if(typeof key==='string'&&key.length<180&&record&&typeof record.source==='string'&&Number.isInteger(record.place)&&record.place>=1&&record.place<=5)
      calendarTrialRights.set(key,{source:record.source,place:record.place});
   }
  if(raw.careers&&typeof raw.careers==='object')for(const [key,c] of Object.entries(raw.careers)){
   if(c&&Number.isInteger(c.wins)&&c.wins>=0&&Number.isInteger(c.starts)&&c.starts>=c.wins)
    calendarCareers.set(key,{wins:Math.min(c.wins,500),starts:Math.min(c.starts,5000),
      prize:Number.isFinite(Number(c.prize))?Math.max(0,Number(c.prize)):0});
  }
 }catch(e){console.warn('ゲーム内カレンダーの復元に失敗しました',e);}
}
function saveCalendarData(){
 try{localStorage.setItem(CALENDAR_KEY,JSON.stringify({version:1,year:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth,completed:[...calendarCompleted],careers:Object.fromEntries(calendarCareers),trialRights:Object.fromEntries(calendarTrialRights),df133RivalStarts:{year:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth,names:[...df133RivalStartedNames],originals:[...df133RivalStartedOriginals]},lastClassicStarts:Object.fromEntries(calendarLastClassicStarts),df16AnnualEliteClassic:Object.fromEntries(df16AnnualEliteClassic),df17AnnualTripleClassics:Object.fromEntries(df17AnnualTripleClassics),df100ClassicLocks:Object.fromEntries(df100ClassicLocks),df145AnnualStarts:Object.fromEntries([...df145AnnualStarts].filter(([year])=>year>=calendarYear-2&&year<=calendarYear)),df202Plans}));}
 catch(e){console.warn('ゲーム内カレンダーの保存が使えません',e);}
}
loadCalendarData();
try{
 const savedFarm=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.farm')||'null');
 if(savedFarm&&Number.isInteger(savedFarm.calendarYear)&&savedFarm.calendarYear>=1&&savedFarm.calendarYear<=9999&&
  Number.isInteger(savedFarm.calendarMonth)&&savedFarm.calendarMonth>=1&&savedFarm.calendarMonth<=12){
  if(calendarYear!==savedFarm.calendarYear||calendarMonth!==savedFarm.calendarMonth)df133ResetMonthlyRivals();
  calendarYear=savedFarm.calendarYear;calendarMonth=savedFarm.calendarMonth;
 }
}catch(_){}
df202EnsurePlans(true);
const HORSE_CALENDAR_TEMPLATES=HORSE_DB.filter(h=>h.startAge===2);
function populateCalendarCohorts(){
 // Year 1 starts with a 3yo cohort born in "year 0" (not shown in UI).
 // Persisted instances are rebuilt from each game year's stable history.
 const first=Math.max(0,calendarYear-8);
 calendarCohorts=[];
 for(let born=first;born<=calendarYear;born++){
  for(const template of HORSE_CALENDAR_TEMPLATES){
   if(classicWinnersForGameYear(born+1).has(template.originalName))continue;
   const name=template.name+'・'+(born===0?'初年度同期':born+'期');
   let h=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(name);
   if(!h){h={...template,name,birthGameYear:born,startAge:2};HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,h);}
   calendarCohorts.push(h);
  }
 }
 for(let season=Math.max(1,calendarYear-6);season<=calendarYear;season++){
  for(const [originalName,titles] of classicWinnersForGameYear(season)){
   const template=CLASSIC_TEMPLATES_BY_ORIGINAL.get(originalName);
   if(!template)continue; // checked statically against all 221 registered horses
   const name=template.name+'・'+season+'年目';
   let h=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(name);
   if(!h){h={...template,name,birthGameYear:season-1,startAge:2,
     classicSeasonYear:season,classicTitles:[...titles]};HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,h);}
   calendarCohorts.push(h);
  }
 }
 // A small set of historically documented fillies also have selectable 3yo instances.
 // This does not add new horse records or change template ability values.
 const knownFillies=new Set(Object.values(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES).flat());
 for(const originalName of knownFillies){
  const template=CLASSIC_TEMPLATES_BY_ORIGINAL.get(originalName);
  if(!template||template.startAge===2)continue; // already in the usual cohort rotation
  for(let born=Math.max(0,calendarYear-2);born<=calendarYear;born++){
   const name=template.name+'・'+(born===0?'初年度同期':born+'期');
   let h=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(name);
   if(!h){h={...template,name,birthGameYear:born,startAge:2};HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,h);}
   if(!calendarCohorts.some(c=>c.name===name))calendarCohorts.push(h);
  }
 }
}
// Ver.19: current-age (0 at birth, +1 each January) historical ranges.
// Each confirmed range was calculated from BIRTH YEAR and FIRST/LAST actual racing YEARS.
// The former Japanese count-age label is never subtracted twice.
function registryAgeLimits(h){
 const ages=HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V15[h?.originalName]||HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V14[h?.originalName]||HISTORIC_RACING_AGE_V19[h?.originalName];
 // Not yet checked: retain the older game's age ceiling instead of asserting a false historical one.
 return ages||[Number.isInteger(h?.startAge)&&h.startAge>=2&&h.startAge<=9?h.startAge:2,9];
}
function calendarHorseAge(h){
 if(Number.isInteger(h?.df202SpecialSeason))return 3+calendarYear-h.df202SpecialSeason;
 if(h.owner)return Math.min(99,Math.max(0,calendarYear-h.birthGameYear)); // Farm and race both count 0 at birth
 const [debut,last]=registryAgeLimits(h);
 const raw=Number.isInteger(h.birthGameYear)?2+calendarYear-h.birthGameYear:h.startAge+calendarYear-1;
 if(raw<debut)return raw; // Cannot debut before the historical starting age.
 return debut+((raw-debut)%(last-debut+1));
}
function careerOf(h){
 const key=h.name,c=calendarCareers.get(key);if(c)return c;
 const age=h.owner?1:(Number.isInteger(h.birthGameYear)?2:h.startAge);
 const id=HORSE_DB.findIndex(t=>t.originalName===h.originalName);
 let wins=0,starts=0;
 if(h.owner){const fresh={wins:0,starts:0};calendarCareers.set(key,fresh);return fresh;}
 if(age===2){wins=0;starts=0;}
 else if(age===3){wins=Math.max(0,(id+1)%4-1);starts=wins+(id%3===0?0:2);}
 else{wins=(id*7+Math.floor(id/3))%7;starts=wins+3+id%7;}
 const seeded={wins,starts};calendarCareers.set(key,seeded);return seeded;
}
// Verified real last START age, keyed by real horse name (not the fictional name).
// Unlisted historical horses have NOT yet been checked; keep the previous rule
// instead of inventing a retirement age. Homebred horses still use their
// original in-game five-year-old ceiling.
const VERIFIED_LAST_START_AGE_V109=Object.freeze({"オグリキャップ":5,"メジロマックイーン":6,"トウカイテイオー":5,"ミホノブルボン":3,"ナリタブライアン":5,"マヤノトップガン":5,"サイレンススズカ":4,"グラスワンダー":5,"ダンスインザダーク":3,"ゼンノロブロイ":5,"ディープインパクト":4,"サトノダイヤモンド":5,"ストレイトガール":7});
function gameHorseLastStartAge(h){
 if(h?.owner)return window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h);
 return registryAgeLimits(h)[1];
}
// The suffix is needed for cohort identity, saved races and betting.
// Remove it only from on-screen horse names.
 function setGateNameGlyphs(target,name){
  target.dataset.gateName=name;
  target.classList.add('gate-name-column');
  target.replaceChildren();
  for(const glyph of [...name]){
   const span=document.createElement('span');
   span.className='gate-name-char'+(glyph==='ー'?' gate-name-stretch':'');
   span.textContent=glyph;
   target.appendChild(span);
  }
 }
 function raceDisplayHorseName(name){
 if(String(name||'').includes('・架空COM'))return String(name).replace(/・架空COM[0-9a-z]+$/,'');
 // Ver.70: Show only the horse's name; generation/year/G1-winner tags stay in internal IDs.
 return String(name??'').replace(/・(?:初年度同期|\d+期|\d+年目(?:G(?:Ⅰ|I|1)(?:勝利馬)?|補充)?|DF202)$/, '');
}
function calendarPool(){
 df202EnsurePlans();
 populateCalendarCohorts();
 return HORSE_DB.filter(h=>calendarHorseAge(h)>=4&&calendarHorseAge(h)<=gameHorseLastStartAge(h)).concat(calendarCohorts,df202ActiveHorses(),ownedRaceHorses()).filter(h=>calendarHorseAge(h)>=2&&(Number.isInteger(h.df202SpecialSeason)||calendarHorseAge(h)<=gameHorseLastStartAge(h)));
}
function calendarAgeLabel(ages){return ages==='2'?'2歳':ages==='3'?'3歳':ages==='4+'?'4歳以上':'3歳以上';}
function calendarRaceEligible(h,card,skipClassicPlan=false,df17AllowG1WinnerA=false){
  if(df202IsControlledOriginal(h))return df202SpecialRaceAllowed(h,card);
  if(!df145MonthlyAllowed(h,card)||!df145AnnualEntryAllowed(h,card))return false;
  if(!df116BoostGradeAllowed(h,card))return false;
 if(!df16RegistryRankAllowed(h,card)&&
   !(df17AllowG1WinnerA&&card.grade==='GⅠ'&&h.overallRank==='A'&&Number(h.g1Wins)>0))return false;
 const age=calendarHorseAge(h);
 if(age>gameHorseLastStartAge(h)||age<registryAgeLimits(h)[0]||(card.female&&h.sex!=='牝'))return false;
 // Male Classics: fillies can start ONLY when the original real horse started
 // this exact race. Newly bred fillies have no real-world start record.
 if(h.sex==='牝'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES,card.name)&&
    !VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[card.name].includes(h.originalName))return false;
 if(!entryDistanceEligible(h,card))return false;
 if(h.owner&&!ownedRaceEligibility(h,card))return false;
 // Ver.133: every rival (including elite / locked / special horses) has a one-start monthly limit.
 // The df133RivalAlreadyStarted check above replaces the older rival 2-start exception.
 if(card.ages==='2'&&age!==2)return false;
 if(card.ages==='3'&&age!==3)return false;
 if(card.ages==='4+'&&age<4)return false;
 if(card.ages==='3+'&&age<3)return false;
 if(card.ages!=='2'&&card.ages!=='3'&&card.ages!=='3+'&&card.ages!=='4+')return false;
 if(card.ages==='2'&&calendarMonth<6)return false;
 // Owners must have won at least once to start a three-year-old G1,
 // unless the horse earned a trial priority place. Generated historic
 // rivals retain their existing simplified record to keep the calendar playable.
 if(h.owner&&card.grade==='GⅠ'&&age===3&&!earnedPriorityFor(h,card)&&careerOf(h).wins<1)return false;
 if(!skipClassicPlan&&h.classicSeasonYear===calendarYear&&age===3){
  if(!classicRaceIsPlanned(h,card,df17AllowG1WinnerA)||!classicStartAllowed(h,card))return false;
 }
 const history=careerOf(h);
 switch(card.classType){
  case 'new':return history.wins===0&&history.starts===0;
  case 'maiden':return history.wins===0&&(history.starts>0||(h.owner&&age>=4));
  case 'class1':return history.wins===1;
  case 'class2':return history.wins===2;
  case 'class3':return history.wins===3;
  case 'open':return history.wins>=4||((age===2||age===3)&&history.wins>=1);
  default:return true; // graded entries use age/sex conditions; class qualification is simplified.
 }
}
function monthlyRaceCards(targetMonth=calendarMonth,targetYear=calendarYear){
 const graded=GRADED_RACES_V78.filter(c=>(GRADED_MONTH_CORRECTIONS[c.name]||c.month)===targetMonth)
  .map(c=>({...c,month:targetMonth,classType:'graded',gameOnly:false}));
 const junior=JUNIOR_GRADED.filter(c=>c.month===targetMonth).map(c=>({...c,classType:'graded',gameOnly:false}));
 const cards=[...graded,...junior];
 const venues=MONTH_VENUES[targetMonth];
 const ageGroups=[...(targetMonth>=6?['2']:[]),...(targetMonth<=8?['3']:[]),'3+'];
 const format={new:['新馬戦','new'],maiden:['未勝利戦','maiden'],class1:['1勝クラス','class1'],class2:['2勝クラス','class2'],class3:['3勝クラス','class3'],open:['オープン','open']};
 for(const ages of ageGroups){
  for(const [type,[title,kind]] of Object.entries(format)){
   if(ages==='3+'&&type==='new')continue;
   if(ages==='2'&&['class2','class3'].includes(type)&&targetMonth<9)continue;
   if(ages==='3'&&type==='new'&&targetMonth>3)continue;
   if(ages==='3'&&type==='maiden'&&targetMonth>8)continue;
   // Several cards per category provide a choice without simulating a whole race-week schedule.
   const venue=venues[((ages==='2'?0:ages==='3'?1:2)+Object.keys(format).indexOf(type))%venues.length];
   const distList=ages==='2'?[1200,1400,1600,1800]:ages==='3'?[1600,1800,2000,2200]:[1200,1600,1800,2000,2400];
   const distance=distList[(targetMonth+Object.keys(format).indexOf(type))%distList.length];
   const layout=venue==='新潟'&&distance>=1600?'外':venue==='京都'&&distance>=1400?'外':venue==='阪神'&&distance===1600?'外':venue==='中山'&&distance===1200?'外':'内';
   cards.push({name:`${calendarAgeLabel(ages)} ${title}`,venue,grade:kind==='open'?'OP':'一般',distance,surface:'芝',layout,
    ages,female:false,weightRule:kind==='new'||kind==='maiden'?'馬齢':'定量',month:targetMonth,
    classType:kind,gameOnly:true});
  }
 }
 // Add only missing 1600m/2000m novice or maiden slots each month.
 // Leave graded races and pre-existing race IDs unchanged by appending new cards.
 for(const [type,label] of [['new','新馬戦'],['maiden','未勝利戦']]){
  for(const distance of [1600,2000]){
   if(cards.some(c=>c.classType===type&&Number(c.distance)===distance))continue;
   const ages=type==='new'&&targetMonth>=6?'2':'3+';
   const venue=venues[(distance===1600?0:1)%venues.length];
   const layout=venue==='新潟'&&distance>=1600?'外':venue==='京都'&&distance>=1400?'外':venue==='阪神'&&distance===1600?'外':'内';
   cards.push({name:`${calendarAgeLabel(ages)} ${label}`,venue,grade:'一般',distance,
    surface:'芝',layout,ages,female:false,weightRule:'馬齢',month:targetMonth,
    classType:type,gameOnly:true});
  }
 }
 return cards.map((card,i)=>({...card,calendarId:`${targetYear}-${targetMonth}-${i}`}));
}
let calendarCards=[];
function eligibleMonthlyRaceCards(){return calendarCards.filter(card=>!calendarCompleted.has(card.calendarId));}
function drawCalendar({preferred=null}={}){
 calendarCards=monthlyRaceCards();
 $('calendarDate').textContent=`${calendarYear}年目 ${calendarMonth}月`;
 $('classicSeasonInfo').textContent=annualClassicIntro();
 const selector=$('calendarRaceSelect');const chosenValue=preferred||selector.value;
 selector.innerHTML='';
 let options=0;
 const groups=new Map();
 for(const card of calendarCards){
  const key=card.classType==='graded'?'重賞':card.classType==='new'?'新馬戦':card.classType==='maiden'?'未勝利戦':card.classType==='open'?'オープン':'条件戦';
  if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]);groups.get(key).push(card);
 }
 for(const [label,cards] of groups){
  const optgroup=document.createElement('optgroup');optgroup.label=label;
  for(const card of cards){
   const completed=calendarCompleted.has(card.calendarId);
   const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=card.calendarId;option.disabled=completed;
   option.textContent=`${card.venue}｜${card.name}（${card.grade}・芝${card.distance}m）${completed?'【出走済】':''}`;
   optgroup.appendChild(option);if(!option.disabled)options++;
  }
  selector.appendChild(optgroup);
 }
 let toSelect=calendarCards.find(card=>card.calendarId===chosenValue&&!calendarCompleted.has(card.calendarId));
 if(!toSelect)toSelect=eligibleMonthlyRaceCards()[0];
 if(toSelect)selector.value=toSelect.calendarId;else selector.selectedIndex=-1;
 $('calendarPrepare').disabled=!options||race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout';
 $('calendarInfo').textContent=`${calendarYear}年目${calendarMonth}月：選択できる競走 ${options}件。${options===0?'今月の出走可能な競走はありません。翌月に進んでください。':'重賞の開催月と一般競走の番組を表示。'} 一般競走の番組はゲーム用です。`;
 refreshStableEntryPicker(toSelect);
 if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='race-home')df25RefreshRaceHome();
}

function advanceGameMonth(){
 if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout'){
  alert('レース中は月を進められません。ゴール後に進めてください。');return;
 }
 if(race==='idle'&&raceTickets.length&&!confirm('今月の発走前の馬券は返金して、翌月へ進みますか？'))return;
 if(race==='finished'&&!ticketsSettled)settleTickets();
 let bridge=null;
 try{bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;}catch(_){}
 if(!bridge?.advanceMonth){alert('牧場の読み込みが完了していません。牧場画面を開いてからお試しください。');return;}
 const previous=bridge.getState();
 // Single authoritative advance also triggers breeding/foaling and the farm save.
 bridge.advanceMonth();
 const current=bridge.getState();
 if(previous?.calendarYear!==current?.calendarYear||previous?.calendarMonth!==current?.calendarMonth)
   dfSyncGameCalendarFromFarm(current);
}
function recordCalendarFinish(){
 if(!activeCalendarCard||calendarCompleted.has(activeCalendarCard.calendarId))return;
 const starters=runners.map(h=>HORSE_BY_NAME.get(h.name)).filter(Boolean);
 for(const h of starters){
  const c=careerOf(h);c.starts++;
  if(h.classicSeasonYear===calendarYear&&calendarHorseAge(h)===3)
   calendarLastClassicStarts.set(h.name,{gameYear:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth});
 }
 df145RecordActualStarts(activeCalendarCard,starters);
 const winner=finished[0];
 if(winner){const horse=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(winner.name);if(horse)careerOf(horse).wins++;}
 // Record earned race purses for COM horses too. Owned-horse prize money is
 // already updated in stableAfterRaceFinish; do not award it twice.
 for(let pos=0;pos<Math.min(5,finished.length);pos++){
  const horse=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(finished[pos].name);
  if(!horse||horse.owner)continue;
  const earned=stableRaceWinnings(activeCalendarCard,pos);
  if(earned<=0)continue;
  const career=careerOf(horse);
  career.prize=(Number(career.prize)||0)+earned;
 }
 // JRA trial rights apply only to the next target G1 in the same 3yo season.
 for(const [target,places] of CLASSIC_TRIAL_RIGHTS[activeCalendarCard.name]||[]){
  for(const finisher of finished.slice(0,places)){
   const h=HORSE_BY_NAME.get(finisher.name);
   if(!h||calendarHorseAge(h)!==3)continue;
   if(h.sex==='牝'&&VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[target]&&!VERIFIED_CLASSIC_FILLIES[target].includes(h.originalName))continue;
   const pos=finished.findIndex(row=>row.name===finisher.name)+1;
   calendarTrialRights.set(trialRightsKey(h,target),{source:activeCalendarCard.name,place:pos});
  }
 }
 // Stored trial rights remain valid for this year only and survive reloads.
 for(const key of calendarTrialRights.keys())if(Number(key.split('|',1)[0])<calendarYear-1)calendarTrialRights.delete(key);
 stableAfterRaceFinish(activeCalendarCard);
 df133RecordRivals(runners); // Count once after a real finish; includes special G1 rivals.
 if(winner?.owner&&['GⅠ','G1'].includes(String(activeCalendarCard.grade)))window.DFV43UnlockVS?.();
 calendarCompleted.add(activeCalendarCard.calendarId);saveCalendarData();
 drawCalendar();
}

function frameNumberForHorseNo(no,n=STARTERS){
 if(!Number.isInteger(no)||no<1||no>n)throw new Error('Invalid horse number');
 if(n<8)return no; // Ver.32: VS small-field races use frames 1...n.
 const counts=Array(8).fill(Math.floor(n/8));

 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){offset+=counts[i];if(no<=offset)return i+1;}
 return 8;
}

function elevation(cfg,t){const h=cfg.hill||[0];const u=fract(t)*h.length,k=Math.floor(u),f=u-k,s=f*f*(3-2*f);return h[k]*(1-s)+h[(k+1)%h.length]*s}
class CoursePath{
 constructor(points,closed,distance,hand,routeId,width){this.points=points;this.closed=closed;this.distance=distance;this.hand=hand;this.routeId=routeId;this.width=width;this.lengths=[0];let sum=0;for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){sum+=points[i].distanceTo(points[i-1]);this.lengths.push(sum)}if(closed){sum+=points[points.length-1].distanceTo(points[0]);this.lengths.push(sum)}this.total=sum}
 get(u){u=this.closed?fract(u):clamp(u,0,1);let v=u*this.total,lo=0,hi=this.lengths.length-1;while(lo<hi){let m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(this.lengths[m]<v)lo=m+1;else hi=m}let idx=Math.max(0,lo-1),len=this.lengths[idx+1]-this.lengths[idx],f=len?(v-this.lengths[idx])/len:0,a=this.points[idx],b=this.points[(idx+1)%this.points.length];return a.clone().lerp(b,f)}
 pose(progress,lane=0){let t=this.closed?fract(progress):clamp(progress,0,1);if(this.hand<0)t=this.closed?fract(1-t):1-t;const p=this.get(t),prev=this.get(this.closed?fract(t-.00018):Math.max(0,t-.00018)),next=this.get(this.closed?fract(t+.00018):Math.min(1,t+.00018));const direction=next.sub(prev).normalize();if(this.hand<0)direction.multiplyScalar(-1);const normal=new THREE.Vector3(-direction.z,0,direction.x).normalize();p.addScaledVector(normal,clamp(lane,-this.width/2+2,this.width/2-2));return {position:p,direction,normal,yaw:Math.atan2(direction.x,direction.z),progress:progress,distanceM:progress*this.distance}}
}
function buildBand(path,width,yOff,m,shade=false){const steps=path.closed?720:280,positions=[],colors=[],uv=[],indices=[];const tint=new THREE.Color(),temp=new THREE.Color('#ffffff');for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
 const p=path.get(i/steps),prev=path.get((i-.25)/steps <0 && path.closed?1-0.25/steps:Math.max(0,(i-.25)/steps)),next=path.get(path.closed?fract((i+.25)/steps):Math.min(1,(i+.25)/steps));const v=next.sub(prev).normalize(),norm=new THREE.Vector3(-v.z,0,v.x).normalize();

}

}

  dfV51InfieldRails.push(posts)
}
// Slope the soil/grass beneath the racing surface down to the surrounding terrain.
// These visual skirts do not change the progress/heading API or race physics.
function addCourseShoulders(path,isDirt){
 const steps=path.closed?440:190;
 const matSide=isDirt?mats.dirtBank:mats.turfBank;
 for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const vertices=[],uvs=[],colors=[],index=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const u=i/steps, p=path.get(u),before=path.get(path.closed?fract(u-.001):Math.max(0,u-.001)),after=path.get(path.closed?fract(u+.001):Math.min(1,u+.001));
    const direction=after.sub(before).normalize(),norm=new THREE.Vector3(-direction.z,0,direction.x).normalize();
    for(let j=0;j<=4;j++){
      const q=j/4,offset=(path.width*.5+4.4)+q*13.8;
      const coord=p.clone().addScaledVector(norm,offset*side);
      // The top blends with the racing apron; the outside reaches the lawn level.
      let level=p.y-.20+(-.75-(p.y-.20))*Math.pow(q,1.6);
      vertices.push(coord.x,level,coord.z);uvs.push(u*32,q*3);
      const light=(1-q*.10)+(i%19<9?-.022:.012);colors.push(light,light,light);
      if(i<steps&&j<4){let k=i*5+j;index.push(k,k+5,k+1,k+1,k+5,k+6)}
    }
  }
  const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(vertices,3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs,2));
  geometry.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geometry.setIndex(index);geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const o=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,matSide);o.receiveShadow=true;group.add(o);
 }
}

function surface(route,path){
 const dirt=route==='dirt',straight=route==='turf_1000',outer=route==='turf_outer',inner=route==='turf_inner';
 addCourseShoulders(path,dirt);
 buildBand(path,path.width+(dirt?8:11),-.19,dirt?mats.dirtEdge:mats.turfEdge);
 buildBand(path,path.width,.035,dirt?mats.dirt:mats.turf,true);
 // Ver.72: no decorative longitudinal lines on the turf or dirt course.
 // Keep both running rails and all goal-line markings unchanged.
 if(activeVenue==='niigata'){
  // Ver.74: 手前のラチがゴールの馬を遮らないよう低く細くする。
  // 内側・外側の両方は引き続き表示する。
  rail(path,path.width/2+1.3,1.22,mats.white,.105,.10);
  rail(path,-path.width/2-1.3,1.22,mats.white,.105,.10);
 }else if(activeVenue==='hanshin'||activeVenue==='nakayama'||activeVenue==='tokyo'||activeVenue==='kyoto'){
  // Ver.85: slender, lowered active rails at the two problem venues.
  // Both sides remain in 3-D; the near rail no longer dominates the frame.
  rail(path,path.width/2+1.3,1.23,mats.white,.125,.115);
  rail(path,-path.width/2-1.3,1.15,mats.white,.125,.115);
 }else{rail(path,path.width/2+1.3,2.2);rail(path,-path.width/2-1.3,1.7);}
 // Thin running rail bottom safety bar. Not used on Hanshin/Nakayama,
 // where it appeared as an extra white line through the horses.
  if((outer||straight)&&!['hanshin','nakayama','tokyo','kyoto'].includes(activeVenue)){const steps=path.closed?350:160,pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
  const u=i/steps,p=path.get(u),bef=path.get(path.closed?fract(u-.0006):Math.max(0,u-.0006)),aft=path.get(path.closed?fract(u+.0006):Math.min(1,u+.0006)),dir=aft.sub(bef).normalize();p.addScaledVector(new THREE.Vector3(-dir.z,0,dir.x),path.width/2+1.3);p.y+=.87;pts.push(p)
 }
 const railLow=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts,path.closed),steps,.19,4,path.closed),mats.white);railLow.castShadow=false;group.add(railLow);dfV51InfieldRails.push(railLow)}
 if(straight){const end=path.get(1);box(1,1.4,path.width+4,end.x,end.y+.6,end.z,mats.white)}
}
// Draw a real-looking, *non-racing* adjacent track surface as scenery only.
// The existing race route geometry, centrelines, rails, finish, and physics are untouched.
function backgroundCourseSurface(route,path){
 const dirt=route==='dirt';
 addCourseShoulders(path,dirt);
 buildBand(path,path.width+(dirt?8:11),-.19,dirt?mats.dirtEdge:mats.turfEdge);
 buildBand(path,path.width,.035,dirt?mats.dirt:mats.turf,true);
 // Both sides of background dirt/turf remain bordered. Niigata's side
 // course rails are very low and silver-gray; avoid competing with the white
 // ACTIVE racing rails in a finish-line camera view.
 if(activeVenue==='niigata'){
  rail(path,path.width*.5+1.2,.86,mats.steel,.09,.095);
  rail(path,-path.width*.5-1.2,.86,mats.steel,.09,.095);
 }else if(activeVenue==='hanshin'||activeVenue==='nakayama'||activeVenue==='tokyo'||activeVenue==='kyoto'){
  // Ver.85: the neighbouring course is scenery, not the active racing lane.
  // Omit its fence objects where they visually cross the active racing rails.
  // The distinct dirt/turf surface is still drawn above.
 }else{
  rail(path,path.width*.5+1.2,1.45);
  rail(path,-path.width*.5-1.2,1.45);
 }
}

 for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const x=-810+i*96;box(92,.09,11,x,-.53,-336,mats.asphalt)}

 // parking lots with repeated bays make the outer grounds feel less empty.
 for(let row=0; row<2; row++){const z=row?530:-520; for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const x=-980+i*108; box(86,.08,40,x,-.60,z,mats.asphalt); for(let j=0;j<4;j++) box(1.5,.03,34,x-36+j*24,-.54,z,mats.white)}}
}
// Ver.3 textures are authored procedurally; no photographs or remote art assets required.
const texCache={};
function textureFromCanvas(kind,size=512){
 const key=kind+size;if(texCache[key])return texCache[key];
 const can=document.createElement('canvas');can.width=can.height=size;const c=can.getContext('2d'),r=randGen(2947+kind.length*299);c.clearRect(0,0,size,size);
 const image=c.createImageData(size,size),pix=image.data;
 for(let y=0;y<size;y++)for(let x=0;x<size;x++){
  const i=(y*size+x)*4,small=(Math.sin(x*.035)+Math.cos(y*.028))*.5,grain=r()-.5;
  let R,G,B;
  if(kind==='grass'){let stripe=((Math.floor(x/22)%2)===0?1:-1)*4;let v=small*9+grain*27+Math.sin(x*.7)*4+stripe;R=78+v;G=126+v*1.24;B=58+v*.72}
  else if(kind==='sand'){let lane=((Math.floor(y/20)%2)===0?1:-1)*2;let v=small*9+grain*47+lane;R=173+v;G=147+v*.83;B=112+v*.62}
  else if(kind==='asphalt'){let v=small*7+grain*26;R=101+v;G=107+v;B=105+v}
  else if(kind==='concrete'){let block=((Math.floor(x/64)+Math.floor(y/64))%2===0?1:-1)*2;let v=small*4+grain*12+block;R=192+v;G=198+v;B=194+v}
  else {let v=grain*22;R=73+v;G=123+v;B=150+v}
  pix[i]=R;pix[i+1]=G;pix[i+2]=B;pix[i+3]=255;
 }
 c.putImageData(image,0,0);
 if(kind==='grass'){for(let i=0;i<3200;i++){let x=r()*size,y=r()*size;c.strokeStyle=r()>.5?'#98be7e44':'#214d2640';c.lineWidth=.6+r()*.5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x+1.4,y-2.2-r()*3);c.stroke()} for(let i=0;i<size;i+=22){c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.025)'; c.lineWidth=2; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(i,0); c.lineTo(i,size); c.stroke()}}
 if(kind==='sand'){for(let i=0;i<size;i+=17){c.strokeStyle='#f5e0b014';c.lineWidth=1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,i);c.lineTo(size,i);c.stroke()} for(let i=0;i<26;i++){c.strokeStyle='rgba(120,90,55,.05)'; c.lineWidth=2; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0,r()*size); c.bezierCurveTo(size*.33,r()*size,size*.66,r()*size,size,r()*size); c.stroke()}}
 const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(can);tex.wrapS=tex.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;tex.anisotropy=Math.min(renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy(),8);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;texCache[key]=tex;return tex;
}
function facadeTexture(design){
 let key='facade:'+design;if(texCache[key])return texCache[key];
 let can=document.createElement('canvas'),c=can.getContext('2d');can.width=1024;can.height=512;
 let grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,512);grad.addColorStop(0,'#bad4d9');grad.addColorStop(.18,'#3d708b');grad.addColorStop(.48,'#547a8e');grad.addColorStop(.6,'#27485b');grad.addColorStop(.9,'#102f43');grad.addColorStop(1,'#6b91a4');c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(0,0,1024,512);
 const r=randGen(3556+design.length*555);for(let i=0;i<32;i++)for(let j=0;j<14;j++){
   let x=i*32+1,y=j*37+3;let lit=r()>.68;
   c.fillStyle=lit?'rgba(220,234,229,.28)':'rgba(10,30,44,.30)';c.fillRect(x,y,30,35);
   c.fillStyle='rgba(235,244,244,.14)';c.fillRect(x,y,30,2);
   if(r()>.8){c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.18)';c.fillRect(x+3,y+2,3,29)}
 }
 c.strokeStyle=design==='kyoto'?'#e1e8e9':'#aabcc0';c.lineWidth=3;
 for(let i=0;i<1024;i+=32){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(i,0);c.lineTo(i,512);c.stroke()}
 for(let j=0;j<512;j+=37){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,j);c.lineTo(1024,j);c.stroke()}
 const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(can);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;t.anisotropy=4;texCache[key]=t;return t;
}




function makeTerrainRoad(x,z,w,d,m=mats.asphalt){box(w,.12,d,x,-.39,z,m)}

// Ver.73: check EVERY course perimeter before placing scenery trees. The
// tested exclusion covers the running lanes, both rails, and tree-crown reach.
let dfV73ProtectedCourses=[];
function dfV73ClearOfCourses(x,z,crownRadius){
 for(const route of dfV73ProtectedCourses){
  const margin=route.width*.5+crownRadius+7, maxDist2=margin*margin;
  for(let i=1;i<route.points.length;i++){
   const a=route.points[i-1],b=route.points[i];
   const dx=b.x-a.x,dz=b.z-a.z,denom=dx*dx+dz*dz;
   const u=denom?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-a.x)*dx+(z-a.z)*dz)/denom)):0;
   const ex=x-a.x-u*dx,ez=z-a.z-u*dz;
   if(ex*ex+ez*ez<maxDist2)return false;
  }
 }
 return true;
}
function treeCluster(count,xMin,xMax,zMin,zMax,seed,size=9){
 const rng=randGen(seed),trunkGeo=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.35,.56,1,5),leafGeo=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),trunks=new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo,mats.trunk,count),crowns=new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafGeo,mats.leaf,count),t=new THREE.Object3D(),q=new THREE.Color();
 let placed=0;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  let pos=null;
  for(let tries=0;tries<24;tries++){
   const x=xMin+rng()*(xMax-xMin),z=zMin+rng()*(zMax-zMin),h=size*(.7+rng()*.85);
   if(dfV73ClearOfCourses(x,z,h*.62)){pos={x,z,h};break;}
  }
  if(!pos)continue; // Safe exclusion takes priority over the number of trees.
  const {x,z,h}=pos;
  t.position.set(x,h*.46,z);t.scale.set(1,h*.90,1);t.updateMatrix();trunks.setMatrixAt(placed,t.matrix);
  t.position.set(x,h*.91,z);t.scale.set(h*.47,h*.46,h*.52);t.updateMatrix();crowns.setMatrixAt(placed,t.matrix);
  q.setHSL(.275+rng()*.08,.24+rng()*.2,.26+rng()*.15);crowns.setColorAt(placed,q);
  placed++;
 }
 trunks.count=placed;crowns.count=placed;
 if(placed){trunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;crowns.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;trunks.castShadow=false;crowns.castShadow=false;group.add(trunks,crowns)}
}

// Ver.4 stand architecture: independently authored silhouettes for each venue.
// Approximate proportion and placement, NOT CAD, photogrammetry or exact as-built plans.
function layeredCanopy(g,w,frontY,backY,frontZ=157,backZ=288,overhang=16,capMat=mats.white){
 const coords=[frontZ,frontZ+13,frontZ+34,frontZ+65,backZ-13,backZ];
 const pos=[],ind=[],n=18;
 for(let k=0;k<=n;k++){
  const xx=(k/n-.5)*(w+overhang*2),side=Math.pow(Math.abs(xx)/((w+overhang*2)/2),2);
  for(let z of coords){const f=(z-frontZ)/(backZ-frontZ),curved=.8*Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*(1-.45*side);
   const y=frontY+(backY-frontY)*f+curved;pos.push(xx,y,z);
  }
 }
 const cols=coords.length;
 for(let k=0;k<n;k++)for(let j=0;j<cols-1;j++){const ix=k*cols+j;ind.push(ix,ix+cols,ix+1,ix+1,ix+cols,ix+cols+1)}
 const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));geo.setIndex(ind);geo.computeVertexNormals();
 const roof=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#edf2ef',metalness:.24,roughness:.48,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));roof.castShadow=true;roof.receiveShadow=true;g.add(roof);
 box(w+overhang*2,.85,1.2,0,frontY,frontZ,capMat,g);
 box(w+overhang*2,.65,1.4,0,backY,backZ,capMat,g);
 for(let x=-w*.48;x<=w*.48;x+=Math.max(12,w/24)){
  const beam=box(.5,.68,backZ-frontZ,x,(frontY+backY)*.5, (frontZ+backZ)*.5,mats.steel,g);
  beam.rotation.x=-(backY-frontY)/(backZ-frontZ);
 }
}
function faceGlass(g,w,h,y,z,design){
 const glass=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w,h),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:facadeTexture(design),color:'#cadde5',roughness:.2,metalness:.42,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
 glass.position.set(0,y,z);g.add(glass);
 const step=Math.max(9,w/30);
 for(let x=-w/2;x<=w/2;x+=step)box(.55,h,.75,x,y,z+.3,mats.silver,g);
 for(let yy=y-h/2+6;yy<y+h/2;yy+=7.5)box(w,.48,.68,0,yy,z+.3,mats.silver,g);
}
function standModule(parent,opts){
 const {x=0,w,z=216,levels=4,roof=49,depth=103,tiers=10,glassDesign='tokyo',openSeats=true,roofRise=3,roofFront=158,roofBack=286}=opts;
 const g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(x,0,0);parent.add(g);
 const wall=glassDesign==='nakayama'?mats.warm:mats.concrete;
 box(w+8,3.5,depth,0,1.4,z+31,wall,g); // podium
 box(w+7,roof-6,depth*.64,0,(roof-6)/2+6,z+54,wall,g);
 // Multi-floor glazing / physical terraces. No billboard-only front.
 const facadeZ=z+23;
 for(let level=0;level<levels;level++){
  const y=13+level*(roof-20)/Math.max(1,levels-1);
  faceGlass(g,w-5,Math.min(6.4,(roof-20)/levels+3),y,facadeZ+.85,glassDesign);
  box(w+8,1.15,7,0,y+4,facadeZ+1.8,mats.white,g);
  box(w+6,.28,8,0,y+4.65,facadeZ+1.8,mats.steel,g);
 }
 if(openSeats){
  const seatRows=tiers;
  for(let r=0;r<seatRows;r++){
   const y=5.7+r*1.43,zz=171+r*3.35;
   box(w+2,.74,3.6,0,y,zz,mats.concrete,g);
   box(w+1,.22,3.4,0,y+.42,zz,mats.walk,g);
   if(r%4===0)box(w,.35,.38,0,y+1.1,zz-1.5,mats.steel,g);
  }
  // density bounded, smaller blocks share materials
  const seatGeo=new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.26,.53,1.05),countPerRow=Math.floor(w/3.2),count=countPerRow*seatRows;
  const seats=new THREE.InstancedMesh(seatGeo,mats.seatBlue,count),o=new THREE.Object3D();let i=0;
  for(let r=0;r<seatRows;r++)for(let col=0;col<countPerRow;col++){
   o.position.set(-w/2+(col+.5)*w/countPerRow,6.4+r*1.43,171+r*3.35);
   o.updateMatrix();seats.setMatrixAt(i++,o.matrix);
  }
  seats.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;seats.castShadow=false;g.add(seats);
  const crowdCount=Math.floor(count*.26),person=new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(.38,.55,2,4),mats.people,crowdCount),c=new THREE.Object3D(),rnd=randGen(Math.floor(w*31)+roof+tiers);
  for(let i=0;i<crowdCount;i++){
   const r=Math.floor(rnd()*seatRows),col=Math.floor(rnd()*countPerRow);
   c.position.set(-w/2+(col+.5)*w/countPerRow,7.3+r*1.43,171+r*3.35);
   c.rotation.y=rnd()*1.4;c.updateMatrix();person.setMatrixAt(i,c.matrix);person.setColorAt(i,new THREE.Color(['#e6e8dc','#b64f41','#586d87','#9b8869','#282e38'][Math.floor(rnd()*5)]));
  }
  person.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;person.castShadow=false;g.add(person);
 }
 layeredCanopy(g,w,roof+roofRise,roof+roofRise+4,roofFront,roofBack,15,mats.silver);
 for(let bx=-w*.45;bx<w*.49;bx+=Math.max(17,w/12)){
  box(.95,roof*.4,1.2,bx,roof*.78,roofBack-15,mats.concrete,g);
 }
 return g;
}

function buildFinish(v,path,finishFraction){
 // Ver.75: Keep the narrow finish line, place identical small goal boards
 // BEYOND both racing rails, and select only the far-side board at render time.
 // This is course scenery only; the result calculation is unchanged.
 const pose=path.pose(finishFraction,0);
 const line=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(path.width+.5,.035,.26),mats.white);
 line.position.copy(pose.position);
 line.position.y+=.15;
 line.rotation.y=pose.yaw;
 line.castShadow=false;line.receiveShadow=false;
 line.name='df73-thin-finish-line';
 group.add(line);
 const boards=[];
 for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const root=new THREE.Group();
  root.name=side===1?'df75-goal-board-side-plus':'df75-goal-board-side-minus';
  // Wider clearance than the former Niigata board, so neither board overhangs
  // a horse lane or the rails. Side +/- comes from the ACTUAL racing path.
  const edgeClearance=v.design==='tokyo'?7:v.design==='niigata'?9:10; // past outer rail without huge offscreen displacement
  const where=pose.position.clone().addScaledVector(pose.normal,side*(path.width*.5+edgeClearance));
  root.position.copy(where);group.add(root);
  const niigataGoal=v.design==='niigata';
  const poleH=niigataGoal?4.2:5.1;
  const pole=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.10,.15,poleH,8),mats.silver);
  pole.position.y=poleH/2;pole.name='df75-goal-post';root.add(pole);
  const face=sign(niigataGoal?3.6:4.6,niigataGoal?1.03:1.35,
    0,niigataGoal?4.6:5.63,0,'GOAL','#ffffff','#17445d',root,pose.yaw+Math.PI/2);
  face.name='df75-goal-face';
  face.material.depthWrite=false;
  boards.push({side,root});
 }
 return {center:pose.position.clone(),normal:pose.normal.clone(),boards};
}

let materialsReady=false;
let dfV51InfieldRails=[];
const venueByJapaneseName=Object.freeze({'東京':'tokyo','中山':'nakayama','阪神':'hanshin','京都':'kyoto','新潟':'niigata'});
function mount(parent,hostThree,hostRenderer,raceCard,raceLength){
  THREE=hostThree;renderer=hostRenderer;
  const id=venueByJapaneseName[raceCard.venue]||'tokyo';
  const venue=VENUES[id];
  const preferred=raceCard.layout==='直線'?'turf_1000':raceCard.surface==='ダート'?'dirt':raceCard.layout==='内'?'turf_inner':'turf_outer';
  const route=venue.layout[preferred]?preferred:'turf_outer';
  // Each race gets fresh materials and textures; Ver.46's original mesh disposer owns them.
  Object.keys(mats).forEach(key=>delete mats[key]);
  Object.keys(texCache).forEach(key=>delete texCache[key]);
  unitBox=boxGeometry();
Object.assign(mats,{turf:mat('#d6e8cf',{vertexColors:true,map:textureFromCanvas('grass'),bumpMap:textureFromCanvas('grass'),bumpScale:.085,roughness:1}),turfEdge:mat(['tokyo','kyoto'].includes(id)?'#c8dfc3':'#607f54',{map:textureFromCanvas('grass')}),turfBank:mat(['tokyo','kyoto'].includes(id)?'#c8dfc3':'#708c5e',{map:textureFromCanvas('grass'),vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,roughness:1}),turfStripe:mat('#7fad67'),dirt:mat('#e9d4b2',{vertexColors:true,map:textureFromCanvas('sand'),bumpMap:textureFromCanvas('sand'),bumpScale:.12,roughness:1}),dirtEdge:mat('#a68763',{map:textureFromCanvas('sand')}),dirtBank:mat('#aa9876',{map:textureFromCanvas('sand'),vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,roughness:1}),white:mat('#f5f8f0'),black:mat('#1a2a2e'),gold:mat('#dfbd64',{metalness:.2}),accent:mat('#ffe5a0',{emissive:'#bfa04b',emissiveIntensity:.3}),glass:mat('#4a7890',{metalness:.62,roughness:.18}),steel:mat('#7c97a2',{metalness:.75,roughness:.31}),silver:mat('#cfd9dd',{metalness:.46,roughness:.28}),warm:mat('#d7cec0'),concrete:mat('#e6e8e4',{map:textureFromCanvas('concrete')}),stone:mat('#dad8c5'),seatBlue:mat('#43667f'),seatGreen:mat('#8b9d98'),people:mat('#f9f8f0'),dark:mat('#152e37'),leaf:mat('#458251'),paleFlower:mat('#f5cbd6'),trunk:mat('#79664f'),water:mat('#a1daed'),lamp:mat('#fff7e6',{emissive:'#ffffdd'}),park:mat('#90b17f',{map:textureFromCanvas('grass')}),sand:mat('#c1b09b',{map:textureFromCanvas('sand')}),walk:mat('#c6cdc2',{map:textureFromCanvas('concrete')}),farBuilding:mat('#8c9f9e'),farBlue:mat('#778d9b'),blue:mat('#2f5b7b'),asphalt:mat('#a3a49f',{map:textureFromCanvas('asphalt')}),sandTrace:mat('#9e7e5d')});
  dfV51InfieldRails=[];
  activeVenue=id;activeRoute=route; // Ver.74: route-specific rail styling during surface construction.
  group=new THREE.Group();group.name='DERBY-FANTASY-V6-'+id+'-'+route;parent.add(group);
  geometries={};
  createGround(7+(Object.keys(VENUES).indexOf(id)+1)*888);
  for(const [rid,cfg] of Object.entries(venue.layout))geometries[rid]=makePath(cfg,venue.hand,rid);
  // Ver.73: Draw all real course regions as independent 3-D surfaces. The dirt
  // ring receives its own sand material even when the active race is on turf.
  // Keep the active course above the background rings in overlapping sections.
  // Ver.85: at Hanshin/Nakayama, inactive turf courses share their home
  // straight with the active turf route. Superimposing both sets of rails
  // drew fences across the horses in portrait race footage. Only show the
  // visually distinct neighbouring dirt/turf surface on these two venues.
  const sceneryRoutes=(id==='niigata'||id==='nakayama'||id==='hanshin'||id==='kyoto')
   ?(route==='dirt'?['turf_outer']:['dirt'])
   :Object.keys(geometries).filter(rid=>rid!==route).sort((a,b)=>
     (a==='dirt'?-1:0)-(b==='dirt'?-1:0));
  for(const rid of sceneryRoutes)backgroundCourseSurface(rid,geometries[rid]);
  surface(route,geometries[route]);
  // Each protected course includes BOTH verges and the crown of each tree.
  dfV73ProtectedCourses=Object.values(geometries).map(path=>{
   const pts=path.points.filter((p,i)=>i%4===0).map(p=>({x:p.x,z:p.z}));
   if(path.closed&&pts.length)pts.push({...pts[0]});
   return {width:path.width,points:pts};
  });
  buildStand(venue);facadeCloseUp(venue);scenery(venue);buildInfield(venue);racecourseTrackside(venue);
  // Existing Ver.46 gate remains authoritative; do not superimpose Ver.6's dummy gates.
  activeVenue=id;activeRoute=route;
  const path=geometries[route];
  let finishFraction=1;
  if(!path.closed)finishFraction=1;
  else {
    let best=Infinity;
    for(let i=0;i<2400;i++){
      const t=i/2400,p=path.pose(t).position;
      const score=Math.pow(p.x-venue.goal,2)+Math.pow(p.z-venue.layout[route].front,2)*7;
      if(score<best){best=score;finishFraction=t;}
    }
  }
  const finishBoards=buildFinish(venue,path,finishFraction);
  return {
    name:venue.name,id,route,root:group,width:path.width,
    cameraSideRails:dfV51InfieldRails,
    goalBoards:finishBoards,
    // Draw this very same active course as a static outline in the small UI.
    // No second course model or new race progression is introduced.
    minimap:{closed:path.closed,points:Array.from({length:181},(_,i)=>{
      const p=path.pose(i/180,0).position;return {x:p.x,z:p.z};
    }),finish:(()=>{const p=path.pose(finishFraction,0).position;return {x:p.x,z:p.z};})()},
    centerAt(distance){
      const fraction=path.closed?finishFraction+(distance-raceLength)/path.distance:1+(distance-raceLength)/path.distance;
      const pose=path.pose(fraction);
      return pose.position;
    },
    clampLateral(lateral){return Math.max(-path.width/2+2.3,Math.min(path.width/2-2.3,lateral));}
  };
}
return {mount};
})();

 },

  },{d:Infinity,i:0}).i;

 },

function dfV75UpdateGoalBoards(){
 const world=dfV47World,finish=world?.goalBoards;
 if(!finish||!camera)return;
 // Two real course-side 3D goal boards exist at the actual finish in each of
 // Tokyo / Nakayama / Hanshin / Kyoto / Niigata. Only the far-side board may
 // appear, so no tall board obstructs a runner in the near racing lanes.
 const signed=camera.position.clone().sub(finish.center).dot(finish.normal);
 const farSide=signed>=0?-1:1;
 const selected=finish.boards.find(b=>b.side===farSide);
 for(const b of finish.boards){
  b.root.visible=b===selected;
  const face=b.root.getObjectByName('df75-goal-face');
  if(!face)continue;
  face.lookAt(camera.position);
  // When the sign is physically on-screen, avoid hiding it behind the distant
  // grandstand mesh. The other (near-side) board remains fully invisible.
  face.material.depthTest=false;face.material.depthWrite=false;
  face.renderOrder=5;
 }

}

// World-space path: first straight, 180-degree turn, home straight.
// Arc length is continuous, and both straights join the curve tangentially.
// Keep the last 400m as a straight for every automatically drawn race distance.
let BEND_START=TOTAL-720,BEND_END=TOTAL-400,BEND_R=60,Z_BEND=0;
function updateTrackShape(){
 currentCourse=courseFromRace(currentRace);
 const bendLength=Math.PI*currentCourse.R/LENGTH;
 BEND_START=TOTAL-currentCourse.straight-bendLength;
 BEND_END=TOTAL-currentCourse.straight;
 BEND_R=currentCourse.R;
 Z_BEND=currentCourse.S/2;
}
function trackAt(d){
 if(dfV47World)return dfV47World.centerAt(d);
 if(!currentCourse)return new THREE.Vector3(0,0,START_Z+d*LENGTH);
 if(currentCourse.straightOnly)return new THREE.Vector3(0,0,(d-TOTAL)*LENGTH);
 const {lap,R,S,turnSign}=currentCourse;
 const perimeter=lap*LENGTH,curve=Math.PI*R;
 const phase=((d-TOTAL)*LENGTH%perimeter+perimeter)%perimeter;
 let x,z;
 if(phase<curve){const a=phase/R;x=-R*Math.cos(a);z=S/2+R*Math.sin(a);}
 else if(phase<curve+S){x=R;z=S/2-(phase-curve);}
 else if(phase<2*curve+S){const a=(phase-curve-S)/R;x=R*Math.cos(a);z=-S/2-R*Math.sin(a);}
 else{x=-R;z=-S/2+(phase-2*curve-S);}
 x*=turnSign;
 // Grade-dependent elevations reflect course undulations, not survey-level laser data.
 const hill=Math.sin(2*Math.PI*phase/perimeter+1.1)*currentCourse.gradient*.20;
 return new THREE.Vector3(x,hill*.20,z);
}
function headingAt(d){
 const eps=.2,a=trackAt(d-eps),b=trackAt(d+eps);
 return b.sub(a).normalize();
}
function inwardAt(d){const t=headingAt(d);return new THREE.Vector3(-t.z,0,t.x).normalize();}
function trackOffset(d,lateral){return trackAt(d).addScaledVector(inwardAt(d),lateral);}
function dfV47VisualLane(lane){
 if(!dfV47World)return lane*2.30;
 const laneSpacing=Math.min(2.30,(dfV47World.width-4.6)/Math.max(1,STARTERS-1));
 return dfV47World.clampLateral(lane*laneSpacing);
}
const centerAt=d=>trackAt(d).x;

// Ver.33: result rows always follow the actual complete finish order, never a fixed top-five board.
const romanRank=n=>['Ⅰ','Ⅱ','Ⅲ','Ⅳ','Ⅴ','Ⅵ','Ⅶ','Ⅷ'][n-1]||String(n);
const ranks=()=>[...runners].sort((a,b)=>b.dist-a.dist||(a.finishedAt!=null&&b.finishedAt!=null?a.finishedAt-b.finishedAt:a.no-b.no));
const formatTime=t=>`${Math.floor(t/60)}:${(t%60).toFixed(1).padStart(4,'0')}`;
// Ver.54: margin to the horse immediately in front, NOT the winner.
// Convert the two finish timestamps to approximate horse lengths at their
// average finish-line speed (2.4m per horse length). Unlike displayed tenths,
// use the underlying high-precision crossing times for close finishes.
function finishMargin(previous,current){
 const gap=Math.max(0,current.finishedAt-previous.finishedAt);
 const speed=clamp((previous.velocity+current.velocity)/2,10,23);
 const lengths=gap*speed/2.4;
 if(lengths<.12)return 'ハナ';
 if(lengths<.24)return 'アタマ';
 if(lengths<.44)return 'クビ';
 if(lengths<.625)return '1/2馬身';
 if(lengths<.875)return '3/4馬身';
 if(lengths>=10)return '大差';
 const quarters=Math.max(4,Math.round(lengths*4));
 const whole=Math.floor(quarters/4),fraction=quarters%4;
 const parts=['','1/4','1/2','3/4'];
 return (whole+(fraction?' '+parts[fraction]:'')+'馬身');
}
// ===== Ver.90 source section: 09_three_geometry_helpers.js | 3D用部品・テクスチャ・文字板 =====
function makeMaterial(color,rough=.87){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:rough,metalness:.02});}
function box(sx,sy,sz,mat,x,y,z,parent,shadows=true){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(sx,sy,sz),mat);m.position.set(x,y,z);if(shadows){m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true}parent.add(m);return m;}
function ball(rx,ry,rz,mat,x,y,z,parent){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,12,9),mat);m.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m;}
function tube(a,b,r,material,parent){const delta=new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b,a), m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,delta.length(),6),material);m.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(.5);m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),delta.normalize());parent.add(m);return m;}
// Ver.22: higher-detail, seamless procedural turf. This changes ONLY the scenic ground texture.
function writeTexture(){
 const wet=currentWeather==='雨'||currentGoing==='重'||currentGoing==='不良';
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=512;
 const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');let seed=127;
 const rnd=()=>{seed=(Math.imul(1664525,seed)+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;};
 const ground=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,512,512);
 ground.addColorStop(0,wet?'#6c8552':'#83cf77');
 ground.addColorStop(.48,wet?'#5b7845':'#68bd62');
 ground.addColorStop(1,wet?'#526e3d':'#57a95d');
 ctx.fillStyle=ground;ctx.fillRect(0,0,512,512);
 // Alternating, irregular mowing light: restrained contrast to avoid hard flat stripes.
 for(let y=0;y<512;y+=64){
  ctx.fillStyle=(y/64)%2===0?'rgba(246,255,214,.075)':'rgba(22,67,37,.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(0,y,512,64);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(245,255,215,.04)';ctx.fillRect(0,y+6,512,2);
 }
 for(let i=0;i<14500;i++){
  const x=rnd()*512,y=rnd()*512,blade=1.3+rnd()*6.0;
  const shade=rnd();
  ctx.strokeStyle=wet
   ?(shade<.5?'rgba(191,208,121,.19)':'rgba(37,82,38,.19)')
   :(shade<.38?'rgba(224,244,147,.22)':shade<.75?'rgba(28,120,56,.23)':'rgba(246,255,211,.16)');
  ctx.lineWidth=.45+rnd()*.80;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);
  ctx.lineTo(x+(rnd()-.5)*2.5,y-blade);ctx.stroke();
 }
 for(let i=0;i<1250;i++){
  const x=rnd()*512,y=rnd()*512,r=.4+rnd()*1.8;
  ctx.fillStyle=wet?'rgba(30,66,35,.13)':'rgba(22,91,36,.10)';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*.64,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 }
 if(wet){for(let i=0;i<95;i++){
  const x=rnd()*512,y=rnd()*512;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(206,224,226,.065)';ctx.fillRect(x,y,10+rnd()*20,.65);
 }}
 const tx=new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);tx.wrapS=tx.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
 tx.repeat.set(10,76);tx.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
 tx.anisotropy=renderer&&renderer.capabilities?Math.min(4,renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy()):1;
 return tx;
}

function buildStartGate(parent){
 startGateGroup=new THREE.Group();parent.add(startGateGroup);startGateDoors=[];
 const base=trackAt(0),forward=headingAt(0);
 startGateGroup.position.set(base.x,0,base.z);
 startGateGroup.rotation.y=Math.atan2(forward.x,forward.z);
 const metal=makeMaterial('#d4e0e5',.52),shadowMetal=makeMaterial('#566d7d',.7),bars=makeMaterial('#b9cbd0',.6),floorMetal=makeMaterial('#485b60',.85),roof=makeMaterial('#607b83',.65),wheel=makeMaterial('#202831',.97);
 const steelDark=makeMaterial('#304b58',.39),steelBright=makeMaterial('#c1d9e2',.36),accentGold=makeMaterial('#d2b46c',.36),signalGlass=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:'#f5f4d9'});
 const step=2.30,stallW=2.13,gateFront=2.70,gateBack=-2.78,top=3.02;
 const xmin=-((STARTERS-1)/2)*step-stallW/2,xmax=-xmin;
 // Roof, overhead truss, continuous structural bracing and towing wheels.
 box(xmax-xmin+.5,.17,5.76,roof,0,top+.07,-.05,startGateGroup,false);
 for(const z of [gateBack,gateFront]){
  box(xmax-xmin+.34,.15,.14,shadowMetal,0,top-.11,z,startGateGroup,false);
  box(xmax-xmin+.34,.09,.10,metal,0,top-.70,z,startGateGroup,false);
 }
 // Ver.84: high truss and multiple signs below are assembled after stall columns.
 // No overhead surface is placed low enough to obscure the jockeys.
 // Outer-side framework is visible in rear and oblique camera angles.
 for(const edge of [xmin,xmax]){
  for(const z of [gateBack,gateFront])box(.115,top,.115,metal,edge,top/2,z,startGateGroup,false);
  for(const y of [.52,1.18,2.02,top-.05])box(.085,.075,gateFront-gateBack,shadowMetal,edge,y,(gateFront+gateBack)/2,startGateGroup,false);
  for(const z of [gateBack+.35,gateFront-.35]){
   const w=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.26,.075,7,16),wheel);
   w.rotation.y=Math.PI/2;w.position.set(edge+(edge<0?-.15:.15),.35,z);startGateGroup.add(w);
  }
 }
 for(let i=0;i<STARTERS;i++){
  const cx=(i-(STARTERS-1)/2)*step,left=cx-stallW/2,right=cx+stallW/2;
  // Dividers: open rail panels (horses remain visible through them), not solid walls.
  for(const x of [left,right]){
   for(const z of [gateBack,gateFront])box(.085,top,.085,metal,x,top/2,z,startGateGroup,false);
   for(const y of [.52,1.18,2.04])box(.048,.055,gateFront-gateBack,bars,x,y,-.04,startGateGroup,false);
  }
  for(const z of [gateBack,gateFront])box(stallW+.05,.08,.075,metal,cx,top-.10,z,startGateGroup,false);
  // Number plates 1-18, colored by their eight JRA-style frames.
  const plate=makeGateNumber(i+1,FRAME_COLORS[frameNumberForHorseNo(i+1)-1],frameTextColor(i+1));
  plate.position.set(cx,top+.10,gateFront+.13);startGateGroup.add(plate);
  const rearCross=box(stallW-.24,.075,.07,shadowMetal,cx,1.23,gateBack+.03,startGateGroup,false);
  // Grated floor: short crossbars, no high solid platform that would hide hooves.
  for(let z=gateBack+.6;z<gateFront-.15;z+=.75){box(stallW-.38,.035,.045,floorMetal,cx,.025,z,startGateGroup,false)}
  // Real hinged gate: the two half-panels rotate around the left and right posts.
  const leafWidth=stallW/2-.03;
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
   const hinge=new THREE.Group();hinge.position.set(side<0?left:right,0,gateFront+.055);startGateGroup.add(hinge);
   const leafDir=side<0?1:-1;
   for(const y of [.46,1.05,1.66,2.17]){
    box(leafWidth,.066,.064,bars,leafDir*leafWidth/2,y,0,hinge,false);
   }
   box(.072,1.86,.068,metal,leafDir*(leafWidth-.03),1.32,0,hinge,false);
   box(.085,2.0,.08,shadowMetal,0,1.29,0,hinge,false);
   for(const offset of [leafWidth*.36,leafWidth*.67]){
    box(.045,1.62,.048,shadowMetal,leafDir*offset,1.31,0,hinge,false);
   }
   startGateDoors.push({hinge,angle:side<0?-Math.PI*.54:Math.PI*.54});
  }
 }
 // Ver.84: realistic, lightweight mobile-friendly race-day gate bodywork.
 // All additions are above stall tops or outside the two end lanes. Opening
 // door hinges, gate positions, lane pitch and starting physics stay untouched.
 const gateUnitBox=new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);
 const gateUnitRod=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1,1,1,6);
 const upAxis=new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
 const beam=(x,y,z,w,h,d,material)=>{
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(gateUnitBox,material);
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);mesh.scale.set(w,h,d);
  mesh.castShadow=false;startGateGroup.add(mesh);return mesh;
 };
 const diagonal=(a,b,r,material)=>{
  const first=new THREE.Vector3(...a),last=new THREE.Vector3(...b);
  const vector=last.clone().sub(first);
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(gateUnitRod,material);
  mesh.position.copy(first).add(last).multiplyScalar(.5);
  mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(upAxis,vector.clone().normalize());
  mesh.scale.set(r,vector.length(),r);
  mesh.castShadow=false;startGateGroup.add(mesh);
 };
 const span=xmax-xmin;
 // Stiff structural members run the whole row of stalls.
 beam(0,3.23,-.05,span+.66,.13,5.9,steelDark);
 beam(0,3.55,gateFront+.17,span+.52,.12,.22,accentGold);
 beam(0,3.89,gateFront+.07,span+.52,.12,.19,steelBright);
 beam(0,4.68,gateFront+.07,span+.52,.12,.19,steelDark);
 beam(0,3.55,gateBack-.16,span+.52,.11,.19,steelDark);
 for(const x of [xmin-.12,xmax+.12]){
  beam(x,3.85,gateFront+.12,.16,1.65,.20,steelDark);
  beam(x,3.85,gateBack-.11,.16,1.65,.20,steelDark);
  // Side protection and towing components sit outside the racing lanes.
  beam(x,1.08,(gateBack+gateFront)/2,.18,.16,5.85,steelDark);
  beam(x,1.64,gateBack+.10,.18,.70,.22,accentGold);
 }
 // Triangulated overhead steel cross-bracing: economical, shared geometry.
 for(let i=0;i<STARTERS;i+=2){
  const a=xmin+i*step,b=Math.min(xmax,a+2*step);
  const middle=(a+b)*.5;
  beam(middle,3.58,gateFront+.13,.09,.54,.10,steelDark);
  diagonal([a,3.23,gateFront+.13],[middle,3.84,gateFront+.13],.048,steelBright);
  diagonal([middle,3.84,gateFront+.13],[b,3.23,gateFront+.13],.048,steelBright);
  diagonal([a,3.23,gateBack-.10],[middle,3.54,gateBack-.10],.036,steelDark);
  diagonal([middle,3.54,gateBack-.10],[b,3.23,gateBack-.10],.036,steelDark);
 }
 // Front-facing race-day boards: visible from the start camera, but fully
 // above the horses. Divide across wide 18-stall gates instead of one tiny sign.
 const bannerCount=STARTERS>=13?3:STARTERS>=8?2:1;
 const bannerSpan=span/bannerCount;
 for(let i=0;i<bannerCount;i++){
  const message=i===0?'DERBY FANTASY':i===bannerCount-1&&i>0?'STARTING GATE':'RACE DAY';
  const bannerWidth=Math.max(5.0,bannerSpan-.58);
  const banner=makeTextPlane(message,'#1c5549','#ffefd0',bannerWidth);
  // Constrain banner height so it stays above all horse/jockey silhouettes.
  banner.scale.y=1.00/(bannerWidth*140/512);
  banner.position.set(xmin+bannerSpan*(i+.5),4.15,gateFront+.24);
  startGateGroup.add(banner);
 }
 // Recessed top marker lamps, placed strictly outside the front gates.
 for(let i=0;i<=STARTERS;i+=3){
  const x=Math.min(xmax,xmin+i*step);
  beam(x,4.82,gateFront+.28,.55,.13,.20,steelDark);
  beam(x,4.91,gateFront+.31,.32,.12,.09,signalGlass);
 }
}
function updateGateAnimation(dt){
 // Ver.80: the start gate is temporary. A later lap goes over the same
 // coordinates, so it MUST disappear once the last horse has cleared it.
 // Do not delete it: rebuilding a new race needs the closed gate again.
 if(startGateGroup){
  const allClear=runners.length>0&&runners.every(h=>(h.dist||0)>23);
  startGateGroup.visible=!allClear&&race!=='finished'&&race!=='runout';
 }
 // Finish opening before the horses reach the front posts; leave the doors open
 // during pauses, after the finish, and while a fresh race has not been set up.
 const target=race==='idle'?0:1;
 gateOpen=target?Math.min(1,gateOpen+dt*6.5):Math.max(0,gateOpen-dt*8);
 const eased=gateOpen*gateOpen*(3-2*gateOpen);
 for(const door of startGateDoors)door.hinge.rotation.y=door.angle*eased;
}

 function facadeTexture(label,w=1536,h=768,variant=0){

   for(let k=0;k<340;k++){ const x=76+((k*37+r*19+variant*13)%(w-152)), dy=((k*17+r*11)%34); ctx.fillStyle=k%5===0?'rgba(248,236,206,.52)':k%3===0?'rgba(82,42,26,.33)':'rgba(18,43,68,.25)'; ctx.fillRect(x,y+7+dy,4,9); }

  const leafMat=makeMaterial(crown,.90), leafMat2=makeMaterial(style.tree2,.90);
  const crown1=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(3.2*scale,16,12),leafMat); crown1.position.set(0,8.4*scale,0); crown1.scale.set(1.10,1.0,.96); crown1.rotation.z=leafTilt; g.add(crown1);
  const crown2=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.4*scale,14,10),leafMat2); crown2.position.set(2.0*scale,9.0*scale,.8*scale); crown2.scale.set(.96,.88,.94); g.add(crown2);
  const crown3=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(2.0*scale,14,10),leafMat); crown3.position.set(-1.8*scale,8.8*scale,-1.2*scale); crown3.scale.set(.98,.86,.9); g.add(crown3);
 }
 function addOuterTreeLine(count,baseOffset=132,spread=34){

  }
 }
 function addTokyoKeyaki(){

// DERBY FANTASY: decorative cherry blossom grounds. Geometry stays outside the racing lanes.
// These scene objects are non-interactive and are recreated/disposed with each racecourse.
function addFantasyRacecourseDecor(parent){
 const group=new THREE.Group();parent.add(group);
 const sign=currentCourse.direction==='左'?-1:1;
 const wet=currentWeather==='雨'||currentGoing==='重'||currentGoing==='不良';
 let seed=33503;const rnd=()=>{seed=(1664525*seed+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;};
 function blossomTexture(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=512;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  // Clusters of many individual blossoms, with transparent space around the crown.
  const clusters=[];
  for(let n=0;n<225;n++){
   const ang=rnd()*Math.PI*2,radius=Math.sqrt(rnd()),x=256+Math.cos(ang)*190*radius,
     y=254+Math.sin(ang)*145*radius;if(x<65||x>448||y<80||y>447)continue;
   clusters.push([x,y,3.2+rnd()*4.0,rnd()]);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha=.35;
  const halo=ctx.createRadialGradient(256,255,24,256,255,195);
  halo.addColorStop(0,'#ffd2e9');halo.addColorStop(.6,'#ffb7d9');halo.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,225,239,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=halo;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(256,257,193,151,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1;
  for(const [x,y,r,b] of clusters){
   const colors=['#fff8fb','#ffe3ed','#f9a9c9','#f5bedf','#fcece6','#ff96bb'];
   for(let p=0;p<5;p++){
    const a=p*Math.PI*2/5+b;
    ctx.fillStyle=colors[(p+Math.floor(b*6))%colors.length];
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+Math.cos(a)*r*.77,y+Math.sin(a)*r*.77,r*.85,r*.58,a,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#fff6ba';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r*.24,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  }
  const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return tex;
 }
 function flowerTexture(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=256;c.height=128;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  for(let i=0;i<95;i++){
   const x=15+rnd()*228,y=22+rnd()*88,r=1.8+rnd()*4.5;
   ctx.fillStyle=['#ffb4ce','#ffdef0','#fff8e7','#f3a5db','#fff0a6'][i%5];
   for(let p=0;p<5;p++){const a=p*2*Math.PI/5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+Math.sin(a)*r,r*.85,r*.65,a,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
   ctx.fillStyle='#e6b753';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r*.3,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.fill();
  }
  const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return tex;
 }
 function cloudTexture(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=512;c.height=256;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const x=110+i*47,y=143-((i*31)%48),r=62+(i%3)*18;
   const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.82)');g.addColorStop(.65,'rgba(255,250,253,.55)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
   ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
  const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return tex;
 }
 const sakura=blossomTexture(),flowers=flowerTexture(),clouds=cloudTexture();
 const bark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#76584c',roughness:1});
 const pink=new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:sakura,transparent:true,alphaTest:.02,depthWrite:false,opacity:wet?.78:1});
 const blooms=new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:flowers,transparent:true,depthWrite:false,opacity:wet?.75:1});
 const whiteClouds=new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:clouds,transparent:true,depthWrite:false,opacity:wet?.35:.83,fog:true});
 const step=Math.max(105,TOTAL/18);
 for(let d=70;d<TOTAL-35;d+=step){
  // Two rows outside the white rails; staggered for depth and variety.
  for(let side=0;side<2;side++){
   if(side===1 && Math.floor(d/step)%2===0)continue;
   const offset=(side===0?sign:-sign)*(39+side*12+(rnd()*9));
   const at=trackOffset(d+side*step*.33,offset),scale=.75+rnd()*.42;
   const trunk=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.29*scale,.51*scale,6*scale,8),bark);
    trunk.position.set(at.x,3.0*scale,at.z);group.add(trunk);
    // Ver.22: fine forked branches reveal a natural tree shape below the blossom canopy.
    for(const fork of [-1,1]){
     const branch=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.10*scale,.22*scale,4.4*scale,6),bark);
     branch.position.set(at.x+fork*1.00*scale,6.15*scale,at.z+.30*scale);
     branch.rotation.z=-fork*.53;group.add(branch);
    }
    const crown=new THREE.Sprite(pink);crown.position.set(at.x,9.2*scale,at.z);
   crown.scale.set(10*scale,8.5*scale,1);group.add(crown);
   const cluster=new THREE.Sprite(pink);cluster.position.set(at.x-3.1*scale,7.5*scale,at.z+2.1*scale);
   cluster.scale.set(6.6*scale,5.5*scale,1);group.add(cluster);
  }
 }
 // Flowerbeds just OUTSIDE the race rails. No physical collider or effect on the horses.
 for(let d=40;d<TOTAL;d+=Math.max(90,TOTAL/20)){
  const at=trackOffset(d,sign*(29.5+rnd()*3));
  const patch=new THREE.Sprite(blooms);patch.position.set(at.x,.75,at.z);
  patch.scale.set(7.0+rnd()*3.5,2.3+rnd()*1.5,1);group.add(patch);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<6;j++){
  const at=trackOffset(TOTAL-95-j*65,sign*(140+j*18));
  const cloud=new THREE.Sprite(whiteClouds);cloud.position.set(at.x,62+(j%3)*13,at.z);
   cloud.scale.set(74+(j%3)*21,33+(j%2)*12,1);group.add(cloud);
  }
  // Ver.22: distant soft spring clouds at a second depth layer; no camera changes.
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++){
   const at=trackOffset(Math.max(60,TOTAL-280-j*165),sign*(220+j*17));
   const high=new THREE.Sprite(whiteClouds);
   high.position.set(at.x,96+(j%2)*13,at.z);
   high.scale.set(114+(j%2)*30,41+(j%3)*9,1);group.add(high);
  }
}

// ===== Ver.22: lightweight, decorative spring landscape ONLY =====
// Nothing created here is a collider, a runner, a camera control or a race-rule value.
function addV22ScenicDetails(parent){
 const side=currentCourse.direction==='左'?-1:1;
 let seed=220026;const random=()=>{seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;};
 const group=new THREE.Group();group.name='v22-scenic-only';parent.add(group);
 const flowerPalette=['#ffd7e9','#fff5e5','#f2a6ce','#f8eaa2'];
 const shrubMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#477e45',roughness:1});
 const shrubGeo=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1);
 const flowerGeo=new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1);
 const location=[];
 const spacing=Math.max(42,TOTAL/41);
 for(let d=38;d<TOTAL+10;d+=spacing){
  for(let bank=0;bank<2;bank++){
   // Both floral borders stay OUTSIDE the existing +/-25m safety rails.
   const offset=(bank===0?side:-side)*(30.5+(bank?4.0:0)+random()*2.8);
   const p=trackOffset(d+(bank?.28:0)*spacing,offset);
   location.push({p,seed:random(),bank});
  }
 }
 // Batching all shrubs into one InstancedMesh maintains mobile-friendly scene cost.
 const shrubs=new THREE.InstancedMesh(shrubGeo,shrubMat,location.length);
 const temp=new THREE.Object3D();
 location.forEach(({p,seed},i)=>{
  temp.position.set(p.x,.55+seed*.12,p.z);
  temp.rotation.set(0,seed*6.28,0);
  temp.scale.set(1.5+seed*.9,.62+seed*.22,1.9+seed*.85);
  temp.updateMatrix();shrubs.setMatrixAt(i,temp.matrix);
 });
 shrubs.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;shrubs.frustumCulled=false;group.add(shrubs);
 // Pastel blossoms stand just above the shrubberies. Four merged instances batches.
 flowerPalette.forEach((color,c)=>{
  const flowerMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,emissive:color,emissiveIntensity:.11,roughness:.95});
  const blooms=new THREE.InstancedMesh(flowerGeo,flowerMat,location.length*3);
  let count=0;
  location.forEach(({p,seed},i)=>{
   for(let petal=0;petal<3;petal++){
    if((i+petal)%flowerPalette.length!==c)continue;
    const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=.25+random()*1.40;
    temp.position.set(p.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,.9+random()*.75,p.z+Math.sin(angle)*distance);
    temp.rotation.set(random(),random()*6.28,random());
    const size=.29+random()*.30;temp.scale.set(size,size*.75,size);
    temp.updateMatrix();blooms.setMatrixAt(count++,temp.matrix);
   }
  });
  blooms.count=count;blooms.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true;
  blooms.frustumCulled=false;group.add(blooms);
 });
 // Low ornamental planted hedges near the outside of the finishing straight.
 const leaf=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#618d55',roughness:.97});
 const bronze=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#e3c17d',roughness:.42,metalness:.23});
 const ivory=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:'#fff8ed',roughness:.65});
 for(let d=Math.max(35,TOTAL-355);d<TOTAL-38;d+=53){
  const at=trackOffset(d,side*38.2),t=headingAt(d),g=new THREE.Group();
  g.position.copy(at);g.rotation.y=Math.atan2(t.x,t.z);group.add(g);
  // Stands on the landscaping side; does not change the fence or racing surface.
  box(3.4,.22,10,ivory,0,.12,0,g,false);
  box(2.8,.75,9.4,leaf,0,.55,0,g,false);
  box(.23,.18,10.4,bronze,-1.50,.19,0,g,false);
  box(.23,.18,10.4,bronze,1.50,.19,0,g,false);
 }
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 12_track_build_and_goal.js | 芝・ラチ・ゴール板・コース生成 =====
function rebuildCourse(){
 dfV52Director.reset();
 dfV47World=null;
 // Dispose old course meshes before creating the track for the new distance.
 if(courseGroup){
  scene.remove(courseGroup);
  const geom=new Set(),mat=new Set(),tex=new Set();
  courseGroup.traverse(o=>{if(!o.isMesh&&!o.isSprite)return;if(o.isMesh&&o.geometry)geom.add(o.geometry);
   for(const m of (Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])){if(!m)continue;mat.add(m);if(m.map)tex.add(m.map)}});
  geom.forEach(g=>g.dispose());mat.forEach(m=>m.dispose());tex.forEach(t=>t.dispose());
 }
 courseGroup=new THREE.Group();scene.add(courseGroup);
 // Ver.47: Use the actual 5-courses Ver.6 stadium mesh and course centerline.
 try{
   dfV47World=DFV47CourseScenery.mount(courseGroup,THREE,renderer,currentRace,TOTAL);

   buildStartGate(courseGroup);
   if(startGateGroup && dfV47World){
     startGateGroup.position.y=dfV47World.centerAt(0).y;
     startGateGroup.scale.x=Math.min(1,(dfV47World.width-3.0)/Math.max(1,STARTERS*2.30+1));
   }
   return;
 }catch(venueError){
   console.error('DF Ver.47 five-course scene unavailable: falling back to Ver.46 scenic surface',venueError);
   dfV47World=null;
   dfV75Minimap.prepare();

   startGateGroup=null;
 }
