function resize(){
 if(!renderer)return;
 const vp=$('viewport');
 const w=Math.round(vp.clientWidth),h=Math.round(vp.clientHeight);
 // This element is intentionally display:none on the farm/newspaper pages.
 // NEVER allocate a 0x0 drawing buffer: that can leave ONLY the static sky.
 if(w<8||h<8)return;
 const current=renderer.getSize(new THREE.Vector2());
 const pixelRatio=renderPixelRatio();
 if(current.x!==w||current.y!==h||Math.abs(renderer.getPixelRatio()-pixelRatio)>.001||
    renderer.domElement.width<8||renderer.domElement.height<8){
  renderer.setPixelRatio(pixelRatio);
  renderer.setSize(w,h,false);
 }
 if(!Number.isFinite(camera.aspect)||Math.abs(camera.aspect-w/h)>.0001){
  camera.aspect=w/h;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
 }
}
// ===== Ver.90 source section: 13_horse_and_jockey_models.js | 馬体・騎手・走行アニメーション =====
// Anatomically guided procedural Thoroughbred model. +Z is the running direction.
function skinMaterial(color,rough=.88){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:rough,metalness:0.0,side:THREE.FrontSide});}
function pathSegment(parent,mat,a,b,r1,r2,ns=10){
 const vec=b.clone().sub(a);
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,1,ns,1),mat);
 mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(.5);mesh.scale.set(1,vec.length(),1);
 mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),vec.normalize());
 mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
function setBone(mesh,a,b){const d=b.clone().sub(a);mesh.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(.5);mesh.scale.y=d.length();mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),d.normalize());}
function makeBone(parent,mat,r1,r2){const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,1,12,1),mat);mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;}
function smoothBody(parent,rings,mat){
 // Ring-based, continuous, smoothly shaded horse torso, instead of intersecting spheres.
 // Input rings run from dock of tail to chest: [z, centerHeight, lateralRadius, verticalRadius].
 const controls=rings.map(([z,y,w,h])=>new THREE.Vector3(z,y,w));
 const crossCount=24,sections=(rings.length-1)*5+1;
 const pos=[],cols=[],indices=[];const col=new THREE.Color(mat.color),light=col.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),.10),shadow=col.clone().multiplyScalar(.75);
 function cat(i,dt,k){const l=rings.length;const p0=rings[Math.max(0,i-1)][k],p1=rings[i][k],p2=rings[Math.min(l-1,i+1)][k],p3=rings[Math.min(l-1,i+2)][k];return .5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*dt+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*dt*dt+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*dt*dt*dt);}
 for(let i=0;i<sections;i++){
   const segment=Math.min(rings.length-2,Math.floor(i/5)),t=(i===sections-1)?1:(i/5-segment);
   const z=cat(segment,t,0),y=cat(segment,t,1),r=Math.max(.012,cat(segment,t,2)),h=Math.max(.02,cat(segment,t,3));
   for(let j=0;j<=crossCount;j++){
    const a=j/crossCount*Math.PI*2,cos=Math.cos(a),sin=Math.sin(a);
    pos.push(Math.sin(a)*r,y+cos*h,z);
    const c=shadow.clone().lerp(light,(cos+1)*.5);cols.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
   }
 }
 for(let i=0;i<sections-1;i++)for(let j=0;j<crossCount;j++){
  const a=i*(crossCount+1)+j,b=a+crossCount+1;
  indices.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
 }
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(cols,3));g.setIndex(indices);g.computeVertexNormals();
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(g,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,roughness:.94}));mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);return mesh;
}
function loftNeck(parent,points,coat){
 const c=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(0,p[0],p[1])));
 const ringCount=32,segments=14,pos=[],indices=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=ringCount;i++){
  const t=i/ringCount,p=c.getPoint(t),tangent=c.getTangent(t).normalize();
  const s=t*(points.length-1),idx=Math.min(points.length-2,Math.floor(s)),a=s-idx;
  const xRadius=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(points[idx][2],points[idx+1][2],a);
  const yzRadius=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(points[idx][3],points[idx+1][3],a);
  // tangent=(0,dy,dz); cross-section perpendicular in the y-z plane.
  const ny=-tangent.z,nz=tangent.y;
  for(let j=0;j<=segments;j++){
   const theta=j/segments*Math.PI*2,ct=Math.cos(theta),st=Math.sin(theta);
   pos.push(st*xRadius,p.y+ct*yzRadius*ny,p.z+ct*yzRadius*nz);
  }
 }
 for(let i=0;i<ringCount;i++)for(let j=0;j<segments;j++){const a=i*(segments+1)+j,b=a+segments+1;indices.push(a,b,a+1,a+1,b,b+1)}
 const geometry=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));geometry.setIndex(indices);geometry.computeVertexNormals();
 const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:coat,roughness:.88,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));mesh.castShadow=true;mesh.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(mesh);
 return mesh;
}
function oval(parent,material,sx,sy,sz,x,y,z){
 const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,20,14),material);m.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);m.position.set(x,y,z);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;parent.add(m);return m;
}
function makeLegGroup(parent,side,hind,coat,hard,hoof){
 const root=new THREE.Group();parent.add(root);
 const upper=makeBone(root,coat,hind?.155:.13,hind?.085:.075);
 const mid=makeBone(root,coat,hind?.095:.075,.046);
 const lower=makeBone(root,hard,.055,.039);
 const kneeJoint=oval(root,coat,.09,.092,.088,0,0,0);
 const hockJoint=oval(root,coat,.066,.075,.072,0,0,0);
 const hoofMesh=oval(root,hoof,.105,.065,.16,0,0,0);
 const pastern=makeBone(root,coat,.050,.055);
 return {root,upper,mid,lower,kneeJoint,hockJoint,hoofMesh,pastern,side,hind};
}
// A racing gallop is a four-beat sequence, not the diagonal two-beat trot.
// Each hoof has its own contact interval: the hind pair land first, then
// the front pair, followed by a short suspension.  While planted, the hoof
// tracks backwards relative to the running horse; in recovery it lifts and
// swings forwards.  All animation is visual and NEVER affects race speed.
function gallopStep(cycle,contact,duty=.23){
 const u=(cycle-contact+1)%1;
 const ease=t=>t*t*(3-2*t);
 if(u<duty){
  const t=ease(u/duty);
  return {sweep:1-2*t,lift:0,fold:0,planted:true};
 }
 const t=(u-duty)/(1-duty),e=ease(t);
 const arc=Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*t),1.35);
 return {sweep:-1+2*e,lift:arc,fold:Math.sin(Math.PI*t),planted:false};
}
function poseLeg(leg,cycle,stride,bodyLift=0,leadRight=true){
 const x=leg.side*.31;
 // On the ground, the hoof is held at the same world-space height even
 // while the barrel bobs.  The swing phase bends the joints to clear turf.
 if(stride<=.001){
  let A,B,C,D,P;
  if(!leg.hind){
   A=new THREE.Vector3(x,1.39,.83);
   B=new THREE.Vector3(x,.97,.79);
   C=new THREE.Vector3(x,.51,.87);
   D=new THREE.Vector3(x,.17,.90);
   P=new THREE.Vector3(x,.077,1.00);
  }else{
   A=new THREE.Vector3(x*.91,1.40,-1.02);
   B=new THREE.Vector3(x*.91,.99,-.72);
   C=new THREE.Vector3(x*.91,.55,-1.28);
   D=new THREE.Vector3(x*.91,.17,-1.25);
   P=new THREE.Vector3(x*.91,.077,-1.31);
  }
  setBone(leg.upper,A,B);setBone(leg.mid,B,C);
  setBone(leg.lower,C,D);setBone(leg.pastern,D,P);
  leg.kneeJoint.position.copy(B);leg.hockJoint.position.copy(C);
  leg.hoofMesh.position.copy(P);leg.hoofMesh.rotation.x=0;
  return;
 }
 // Opposite lead horses run mirrored contact sequences.  A true gallop
 // does not strike both forehooves or both hindhooves simultaneously.
 const leadingSide=leadRight?1:-1;
 const contact=leg.hind
  ?(leg.side===leadingSide?.19:.075)
  :(leg.side===leadingSide?.57:.435);
 const foot=gallopStep(cycle,contact,leg.hind?.24:.205);
 const fold=foot.fold*stride,reach=foot.sweep*stride;
 // Suspended hooves fold deeply; planted hooves skim the grass.
 const hoofLift=foot.lift*stride*(leg.hind?.35:.43);
 const groundY=Math.max(.035,.075-bodyLift)+hoofLift;
 let A,B,C,D,P;
 if(!leg.hind){
  A=new THREE.Vector3(x,1.39,.83);
  // Elbow is kept under the shoulder, while the carpus bends forwards
  // before the cannon reaches out for the next landing.
  B=new THREE.Vector3(x,.96+.065*fold,.76+.055*reach);
  C=new THREE.Vector3(x,.50+.19*fold,.88+.28*reach+.25*fold);
  D=new THREE.Vector3(x,groundY+.105,.89+.55*reach-.11*fold);
  P=new THREE.Vector3(x,groundY,.99+.57*reach-.11*fold);
 }else{
  const hx=x*.91;
  A=new THREE.Vector3(hx,1.40,-1.02);
  // Stifle drives forward; the hock folds back underneath the haunch
  // for recovery, then extends forcefully behind for the propulsive push.
  B=new THREE.Vector3(hx,.99+.10*fold,-.73+.13*reach+.12*fold);
  C=new THREE.Vector3(hx,.55+.22*fold,-1.28+.24*reach-.25*fold);
  D=new THREE.Vector3(hx,groundY+.095,-1.25+.54*reach-.09*fold);
  P=new THREE.Vector3(hx,groundY,-1.32+.57*reach-.09*fold);
 }
 setBone(leg.upper,A,B);setBone(leg.mid,B,C);
 setBone(leg.lower,C,D);setBone(leg.pastern,D,P);
 leg.kneeJoint.position.copy(B);leg.hockJoint.position.copy(C);
 leg.hoofMesh.position.copy(P);
 // Slight pastern/hoof flex on weight bearing; point toe in recovery.
 leg.hoofMesh.rotation.x=foot.planted?-.055*stride:.10*foot.lift*stride;
}



function animateHorseRig(h,dt=0){
 if(!h.horseRig)return;
 const rig=h.horseRig;
 // Pause freezes the limbs in their current pose instead of snapping
 // them to a standing frame.  A stationary horse stands with all 4 hooves.
 if(race==='paused')return;
 const active=race==='running'||race==='runout';
 const spd=h.velocity||0;
 const stride=active?clamp((spd-1.3)/13.4,0,1):0;
 const leadRight=h.no%2===0;
 if(h.gaitCycle===undefined)h.gaitCycle=((h.phase||0)/(2*Math.PI))%1;
 if(active){
  // Hoof beats track the simulated (not real-world) time, including 2x/4x.
  // Accumulating phase avoids abrupt changes as velocity ramps up.
  const beatsPerSecond=1.48+.039*Math.min(spd,18);
  h.gaitCycle=(h.gaitCycle+Math.max(0,dt)*beatsPerSecond)%1;
 }
 const cycle=h.gaitCycle;
 // Push-off follows the last forehoof contact. A brief flight occurs
 // before the first hind hoof reaches the grass in the next stride.
 const flight=(cycle>.78)?Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI*(cycle-.78)/.22),1.15):0;
 const compress=(cycle>.56&&cycle<.75)?Math.sin(Math.PI*(cycle-.56)/.19):0;
 const bodyLift=active?(.025+.145*flight-.015*compress)*stride:0;
 rig.horse.position.y=bodyLift;
 rig.horse.rotation.x=active?(.021*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*(cycle-.12))+.018*flight)*stride:0;
 poseLeg(rig.legs.hl,cycle,stride,bodyLift,leadRight);
 poseLeg(rig.legs.hr,cycle,stride,bodyLift,leadRight);
 poseLeg(rig.legs.fl,cycle,stride,bodyLift,leadRight);
 poseLeg(rig.legs.fr,cycle,stride,bodyLift,leadRight);
 rig.neckPivot.rotation.x=active?.033*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*(cycle+.16))*stride:0;
 rig.headPivot.rotation.x=active?.025*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*(cycle+.08))*stride:0;
 // Ver.150: a pulling horse raises its head while the jockey regains control.
 if(active&&h.df150?.pullLeft>0){rig.neckPivot.rotation.x+=.09;rig.headPivot.rotation.x+=.12;}
 rig.tail.rotation.x=active?.075*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*(cycle+.35))*stride:0;
 h.rider.position.y=active?.012*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*(cycle+.16))*stride:0;
}

// Ver.153: race-only coat display. The horse's saved coatType remains unchanged.
// Include the three previously unmapped owned-horse coats (they used to appear as bay).
const RACE_COAT_MAP={
 '鹿毛':'bay','黒鹿毛':'dark_bay','青鹿毛':'seal_brown','栗毛':'chestnut',
 '栃栗毛':'liver_chestnut','芦毛':'gray','白毛':'white','青毛':'black',
 '月毛':'palomino','河原毛':'buckskin','尾花栗毛':'flaxen_chestnut'
};
// Individual horses keep a stable, subtle shade within their recorded coat category.
// No random redraw on refresh, replay, or race entry; no save-data changes.
function dfV152RaceCoatForHorse(def){
 const base=RACE_COAT_MAP[String(def?.coatType||'').trim()]||'bay';
 if(base!=='bay'&&base!=='chestnut'&&base!=='gray')return base;
 const id=String(def?.originalName||def?.name||def?.id||'')+'|'+String(def?.coatType||'');
 let hash=2166136261;
 for(let i=0;i<id.length;i++)hash=Math.imul(hash^id.charCodeAt(i),16777619)>>>0;
 if(base==='bay'&&hash%3===0)return 'bay_light';
 if(base==='chestnut'&&hash%3===1)return 'chestnut_light';
 if(base==='gray'&&hash%3===2)return 'gray_dark';
 return base;
}

function dfV129GetRaceAtlas(coat){
 if(!dfV129HorseBase.complete||!dfV129HorseBase.naturalWidth)return null;
 if(coat==='bay')return dfV129HorseBase;

 }

 for(let i=0;i<pixels.length;i+=4){
  const weight=mask[i+3]/255; // Ver.132: saturated body-only mask; no rider/frame color spill
  if(weight<.015||pixels[i+3]===0)continue;

  const shade=Math.max(.30,Math.min(1.52,l/112));
  pixels[i]=pixels[i]*(1-weight)+Math.min(255,rgb[0]*shade)*weight;
  pixels[i+1]=pixels[i+1]*(1-weight)+Math.min(255,rgb[1]*shade)*weight;
  pixels[i+2]=pixels[i+2]*(1-weight)+Math.min(255,rgb[2]*shade)*weight;
 }

}
// Ver.130: select a sprite from the camera's COMMON viewing axes, not each
// horse-to-camera position vector. Horses heading in parallel must show the
// same orientation even when they occupy opposite edges of the screen.
const raceInverse=new THREE.Quaternion();
const raceCamQuat=new THREE.Quaternion();
const raceCameraBack=new THREE.Vector3();
const raceCameraRight=new THREE.Vector3();
const raceCameraUp=new THREE.Vector3();
const raceHorseForward=new THREE.Vector3();
function selectRaceSpriteDirection(runner){
 // The horse travels along its local +Z. Its world heading can legitimately
 // change on a bend; its lateral position within the pack must not matter.
 runner.root.getWorldQuaternion(raceInverse);
 raceHorseForward.set(0,0,1).applyQuaternion(raceInverse);
 const screenX=raceHorseForward.dot(raceCameraRight);
 const horizontal=Math.hypot(raceCameraBack.x,raceCameraBack.z);
 let angle;
 if(horizontal>.10){
  // 0 = facing viewer, 2 = facing left, 4 = going away, 6 = facing right.
  const faceViewer=(raceHorseForward.x*raceCameraBack.x+
   raceHorseForward.z*raceCameraBack.z)/horizontal;
  angle=Math.atan2(-screenX,faceViewer);
 }else{
  // Direct overhead: the camera's horizontal bearing is undefined.
  // Select from the horse's SCREEN heading instead of a noisy tiny vector.
  const screenY=raceHorseForward.dot(raceCameraUp);
  angle=Math.atan2(-screenX,-screenY);
 }
 let oct=((Math.round(angle/(Math.PI/4))%8)+8)%8;
 // 3-degree hysteresis stops sprite flipping across an octant boundary.
 // It affects only visible image selection, not horse trajectory or camera.
 const previous=RACE_SPRITE_DIRECTIONS.indexOf(runner.spriteArt?.dir);
 if(previous>=0){
  const delta=Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-previous*Math.PI/4),
                          Math.cos(angle-previous*Math.PI/4));
  if(Math.abs(delta)<Math.PI/8+Math.PI/60)oct=previous;
 }
 return RACE_SPRITE_DIRECTIONS[oct];
}
// Ver.82: cache at most two tinted sprite poses for each horse. Blending
// them near a frame boundary removes the hard 7-frame 'click' without
// changing gait timings, actual runner speed, number, costume or race logic.
function dfV82SpriteCacheFrame(art,runner,loaded,dir,row,ix,slot){
 const frame=art.smoothFrames[slot];
 if(frame.dir===dir&&frame.ix===ix&&frame.rev===raceSpriteTintRevision)return frame.canvas;
 frame.ctx.clearRect(0,0,200,160);
 frame.ctx.drawImage(loaded,ix*200,row*160,200,160,0,0,200,160);
 paintRaceRiderColor(art,'helmet',art.helmet,ix,row,frame.ctx);
 paintRaceRiderColor(art,'silks',art.silk,ix,row,frame.ctx);
 // Ver.129: plain saddlecloth; no race number is painted onto the sprite.
 frame.dir=dir;frame.ix=ix;frame.rev=raceSpriteTintRevision;
 return frame.canvas;
}
function updateRaceHorseSprites(){
 if(!camera)return;
 // Camera pose is already updated by setCam() for this render frame.
 // Calculate a single shared viewing basis before drawing any runner.
 raceCameraBack.set(0,0,1).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
 raceCameraRight.set(1,0,0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
 raceCameraUp.set(0,1,0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
 const active=race==='running'||race==='runout'||race==='paused';
 const frames=7;
 for(const runner of runners){
  const art=runner.spriteArt;
  if(!art)continue;
  if(active&&race!=='paused'){
   const beats=1.48+.039*Math.min(runner.velocity||0,18);
   // Ease only the visible leg-cycle cadence as a horse accelerates. The
   // travelled distance, physics velocity and race clock are untouched.
   if(!Number.isFinite(runner.spriteGaitRate))runner.spriteGaitRate=beats;
   const a=1-Math.exp(-Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,renderDeltaSeconds))*7);
   runner.spriteGaitRate+=(beats-runner.spriteGaitRate)*a;
   runner.gaitCycle=((runner.gaitCycle||0)+Math.max(0,renderDeltaSeconds)*speed*dfV59PlaybackScale*runner.spriteGaitRate)%1;
  }
  const dir=selectRaceSpriteDirection(runner),row=RACE_SPRITE_DIRECTIONS.indexOf(dir);
  const phase=active?(((runner.gaitCycle||0)%1)*frames):0;
  const ix=Math.floor(phase)%frames,frac=phase-Math.floor(phase);
  // Hold the clear original pose for most of the beat, then blend across its
  // final 38%. This avoids constant double silhouettes and hard frame pops.
  const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(frac-.62)/.38));
  const mix=active?u*u*(3-2*u):0;
  const nextIx=(ix+1)%frames;
  const loaded=art.mecha?(df153MechaAtlas.complete&&df153MechaAtlas.naturalWidth===1400?df153MechaAtlas:null):dfV129GetRaceAtlas(art.coat);
  if(!loaded||(loaded.naturalWidth||loaded.width)!==1400)continue;
  if(!art.smoothFrames){
   art.smoothFrames=Array.from({length:2},()=>{
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=200;canvas.height=160;
    return {canvas,ctx:canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true}),dir:null,ix:-1,rev:-1};
   });
  }
  // Repaint only when a pose/direction/tint changes or the blended fraction
  // advances visibly. The expensive rider color overlays are cached.
  if(art.dir!==dir||art.frame!==ix||art.rev!==raceSpriteTintRevision||
      !art.hasRendered||Math.abs((art.smoothMix??-1)-mix)>.035){
   const current=dfV82SpriteCacheFrame(art,runner,loaded,dir,row,ix,0);
   art.ctx.clearRect(0,0,200,160);
   art.ctx.globalAlpha=1;art.ctx.drawImage(current,0,0);
   if(mix>.001){
    const next=dfV82SpriteCacheFrame(art,runner,loaded,dir,row,nextIx,1);
    art.ctx.globalAlpha=mix;art.ctx.drawImage(next,0,0);
    art.ctx.globalAlpha=1;
   }
   art.texture.needsUpdate=true;
   art.dir=dir;art.frame=ix;art.rev=raceSpriteTintRevision;
   art.smoothMix=mix;art.hasRendered=true;
  }
  runner.root.getWorldQuaternion(raceCamQuat);raceCamQuat.invert();
  art.plane.quaternion.copy(raceCamQuat).multiply(camera.quaternion);
  if(race!=='paused'){
   const bend=dfV56BendAt(runner.dist);
   const target=(race==='running'||race==='runout')?bend.side*bend.strength*.033:0;
   art.cornerBank=(art.cornerBank||0)+(target-(art.cornerBank||0))*(1-Math.exp(-Math.max(.001,renderDeltaSeconds)*6));
  }
  art.plane.rotateZ(art.cornerBank||0);
 }
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 14_tactics_and_master_effects.js | 脚質・追走位置・マスタ能力補正 =====
// Compare 逃げ+先行 vs 差し+追込 only among the eight entrants.
// The less numerous side receives a small per-race pace benefit; 4:4 gets none.
// If one side has zero starters, nobody gets a bonus. No permanent stats are changed.
function assignTacticBalanceBonuses(starters){
 const frontCount=starters.filter(h=>h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行').length;
 const backCount=starters.filter(h=>h.tactic==='差し'||h.tactic==='追込').length;
 const smaller=frontCount>0&&backCount>0&&frontCount!==backCount
  ?(frontCount<backCount?'front':'back'):null;
 const minorityBonus=Math.min(.27,Math.abs(frontCount-backCount)*.045);
 for(const h of starters){
  const group=(h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行')?'front':'back';
  h.tacticBalanceBonus=smaller===group?minorityBonus:0;
 }
}
// Ver.71: keep a clear running-style formation THROUGHOUT the race.
// Position guidance never fades out. A closer's target moves FORWARD only when
// their designated finishing run starts; it remains an active position target.
// Actual passing still uses travelled distance and velocity (no scripted placings).
const TACTIC_STAGES=Object.freeze({'逃げ':0,'先行':1,'差し':2,'追込':3});
function assignTacticPositions(field){
 const fieldOrder=[...field].sort((a,b)=>(TACTIC_STAGES[a.tactic]??2)-(TACTIC_STAGES[b.tactic]??2)
  || (b.raceEarly+b.raceSp*.18)-(a.raceEarly+a.raceSp*.18) || a.no-b.no);
 const spacing=field.length>=15?5.2:field.length>=11?5.9:6.4;
 for(let i=0;i<fieldOrder.length;i++){
  const h=fieldOrder[i];
  h.tacticPositionRank=i;
  h.tacticPositionOffset=((fieldOrder.length-1)*.5-i)*spacing;
  h.tacticPositionSpacing=spacing;
 }
}
// Ver.171: decide when to prepare and launch a closer's finishing run from
// actual leader gap, finishing ability, distance suitability and stamina.
// This controls running decisions only: it never assigns placings or edits stats.
function df171CloserKickPlan(h,order){
 if(h.tactic!=='差し'&&h.tactic!=='追込')return null;
 const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-h.dist);
 const base=h.tactic==='差し'?Math.min(1050,TOTAL*.49):Math.min(880,TOTAL*.43);
 const finishingAbility=.62*h.raceKick+.23*h.raceSp+.15*h.raceSta;
 const suitability=clamp(h.distanceFactor/.92,.45,1);
 const staminaReserve=clamp((h.raceSta-65)/55,.25,1);
 const maximum=Math.max(base,Math.min(TOTAL*.72,base+280+530*staminaReserve));
 // Read both the actual leader and the leading 逃げ/先行 group. Never decide
 // not to chase because the horse is too far back or unlikely to win.
 const front=order.filter(o=>o!==h&&o.finishedAt===null&&(o.tactic==='逃げ'||o.tactic==='先行'));
 const frontDist=front.length?Math.max(...front.map(o=>o.dist)):h.dist;
 const leaderDist=order.length?order[0].dist:h.dist;
 const gap=Math.max(0,Math.max(frontDist,leaderDist)-h.dist);
 h.df171Gap=gap;
 // Estimate how much road is needed to close the gap at this horse's own
 // potential finishing pace. Cap the earlier launch by stamina and race length.
 const closingPace=clamp((.62+(finishingAbility-75)*.027)*suitability,.55,1.65);
 const necessaryRoad=gap*16.35/closingPace+160;
 const candidate=clamp(Math.max(base,necessaryRoad),base,maximum);
 h.df171KickTarget=Math.max(Number(h.df171KickTarget)||base,candidate);
 if(!Number.isFinite(h.df171KickStart)&&remaining<=h.df171KickTarget){
  h.df171KickStart=h.df171KickTarget;
 }
 return {remaining,gap,kickTarget:h.df171KickTarget,
  preparationStart:Math.min(TOTAL*.82,h.df171KickTarget+220)};
}
function tacticPositionDrive(h,order,progress){
 const center=order[Math.floor(order.length/2)].dist;
 const style=h.tactic;
 let desiredOffset=h.tacticPositionOffset;
 if(style==='差し'||style==='追込'){
  // Begin moving into a usable position *before* the planned acceleration.
  // Ability-based real speed and stamina still decide whether a pass succeeds.
  const base=style==='差し'?Math.min(1050,TOTAL*.49):Math.min(880,TOTAL*.43);
  const chaseStart=Math.max(base,h.df171KickTarget||base);
  const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-h.dist);
  const preparationStart=Math.min(TOTAL*.82,chaseStart+220);
  const launch=clamp((preparationStart-remaining)/preparationStart,0,1);
  const move=Math.pow(launch,1.05);
  const realAbility=(.48*h.raceKick+.32*h.raceSp+.20*h.raceSta);
  const fitness=clamp((realAbility-73)/24,.36,1.07)*clamp(h.distanceFactor/.9,.42,1);
  const frontOffset=(order.length-1)*.5*h.tacticPositionSpacing;
  const finalAim=frontOffset+(style==='追込'?5:2.5);
  desiredOffset+=(finalAim-h.tacticPositionOffset)*move*fitness;
  // Prepare a forward position before kicking, and do not let the old
  // rear-pack formation brake a closer trying to catch the leaders. This
  // remains inside the original guide cap and actual fitness/ability factors.
  if(remaining<=preparationStart&&h.df171Gap>15){
   const begun=Number.isFinite(h.df171KickStart);
   const moveForward=Math.min(begun?8:4,h.df171Gap*.06)*fitness;
   desiredOffset=Math.max(desiredOffset,(h.dist-center)+moveForward);
  }
 }
 const error=desiredOffset-(h.dist-center);
 const skill=clamp(h.distanceFactor/.85,.48,1);
 // The former +/-5.25 m/s correction overpowered meaningful point differences.
 // Guide formation gently and taper in the finishing straight so passing
 // is driven by raceSp/raceKick/raceSta rather than a scripted position.
 const finishFreedom=1-.35*clamp((progress-.80)/.20,0,1);
 return clamp(error*.12,-1.60,1.60)*skill*finishFreedom;
}

// Master Ver.2 race influence. These are intentionally *small* additions to the
// established speed/stamina/kick model, rather than replacing it or giving a
// second full set of ability points to an already high-ranked horse.
// Verified G1 performance has greater confidence than reference estimates.
function masterV2RaceModifiers(h,random01=Math.random()){
 if(isSpecial125(h))return {temperamentPace:0,healthFatigueRate:1,g1Experience:0,marginStrength:0,rankCloseFinish:0};
 const reliability=h.g1WinsStatus==='資料照合済'?1:.35;
 const marginVerified=h.g1AverageMarginMeasured!==null;
 const margin=marginVerified?h.g1AverageMarginMeasured:h.g1AverageMarginForGame;
 return {
  // Temperament: calm horses run a steadier pace; unsettled horses can lose
  // a little rhythm (rolled once at the start of the race).
  temperamentPace:clamp((h.temperament-90)*.0045,-.16,.041)+
    (random01-.5)*(100-h.temperament)*.004,
  // Health: stronger horses resist sustained fatigue; no mid-race injuries.
  healthFatigueRate:clamp(1+(90-h.health)*.006,.94,1.28),
  // G1 win count and victory margins are small finish strengths; provisional
  // and game-estimated figures have reduced influence until verified.
  g1Experience:Math.min(.085,Math.max(0,h.g1Wins-1)*.015)*reliability,
  marginStrength:clamp((margin-.9)*.045,-.025,.055)*(marginVerified?1:.3),
  // Composite rank is applied only to close finishes to avoid double counting.
  rankCloseFinish:({SS:.072,S:.048,A:.022,B:0})[h.overallRank]||0,
 };
}
function masterV2FinishDrive(h,order,remaining){
 if(remaining>400)return 0;
 const modifiers=h.masterRace;
 const nearby=order.some(o=>o!==h&&o.finishedAt===null&&Math.abs(o.dist-h.dist)<4.5);
 const finishPhase=clamp((400-remaining)/400,0,1);
 // Positioning changes, not guaranteed victories. Only close contests receive
 // the rank bonus; the original tactical finishing drives remain untouched.
 const bonus=(modifiers.g1Experience+modifiers.marginStrength)*(.25+.75*finishPhase)+
   (nearby?modifiers.rankCloseFinish*(.3+.7*finishPhase):0);
 return bonus*h.distanceFactor;
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 15_race_volatility.js | 馬の調子・波乱の発生 =====
// Ver.65: race-day surprises. Baseline form varies every race; occasionally several
// independently plausible uncertainties combine into a high-upset opportunity.
// No results or payout amounts are forced. Odds are fixed from the race card before
// these *unobservable* race-day changes. This is a game model, not the real market.
let raceVolatility={active:false,kind:'normal',chance:0,pressure:0};
function chooseVolatilityType(field){
 const escapes=field.filter(h=>h.tactic==='逃げ').length;
 const fronts=field.filter(h=>h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行').length;
 const damp=currentGoing==='重'||currentGoing==='不良';
 // On very wet turf, a horse's own going aptitude can overturn pre-race form.
 if(damp&&Math.random()<.62)return 'wet';
 if(escapes>=2&&Math.random()<.80)return 'pace';
 if(fronts<=Math.max(3,field.length*.38)&&Math.random()<.42)return 'slow';
 if(currentGoing!=='良'&&Math.random()<.45)return 'wet';
 return 'form';
}
function volatilityCompatibility(h,kind){
 const fit=distanceFactor(h);
 const ground=goingScore(h);
 if(fit<.93)return 0; // A hopelessly unsuitable distance does not become an upset win.
 if(kind==='wet')return ground>=94?1+Math.max(0,ground-100)*.06:ground<89?.1:.5;
 if(kind==='pace')return (h.tactic==='差し'||h.tactic==='追込')
  ?(.70+(skillAdjustedStat(h,'kick')-85)*.024+(skillAdjustedStat(h,'sta')-85)*.014):.12;
 if(kind==='slow')return (h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行')
  ?(.70+(h.early-85)*.027+(h.sustain-85)*.013):.12;
 // Horses with potential but uncertain public form can outrun their apparent rating.
 return .50+(h.sustain-85)*.015+(h.grit-85)*.018;
}
function configureRaceVolatility(){
 const field=runners,entries=currentPreRaceOdds.horse;
 const fronts=field.filter(h=>h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行').length;
 const escapes=field.filter(h=>h.tactic==='逃げ').length;
 const top=entries[0]?.winProbability??.6;
 // Large fields, close contests and bad turf produce slightly more surprises.
 // This is the chance of a turbulent RACE, not a promised 10,000-yen payout.
 const pressure=(escapes>=3?.23:escapes===2?.13:0)+Math.max(0,fronts-6)*.023;
 const chance=clamp(.17+(field.length-8)*.011+(currentGoing==='稍重'?.015:(currentGoing==='重'||currentGoing==='不良'?.035:0))+(top<.32?.025:0)+(pressure>.2?.015:0),.10,.35);
 const active=Math.random()<chance;
 const kind=active?chooseVolatilityType(field):'normal';
 raceVolatility={active,kind,chance,pressure,fronts,escapes};
 const ranking=new Map(entries.map((entry,i)=>[entry.no,i]));
 for(const h of field){
  // Everyday fluctuations depend on stability: steady horses vary less.
  const noise=(Math.random()+Math.random()+Math.random()+Math.random()-2);
  const formScale=.98*(.82+(100-h.stability)*.014);
  h.variant=isSpecial125(h)?0:noise*formScale;
  h.upsetDrive=0;
  h.paceCollapse=0;
 }
 if(!active)return;
 const eligible=field.map(h=>({h,rank:ranking.get(h.no)??0,weight:volatilityCompatibility(h,kind)}))
  .filter(o=>!isSpecial125(o.h)&&o.weight>.30&&o.rank>=2); // 125-point elites don't fluctuate
 if(!eligible.length)return;
 const pool=eligible.map(o=>({...o,weight:o.weight*(o.rank>=5?1.10:1)}));
 const sum=pool.reduce((a,o)=>a+o.weight,0);
 let cursor=Math.random()*sum,chosen=pool[pool.length-1];
 for(const o of pool){cursor-=o.weight;if(cursor<=0){chosen=o;break}}
 const h=chosen.h;
 // One little-noticed runner has a particularly good day. Boost builds during the
 // back straight and lasts to the finish; it doesn't teleport or guarantee a placing.
 h.upsetDrive=(1.04+.85*Math.random())*distanceFactor(h);
 // A strongly-backed runner sometimes has a below-par day, with severity moderated
 // by consistency/health. This is independent of whether a ticket was bought.
 if(Math.random()<.62){
  const fav=field.find(o=>o.no===entries[0].no);
  if(fav&&fav!==h&&!isSpecial125(fav))fav.variant-=(.30+.40*Math.random())*(.9+(100-fav.stability)*.01);
 }
 if(kind==='pace'){
  for(const r of field)if(!isSpecial125(r)&&(r.tactic==='逃げ' || (r.tactic==='先行'&&Math.random()<.40)))
   r.paceCollapse=.17+.24*Math.random();
 }else if(kind==='wet'){
  for(const r of field)if(!isSpecial125(r)&&goingScore(r)<89)r.paceCollapse=.13+.17*Math.random();
 }else if(kind==='slow'){
  for(const r of field)if(!isSpecial125(r)&&r.tactic==='追込')r.paceCollapse=.12+.17*Math.random();
 }
}
// Smoothly apply each event across the actual 3D race rather than editing ranks.
function raceDayDrive(h,progress){
 if(isSpecial125(h))return 0;
 const surge=(h.upsetDrive||0)*clamp((progress-.36)/.40,0,1);
 const fatigue=(h.paceCollapse||0)*clamp((progress-.58)/.27,0,1);
 const earlySpeed=progress>.42?(raceVolatility.pressure||0)*clamp((progress-.42)/.35,0,1):0;
 const frontPenalty=h.tactic==='逃げ'?earlySpeed*.85:h.tactic==='先行'?earlySpeed*.36:0;
 return surge-fatigue-frontPenalty;
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 16_odds_and_racecard.js | オッズ・馬柱の表示 =====
// All possible unordered horse pairs are evaluated; only popular combinations are printed.
// Probabilities are a model estimate (Plackett-Luce two-order finish), not actual betting markets.
let currentPreRaceOdds={umaren:[],wakuren:[],horse:[]};
const oddsMoney=prob=>Math.max(1.1,Math.min(999.9,Math.round(0.775/Math.max(.00001,prob)*10)/10));
function racePaperRating(h){
 // Newspaper estimate uses the SAME expected race-stat scale as seedRace:
 // distance, going, age, form/fatigue, power and mean stability realization.
 // No pre-race knowledge of the actual stability draw or surprise events.
 const stability=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(h.stability)||0)));
 const meanStability=(100+stability)/200;
 const age=ageForRace(h,currentRace);
 const expectedScale=meanStability*distanceFactor(h)*goingFactor(h)
  *(h.owner||isSpecial125(h)?1:ageGrowthFactor(h.growth,age))
  *conditionRaceMultiplier(h)*df28RaceFormFactor(h)*powerMultiplier(h);
 // One weighting for owner and COM.  All seven abilities affect either
 // speed, fatigue, passing or consistency in the race simulation.
 const base=(skillAdjustedStat(h,'sp')*.38+skillAdjustedStat(h,'sta')*.17
  +skillAdjustedStat(h,'kick')*.20+h.early*.08+h.sustain*.12+h.grit*.05)*expectedScale;
 const master=.024*(h.temperament-75)+.018*(h.health-75)+.12*Math.min(8,h.g1Wins||0);
 const rank=({SS:.42,S:.23,A:.08,B:0})[h.overallRank]||0;
 const terrain=h.surface===currentRace.surface?0:2.8;
 const currentWeight=Number.isFinite(h.weight)?h.weight:weightForRace(h,currentRace,age);
 const jockeyForm=h.jockeySkills?(h.jockeySkills.overall-1)*6:0;
 const score=base+master+rank-terrain+goingTacticBonus(h)*4.0+(57-currentWeight)*.12+jockeyForm;
 // DBF14: newspaper, popularity and odds only. COM horses use 130%; non-COM unchanged.
 return h.owner?score:score*1.10;
}
// DBF23: one shared source for the four VISIBLE newspaper marks.
// Only the printed ◎/○/▲/△/blank ranks determine betting popularity and odds.
function df23VisibleMarks(entrants){
 const stat=(horse,key)=>{
  const value=Number(['sp','sta','kick'].includes(key)?skillAdjustedStat(horse,key):horse[key]);
  return Number.isFinite(value)?value:0;
 };
 const formFactor=horse=>{
  const record=typeof conditionRecord==='function'?conditionRecord(horse):null;
  const raw=Number(record?.form??horse.form);
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number.isFinite(raw)?raw:75))/100;
 };
 const rated=entrants.map((horse,index)=>{
  const sp=stat(horse,'sp'),sta=stat(horse,'sta'),kick=stat(horse,'kick');
  const grit=stat(horse,'grit'),early=stat(horse,'early');
  const sustain=stat(horse,'sustain'),stability=stat(horse,'stability');
  const stored=horse.overallScore??horse.masterV2?.['総合点_ゲーム評価']??horse.potential;
  const overall=Number(stored),factor=(horse.owner?1:1.20)*formFactor(horse);
  return {no:index+1,
   prediction:racePaperRating(horse)*(horse.owner?1:(1.20/1.10))*formFactor(horse),
   overall:(stored!=null&&Number.isFinite(overall)?overall:(sp+sta+kick+grit+early+sustain+stability)/7)*factor,
   four:(sp+sta+kick+grit)*factor,
   three:(early+sustain+stability)*factor};
 });
 const keys=['prediction','overall','four','three'],ranks={};
 for(const key of keys){
  const sorted=[...rated].sort((a,b)=>b[key]-a[key]||a.no-b.no);
  ranks[key]=new Map(sorted.map((row,index)=>[row.no,index]));
 }
 // The 4 printed columns have equal weight; blank marks all contribute zero.
 const scores=rated.map(row=>keys.reduce((total,key)=>{
  const place=ranks[key].get(row.no);
  return total+(place<4?4-place:0);
 },0));
 return {ranks,scores};
}
function computePreRaceOdds(entrants){
 if(entrants.length===1)return {umaren:[],wakuren:[],horse:[{no:1,frameNo:entrants[0].frameNo,weight:1,winProbability:1,score:racePaperRating(entrants[0]),h:entrants[0]}]};
 const scores=df23VisibleMarks(entrants).scores,hi=Math.max(...scores);
 // More conservative than the former /3.8: race-day pace, stability and
 // tactical interactions make small point advantages uncertain.
 const weights=scores.map(s=>Math.exp(Math.max(-50,(s-hi)/3.0)));
 const sum=weights.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
 const horse=entrants.map((h,i)=>({no:i+1,frameNo:h.frameNo,weight:weights[i],winProbability:weights[i]/sum,score:scores[i],h}));
 const umaren=[],frameMap=new Map();
 for(let i=0;i<entrants.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<entrants.length;j++){
  const wi=weights[i],wj=weights[j];
  const prob=wi/sum*wj/(sum-wi)+wj/sum*wi/(sum-wj);
  umaren.push({numbers:[i+1,j+1],prob,odds:oddsMoney(prob)});
  const a=entrants[i].frameNo,b=entrants[j].frameNo;
  const key=[a,b].sort((x,y)=>x-y).join('-');
  const old=frameMap.get(key)||{numbers:[Math.min(a,b),Math.max(a,b)],prob:0};
  old.prob+=prob;frameMap.set(key,old);
 }
 umaren.sort((a,b)=>b.prob-a.prob);
 const wakuren=[...frameMap.values()].map(o=>({...o,odds:oddsMoney(o.prob)})).sort((a,b)=>b.prob-a.prob);
 horse.sort((a,b)=>b.winProbability-a.winProbability);
 const total=umaren.reduce((a,o)=>a+o.prob,0);
 if(Math.abs(1-total)>1e-7)throw new Error('Pair probabilities not normalized: '+total);
 return {umaren,wakuren,horse};
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 17_betting_wallet.js | 資金・馬券・購入・払戻 =====
// Ver.62 virtual betting: balances persist across races in this browser.
// An unfinished bet is refunded on page reload (new races are generated on reload).
const CASH_STORAGE_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.wallet';
const FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.farm';
const INITIAL_CASH=300000000;
let walletStorageAvailable=true;
function readFarmSharedCash(){
 try{
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY);
  if(raw===null)return null;
  const item=JSON.parse(raw);
  const cash=Math.floor(Number(item?.walletCash));
  return Number.isFinite(cash)&&cash>=0?Math.min(10000000000000,cash):null;
 }catch(_){return null;}
}
function writeFarmSharedCash(value,pushBridge=true){
 const safe=Math.max(0,Math.min(10000000000000,Math.floor(Number(value)||0)));
 try{
  let item={};
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY);
  if(raw!==null){
   const parsed=JSON.parse(raw);
   if(parsed&&typeof parsed==='object')item=parsed;
  }
  item.walletCash=safe;
  localStorage.setItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY,JSON.stringify(item));
 }catch(e){console.warn('牧場側の所持金を保存できません',e);}
 if(!pushBridge)return;
 try{
  const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  if(bridge)bridge.setState({walletCash:safe});
 }catch(e){console.warn('牧場側の所持金を同期できません',e);}
}
function restoreCash(){
 try{
  const farmCash=readFarmSharedCash();
  if(Number.isSafeInteger(farmCash)){
   // Unsettled wagers are cancelled at reload. Refund only the same wallet's
   // pending wagers; do not invent a second independent balance.
   let recovered=farmCash;
   try{
    const old=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY)||'null');
    if(old&&Number.isSafeInteger(old.pending)&&old.pending>0&&
       Number.isSafeInteger(old.balance)&&old.balance===farmCash){
      recovered=Math.min(10000000000000,farmCash+old.pending);
      writeFarmSharedCash(recovered,false);
    }
   }catch(_){}
   localStorage.setItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:recovered,pending:0}));
   return recovered;
  }
  const data=localStorage.getItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY);
  if(data===null){
   writeFarmSharedCash(INITIAL_CASH,false);
   localStorage.setItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:INITIAL_CASH,pending:0}));
   return INITIAL_CASH;
  }
  const item=JSON.parse(data);
  if(!item||!Number.isSafeInteger(item.balance)||item.balance<0||
     !Number.isSafeInteger(item.pending)||item.pending<0||item.balance+item.pending>Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)throw new Error('invalid wallet');
  const recovered=item.balance+item.pending;
  localStorage.setItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:recovered,pending:0}));
  writeFarmSharedCash(recovered,false);
  return recovered;
 }catch(e){walletStorageAvailable=false;console.warn('所持金の保存を利用できません',e);return INITIAL_CASH;}
}
let walletCash=restoreCash();
// Ver.32: separate persistent VS play-money bankroll, initial 1億円. Never sync to farm.
const DFV32_VS_WALLET_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.vsWallet';
const DFV32_VS_INITIAL_CASH=100000000;
function dfV32RestoreVsCash(){
 try{
  const raw=localStorage.getItem(DFV32_VS_WALLET_KEY);
  if(raw===null)return DFV32_VS_INITIAL_CASH;
  const v=JSON.parse(raw),balance=Number(v?.balance),pending=Number(v?.pending);
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(balance)||balance<0||balance>10000000000000||
     !Number.isSafeInteger(pending)||pending<0||balance+pending>10000000000000)throw Error('bad VS wallet');
  // As in ordinary races, a pending wager is refunded if the HTML reloads before the finish.
  const recovered=balance+pending;
  localStorage.setItem(DFV32_VS_WALLET_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:recovered,pending:0}));
  return recovered;
 }catch(e){console.warn('VS資金の読み込みに失敗',e);return DFV32_VS_INITIAL_CASH;}
}
let dfV32VsCash=dfV32RestoreVsCash();
// Ver.179: initialize the shared SFX balance tracker without a coin sound.
window.df175InitCash?.(walletCash,dfV32VsCash,readFarmSharedCash()??walletCash);
const dfV32ActiveCash=()=>dfV30VsActive?dfV32VsCash:walletCash;
function dfV32PersistBetCash(silentMoney=false){
 if(!dfV30VsActive){persistCash(true,silentMoney);return;}
 try{
  localStorage.setItem(DFV32_VS_WALLET_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:dfV32VsCash,pending:ticketsSettled?0:ticketStakeSum()}));
  walletStorageAvailable=true;
  window.df175MoneyTrack?.('vs',dfV32VsCash,silentMoney?'silent':'');
 }catch(e){walletStorageAvailable=false;console.warn('VS資金を保存できません',e);}
}

function dfFormatAmount(yen){
 const amount=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(yen)||0));
 const billion=Math.floor(amount/100000000);
 const rem=amount%100000000;
 const fraction=rem/10000;
 const formatMan=x=>Number(x.toFixed(4)).toString();
 return billion?`${billion}億${rem?formatMan(fraction)+'万':''}`:`${formatMan(amount/10000)}万`;
}
const cashText=value=>dfFormatAmount(value);
const fundsText=value=>dfFormatAmount(Math.floor(Math.max(0,Number(value)||0)/10000)*10000);
const roundTicketPayout=odds=>Math.floor(odds*10+1e-8)*10;
const ticketReturn=ticket=>roundTicketPayout(ticket.odds)*(ticket.stake/100);
const ticketStakeSum=()=>raceTickets.reduce((sum,t)=>sum+t.stake,0);
// Ver.21: a single gift per period below the threshold, even after a reload.
const SECRETARY_AID_LIMIT=10000000;
const SECRETARY_AID_AMOUNT=10000000;
const SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.secretary_aid_active';
function secretaryAidIfNeeded(){
 const cash=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(walletCash)||0));
 if(cash>SECRETARY_AID_LIMIT){
  try{localStorage.removeItem(SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY);}catch(_){}
  return false;
 }
 let locked=false;
 try{locked=localStorage.getItem(SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY)==='1';}catch(_){}
 if(locked)return false;
 // Latch before notifying the child so that child->parent snapshots cannot pay twice.
 try{localStorage.setItem(SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY,'1');}catch(_){}
 walletCash=cash+SECRETARY_AID_AMOUNT;
 // A gift that raises the balance above the threshold begins a new healthy period.
 // A gift from zero ends at exactly 10m, so it stays locked until cash rises above 10m.
 if(walletCash>SECRETARY_AID_LIMIT){
  try{localStorage.removeItem(SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY);}catch(_){}
 }
 try{showSecretaryAidEvent();}catch(e){console.warn('秘書の資金援助画面を表示できません',e);}
 return true;
}

function persistCash(pushFarm=true,silentMoney=false){
 // Mark recovery from a previous low-balance period, but NEVER grant aid here.
 // The secretary appears only after explicitly returning to the farm home.
 if(walletCash>SECRETARY_AID_LIMIT){
  try{localStorage.removeItem(SECRETARY_AID_LOCK_KEY);}catch(_){}
 }
 try{
  localStorage.setItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify({balance:walletCash,pending:ticketsSettled?0:ticketStakeSum()}));
  walletStorageAvailable=true;
  if(pushFarm)writeFarmSharedCash(walletCash,true);
  if(pushFarm)window.df175MoneyTrack?.('normal',walletCash,silentMoney?'silent':'');
 }
 catch(e){walletStorageAvailable=false;console.warn('所持金を保存できません',e);}
}
// Ver.181: the ordinary wallet is the authoritative liquid-asset balance.
// This API lives alongside walletCash so a manual-backup fee cannot update
// only an obsolete localStorage copy while leaving the running game unchanged.
window.DF181BackupMoney=Object.freeze({
 getBalance(){
  const farmCash=readFarmSharedCash();
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(walletCash)||walletCash<0||farmCash!==walletCash)
   throw Error('資金の同期中です。牧場画面に戻ってから保存してください。');
  return walletCash;
 },
 charge(expected,fee){
  if(!Number.isSafeInteger(expected)||!Number.isSafeInteger(fee)||fee<0||
     fee!==Math.floor(expected/10)||walletCash!==expected||readFarmSharedCash()!==expected)
   throw Error('バックアップ中に資金が変わりました。保存し直してください。');
  const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  if(!bridge?.setState||!bridge?.getState)
   throw Error('牧場が準備できていません。保存し直してください。');
  const post=expected-fee;
  const oldWallet=localStorage.getItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY);
  const oldFarm=localStorage.getItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY);
  try{
   walletCash=post;
   persistCash(true);
   const persistedWallet=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY)||'null');
   if(!walletStorageAvailable||readFarmSharedCash()!==post||
      persistedWallet?.balance!==post||bridge.getState()?.walletCash!==post)
    throw Error('手数料の保存を確認できませんでした。');
   updateTicketDisplay();refreshStableCash();
   return true;
  }catch(e){
   walletCash=expected;
   try{
    if(oldWallet===null)localStorage.removeItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY);
    else localStorage.setItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY,oldWallet);
    if(oldFarm===null)localStorage.removeItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY);
    else localStorage.setItem(FARM_SHARED_CASH_KEY,oldFarm);
    bridge.setState({walletCash:expected});
    updateTicketDisplay();refreshStableCash();
   }catch(rollbackError){console.error('Ver.181 手数料取消しの復旧に失敗',rollbackError);}
   throw e;
  }
 },
 refund(expected,fee){
  if(walletCash!==expected-fee||!Number.isSafeInteger(fee)||fee!==Math.floor(expected/10))
   throw Error('残高が変わったため自動返金できません。');
  walletCash=expected;
  persistCash(true);
  if(readFarmSharedCash()!==expected||
     JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CASH_STORAGE_KEY)||'null')?.balance!==expected)
   throw Error('手数料の返金を確認できません。');
  updateTicketDisplay();refreshStableCash();
 }
});

function winnerTicket(ticket){
 if(!finished.length)return false;
 const f=finished[0],s=finished[1];
 const same=(a,b)=>ticket.numbers[0]===Math.min(a,b)&&ticket.numbers[1]===Math.max(a,b);
 return ticket.kind==='tansho'?ticket.numbers[0]===f.no:
        ticket.kind==='umaren'&&s?same(f.no,s.no):
        ticket.kind==='wakuren'&&s?same(f.frameNo,s.frameNo):false;
}
function settleTickets(){
 if(ticketsSettled)return;
 if(finished.length<1)return;
 const staked=ticketStakeSum();
 const outcomes=raceTickets.map(t=>({ticket:t,payout:winnerTicket(t)?ticketReturn(t):0}));

 if(dfV30VsActive)dfV32VsCash+=paid;else walletCash+=paid;
 ticketsSettled=true;dfV32PersistBetCash();updateTicketDisplay();

  (outcomes.length?outcomes.map(({ticket:t,payout})=>`<div class="ticket-row"><span class="ticket-label">${ticketTypeName(t.kind)} ${ticketNumbers(t)} ／ ${cashText(t.stake)}</span><span class="${payout?'bet-hit':'bet-miss'}">${payout?'的中 '+cashText(payout):'不的中'}</span></div>`).join(''):'<div class="ticket-empty">このレースでは馬券を購入していません。</div>');
 $('betResultPanel').hidden=false;
}
function discardRaceTickets(){

 raceTickets=[];ticketsSettled=false;dfV32PersistBetCash(true);
}

// Ver.171: same ability-scaled late kick, launched earlier when real race gaps
// demand it. A horse still tires, can be blocked, and is never promised a win.
function lateCloserBoost(h,remaining){
 const suitability=clamp(h.distanceFactor/.92,.43,1)*GOING_LATE_KICK_FACTOR[currentGoing];
 const finishingAbility=.62*h.raceKick+.23*h.raceSp+.15*h.raceSta;
 const power=clamp((finishingAbility-71)/25,.44,1.12);
 if(h.tactic==='差し'||h.tactic==='追込'){
  const base=h.tactic==='差し'?Math.min(1050,TOTAL*.49):Math.min(880,TOTAL*.43);
  const kickStart=Number.isFinite(h.df171KickStart)?h.df171KickStart:base;
  if(remaining>kickStart)return 0;
  const stage=clamp((kickStart-remaining)/kickStart,0,1);
  return (h.tactic==='差し'?( .12+.65*Math.pow(stage,1.18)):
   (.45+2.10*Math.pow(stage,1.12)))*suitability*power;
 }
 return 0;
}
// A small head-to-head contest only while two visible race positions are truly
// side-by-side in the last 400m. Calculate from one snapshot each frame, so
// the result does not depend on which horse the update loop processes first.
function duelAbility(h){
 const score=0.45*h.raceGrit+0.30*h.raceSta+0.25*h.raceSp;
 return clamp(score/100,0,1);
}
function calculateDuelDrives(){
 const bonuses=new Map();
 for(const h of runners){
  if(h.finishedAt!==null||TOTAL-h.dist>400)continue;
  let partner=null,best=Infinity;
  for(const other of runners){
   if(other===h||other.finishedAt!==null||TOTAL-other.dist>400)continue;
   const gap=Math.abs(h.dist-other.dist);
   const laneGap=Math.abs(h.lane-other.lane);
   // Adjacent lanes, rather than distant horses or horses in the same lane.
   if(gap>=2.4||laneGap<.32||laneGap>1.7)continue;
   const score=gap+.2*Math.abs(laneGap-1);
   if(score<best){best=score;partner=other;}
  }
  if(!partner)continue;
  const gap=Math.abs(h.dist-partner.dist);
  const closeness=clamp(1-gap/2.4,0,1);
  const abilityDelta=clamp((duelAbility(h)-duelAbility(partner))*.32,-.08,.08);
  const a=Math.min(h.no,partner.no),b=Math.max(h.no,partner.no);
  // Opposite pulses make one nose ahead briefly, then the other responds.
  // The amplitude fades naturally when a gap opens, rather than forcing a pass.
  const wave=Math.sin(elapsed*2.15+a*.91+b*.47)*(h.no===a?1:-1);
  const finishRamp=.75+.25*clamp((400-(TOTAL-h.dist))/400,0,1);
  const drive=(.055+abilityDelta+.24*wave)*closeness*finishRamp*h.distanceFactor;
  bonuses.set(h.no,drive);
 }
 return bonuses;
}

function df150Seed(h){
 const c=conditionRecord(h);
 const temperament=clamp(Number.isFinite(Number(h.temperament))?Number(h.temperament):85,0,100);
 const form=clamp(Number.isFinite(Number(c?.form))?Number(c.form):75,0,100);
 const restless=(100-temperament)/100,unfit=(100-form)/100;
 const stumbleChance=clamp(.008+.090*restless+.058*unfit+.035*restless*unfit,.006,.20);
 const pullChance=clamp(.012+.13*restless+.075*unfit,.008,.20);
 const stumble=Math.random()<stumbleChance;
 const pulling=Math.random()<pullChance;
 const riderStart=clamp(Number(h.jockeySkills?.start)||1,.7,1.3);
 const riderCalm=clamp(Number(h.jockeySkills?.pace)||1,.7,1.3);
 const riderPosition=clamp(Number(h.jockeySkills?.position)||1,.7,1.3);
 const max=df150MaxLateral(),inside=df150InsideSign();
 h.df150={temperament,form,restless,unfit,stumble,
  startLag:stumble?(.34+Math.random()*.78)/riderStart:0,pullLeft:pulling?(2.8+Math.random()*3.5)/riderCalm:0,
  pullCooldown:pulling?11:4+Math.random()*5,blockedTime:0,blockedTotal:0,
  blockedNoted:false,outerMove:false,outerTotal:0,recovered:false,
  lastPassing:0,lastEvent:{},events:[],decisionAt:0,
  preferred:inside*max*(.70+.28*Math.random()),lastReal:df150RealLane(h),
  df18Maneuver:0,df18ManeuverUntil:0,df18LaneLock:0,
  dfV17BreakoutUntil:0,
  response:clamp(.80+(form-65)*.006+(temperament-65)*.003+(riderPosition-1)*.20,.62,1.30)};
 if(stumble)df150Event(h,'slow-start');
 else if(Math.random()<.11)df150Event(h,'good-start');
 if(pulling)df150Event(h,'pull');
}
function df150LateralFree(h,candidate,order){
 const here=df150RealLane(h);
 // Never cross a neighbouring horse's actual occupied running corridor.
 return order.every(o=>{
  if(o===h||o.finishedAt!==null)return true;
  if(Math.abs(o.dist-h.dist)>DF150_MIN_LONG_GAP+0.4)return true;
  const oth=df150RealLane(o);
  return !(oth>=Math.min(here,candidate)-DF150_MIN_SIDE_GAP &&
           oth<=Math.max(here,candidate)+DF150_MIN_SIDE_GAP);
 });
}
function df150Front(h,order,lateral=df150RealLane(h),lookahead=10){
 let front=null,best=Infinity;
 for(const o of order){
  if(o===h||o.finishedAt!==null)continue;
  const gap=o.dist-h.dist;
  if(gap<-.3||gap>lookahead||Math.abs(df150RealLane(o)-lateral)>=DF150_MIN_SIDE_GAP)continue;
  if(gap<best){best=gap;front=o;}
 }
 return front;
}
function df150LanePlan(h,dt,order,p){
 const a=h.df150;if(!a)return;
 const side=df150InsideSign(),max=df150MaxLateral(),scale=df150LaneScale();
 const here=df150RealLane(h);
 // DBF18: all styles normally use the inner 30% of the available track.
 // Keep gate formation until the runners are moving, and never force a
 // crossing when the inner corridor is occupied.
 const innerEdge=side*max*.40;
 if(elapsed>=2.2)a.preferred=side*max*(.70+.28*(h.no%7)/6); // DBF22: stable target in inner 30% for every runner
 // DF200: Keep the original inside preference for the ENTIRE race.
 // Detect a closing wall for ALL tactics at ANY distance, not only in the
 // last 1000m or during a closer's late kick. Move outside only when needed.
 const ahead=df150Front(h,order,here,10);
 const forecast=df150Front(h,order,here,22);
 const gap=forecast?forecast.dist-h.dist:Infinity;
 const closing=forecast?h.velocity-forecast.velocity:0;
 const needOutside=!!forecast && (gap<9 ||
  (gap<22 && closing>0.12 && gap/Math.max(.12,closing)<9));
 // A stronger grit/kick/early combination improves the urgency and precision
 // of searching a real physical opening; it never bypasses collision checks.
 const breakoutAbility=clamp((Number(h.grit||0)*.50+
  Number(h.kick||0)*.30+Number(h.early||0)*.20)/120,0,1);
 const pressing=needOutside && gap<Math.max(5.5,10+breakoutAbility*5);
 if(pressing)a.dfV17BreakoutUntil=elapsed+.6;
 // Keep the full-width starting-gate formation until the pack is moving.
 if(elapsed>=2.2&&elapsed>=a.decisionAt){
  a.decisionAt=elapsed+(pressing?(.15-.11*breakoutAbility):needOutside?.12:.32)+Math.random()*(pressing?.035:needOutside?.08:.24);
  // When a horse blocks the planned outside move, make a small temporary
  // pace adjustment to slip behind it or move ahead before changing lanes.
  // Never force a crossing; the physical corridor check remains authoritative.
  if(needOutside && elapsed>=a.df18ManeuverUntil){
   const outer=clamp(here-side*1.9,-max,max);
   const neighbour=order.filter(o=>o!==h&&o.finishedAt===null&&
    Math.abs(df150RealLane(o)-outer)<DF150_MIN_SIDE_GAP*1.35&&
    Math.abs(o.dist-h.dist)<10).sort((x,y)=>Math.abs(x.dist-h.dist)-Math.abs(y.dist-h.dist))[0];
   if(neighbour && !df150LateralFree(h,outer,order)){
    const aheadOfOther=h.dist>neighbour.dist+1.0;
    const behindOther=h.dist<neighbour.dist-1.0;
    // Accelerate only if the horse is already ahead and can open a gap;
    // otherwise yield briefly to create a safe opening behind the neighbour.
    a.df18Maneuver=aheadOfOther?0.28:behindOther?-0.24:-0.32;
    a.df18ManeuverUntil=elapsed+1.1;
   }else a.df18Maneuver=0;
  }
  const step=pressing?1.9+breakoutAbility*.65:1.9;
  // When blocked, search further OUTSIDE first; otherwise retain the
  // original local lane candidates and the inner-running preference.
  const proposals=needOutside?
   [here,here-side*step,here-side*2*step,here-side*3*step,
    here-side*4*step,here+side*step,here+side*2*step,
    here+side*3*step,here+side*4*step]:
   [here,here+side*step,here+side*2*step,here+side*3*step,here+side*4*step,innerEdge,a.preferred,here-side*step];
  let best=here,score=-Infinity;
  for(let loc of proposals){
   loc=clamp(loc,-max,max);
   if(!df150LateralFree(h,loc,order))continue;
   const blocker=df150Front(h,order,loc,needOutside?22:10);
   let quality=-Math.abs(loc-a.preferred)*.36-Math.abs(loc-here)*.10;
   // Discourage drifting outside the inner 30% without a passing need.
   if(!needOutside){
    // DBF22: a clear inner corridor decisively beats staying outside.
    // Do not force crossing occupied corridors; lateral clearance is checked above.
    const outsideDistance=Math.max(0,max*.40-side*loc);
    quality-=outsideDistance*1.45;
    if(outsideDistance<.01)quality+=3.0;
    if(side*here<max*.40 && side*loc>side*here+.2)quality+=1.0;
   }
   if(blocker){
    quality-=2.8+Math.max(0,9-(blocker.dist-h.dist))*.26;
    if(needOutside)quality-=4.2+Math.max(0,18-(blocker.dist-h.dist))*.23;
   }
   if(ahead&&!blocker)quality+=3.6;
   if(needOutside){
    if(!blocker)quality+=5.0+(pressing?breakoutAbility*5:0);
    // A clear outside passing lane wins over a clear inside lane.
    if(side*(loc-here)<-.1&&!blocker)quality+=2.2;
   }
   // Poor form / excitable temperament produce less decisive responses.
   quality+=Math.sin(h.no*13.9+elapsed*1.63+loc*.15)*
    (.1+.6*a.restless+.3*a.unfit)/clamp(Number(h.jockeySkills?.position)||1,.7,1.3);
   if(quality>score){score=quality;best=loc;}
  }
  h.targetLane=best/scale;
 }
 const desired=clamp(h.targetLane*scale,-max,max);
 const returningInside=!needOutside && side*here<max*.40 && side*(desired-here)>.1;
 const rate=(needOutside?clamp((4.0+ (pressing?2.0*breakoutAbility:0))*a.response,2.8,6.8):
  returningInside?clamp(3.0*a.response,1.8,3.8):clamp(2.1*a.response,1.1,2.9))*dt;
 const next=here+clamp(desired-here,-rate,rate);
 // Preserve the physical no-crossing collision check.
 if(df150LateralFree(h,next,order))h.lane=next/scale;
 const moved=Math.abs(df150RealLane(h)-here);
 if(df150InsideSign()*df150RealLane(h)<max*.10)a.outerTotal+=moved;
 if(ahead && !a.outerMove &&
    side*(desired-here)<-.9 && Math.abs(desired-here)>.9){
  a.outerMove=true;df150Event(h,'outside');
 }
 const blocking=df150Front(h,order,df150RealLane(h),5.5);
 if(blocking){
  a.blockedTime+=dt;a.blockedTotal+=dt;
  if(a.blockedTime>.75&&!a.blockedNoted){df150Event(h,'blocked');a.blockedNoted=true;}
 }else if(a.blockedTime>.75){
  df150Event(h,'clear');a.blockedTime=0;a.blockedNoted=false;
 }else {a.blockedTime=0;a.blockedNoted=false;}
 a.lastReal=df150RealLane(h);
}
function df150IncidentStep(h,dt,p){
 const a=h.df150;if(!a)return {pace:0,fatigue:0};
 if(a.pullLeft>0){
  a.pullLeft-=dt;
  if(a.pullLeft<=0){a.pullLeft=0;a.pullCooldown=16;df150Event(h,'settled');}
  return {pace:.34+.17*a.restless,fatigue:.015+.009*a.restless};
 }
 a.pullCooldown-=dt;
 // Only temperament and form decide whether an episode occurs.
 if(p<.77&&elapsed>7&&a.pullCooldown<=0 &&
    Math.random()<dt*(.0008+.006*a.restless+.004*a.unfit)){
  a.pullLeft=(2.3+Math.random()*3.2)/clamp(Number(h.jockeySkills?.pace)||1,.7,1.3);df150Event(h,'pull');
 }
 return {pace:0,fatigue:0};
}
function df150DistanceAdvance(h,advance,order){
 // Process leaders first and preserve a horse-length gap on the same corridor.
 // The passing horse must first move to a genuinely clear lateral corridor.
 let usable=Math.max(0,advance);
 // Every horse has its own gate stall before the pack has formed.
 if(elapsed<2.8)return usable;
 for(const o of order){
  if(o===h||o.finishedAt!==null)continue;
  if(Math.abs(df150RealLane(o)-df150RealLane(h))>=DF150_MIN_SIDE_GAP)continue;
  if(o.dist<h.dist+.05 || (Math.abs(o.dist-h.dist)<.05 && o.no>h.no))continue;
  usable=Math.min(usable,Math.max(0,o.dist-DF150_MIN_LONG_GAP-h.dist));
 }
 return usable;
}
function df150NewestCall(order){
 const n=raceNarration;
 for(let i=df150RaceEvents.length-1;i>=0;i--){
  const e=df150RaceEvents[i];
  if(e.at<=n.df150LastEventAt||elapsed-e.at>16)continue;
  const h=order.find(o=>o.no===e.no);
  if(!h||!Number.isFinite(h.dist))continue;
  const names={
   'slow-start':'スタートで出遅れた！ 後方からの競馬です！',
   'good-start':'好スタート！ 前へ出ます！',
   'pull':'掛かっています！ 騎手が懸命に抑えます！',
   'settled':'折り合いがつきました！ 落ち着いて追走！',
   'blocked':'前が壁になった！ 進路がありません！',
   'clear':'進路が開いた！ ここから追い上げる！',
   'outside':'外へ持ち出して、進路を確保！'
  };
  if(names[e.kind]){
   n.df150LastEventAt=e.at;
   return {h,message:`${df103HorseCall(h)}、${names[e.kind]}`};
  }
 }
 return null;
}
function df150SecretaryComment(h,rank){
 const a=h.df150;if(!a)return null;
 // Only actually recorded events may be mentioned.
 if(a.stumble&&rank===1)return '出遅れながら見事に差し切りましたね！本当に強い競馬でした！';
 if(a.blockedTotal>2.0&&rank>1)return '道中で前が詰まる場面がありましたね。進路取りが難しいレースでした。';
 if(a.events.some(e=>e.kind==='pull')&&rank>1)return '道中で掛かる場面がありましたね。折り合いが次への課題になりそうです。';
 if(a.stumble&&rank>1)return 'スタートで後手を踏んでしまいましたね。次はいいスタートを切りたいです！';
 if(a.events.some(e=>e.kind==='clear')&&rank===1)return '馬群で進路を見つけて、最後は見事な勝利でしたね！';
 if(a.events.some(e=>e.kind==='settled')&&rank===1)return '道中の掛かりを立て直して勝ち切りましたね！素晴らしいです！';
 if(a.form<=70&&rank>1)return '今日は調子が万全ではなかったようですね。次はいい状態で挑みたいです！';
 if(a.form>=95&&rank===1)return '調子の良さを生かして、見事な勝利でしたね！';
 return null;
}
// ===== End Ver.150 racing model =====

function doRace(dt){const previousElapsed=elapsed;elapsed+=dt;const order=ranks();const duelDrives=calculateDuelDrives();
// DERBY COPY V14: one-time inner-lane activation only. COM plans before owner;
// race speed, stamina and finishing updates still run in their original order.
const df14StartLaneOrder=previousElapsed<2.2&&elapsed>=2.2;
if(df14StartLaneOrder){
 for(const h of order){if(h.finishedAt===null)df171CloserKickPlan(h,order);}
 for(const h of order){if(h.finishedAt===null&&!h.owner)df150LanePlan(h,dt,order,h.dist/TOTAL);}
 for(const h of order){if(h.finishedAt===null&&h.owner)df150LanePlan(h,dt,order,h.dist/TOTAL);}
}
for(const h of order){if(h.finishedAt!==null)continue;const p=h.dist/TOTAL;
if(!df14StartLaneOrder){df171CloserKickPlan(h,order);df150LanePlan(h,dt,order,p);}
const incident=df150IncidentStep(h,dt,p);const pace=h.tactic==='逃げ'?(p<.55?.80:p<.84?.58:.38):h.tactic==='先行'?(p<.7?.194:.3298):h.tactic==='差し'?(p<.66?-.12:p<.84?.34:.38):(p<.67?-.20:p<.84?.62:.90);// Ability realization factor is rolled once in seedRace, never during running.
// The race distance is automatically drawn. Distance penalties are computed once in seedRace.
// Distance aptitude is factored into raceSp/raceSta/etc at the start; do not apply it twice.
const surfacePenalty=h.surface!==currentRace.surface?1.30:0;
// Let early leaders build a lead without overwriting horse abilities.
// Full 5x aptitude penalty remains in raceSp/raceSta/raceKick etc.
let target=16.35+pace+(h.raceSp-90)*.052+h.variant-surfacePenalty-GOING_TRACK_DRAG[currentGoing];
// Temperament affects the steadiness of the actual race pace.
target+=h.masterRace.temperamentPace*h.distanceFactor;target+=incident.pace;
 // Carried weight affects running speed and stamina, and riding skill helps use the horse well.
 target+=Math.min(.35,(57-h.weight)*.045)+jockeyRaceBoost(h,p);
 // Course slope/straight geometry: turning demands and the home straight differ by venue.
 const slopeAhead=trackAt(h.dist+5).y-trackAt(h.dist-5).y;
 target-=clamp(slopeAhead*.75,-.10,.10);
 const turnNow=Math.abs(headingAt(h.dist+2).x-headingAt(h.dist-2).x);
 target-=Math.min(.13,turnNow*.52)*(1-h.raceEarly/210);
 if(TOTAL-h.dist<=currentCourse.straight && currentCourse.surface==='芝')target+=(currentCourse.straight-350)/250*.065*(h.tactic==='追込'?1:h.tactic==='逃げ'?-.35:.20);
const midDist=order.length>=4?(order[2].dist+order[3].dist)*.5:(order[Math.floor((order.length-1)/2)].dist+order[Math.floor(order.length/2)].dist)*.5;
const crowdBalance=clamp((midDist-h.dist)*.035,-.08,.08);
// No artificial rescue for clearly unsuitable entrants; taper the pack effect in the finish.
target+=crowdBalance*clamp((h.distanceFactor-.18)/.82,0,1)*(p<.78?1:.12);
if(p<.52)target+=(h.raceEarly-85)*.010;
if(p>.50)target+=(h.raceSustain-85)*.012;
if(p>.80&&order[0]!==h&&Math.abs(order[0].dist-h.dist)<12)target+=(h.raceGrit-85)*.010;const ahead=df150Front(h,order,df150RealLane(h),5.5);if(ahead)target-=.32;
if(p>.78)target+=(h.raceKick-90)*.072+(h.raceSta-90)*.032;
if(p>.78&&h.tactic==='逃げ')target-=.15;
// Add a gradually rising late drive; preserve ability, stability and aptitude effects.
const finishingDrive=lateCloserBoost(h,TOTAL-h.dist);
target+=finishingDrive;
// Going preference of running styles applies in addition to each horse's going aptitude.
target+=goingTacticFinishDrive(h,TOTAL-h.dist)*(currentGoing==='良'?1:currentGoing==='稍重'?1.8:currentGoing==='重'?3.0:4.0);
// G1 record, victory margin and overall rank provide only small close-finish
// adjustments; do not override the existing tactical drive.
target+=masterV2FinishDrive(h,order,TOTAL-h.dist);
// Brief, ability-weighted exchanges of pace between adjacent horses in the last 400m.
target+=duelDrives.get(h.no)||0;
// The minority-group bonus is intentionally small, and never cancels distance penalties.
target+=h.tacticBalanceBonus*h.distanceFactor;
// Rare upset conditions: late surge, pace collapse, wet-track fatigue.
target+=raceDayDrive(h,p);
h.stamina=clamp(h.stamina-(.0036+.0014*Math.max(0,target-16))*(92/Math.max(40,h.raceSta))*h.masterRace.healthFatigueRate*(1+Math.max(-.06,(h.weight-57)*.012))*(1+(1-h.jockeySkills.pace)*.16)*dt-incident.fatigue*dt,0,1);if(h.stamina<.76)target-=Math.pow(.76-h.stamina,1.8)*5.4;
// Ver.71: style-position correction stays active for the ENTIRE race;
// closer targets change from the rear to a charge toward the leaders, not an
// absence of position control. Velocity, form and going still decide the result.
// Ver.69: looser pack pacing leaves genuine gaps across the entire field.
// Strengthened late finishing phase is gradual; good ground favors closers,
// while poor ground increasingly favors front-runners. Never force a finish.
// Ver.68: stronger full-field pack dynamics, retaining some long-shot finishes.
// Ver.67: a race is a pack contest: jockeys regulate the cruising tempo,
// and horses drifting behind the mid-pack respond before the final sprint.
// Keep all individual ability, tactics, distance and going scores upstream.
// This changes actual travelled distances/timestamps, not displayed margins.
const cruisingPace=16.35-GOING_TRACK_DRAG[currentGoing];
target=cruisingPace+(target-cruisingPace)*0.59;
const packMiddle=order[Math.floor(order.length/2)].dist;
const packResponse=clamp((packMiddle-h.dist)*0.035,-0.75,0.75);
const packPhase=p<.72?1:p<.93?(1-(p-.72)/.21*(1-0.52)):0.52;
target+=packResponse*packPhase*clamp((h.distanceFactor-.18)/.82,.3,1);
// In heavy going, conserving speed near the front is an advantage.
// Scale by distance ability and progress; never guarantee a given result.
const wetHold=(currentGoing==='不良'?.68:currentGoing==='重'?.36:0)*clamp((p-.60)/.24,0,1);
if(wetHold)target+=wetHold*(h.tactic==='逃げ'||h.tactic==='先行'?1:-.20)*clamp(h.distanceFactor/.92,.4,1);
// Enforce running-style positions from the break through the finish.
// The move-up targets during the last stages preserve meaningful late passing.
if(!Number.isFinite(h.tacticPositionRank))assignTacticPositions(runners);
target+=tacticPositionDrive(h,order,p);
// DBF18: small temporary pace choice to open a safe outside passing gap.
// No direct speed/position teleportation and no change to stored horse stats.
if(h.df150&&elapsed<h.df150.df18ManeuverUntil)
 target+=h.df150.df18Maneuver;
// Ver.77: the strong positional guide still runs, but a 差し horse no
// longer gets an excessive free velocity lift in the final 550 metres.
// This only affects 差し; 追込, 逃げ, 先行 and all saved abilities are unchanged.
if(h.tactic==='差し')target-=.18*clamp((550-(TOTAL-h.dist))/550,0,1);
// Turning outside makes the horse cover more ground and reduces effective pace.
const bend=dfV56BendAt(h.dist).strength;
const inside=df150InsideSign()*df150RealLane(h);
target-=bend*.018*Math.max(0,df150MaxLateral()-inside);
// A genuine late reaction at the start may never be erased by position scripting.
if(h.df150 && elapsed<h.df150.startLag)target*=.10;
target=Math.max(0,target);const onset=clamp(elapsed/2,0,1);target*=.4+.6*onset;
// Late runners respond decisively to their bigger kick; position correction
// above remains active regardless of this acceleration-response change.
const accelerationResponse=finishingDrive>0?3.35:2;
h.velocity=smooth(h.velocity,target,clamp(dt*accelerationResponse,0,1));const advance=df150DistanceAdvance(h,h.velocity*dt,order);const old=h.dist;h.dist=Math.min(TOTAL,h.dist+advance);
df132NoteRaceProgress(h,old,h.dist);
if(h.dist>=TOTAL){
 if(!df140FirstGoalAt)df140FirstGoalAt=performance.now();
 h.finishedAt=elapsed-(h.dist-old===0?0:((old+advance-TOTAL)/Math.max(.01,advance/Math.max(dt,.001))));
 h.runoutDist=TOTAL+Math.max(0,old+advance-TOTAL); // preserve excess travelled this frame
 finished.push(h);
}
}
if(finished.length===runners.length){
 // Freeze the real crossing order and persist the actual result immediately.
 finished.sort((a,b)=>a.finishedAt-b.finishedAt);
 try{df170ResultAtGoal();}catch(e){
  console.error('レース結果の即時保存失敗',e);
  df103Subtitle('レース結果を保存できませんでした。アプリを終了せず、保存状態をご確認ください。');
  return;
 }
 dfNormalAllFinishedAt=performance.now();
 race='runout';window.df25Sfx?.finishRace(); // defer results until all eight horses have disappeared down the straight
 /* V106: Do not display results or post-race call in the video. */
}}
// Result times are frozen at the instant of each finish-line crossing.
// Only the visual position continues down the extended straight.
function advanceRunout(dt){
 for(const h of runners){
  if(h.finishedAt===null)continue;
  if(h.runoutDist<TOTAL+GOAL_RUNOUT_METERS+1){
   h.runoutDist+=Math.max(10,h.velocity)*dt;
  }
 }
 if(race!=='runout')return;
 // The finish button appears three real seconds after the LAST horse's goal
 // in both ordinary and VS races. Neither mode transitions automatically.
 if(!dfNormalAllFinishedAt||performance.now()-dfNormalAllFinishedAt<3000)return;
 if(!dfNormalWaitingForEnd){
  dfNormalWaitingForEnd=true;
  dfNormalShowFinishButton(true);
  $('start').disabled=true;
  $('start').textContent='全馬ゴール';
  syncPauseButton();
 }
}
function dfNormalPublishRaceResults(){
  // End the goal-side video after the last horse has passed the fixed camera.
  // Official times, order, tickets and the separate results screen are intact.
  race='finished';
  if(finished[0]?.owner)window.df25Sfx?.play('victory',.85);
  // Official record was saved at the real finish line in Ver.170.
  if(!dfV30VsActive){df27ShowRacePrizes();}
  /* V106: Do not display results or post-race call in the video. */
  $('start').disabled=true;
  $('start').textContent='着順発表中…';
  syncPauseButton();
  // Ver.32: results cover every starter; payouts use the odds frozen at the gate.
  $('postRacePanel').hidden=false;
  $('preRacePanel').hidden=false;
  $('result').classList.remove('visible');
  $('result').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  $('payoutPanel').hidden=true;
  const boardRows=finished; // Ver.33: full field for ordinary and VS races.
  // Ver.44: use the frozen, pre-race singles popularity order, exactly as printed in the newspaper.
  const df44Popularity=new Map((currentPreRaceOdds.horse||[]).map((entry,index)=>[entry.no,index+1]));
  $('resultRaceNo').textContent=String(raceNo);
  $('resultrows').innerHTML=boardRows.map((h,i)=>{
   const detail=i===0?formatTime(h.finishedAt):finishMargin(boardRows[i-1],h);
   const ink=frameTextColor(h.no);
   const popularity=df44Popularity.get(h.no);
   const popularityLabel=Number.isInteger(popularity)?`単勝 ${popularity}番人気`:'単勝 ―';
   return `<div class="result-line" title="${i+1}着 ${raceDisplayHorseName(h.name)}"><strong class="result-rank">${i+1}着</strong><span class="result-bib" style="background:${h.frameColor};color:${ink}">${h.no}</span><span class="df28-result-name">${paperEscape(raceDisplayHorseName(h.name))}<small class="df44-result-popularity">${popularityLabel}</small></span><span class="result-detail">${detail}</span></div>`;
  }).join('');
  renderRacePayouts();
  df132PrepareSecretaryAdvice();
  resultVisibleRows=0;
  resultRevealStart=performance.now()+RESULT_PRE_DELAY_MS;

  }
// ===== Ver.90 source section: 20_finish_results_and_motion.js | 結果発表・払戻・馬体移動 =====
// The same pre-race odds, NOT newly calculated post-race odds, determine these
// purely simulated JPY payouts per 100-yen ticket.
function renderRacePayouts(){
 const first=finished[0],second=finished[1];
 if(!first)return;
 const pair=(a,b)=>[a,b].sort((x,y)=>x-y);
 const samePair=(record,a,b)=>record.numbers[0]===a&&record.numbers[1]===b;
 const [a,b]=second?pair(first.no,second.no):[first.no,null];
 const winPair=second?currentPreRaceOdds.umaren.find(o=>samePair(o,a,b)):null;
 const [fa,fb]=second?pair(first.frameNo,second.frameNo):[first.frameNo,null];
 const framePair=STARTERS>8?currentPreRaceOdds.wakuren.find(o=>samePair(o,fa,fb)):null;
 const yen=(p)=>dfFormatAmount(Math.floor(p.odds*100/10)*10*100);
 const payoutRow=(kind,pairLabel,amount)=>`<div class="payout-row"><strong class="payout-type">${kind}</strong><span class="payout-combination">${pairLabel}</span><strong class="payout-amount">${amount}</strong></div>`;
  const winSingle=currentPreRaceOdds.horse.find(o=>o.no===first.no);
  $('payoutRows').innerHTML=payoutRow('単勝',`${first.no}`,winSingle?yen({odds:oddsMoney(winSingle.winProbability)}):'計算対象外')+
   payoutRow('馬連',second?`${a}－${b}`:'発売なし',winPair?yen(winPair):'―')+
  (STARTERS<=8?payoutRow('枠連','発売なし','―'):
   payoutRow('枠連',`${fa}－${fb}`,framePair?yen(framePair):'計算対象外'));
 const payout100=Math.max(winSingle?roundTicketPayout(oddsMoney(winSingle.winProbability)):0,
  winPair?roundTicketPayout(winPair.odds):0,framePair?roundTicketPayout(framePair.odds):0);
 const banner=$('upsetReport');
 banner.hidden=payout100<10000;
 if(payout100>=10000){
  const kind=raceVolatility.kind;
  const reasons=[];
  if(kind==='pace')reasons.push('先行争いが激しくなり、終盤の失速が波乱につながりました');
  else if(kind==='wet')reasons.push('馬場適性の差で、人気どおりに走れない馬が出ました');
  else if(kind==='slow')reasons.push('遅い流れで前にいる馬が粘る展開になりました');
  else if(kind==='form')reasons.push('当日の調子の差が結果に影響しました');
  else reasons.push('力が接近するなかで予想外の決着となりました');
  banner.innerHTML=`<strong>🎯 万馬券！</strong> 1万あたり最大 ${cashText(payout100*100)}<div>${reasons.join('。')}。</div>`;
 }
}
// Ver.73: visible result text only; no synthesized audio or spoken guidance.
// Let the camera rest briefly, slowly fade up the board, and reveal one rank
// every half-second. No timeouts: a new race safely cancels the whole sequence.
function updateResultsReveal(ts){
 if(race!=='finished'||resultRevealStart===null||ts<resultRevealStart)return;
 const board=$('result');
 if(!board.classList.contains('visible')){
  board.classList.add('visible');
  board.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
  // The result is now below the race video, not on top of it.
  $('postRacePanel').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
 }
 const elapsedMs=ts-resultRevealStart;
 const desiredRows=Math.min(finished.length,Math.max(0,1+Math.floor((elapsedMs-RESULT_FIRST_ROW_MS)/RESULT_ROW_MS)));
 if(desiredRows>resultVisibleRows){
  const rows=$('resultrows').children;
  for(let i=resultVisibleRows;i<desiredRows;i++){
   if(rows[i])rows[i].classList.add('show');
  }
  resultVisibleRows=desiredRows;
 }
 const analysis=$('df132SecretaryAdvice');
 if(analysis)analysis.hidden=!(resultVisibleRows===finished.length&&analysis.dataset.hasAdvice==='true');
 const totalBoardRows=finished.length;
 if(resultVisibleRows===totalBoardRows&&elapsedMs>=RESULT_FIRST_ROW_MS+(Math.max(0,totalBoardRows-1))*RESULT_ROW_MS+900){
  resultRevealStart=null;
  $('payoutPanel').hidden=false;
  settleTickets();
  // Move the ACTUAL pre-race table + odds below payouts: same nodes, unchanged values.
  const paper=$('preRacePanel');
  paper.hidden=false;
  // Keep the newspaper in its own screen instead of appending it below payouts.
  $('start').disabled=false;
  $('start').textContent=dfV30VsActive?'⚔ VSレース完了':'▶ 次のレース';
  /* V106: Do not display results or post-race call in the video. */
 }
}
function moveModels(dt){
 // Ver.82: interpolate rendered positions with an exponential, frame-rate
 // independent visual filter. Never write to actual dist/lane/speed or ranks.
 const visualDt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,renderDeltaSeconds));
 const positionAlpha=1-Math.exp(-visualDt*10.5);
 const headingAlpha=1-Math.exp(-visualDt*7.0);
 for(const h of runners){
  const pos=trackOffset(h.finishedAt===null?h.dist:h.runoutDist,dfV47VisualLane(h.lane));
  h.root.position.lerp(pos,positionAlpha);
  const forward=headingAt(h.dist),heading=Math.atan2(forward.x,forward.z);
  let delta=(heading-h.root.rotation.y+Math.PI)%(Math.PI*2);if(delta<0)delta+=Math.PI*2;delta-=Math.PI;
  h.root.rotation.y+=delta*headingAlpha;
  animateHorseRig(h,dt);
 }
}
// ===== Ver.90 source section: 21_camera_logic.js | 自動カメラ・固定カメラの画角 =====
// Ver.56 visual-only corner detector. Measure the change of direction in the
// mounted venue's actual centreline over 18m. The first/last samples are
// confined to the race route, never altering horse trajectory or tactics.
function dfV56BendAt(distance){
 if(!dfV47World || TOTAL<=0)return {strength:0,side:0};
 const d=Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL,distance));
 const a=headingAt(Math.max(0,d-9)),b=headingAt(Math.min(TOTAL,d+9));
 const dot=Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,a.x*b.x+a.z*b.z));
 const cross=a.z*b.x-a.x*b.z;
 const angle=Math.atan2(cross,dot);
 return {strength:clamp((Math.abs(angle)-.018)/.14,0,1),side:Math.sign(angle)};
}
// Ver.57: camera-only gate dolly. The race stays in its existing idle state

// Track displacement comes from the PRESENTATION centreline only, never
// changes physical runner positions, the simulation clock, or race outcome.
// Ver.62: the finish camera uses a single fixed physical 3-D position and
// a single aim for the final stretch. No result, betting or race data is used.
let dfV62EndHoldUntil=0;

 active:false,eye:null,aim:null,fov:0,origin:null,startedAt:0,

};
function selectShot(){

 // before the final 100m. Its position and viewing direction NEVER change
 // throughout the finish and post-line footage.
 if(dfV47World&&runners.length&&
    (race==='running'||race==='runout'||race==='finished'||race==='paused')&&
    (ranks()[0].dist>=TOTAL-200||race==='runout'||race==='finished'))return 'v62-goal';
 // Original camera for the legacy (non-imported) scene is not modified.
 if(!dfV47World&&runners.length&&(race==='running'||race==='runout'||race==='finished'||race==='paused')&&
    (ranks()[0].dist>=TOTAL-GOAL_CAMERA_TRIGGER||race==='runout'||race==='finished'))return 'finish';
 // The pre-start gate television shot takes precedence over manually saved camera settings.
 if(dfV57GateIntro.active&&race==='idle')return 'front';
 // Keep the original gate lens travelling WITH the field well beyond the
 // initial super-slow break. The departure to TV tracking is gradual.
 if(dfV61GateFollow.active&&(race==='running'||race==='paused')&&
    ranks()[0].dist<220)return 'gate-follow';
 if(camMode!=='auto')return camMode;
 // Ver.59: one continuous broadcast position instead of repeated large
 // switches between corner/front5/side/spotlight. Curvature is blended into
 // the camera geometry, so corner footage is retained without a hard cut.
 if(race==='idle')return 'front';
 return 'broadcast';
}
