// Ver.79: choose the clear filming side PER VENUE and ACTIVE COURSE rather
// than forcing all five stadiums onto the same outer/infield side.
// A fixed choice per race is essential for the continuous, no-cut broadcast:
// a side flip near the finish would send the lens across the horse field.
// +1 = infield side, -1 = outer side; neither changes race positions.
const dfV79CameraSideProfiles=Object.freeze({
 // Ver.101: avoid Tokyo's grandstand/foreground spectators obstructing the
 // live running pack. Keep a consistent unobstructed infield camera side.
 tokyo:{turf_outer:1,dirt:1},
 nakayama:{turf_outer:-1,turf_inner:1,dirt:1},
 hanshin:{turf_outer:-1,turf_inner:-1,dirt:1},
 kyoto:{turf_outer:-1,turf_inner:1,dirt:1},
 // Niigata's long home straight has large grandstand meshes on the OUTER
 // apron. Camera placements among those structures create poor finish shots.
 // Film from the open infield, high enough to see over the near low rail.
 niigata:{turf_outer:1,turf_inner:1,dirt:1,turf_1000:1}
});
function dfV79CameraSideSign(distance){
 const pos=trackAt(Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL,distance)));
 const inward=inwardAt(Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL,distance)));
 const towardCentre=new THREE.Vector3(-pos.x,0,-pos.z);
 const inSign=towardCentre.dot(inward)>=0?1:-1;
 const venue=dfV47World?.id||'tokyo',route=dfV47World?.route||'turf_outer';
 const preference=dfV79CameraSideProfiles[venue]?.[route]??-1;
 return inSign*preference;
}
// Camera-only: anchor the broadcast shooting side to the finish straight's
// physical world direction, NOT to the ever-rotating local track normal.
// As horses reverse direction around each bend, the camera naturally moves
// from inner to outer (and back) relative to their travel while remaining on
// one continuous world side. The static minimap never changes orientation.
// The fixed minimap is the sole authority for the starting camera side.
// Upper/back half of the UNROTATED course plan => shoot from inside.
// Lower/front half => shoot from outside.  Map y increases with world z.
// This is a position rule, NOT a left/right heading or view-camera rule.
function dfV128StartCameraPolicy(){
 const world=dfV47World;
 const start=world?.centerAt?.(0)||trackAt(0);
 // The same venue can run different races: never reuse a cached start-side
 // decision if the route, distance or starting coordinates have changed.
 const cacheKey=`${world?.id||''}|${world?.route||''}|${TOTAL}|${start.x.toFixed(3)}|${start.z.toFixed(3)}`;
 if(world?._dfV128StartCameraPolicy?.cacheKey===cacheKey)return world._dfV128StartCameraPolicy;
 const points=world?.minimap?.points||[];
 let startFar=false,insideSign=1;
 if(points.length){
  const xs=points.map(p=>p.x),zs=points.map(p=>p.z);
  const midZ=(Math.min(...zs)+Math.max(...zs))*.5;
  const midX=(Math.min(...xs)+Math.max(...xs))*.5;
  // Use the same z-axis orientation as dfV75Minimap.prepare(), which
  // transforms (x,z) into (screen x,screen y) without any rotation.
  startFar=start.z<midZ;
  if(world.minimap.closed){
   const normal=inwardAt(0);
   const centreVector=new THREE.Vector3(midX-start.x,0,midZ-start.z);
   const signed=centreVector.dot(normal);
   if(Math.abs(signed)>1e-5)insideSign=signed>0?1:-1;
   else insideSign=dfV79CameraSideSign(0)>=0?1:-1;
  }else{
   // A straight course does not have an oval centre to determine 'inside'.
   insideSign=dfV79CameraSideSign(0)>=0?1:-1;
  }
 }else{
  insideSign=dfV79CameraSideSign(0)>=0?1:-1;
 }
 const sideSign=(startFar?1:-1)*insideSign;
 const side=inwardAt(0).multiplyScalar(sideSign).normalize();
 const policy={startFar,insideSign,sideSign,side,cacheKey};
 if(world)world._dfV128StartCameraPolicy=policy;
 return policy;
}
function dfV128FixedWorldCameraSide(){
 // One continuous WORLD-space camera rail from gate to goal.  On the far
 // straight this naturally becomes the opposite inner/outer relationship,
 // with a smooth camera move through the corner and no hard perspective cut.
 return dfV128StartCameraPolicy().side.clone();
}
// ===== Ver.52: single broadcast direction engine for all five Three.js venues =====
// Presentation only. Receives current race-state snapshots and never writes to
// dist, runoutDist, lane, velocity, finish order, model scale, money or storage.
// No free-flying cameras: each cut is an infield TV position following a small
// actual group. Bounding calculations use the existing 5.25 x 4.20 sprite art.
const dfV52Director={
 key:'', anchorNo:null, focusNos:[], lastCutAt:-100, shownRails:null, cornerShotActive:false,
 eye:new THREE.Vector3(), aim:new THREE.Vector3(), initialized:false, transition:null,
 oneTakeStarted:false,oneTakeStartEye:null,oneTakeStartAim:null,oneTakeStartFov:0,
 oneTakeOrigin:null,oneTakeFocus:null,oneTakeGoalLocked:false,oneTakeZoomReference:0,
 narrationCatchUp:0,
 reset(){
  this.key='';this.anchorNo=null;this.focusNos=[];this.lastCutAt=-100;
  this.initialized=false;this.transition=null;this.cornerShotActive=false;
  this.oneTakeStarted=false;this.oneTakeStartEye=null;this.oneTakeStartAim=null;
  this.oneTakeStartFov=0;this.oneTakeOrigin=null;this.oneTakeFocus=null;this.oneTakeGoalLocked=false;this.oneTakeZoomReference=0;
  this.narrationCatchUp=0;
  if(this.shownRails){for(const r of this.shownRails)r.visible=true;this.shownRails=null;}
 },
 railVisibility(show){
  const rails=dfV47World?.cameraSideRails;
  if(!rails)return;
  // Ver.71: ユーザー指定により、内ラチと外柵は常時表示する。
  // レース演出用の一時非表示は行わず、どのカメラでも両方見えるように固定。
  for(const r of rails)if(r.visible!==true)r.visible=true;
  this.shownRails=rails;
 },
 selectGroup(order,shot){
  const leader=order[0];
  if(shot==='front'&&race==='idle')return {list:order,kind:'gate'};
  if(shot==='front'&&leader.dist<8)return {list:order,kind:'gate'};
  if(shot==='aerial')return {list:order.slice(0,Math.min(6,order.length)),kind:'wide'};
  if(shot==='v62-goal')return {list:order.slice(0,Math.min(5,order.length)),kind:'goal'};
  if(shot==='broadcast'){
   // Ver.81: show actual FRONT / MIDFIELD / BACKMARKERS in the early and
   // middle stages, with a smooth one-take transfer between subjects. In the
   // last 800m return to the current leading group. Race order and pace are
   // read-only; changing the broadcast subject NEVER changes horse movement.
   const remaining=TOTAL-leader.dist;
   // Ver.106: focus a horse BEFORE its name is spoken, while the camera
   // remains one continuous, fixed-angle shot without jump cuts.
   // No commentary cutaway once the lead group must remain in view.
   const spoken=remaining>800?order.find(h=>h.no===raceNarration.focusNo&&elapsed<raceNarration.focusUntil):null;
   if(spoken){
    const companions=order.filter(h=>h!==spoken)
     .sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.dist-spoken.dist)-Math.abs(b.dist-spoken.dist))
     .slice(0,3);
    return {list:[spoken,...companions],kind:'broadcast',phase:'narration'};
   }
   // From 800m out show the live leaders continuously, not touring/rear runners.
   if(remaining<=800){
    return {list:order.filter(h=>leader.dist-h.dist<=22).slice(0,5),kind:'broadcast',phase:'leading'};
   }
   let anchor=leader,phase='leading';
   if(remaining>800&&leader.dist>=95&&order.length>5){
    const touringMetres=Math.max(1,TOTAL-800-95);
    const segment=Math.max(170,Math.min(320,touringMetres/3));
    const stage=Math.floor((leader.dist-95)/segment)%4;
    const slot=stage===0?.47:stage===1?.84:stage===2?.30:0;
    anchor=order[Math.min(order.length-1,Math.round((order.length-1)*slot))];
    phase=stage===1?'rear':stage===0||stage===2?'middle':'leading';
   }
   // Four closest companions keep the SAME relatively tight view at every
   // section of the field: do not zoom out to fit both leader and last horse.
   const companions=order.filter(h=>h!==anchor)
    .sort((a,b)=>{
     const da=Math.abs(a.dist-anchor.dist)+Math.abs(a.lane-anchor.lane)*1.7;
     const db=Math.abs(b.dist-anchor.dist)+Math.abs(b.lane-anchor.lane)*1.7;
     return da-db||a.no-b.no;
    }).slice(0,4);
   return {list:[anchor,...companions],kind:'broadcast',phase};
  }
  if(shot==='spotlight'){
   const featured=order.find(h=>h.no===raceNarration.focusNo)||leader;
   return {list:[featured],kind:'detail'};
  }
  // The actual running order is authoritative. A camera subject is NOT a
  // chosen future winner: it is only a temporary view of real contenders.
  const gap=order.length>4?leader.dist-order[4].dist:0;
  const followChasers=camMode==='auto'&&race==='running'&&gap>10&&
      Math.floor(Math.max(0,elapsed-5)/14)%4===2&&shot!=='finish';
  const primary=followChasers?order[Math.min(4,order.length-1)]:leader;
  // Hysteresis prevents tiny overtakes from changing the shot every frame.
  const remembered=order.find(h=>h.no===this.anchorNo);
  const anchor=remembered&&this.key.startsWith(followChasers?'chasing':'leading')&&
        Math.abs(remembered.dist-primary.dist)<3.2?remembered:primary;
   // Include the close competitors in the same television frame rather than
   // only the anchor and one horse. Limit to a compact group so distant runners
   // never force a whole-field zoom-out.
   const nearby=order.filter(h=>h!==anchor&&Math.abs(h.dist-anchor.dist)<11.0&&
         Math.abs(h.lane-anchor.lane)<8.0)
     .sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.dist-anchor.dist)-Math.abs(b.dist-anchor.dist))
     .slice(0,5);
   return {list:[anchor,...nearby],kind:followChasers?'chasing':'leading'};
 },
 calculate(group,shot,aspect,portrait){
  const chosen=group.list,gate=group.kind==='gate',wide=group.kind==='wide',corner=shot==='corner';
  if(group.kind==='goal'){
   // Ver.78: fixed finish camera from the OUTER side of the course.
   // Keep the leading group in frame while locking at the goal, but avoid
   // an infield/inside-rail viewpoint.
   const finish=trackAt(TOTAL),direction=headingAt(TOTAL);
   const eye=finish.clone().addScaledVector(direction,31)
     .addScaledVector(dfV128FixedWorldCameraSide(),18);
   eye.y+=dfV47World?.id==='niigata'?9.0:7.1;
   const aim=finish.clone().addScaledVector(direction,-16);
   aim.y+=2.25;
   return {eye,aim,fov:portrait?44:40};
  }
  const focusDist=group.kind==='broadcast'?chosen[0].dist:chosen.reduce((sum,h)=>sum+h.dist,0)/chosen.length;
  const t=headingAt(focusDist),n=inwardAt(focusDist),track=trackAt(focusDist);
  const bend=(corner||group.kind==='broadcast')?dfV56BendAt(focusDist):{strength:0,side:0};
  // Route profile decides the filming side; never assume outer is clearer.
  const filmSide=dfV79CameraSideSign(focusDist);
  // Follow from the same physical WORLD side on every straight and bend.
  // The inward normal reverses after each 180-degree corner, so this fixed
  // world-side offset truly crosses from inside to outside (and vice versa).
  // Previous versions applied this vector ONLY at the goal, leaving the race
  // camera stuck on a constant inside/outside local normal.
  const continuousBroadcastSide=group.kind==='broadcast'
   ?dfV128FixedWorldCameraSide():null;
  const centre=chosen.reduce((v,h)=>v.add(h.root.position),new THREE.Vector3())
                  .multiplyScalar(1/chosen.length);
  if(group.kind==='broadcast')centre.lerp(chosen[0].root.position,.68); // keep narrated horse central
  let fov=portrait?49:47;
  const aim=centre.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.22,0));
  if(corner)aim.addScaledVector(t,8+10*bend.strength); // show track turning ahead
  if(group.kind==='broadcast')aim.addScaledVector(t,3*bend.strength);
  if(gate){
   // Ver.78: gate shot from the OUTER side, slightly closer and lower so the
   // horses/jockeys read larger at the break while preserving all starters.
   const visibleStalls=Math.min(STARTERS,10);
   const stallPitch=Math.min(2.30,(dfV47World.width-4.6)/Math.max(1,STARTERS-1));
   const width=Math.max(13,(visibleStalls-1)*stallPitch+5);
   // Hanshin: film beside the gate rather than looking straight through
   // a long foreground rail. Keep enough width for a full starting field.
   const isHanshinGate=dfV47World?.id==='hanshin';
   fov=isHanshinGate?(portrait?55:50):(portrait?58:53);
   const dist=Math.max(34,width/(2*Math.tan(fov*Math.PI/360)*Math.max(.38,aspect)*.80));
   const u=dfV57GateIntro.active?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,dfV57GateIntro.progress)):1;
   const ease=u*u*(3-2*u);
   const gateDistance=dfV57GateIntro.active?dist*(1.02-.34*ease):dist*.96;
   if(dfV57GateIntro.active)fov+=1.5*(1-ease);
   const lateral=isHanshinGate?Math.max(27,(dfV47World?.width||26)*.5+13):15;
   // Start on the map upper/back half -> inside; lower/front -> outside.
   // The minimap itself remains fixed and does not rotate.
   const startSide=dfV128StartCameraPolicy().side;
   const eye=centre.clone().addScaledVector(t,gateDistance*(isHanshinGate?.91:1))
     .addScaledVector(startSide,lateral);
   eye.y+=isHanshinGate?8.6:7.2;
   return {eye,aim,fov};
  }
  if(wide){
   fov=portrait?55:51;
   const eye=centre.clone().addScaledVector(n,filmSide*33).addScaledVector(t,-12);
   eye.y+=34;
   return {eye,aim,fov};
  }
  if(group.kind==='detail')fov=portrait?34:32; // Ver.57 commentary closeup
  if(corner)fov=portrait?54:50; // more curvature and nearby rails in the frame
  if(group.kind==='broadcast')fov=portrait?50:47; // Ver.80: close field coverage, not a distant wide shot
  // Ver.79: camera stays to the preferred safe side for this course,
  // slightly above the rails and aimed toward the live racing group.
  const along=corner?(-19-10*bend.strength):group.kind==='broadcast'?-3-9*bend.strength:shot==='chase'?-7:shot==='finish'?3:shot==='spotlight'?2:5;
  const height=corner?(portrait?22.5:20.5)+4*bend.strength:group.kind==='broadcast'?(portrait?13.6:12.8)+6*bend.strength:group.kind==='detail'?(portrait?8.6:8.0):(portrait?11.7:10.8);
  const computeEye=(distance)=>{
   const eye=centre.clone()
     .addScaledVector(continuousBroadcastSide||n,(continuousBroadcastSide?1:filmSide)*distance)
     .addScaledVector(t,along);
   eye.y+=height+Math.max(0,distance-29)*.10;
   return eye;
  };
  // Proper perspective fit in screen space: the existing sprite is billboarded
  // at scale 1.08. Account for visible label headroom and portrait HUD space.
  const fit=(eye)=>{
   const front=aim.clone().sub(eye).normalize();
   const right=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(front,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)).normalize();
   const up=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(right,front).normalize();
   const tan=Math.tan(fov*Math.PI/360);
   const safeX=.84,safeY=.69;
   let ratio=0;
   for(const h of chosen){
    const rel=h.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.25,0)).sub(eye);
    const depth=Math.max(.01,rel.dot(front));
    ratio=Math.max(ratio,
     (Math.abs(rel.dot(right))+2.86)/(depth*tan*Math.max(.37,aspect)*safeX),
     (Math.abs(rel.dot(up))+2.40)/(depth*tan*safeY));
   }
   return ratio;
  };
  // Solve a single physical distance; never re-open the field of view every
  // frame and never try to frame the entire spread-out 18-horse field.
   let low=22,high=96;
   for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
   const mid=(low+high)*.5;
   if(fit(computeEye(mid))>1)low=mid;else high=mid;
  }
   // Mild pullback: more of the racing surface and nearby horses stay visible.
   // The capped distance prevents a distant runner from shrinking the whole pack.
   // Ver.63: modestly tighter race coverage while still solving the actual
   // five horses' on-screen perspective bounds (do NOT crop to a single horse).
   const distance=Math.min(group.kind==='broadcast'?55:95,Math.max(corner?39:group.kind==='detail'?24.5:(group.kind==='broadcast'?30:(chosen.length===1?35:37)),high*(corner?1.01:group.kind==='broadcast'?.73:group.kind==='detail'?1.01:1.03)));
  return {eye:computeEye(distance),aim,fov};
 },
 // The first hundred metres are ONE continuous mobile shot starting precisely
 // at the end of the pre-start gate closeup. No automatic focus changes, no
 // bird's-eye crane, no shot key transition and no "missing horse" teleport.
 updateGateFollow(instant,order){
  const gate=dfV61GateFollow;
  if(!gate.active||!gate.eye||!gate.aim||!gate.origin)return false;
  const progress=Math.max(0,order[0].dist);
  // Live 3-D course tangent and bends determine where the group has travelled.
  const displacement=trackAt(Math.min(220,progress)).sub(gate.origin);
  // Translate the SAME gate viewpoint together with the horses, preserving
  // the eye-to-aim direction rather than turning it into a new TV camera.
  const eyeWanted=gate.eye.clone().add(displacement);
  const aimWanted=gate.aim.clone().add(displacement);
  // Follow the horses, smoothly accelerating and decelerating, without
  // replacing the gate camera at the very moment the doors open.
  const dt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(.001,renderDeltaSeconds));
  const eyeAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*4.0);
  const aimAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*5.8);
  if(instant){this.eye.copy(eyeWanted);this.aim.copy(aimWanted);}
  else{this.eye.lerp(eyeWanted,eyeAlpha);this.aim.lerp(aimWanted,aimAlpha);}
  // Keep the original lens for the first metres; close a little as the pack
  // moves away, without zooming out into the sky or losing the gate picture.
  const u=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(progress-8)/180));
  const ease=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const fov=gate.fov+(Math.min(gate.fov,49)-gate.fov)*.45*ease;
  if(Math.abs(camera.fov-fov)>.01){camera.fov=fov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
  this.transition=null;
  this.key='gate-follow:continuous';
  this.anchorNo=order[0].no;
  this.focusNos=order.slice(0,Math.min(5,order.length)).map(h=>h.no);
  this.initialized=true;
  this.railVisibility(false);
  camera.position.copy(this.eye);viewTarget.copy(this.aim);
  camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  lastCameraShot='gate-follow';
  $('camname').textContent='CAM　ゲートから連続追走';
  mats.sun.position.set(viewTarget.x-42,viewTarget.y+78,viewTarget.z+24);
  mats.sun.target.position.copy(viewTarget);
  return true;
 },
 // Ver.66: The very same virtual camera persists for the ENTIRE run.
 // Only its position, direction and zoom are interpolated over time. NEVER
 // switch to a new eye/aim, trigger a cut, crane transition or goal-camera
 // preset. The horse data, simulation clock and result display are untouched.
 updateOneTake(order,aspect,portrait){
  if(!order.length)return;
  const gate=dfV61GateFollow;
  const dt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(.001,renderDeltaSeconds));
  if(!this.oneTakeStarted){
   // First frame inherits the ACTUAL gate frame already being shown. The
   // screenshot at the instant the gates open therefore remains continuous.
   this.oneTakeStarted=true;this.transition=null;
   this.oneTakeStartEye=(gate.active&&gate.eye?gate.eye:this.eye).clone();
   this.oneTakeStartAim=(gate.active&&gate.aim?gate.aim:this.aim).clone();
   this.oneTakeStartFov=gate.active&&gate.fov?gate.fov:camera.fov;
   // Ver.80: preserve the horses' apparent size from the just-launched gate
   // shot. Distance * tan(half FOV) is an angular-size reference; as the
   // camera moves, the optical field of view compensates automatically.
   const startDistance=this.oneTakeStartEye.distanceTo(this.oneTakeStartAim);
   this.oneTakeZoomReference=clamp(
     startDistance*Math.tan(this.oneTakeStartFov*Math.PI/360)*1.12,14.5,26);
   this.oneTakeOrigin=(gate.active&&gate.origin?gate.origin:trackAt(0)).clone();
   this.eye.copy(this.oneTakeStartEye);
   this.aim.copy(this.oneTakeStartAim);
   this.initialized=true;
  }
  // Stay with the horses during the final 100m; parking an exactly side-on
  // camera at 100m would leave the horses completely outside the narrow frame.
  // Lock only once the SAME camera has reached the finish-line SIDE position.
  const leader=order[0];
  const progress=Math.max(0,leader.dist);
  const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-progress);
  // Mark the shot as locked only after the camera itself reaches the goal.
  // The final position is checked after the smooth move below.
  if(this.oneTakeGoalLocked||race==='finished'){
   this.railVisibility(false);
   camera.position.copy(this.eye);viewTarget.copy(this.aim);
   camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
   $('camname').textContent='CAM　ゴール固定・ワンカット';
   return;
  }
  // Follow the gates in their original physical frame first. This target is
  // a TRANSLATION of the actual gate camera along the real course centreline.
  const displacement=trackAt(Math.min(progress,480)).sub(this.oneTakeOrigin);
  const gateEye=this.oneTakeStartEye.clone().add(displacement);
  const gateAim=this.oneTakeStartAim.clone().add(displacement);
  const group=this.selectGroup(order,'broadcast');
  const tracking=this.calculate(group,'broadcast',aspect,portrait);
  const smooth=(x)=>{const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));return u*u*(3-2*u);};
  // Pan the SAME gate lens toward the gate leaders as they accelerate;
  // Ver.81 then tracks the selected pack smoothly after the early straight.
  const gatePan=smooth((progress-2)/115)*.95;
  gateAim.lerp(group.list[0].root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.2,0)),gatePan);
  // Start sliding from the gate toward a trackside position without a cut;
  // finish the gradual move before tight bends can hide the horse pack.
  const travel=smooth((progress-55)/265);
  // Ver.126: keep the TV-follow position a little closer to the horses.
  // This preserves the large starting view without cutting or changing viewpoint.
  // The existing finish-side camera below is not modified.
  // Slightly wider / slightly higher TV camera, keeping the same one-take movement.
  // Pull back gently from the working camera, and shoot from higher above.
  const closeTrackingEye=tracking.eye.clone().lerp(tracking.aim,-.11);
  closeTrackingEye.y+=5.6;
  const desiredEye=gateEye.lerp(closeTrackingEye,travel);
  const desiredAim=gateAim.lerp(tracking.aim,travel);
  let desiredFov=this.oneTakeStartFov+(tracking.fov-this.oneTakeStartFov)*travel;
   // For early-course overtakes, use the existing single camera and briefly
   // aim between the two actual runners; late overtakes use the side camera below.
   if(remaining>1000&&progress>45&&performance.now()<df140LeadDuels.until&&df140LeadDuels.nos.length===2){
    const pair=df140LeadDuels.nos.map(no=>order.find(h=>h.no===no)).filter(Boolean);
    if(pair.length===2){
     const aim=pair[0].root.position.clone().add(pair[1].root.position).multiplyScalar(.5);
     aim.y+=2.75;
     desiredAim.lerp(aim,.45);
    }
   }
  // Ver.103: one continuous sideways leader camera. Start the approach at
  // 1000m to go, reach the true side and slightly overhead by 600m, and keep
  // that very same angle alongside the leaders all the way to the goal.
  // No early '300m goal camera' transition and no 100m shot switch.
  const nearLeaders=order.filter(h=>leader.dist-h.dist<=24).slice(0,5);
  const isNiigataFinish=dfV47World?.id==='niigata';
  const sideBlend=smooth((1000-remaining)/400);
  const goalTrackPoint=trackAt(TOTAL);
  // Constant WORLD-side filming vector. Relative to the track's reversing
  // direction, this gradually changes from the inside to the outside.
  const broadcastSide=dfV128FixedWorldCameraSide();
  // Issue #7: normal and VS races share the same low, oblique rail-side
  // finish camera. Keep the existing one-take smoothing and zoom unchanged.
  const finishGap=Math.max(23,(dfV47World?.width??30)*.5+7);
  const goalEye=goalTrackPoint.clone().addScaledVector(broadcastSide,finishGap);
  goalEye.addScaledVector(headingAt(TOTAL),-10);
  goalEye.y+=6.5;
  const goalAim=goalTrackPoint.clone().addScaledVector(headingAt(TOTAL),-8);
  goalAim.y+=2.6;
  if(sideBlend>0){
   // Use ONLY runners currently close to the lead, so a straggler cannot
   // force a zoomed-out view. The selection is read-only.
   const pack=order.filter(h=>leader.dist-h.dist<=16).slice(0,5);
   if(!pack.length)pack.push(leader);
   // Only the leading pack decides the finish shot. Narration may not
   // drag the lens away toward a midfield or rear horse.
   const packDistance=pack.reduce((sum,h)=>sum+h.dist,0)/pack.length;
   // Final 100m: follow the live leaders toward the line, rather than
   // sending the camera ahead to GOAL at 350m out (which loses the horses).
   // The eye stays alongside the pack; during the last 100m it gradually
   // catches up from the group centre to the leading horse's position.
   // At the line it reaches the fixed goal position without a sudden cut.
   const finishApproach=smooth((100-remaining)/100);
   const sideDist=Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL,
     packDistance+Math.max(0,leader.dist-packDistance)*finishApproach));
   const sideTrack=trackAt(sideDist);
   const localNormal=inwardAt(sideDist);
   const cornerOverhead=1-Math.abs(localNormal.dot(broadcastSide));
   const sideEye=sideTrack.clone().addScaledVector(broadcastSide,finishGap);
   sideEye.addScaledVector(headingAt(sideDist),-10);
   sideEye.y+=6.5+cornerOverhead*2.0;
   const sideAim=pack.reduce((v,h)=>v.add(h.root.position),new THREE.Vector3())
      .multiplyScalar(1/pack.length);
   sideAim.y+=2.6;
    if(remaining>70&&performance.now()<df140LeadDuels.until&&df140LeadDuels.nos.length===2){
     const pair=df140LeadDuels.nos.map(no=>order.find(h=>h.no===no)).filter(Boolean);
     if(pair.length===2){
      const point=pair[0].root.position.clone().add(pair[1].root.position).multiplyScalar(.5);
      point.y+=2.75;
      sideAim.lerp(point,.65);
     }
    }
    // Keep aiming at the leading pack through the final 100m. Gently
   // settle on the goal point only within the last 35m, avoiding a premature
   // pan that previously let all horses leave the screen.
   sideAim.lerp(goalAim,smooth((35-remaining)/35));
   desiredEye.lerp(sideEye,sideBlend);
   desiredAim.lerp(sideAim,sideBlend);
  }
  // Smoothly move the same eye and optical axis each rendered frame. Cap the
  // maximum camera travel, so a popular horse / leadership swap cannot throw
  // the spectator from one side of the course to another in one frame.
  const playbackCameraRate=df128PresentationRate();
  // Ease into a calmer lateral follow. The finish shot now tracks the
  // leaders toward the line rather than racing ahead of them.
  const calmFollow=smooth((progress-40)/110)*(1-smooth((260-remaining)/70));
  // Ver.127: an announced horse takes priority over the deliberately slow
  // Ver.126 touring camera.  The caption system waits until the horse is
  // visibly framed BEFORE introducing its name; it must not be stranded by
  // the ordinary 24m/s lateral speed limit when the subject is far away.
  // Read-only position/camera test: no race state or commentary text changes.
  const spokenTarget=remaining>185?order.find(h=>
    h.no===raceNarration.focusNo&&elapsed<raceNarration.focusUntil):null;
  const needsNarrationPan=Boolean(spokenTarget&&!df106FeaturedHorseOnCamera(spokenTarget));
  const responseRate=needsNarrationPan?2.9:2.4;
  this.narrationCatchUp+=(Number(needsNarrationPan)-this.narrationCatchUp)*
    (1-Math.exp(-dt*responseRate));
  const catchUp=this.narrationCatchUp;
  // Ver.128: the 3-second camera head start permits a gentler narration pan.
  // Keep normal follow, zoom and the fixed finish-shot logic unchanged.
  // At the finish do NOT accelerate the camera to 51-56m/s. Its target
  // follows the actual leaders; let the eye/aim move smoothly at a calm
  // tracking rate even with the default 2x replay speed selected.
  const lastHundred=smooth((110-remaining)/110);
  const eyeRate=(3.15-.60*lastHundred)*(1-.34*calmFollow)+1.2*catchUp;
  const aimRate=(4.0-.70*lastHundred)*(1-.34*calmFollow)+1.6*catchUp;
  const eyeCap=(remaining<360?39:30)-(remaining<360?15*lastHundred:0);
  const aimCap=(remaining<360?45:33)-(remaining<360?17*lastHundred:0);
  const moveAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*playbackCameraRate*eyeRate);
  const aimAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*playbackCameraRate*aimRate);
  const eyeMove=desiredEye.sub(this.eye);
  const eyeStep=Math.min(eyeMove.length()*moveAlpha,dt*eyeCap*playbackCameraRate);
  if(eyeMove.lengthSq()>1e-10)this.eye.addScaledVector(eyeMove.normalize(),eyeStep);
  const aimMove=desiredAim.sub(this.aim);
  const aimStep=Math.min(aimMove.length()*aimAlpha,dt*aimCap*playbackCameraRate);
  if(aimMove.lengthSq()>1e-10)this.aim.addScaledVector(aimMove.normalize(),aimStep);
  // Ver.81: maintain a similar zoom on the CURRENT featured pack, not the
  // race leader. Ver.80 mistakenly zoomed with the leader even while trying
  // to film horses behind, pulling the selected group out of the picture.
  // Near the finish frame the leaders and fixed goal together as before.
  const featured=(raceNarration.focusNo&&elapsed<raceNarration.focusUntil&&remaining>800)?group.list[0]:(remaining<=800?leader:group.list[0]);
  const featuredBody=featured.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.2,0));
  const eyeToFeatured=Math.max(9,this.eye.distanceTo(featuredBody));
  const matchedFov=2*Math.atan(this.oneTakeZoomReference/eyeToFeatured)*180/Math.PI;
  // Ver.87: only the final approach gradually tightens the composition.
  // The five-runner framing check below still widens the lens as needed.
  const finishZoom=1; // Ver.103: no sudden last-100m zoom or shot change
   desiredFov=clamp(matchedFov*finishZoom*1.10,portrait?36:34,portrait?62:59);
   // Ver.126: maintain a consistent close-up throughout normal racing.
   // Do not repeatedly open the lens to fit another selected horse; pan to it
   // slowly instead. The first 40m and the final special goal shot are unchanged.
   const closeLensBlend=smooth((progress-40)/135)*(1-smooth((270-remaining)/135));
   if(closeLensBlend>0){
    const calmerFov=Math.max(portrait?35:33,desiredFov*.99);
    desiredFov+=(calmerFov-desiredFov)*closeLensBlend;
   }
  // Ver.84: during the moving goal shot calculate the projected bounds of
  // FIVE live runners. Merely sizing from the leader cuts everybody else out
  // for an instant, particularly while the camera angle is rotating.
  if(remaining<240&&nearLeaders.length>1){
   const forward=this.aim.clone().sub(this.eye).normalize();
   const right=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(forward,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0)).normalize();
   const up=new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(right,forward).normalize();
   let requiredHalfFov=0;
   for(const h of nearLeaders){
    const displacement=h.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.2,0)).sub(this.eye);
    const depth=Math.max(1,displacement.dot(forward));
    // Allow head, legs and on-screen race labels to fit within the viewport.
    const x=Math.abs(displacement.dot(right))+2.8;
    const y=Math.abs(displacement.dot(up))+2.55;
    const horizontalNeeded=x/(depth*Math.max(.35,aspect)*.89);
    const verticalNeeded=y/(depth*.86);
    requiredHalfFov=Math.max(requiredHalfFov,Math.atan(Math.max(horizontalNeeded,verticalNeeded)));
   }
   const fiveHorseFov=2*requiredHalfFov*180/Math.PI;
   const fiveHorseBlend=smooth((240-remaining)/135);
   // Give priority to the FRONT pack, not far-away stragglers at finish.
   const nearFront=nearLeaders.filter(h=>leader.dist-h.dist<=20);
   if(nearFront.length===nearLeaders.length)
    desiredFov=Math.max(desiredFov,Math.min(portrait?63:60,fiveHorseFov)*fiveHorseBlend);
  }
  // Ver.101: once transferred, keep the finish-camera lens stable. Its
  // placement is next to the goal, filming the horses as they run past.
  if(this.oneTakeGoalLocked)desiredFov=camera.fov;
  const newFov=camera.fov+(desiredFov-camera.fov)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*(remaining<120?6.0:4.8)));
  if(Math.abs(newFov-camera.fov)>.005){camera.fov=newFov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
  // Ver.86: reach the slightly oblique (~15 degree) goal-side broadcast
  // position before the first horse finishes. Follow the leading five
  // smoothly during the approach, then park about 10m before the line.
  if(remaining<=35&&this.eye.distanceTo(goalEye)<7.5&&this.aim.distanceTo(goalAim)<11)
    this.oneTakeGoalLocked=true;
  this.key='one-take';this.anchorNo=group.list[0].no;
  this.focusNos=group.list.map(h=>h.no);this.transition=null;
  // Rail geometry is non-interactive scenery: avoid blocking the live horses.
  this.railVisibility(false);
  camera.position.copy(this.eye);viewTarget.copy(this.aim);
  camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  lastCameraShot='one-take';
  $('camname').textContent=remaining<=600?'CAM　柵沿い・低い斜め追走':
    remaining<=1000?'CAM　ワンカット・先頭へ接近':
    group.phase==='rear'?'CAM　ワンカット・後方集団':
    group.phase==='middle'?'CAM　ワンカット・中団':'CAM　ワンカット・先頭';
  mats.sun.position.set(viewTarget.x-42,viewTarget.y+78,viewTarget.z+24);
  mats.sun.target.position.copy(viewTarget);
 },
 update(instant,order,shot,aspect,portrait){
  if(shot==='gate-follow'&&this.updateGateFollow(instant,order))return;
  if(dfV61GateFollow.active&&shot!=='gate-follow'){
   // First handoff tracks the same leading horse; do not abruptly seek a
   // distant commentator/favourite before this camera move has completed.
   dfV59Focus.no=order[0].no;dfV59Focus.holdUntil=performance.now()+3600;
   dfV61GateFollow.reset();
  }
  const group=this.selectGroup(order,shot);
  const front=group.kind==='gate',wide=group.kind==='wide';
  const next=this.calculate(group,shot,aspect,portrait);
  const subject=group.list[0].no;
  const key=group.kind+':'+shot;
  const dt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(.001,renderDeltaSeconds));
  if(instant||!this.initialized){
   // First display, new race and non-broadcast resize: start exactly at the
   // current subject. These are not changes between two broadcast cameras.
   this.transition=null;
   this.eye.copy(next.eye);this.aim.copy(next.aim);
   camera.fov=next.fov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }else{
   if(key!==this.key||(group.kind==='broadcast'&&subject!==this.anchorNo&&this.anchorNo!==null)){
    // Preserve the LAST rendered eye/aim even when a second camera selection
    // arrives before the previous three-second move completes.
    const previous=order.find(h=>h.no===this.anchorNo);
    const previousPosition=previous?previous.root.position.clone():null;
    const span=this.eye.distanceTo(next.eye);
    this.transition={
     elapsed:0,duration:Math.min(6.0,Math.max(3.0,2.7+span/55)),
     fromEye:this.eye.clone(),fromAim:this.aim.clone(),fromFov:camera.fov,
     anchorNo:previous?previous.no:null,anchorStart:previousPosition,
     // An infield crane arc avoids sweeping a low camera directly through
     // scenery. Small adjustments stay low; long transfers fly higher.
     // Ver.60: the 46m crane ascent let the camera float into the sky.
     // Keep the camera near horse height while switching from the gate to TV.
     lift:Math.min(2.8,Math.max(0,(span-38)*.026))
    };
   }
   const move=this.transition;
   if(move){
    move.elapsed=Math.min(move.duration,move.elapsed+dt);
    if(move.duration-move.elapsed<1e-6)move.elapsed=move.duration;
    const u=move.elapsed/move.duration;
    // Zero starting and ending velocity: gentle acceleration, then slowing.
    const ease=u*u*(3-2*u);
    const movingAnchor=move.anchorNo===null?null:order.find(h=>h.no===move.anchorNo);
    const drift=(movingAnchor&&move.anchorStart)?
      movingAnchor.root.position.clone().sub(move.anchorStart):new THREE.Vector3();
    // Follow the former subject while departing and the new live subject
    // while arriving, rather than looking at an out-of-date fixed point.
    const followEye=move.fromEye.clone().add(drift);
    const followAim=move.fromAim.clone().add(drift);
    this.eye.copy(followEye).lerp(next.eye,ease);
    this.aim.copy(followAim).lerp(next.aim,ease);
    this.eye.y+=move.lift*Math.sin(Math.PI*ease);
    // No flyover into empty sky. The visual shot must remain close to the
    // actual racing surface throughout a 3–6 second transfer.
    const courseY=group.list[0].root.position.y;
    this.eye.y=clamp(this.eye.y,courseY+7.0,courseY+27.0);
    this.aim.y=clamp(this.aim.y,courseY+1.2,courseY+4.1);
    const fov=move.fromFov+(next.fov-move.fromFov)*ease;
    if(Math.abs(camera.fov-fov)>.01){camera.fov=fov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
    if(u>=1)this.transition=null;
   }else{
    // Normal tracking of moving horses between transitions remains smooth.
    const eyeAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*6.5);
    const aimAlpha=1-Math.exp(-dt*9.0);
    this.eye.lerp(next.eye,eyeAlpha);
    this.aim.lerp(next.aim,aimAlpha);
    if(Math.abs(camera.fov-next.fov)>.01){
     camera.fov+= (next.fov-camera.fov)*(1-Math.exp(-dt*6));
     camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    }
   }
  }
  // Near rails are scenery only. Hide them during a travelling shot so that
  // they cannot momentarily cover the runners as the viewpoint passes by.
  this.railVisibility(!this.transition&&(front||wide||race==='idle'));
  this.key=key;this.anchorNo=subject;
  this.focusNos=group.list.map(h=>h.no);
  this.initialized=true;
  camera.position.copy(this.eye);viewTarget.copy(this.aim);
  camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  // Ver.60: project the ACTUAL horse (not its HTML name label) into this
  // frame. If gate -> broadcast travel or an unexpectedly large focus move
  // puts the subject outside the picture, recover the camera on-course now.
  // This only changes the visual camera; the racing model remains untouched.
  if(!front&&!wide&&group.kind!=='goal'&&race!=='idle'){
   const subjectHorse=group.list[0];
   const body=subjectHorse.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.0,0));
   const ndc=body.clone().project(camera);
   const cameraToHorse=body.distanceTo(camera.position);
   const missing=!Number.isFinite(ndc.x)||!Number.isFinite(ndc.y)||!Number.isFinite(ndc.z)||
     ndc.z<=-1||ndc.z>=1||Math.abs(ndc.x)>.82||Math.abs(ndc.y)>.73||
     cameraToHorse>155;
   if(missing){
    this.transition=null;
    this.eye.copy(next.eye);this.aim.copy(next.aim);
    camera.position.copy(this.eye);viewTarget.copy(this.aim);
    camera.fov=next.fov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
   }
  }
  lastCameraShot=shot;
  const name=group.kind==='goal'?'ゴール固定カメラ':front?'スタート':wide?'コーナー俯瞰':group.kind==='broadcast'?(TOTAL-order[0].dist<=800?'先頭集団を追跡':'注目馬を中心に約5頭'):shot==='corner'?'コーナー追走':group.kind==='chasing'?'追走集団':
    group.kind==='detail'?'注目馬':shot==='finish'?'ゴール前':shot==='chase'?'先頭追走':'先頭争い';
  $('camname').textContent='CAM　'+name;
  mats.sun.position.set(viewTarget.x-42,viewTarget.y+78,viewTarget.z+24);
  mats.sun.target.position.copy(viewTarget);
 }
};
// User-selected single-horse camera; read-only against race simulation.
const dfFollowCamera={
 active:false,no:null,roster:null,offset:null,
 refresh(){
  if(this.roster===runners)return;
  this.roster=runners;this.active=false;this.no=null;this.offset=null;
  const panel=document.getElementById('dfFollowControls');
  const select=document.getElementById('dfFollowHorse');
  if(!panel||!select)return;
  select.replaceChildren();
  for(const h of runners){
   const option=document.createElement('option');
   option.value=String(h.no);
   option.textContent=`${h.no}番 ${h.name||h.displayName||h.original||'出走馬'}`;
   select.appendChild(option);
  }
  panel.hidden=!runners.length;
  this.reflect();
 },
 reflect(){
  const on=document.getElementById('dfFollowSet');
  const off=document.getElementById('dfFollowAuto');
  if(on)on.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(this.active));
  if(off)off.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(!this.active));
 },
 follow(){
  const no=Number(document.getElementById('dfFollowHorse')?.value);
  if(!runners.some(h=>h.no===no))return;
  // A new target must start at its own true screen centre, not the old
  // horse's smoothed viewing offset or the previous broadcast camera.
  this.no=no;this.active=true;this.offset=null;this.reflect();setCam(false);
 },
 normal(){
  this.active=false;this.no=null;this.offset=null;this.reflect();
  camMode='auto';
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-camera]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.camera==='auto'));
  // Resume the existing continuous camera from the frame currently on screen,
  // rather than snapping back to its outdated pre-follow coordinates.
  if(dfV47World&&camera&&dfV52Director.oneTakeStarted&&dfV52Director.oneTakeOrigin){
   dfV52Director.oneTakeStarted=true;
   dfV52Director.oneTakeGoalLocked=false;
   dfV52Director.eye.copy(camera.position);
   dfV52Director.aim.copy(viewTarget);
   dfV52Director.oneTakeStartEye=camera.position.clone();
   dfV52Director.oneTakeStartAim=viewTarget.clone();
   dfV52Director.oneTakeStartFov=camera.fov;
  }
  setCam(false);
 },
 update(h,instant){
  const distance=Math.min(TOTAL,Math.max(0,h.dist));
  const forward=headingAt(distance);
  const side=dfV47World?dfV128FixedWorldCameraSide():inwardAt(distance);
  const aim=h.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.2,0));
  // Ver.169: only the user-selected horse camera sits a little farther back
  // and higher, keeping the chosen horse centered with a wider track view.
  const eye=aim.clone().addScaledVector(side,Math.max(27,(dfV47World?.width||28)*.5+13));
  eye.addScaledVector(forward,-11);
  eye.y+=13.5;
  const portrait=$('viewport').clientWidth/Math.max(1,$('viewport').clientHeight)<.88;
  const desiredFov=portrait?53:48;
  const dt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(.005,renderDeltaSeconds));
  const alpha=instant?1:1-Math.exp(-dt*4.3);
  // Ver.189: smoothing the absolute camera and aim coordinates separately
  // left the selected runner off-centre while it moved (especially on bends).
  // Lock the aim to the horse's CURRENT world position on EVERY frame and
  // smooth only the viewing offset. This keeps the Ver.169 higher/wider
  // camera angle and distance, without moving or altering the horse itself.
  const desiredOffset=eye.sub(aim);
  if(!this.offset||instant)this.offset=desiredOffset.clone();
  else this.offset.lerp(desiredOffset,alpha);
  camera.position.copy(aim).add(this.offset);
  viewTarget.copy(aim);
  camera.fov+=(desiredFov-camera.fov)*alpha;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  // Keep the auto director synced for a smooth return to its usual camera.
  if(dfV47World){dfV52Director.eye.copy(camera.position);dfV52Director.aim.copy(viewTarget);}
  lastCameraShot='selected-horse';
  $('camname').textContent=`CAM　注目馬 ${h.no}番 ${h.name||''}`;
  mats.sun.position.set(viewTarget.x-42,viewTarget.y+78,viewTarget.z+24);
  mats.sun.target.position.copy(viewTarget);
 }
};
function dfFollowCameraBind(){
 const follow=document.getElementById('dfFollowSet');
 const normal=document.getElementById('dfFollowAuto');
 const select=document.getElementById('dfFollowHorse');
 if(!follow||!normal||!select)return;
 follow.addEventListener('click',()=>dfFollowCamera.follow());
 normal.addEventListener('click',()=>dfFollowCamera.normal());
 select.addEventListener('change',()=>{if(dfFollowCamera.active)dfFollowCamera.follow();});
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',dfFollowCameraBind,{once:true});
else dfFollowCameraBind();
function setCam(instant=false){
 if(!camera||!runners.length)return;
 dfFollowCamera.refresh();
 if(dfFollowCamera.active){
  const chosen=runners.find(h=>h.no===dfFollowCamera.no);
  if(chosen){dfFollowCamera.update(chosen,instant);return;}
  dfFollowCamera.active=false;dfFollowCamera.reflect();
 }
 // Always compute from the latest running order, not a stored set of horse numbers.
 const order=ranks(),leader=order[0],shot=selectShot();
 const vp=$('viewport'),aspect=vp.clientWidth/Math.max(1,vp.clientHeight);
 const portrait=aspect<.88;
 // Ver.48's infield television cameras apply ONLY to Ver.47's imported scene.
 if(dfV47World){
  // Ver.66: one virtual camera from the gate opening right through the finish.
  // The existing gate INTRO (race idle) is left unchanged.
  if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout'||race==='finished')
   dfV52Director.updateOneTake(order,aspect,portrait);
  else dfV52Director.update(instant,order,shot,aspect,portrait);
  return;
 }
 if(shot==='finish'){
  // Ver.77: at 200m remaining, travel to the real goal-side camera position.
  // After arriving, stay beside the goal board and gently turn up the home
  // straight toward the incoming runners; do not jump or zoom abruptly.
  const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-leader.dist);
  const eye=trackOffset(TOTAL+7,(currentCourse.direction==='左'?-35:35));
  eye.y=portrait?6.3:6.8;
  const look=trackOffset(TOTAL-clamp(remaining*.42,12,78),(currentCourse.direction==='左'?2:-2));
  look.y=2.7;
  const fov=portrait?53:47;
  if(instant){camera.position.copy(eye);viewTarget.copy(look);camera.fov=fov;}
  else{
   const alpha=1-Math.exp(-Math.min(.05,Math.max(.005,renderDeltaSeconds))*4.0);
   camera.position.lerp(eye,alpha);
   viewTarget.lerp(look,alpha);
   camera.fov+=(fov-camera.fov)*alpha;
  }
  if(instant||Math.abs(camera.fov-fov)>.025)camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  camera.lookAt(viewTarget);
  camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  lastCameraShot='finish';
  $('camname').textContent='CAM 05　残り200m・ゴール板前';
  mats.sun.position.set(look.x-42,78,look.z+24);
  mats.sun.target.position.copy(look);
  return;
 }
 let focus,focusDist,camLateral=0,camHeight=0,camAlong=0,desiredFov;
 if(shot==='sweep'){
  // Two smooth leader -> tail -> leader sweeps, synchronized to the race
  // distance rather than replay speed. At 25% and 75%, the tail is in focus.
  // A 1200m sprint naturally has less available time than a 3200m race.
  const tail=order[order.length-1];
  const sweepPhase=clamp(leader.dist/Math.max(1,TOTAL-1000),0,1);
  const sweepRatio=(1-Math.cos(4*Math.PI*sweepPhase))*.5;
  focus=[leader,tail];
  focusDist=leader.dist+(tail.dist-leader.dist)*sweepRatio;
  sideCamState.active=true;
  sideCamState.focusNos=focus.map(h=>h.no);
  desiredFov=portrait?59:51;
  camLateral=portrait?-28:-26;
  camHeight=portrait?5.2:4.5;
  camAlong=0;
 }else if(shot==='side'||shot==='front5'){
  // Once there are only 600m left, always cover the actual running top five.
  // During 1000m-600m retain the previous top-three camera and commentary zooms.
  const last600=shot==='front5';
  focus=order.slice(0,last600?5:3);
  sideCamState.active=true;
  sideCamState.focusNos=focus.map(h=>h.no);
  const rear=focus[focus.length-1];
  focusDist=(leader.dist+rear.dist)*.5;
  desiredFov=last600?(portrait?61:53):(portrait?57:49);
  // Frame the real 3-D span of the top five, including turns, lateral lanes
  // and moving labels. Keep extra room so smoothing never clips the fifth horse.
  const tangentAtMid=headingAt(focusDist),sideAtMid=inwardAt(focusDist);
  const anchor=trackAt(focusDist);
  let alongMax=0,acrossMax=0;
  for(const h of focus){
   const offset=h.root.position.clone().sub(anchor);
   alongMax=Math.max(alongMax,Math.abs(offset.dot(tangentAtMid)));
   acrossMax=Math.max(acrossMax,Math.abs(offset.dot(sideAtMid)));
  }
  const longitudinalHalf=alongMax+(last600?7.2:3.35);
  const tanHalf=Math.tan(desiredFov*Math.PI/360);
  const requiredSideDistance=longitudinalHalf/Math.max(.16,tanHalf*aspect*(last600?.76:.72));
  camLateral=-Math.max(portrait?22:19,requiredSideDistance+acrossMax+2.8);
  camHeight=portrait?4.8:4.4;
  camAlong=0;
 }else if(shot==='spotlight'){
  // Short, fact-driven close-up on the horse mentioned by the text commentary.
  // This does not invent a winner and never moves the horse itself.
  const featured=runners.find(h=>h.no===raceNarration.focusNo);
  if(!featured){
   focus=order.slice(0,3);
   focusDist=leader.dist;
  }else{
   focus=[featured];
   focusDist=featured.dist;
  }
  sideCamState.active=true;
  sideCamState.focusNos=focus.map(h=>h.no);
  desiredFov=portrait?44:39;
  camLateral=portrait?-19:-17;
  camHeight=portrait?3.9:3.7;
  camAlong=0;
 }else if(shot==='aerial'){
  sideCamState.active=false;
  // A large gap to the last horse must not make the top runners tiny specks.
  // Use the ACTUAL world positions of the first four, not a curved-path midpoint.
  focus=order.slice(0,4);
  focusDist=focus.reduce((sum,h)=>sum+h.dist,0)/focus.length;
  desiredFov=portrait?60:53;
  const xs=focus.map(h=>h.root.position.x),zs=focus.map(h=>h.root.position.z);
  const maxX=Math.max(...xs)-Math.min(...xs),maxZ=Math.max(...zs)-Math.min(...zs);
  const tanHalf=Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(desiredFov*.5));
  const fitX=(maxX*.5+2.5)/Math.max(.24,tanHalf*aspect*.78);
  const fitZ=(maxZ*.5+3.4)/Math.max(.24,tanHalf*.75);
  camLateral=-4;
  camHeight=clamp(Math.max(fitX,fitZ,portrait?26:23),portrait?26:23,portrait?43:39);
  camAlong=portrait?-9:-8;
 }else if(shot==='chase'){
  sideCamState.active=false;
  focus=order.slice(0,4);
  // Side views track the top three; tracking views prioritize the actual current leader.
  focusDist=leader.dist;
  desiredFov=portrait?56:48;
  camLateral=-4;
  camHeight=portrait?5.1:4.6;
  camAlong=portrait?-18:-16;
 }else{
  sideCamState.active=false;
  const startWide=(race==='idle'||leader.dist<50);
  focus=startWide?order.slice(0,STARTERS):order.slice(0,3);
  focusDist=startWide?(focus.reduce((s,h)=>s+h.dist,0)/Math.max(1,focus.length)):leader.dist;
  desiredFov=startWide?(portrait?63:53):(portrait?57:47);
  const fovTan=Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(desiredFov*.5));
  const halfGateWidth=(STARTERS-1)*2.30*.5+1.55;
  const fitDistance=halfGateWidth/(Math.max(.25,aspect)*fovTan*.79)+4.0;
  camLateral=startWide?0:-2.0;camHeight=startWide?(portrait?5.4:4.8):(portrait?4.3:4.0);
  camAlong=startWide?Math.max(portrait?24:19,fitDistance-2):(portrait?17:14);
 }
 let center=trackAt(focusDist),tangent=headingAt(focusDist),inside=inwardAt(focusDist);
 if(shot==='sweep'){
  // Sideways moving location on the real track; do not recenter on a few leaders.
  center=trackAt(focusDist);
  center.y=0;
 }else if(shot==='spotlight'){
   center=focus[0].root.position.clone();
   center.y=0;
 }else if(shot==='side'||shot==='front5'){
  // Centre on the actual first and third/fifth horses; re-evaluate every frame.
  // Follow the midpoint of the leading and fifth horse on the track.
  center=trackAt(focusDist);
  center.y=0;
 }else if(shot==='aerial'){
  // Never aim at an empty patch of curve if leaders are well spread apart.
  center=focus.reduce((v,h)=>v.add(h.root.position),new THREE.Vector3()).multiplyScalar(1/focus.length);
  center.y=0;
 }else if(shot==='chase'||shot==='front'){
  if(shot==='front'&&(race==='idle'||leader.dist<50)){
   center=focus.reduce((v,h)=>v.add(h.root.position.clone()),new THREE.Vector3()).multiplyScalar(1/Math.max(1,focus.length));
  }else{
   // Screen aim always starts from the visible position of the CURRENT leader.
   center=leader.root.position.clone();
  }
  center.y=0;
 }
 let look=center.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,(shot==='side'||shot==='front5'||shot==='sweep'||shot==='spotlight')?1.55:(shot==='front'&&(race==='idle'||leader.dist<50)?1.75:1.45),0));
 if(shot==='side'||shot==='front5'||shot==='sweep'||shot==='spotlight'){
  if(instant||!['side','front5','sweep','spotlight'].includes(lastCameraShot)){
   sideCamState.center.copy(center);
   sideCamState.look.copy(look);
   sideCamState.fov=desiredFov;
   sideCamState.lateral=camLateral;
   sideCamState.height=camHeight;
   sideCamState.along=camAlong;
  }else{
   // Smooth framing and zoom more gently than Ver.73. A spotlight cuts in
   // through interpolation instead of teleporting the camera across the course.
   const alpha=1-Math.exp(-Math.min(.05,Math.max(.005,renderDeltaSeconds))*10.5);
   const zoomAlpha=1-Math.exp(-Math.min(.05,Math.max(.005,renderDeltaSeconds))*8.0);
   sideCamState.center.lerp(center,alpha);
   sideCamState.look.lerp(look,alpha);
   sideCamState.fov+=(desiredFov-sideCamState.fov)*zoomAlpha;
   sideCamState.lateral+=(camLateral-sideCamState.lateral)*zoomAlpha;
   sideCamState.height+=(camHeight-sideCamState.height)*zoomAlpha;
   sideCamState.along+=(camAlong-sideCamState.along)*zoomAlpha;
  }
  center=sideCamState.center.clone();
  look=sideCamState.look.clone();
  desiredFov=sideCamState.fov;
  camLateral=sideCamState.lateral;
  camHeight=sideCamState.height;
  camAlong=sideCamState.along;
 }
 const pos=center.clone().addScaledVector(inside,camLateral)
   .addScaledVector(tangent,camAlong).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,camHeight,0));
 // Avoid rebuilding the projection matrix on every animation frame.
 if(Math.abs(camera.fov-desiredFov)>.025){camera.fov=desiredFov;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();}
 const cameraChanged=shot!==lastCameraShot;
 if(instant){camera.position.copy(pos);viewTarget.copy(look)}
 else{
  // Smooth chase/front framing too, while continuing to aim at the latest leader.
  const followStrength=shot==='front5'?12:(shot==='side'||shot==='sweep'||shot==='spotlight')?10:14;
  const smoothStep=1-Math.exp(-Math.min(.05,Math.max(.005,renderDeltaSeconds))*followStrength);
  camera.position.lerp(pos,smoothStep);
  viewTarget.lerp(look,smoothStep);
 }
 camera.lookAt(viewTarget);camera.updateMatrixWorld();
 lastCameraShot=shot;
 $('camname').textContent={sweep:'CAM 01　先頭〜最後尾・2回巡回',side:'CAM 01　残り1000m・先頭争い',front5:'CAM 01　ラスト600m・先頭〜5番手',spotlight:'CAM 02　実況注目馬アップ',chase:'CAM 03　先頭追走',front:'CAM 04　スタート',aerial:'CAM 05　コーナー俯瞰'}[shot];
 mats.sun.position.set(center.x-42,78,center.z+24);
 mats.sun.target.position.copy(center);
}

const horseVisibilitySamples=[
 new THREE.Vector3(0,1.4,0),
 new THREE.Vector3(-.43,1.4,0),new THREE.Vector3(.43,1.4,0),

function showGateNameLabels(w,h){
 const small=w<550;
 // Preserve all eight full names, but use narrow columns and adapt the font
 // so the longest one ends above the actual gate instead of covering horses.
 const badgeWidth=small?(STARTERS>=14?16:STARTERS>=11?21:25):28;
 const gap=small?(STARTERS>=11?1:2):4;
 camera.updateMatrixWorld();
 const columns=runners.map(runner=>{
  runner.root.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
  const pos=new THREE.Vector3(0,2.65,0).applyMatrix4(runner.root.matrixWorld).project(camera);
  const px=Number.isFinite(pos.x)?(pos.x+1)*w*.5:w*.5;
  const py=Number.isFinite(pos.y)?(1-pos.y)*h*.5:h*.58;
  return {runner,px,py,x:clamp(px-badgeWidth*.5,4,w-badgeWidth-4)};
 }).sort((a,b)=>a.px-b.px);
 for(let i=1;i<columns.length;i++)columns[i].x=Math.max(columns[i].x,columns[i-1].x+badgeWidth+gap);
 if(columns.length){
  const over=columns[columns.length-1].x+badgeWidth-(w-4);
  if(over>0)for(const c of columns)c.x-=over;
  if(columns[0].x<4){const shift=4-columns[0].x;for(const c of columns)c.x+=shift;}
 }
 const longest=Math.max(1,...columns.map(c=>[...raceDisplayHorseName(c.runner.name)].length));
 const closestGateY=Math.min(...columns.map(c=>c.py),h*.65);
 const commonTop=clamp(Math.min(h*.27,closestGateY-134),small?88:98,h*.35);
 const room=Math.max(50,closestGateY-commonTop-35);
 const nameFont=clamp((room-27)/longest,small&&STARTERS>=14?6:small?7:8,small&&STARTERS>=14?7:small?9:10);
 for(const c of columns){
  const label=c.runner.label;
  if(label.className!=='namebadge start-vertical')label.className='namebadge start-vertical';
  const displayedName=raceDisplayHorseName(c.runner.name);
  if(c.runner.nameText.dataset.gateName!==displayedName)setGateNameGlyphs(c.runner.nameText,displayedName);
  c.runner.nameText.style.fontSize=nameFont.toFixed(1)+'px';
  c.runner.nameText.style.lineHeight='1.05';
  c.runner.nameText.style.letterSpacing='0';
  c.runner.nameText.style.writingMode='horizontal-tb';
  c.runner.nameText.style.textOrientation='upright';
  const numberEl=label.querySelector('.horse-label-number');
  if(numberEl){
   const compactGate=small&&STARTERS>=14;
   numberEl.style.width=compactGate?'14px':'';
   numberEl.style.height=compactGate?'15px':'';
   numberEl.style.fontSize=compactGate?'9px':'';
  }
  label.style.left=Math.round(c.x)+'px';
  label.style.top=Math.round(commonTop)+'px';
  label.style.width=badgeWidth+'px';
  label.style.height='auto';
  label.style.display='flex';
  label.style.opacity='1';
  label.removeAttribute('data-edge');
 }
}
function showLabels(){
 if(!camera||!runners.length)return;
 // Gate labels above each horse; after the gun, compact three-character badges.
 const beforeStart=race==='idle';
 // Names go away BEFORE the gate opens; no 3-D labels during the super-slow
 // break. They return after the first 65m of uninterrupted gate footage.
 const gateBreaking=(race==='running'||race==='paused')&&ranks()[0].dist<65;
 if(dfV57GateIntro.active||gateBreaking){
  for(const horse of runners)horse.label.style.display='none';
  return;
 }
 const vp=$('viewport'),w=vp.clientWidth,h=vp.clientHeight;
 if(w<=0||h<=0)return;
 if(beforeStart){showGateNameLabels(w,h);return;}
 const small=w<550;
 const upper=small?88:110,bottom=Math.max(upper+20,h-78);
 const labelHeight=small?13:14;
  const placements=[];
  const measureContext=document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
  // Actual pre-race win-popularity ranking; not the gate or frame number.
 const topFiveByPopularity=new Set((currentPreRaceOdds?.horse||[]).slice(0,5).map(entry=>Number(entry.no)));
 const shotForLabels=selectShot();
 camera.updateMatrixWorld();
 for(const runner of ranks()){
  const label=runner.label;
  if(label.className!=='namebadge race-compact')label.className='namebadge race-compact';
  const fullName=raceDisplayHorseName(runner.name);
  const nameChars=Array.from(fullName).length;
  // Keep the complete name for every visible runner, not just favourites.
   const labelPrefix=runner.owner?24:18;
   // Fit complete names without inserting spaces or clipping the last characters.
   const availableWidth=Math.min(w-12,Math.max(96,Math.min(192,w*.49)));
   const nameFont=Math.max(6.0,Math.min(8.4,(availableWidth-labelPrefix-5)/Math.max(1,nameChars)));
  if(runner.nameText.childElementCount||runner.nameText.textContent!==fullName)runner.nameText.textContent=fullName; // Ver.132: remove gate glyph wrappers
  runner.nameText.dataset.gateName=''; // reconstruct full vertical label at the next gate
  // Outside the five most popular runners only the actual horse number stays.
  runner.nameText.style.display='block';
  runner.nameText.style.fontSize=nameFont.toFixed(2)+'px';
  runner.nameText.style.lineHeight='12px';
  runner.nameText.style.letterSpacing='-0.6px';
  runner.nameText.style.writingMode='horizontal-tb';
  runner.nameText.style.textOrientation='mixed';
  runner.nameText.style.width='auto';
  const raceNumber=label.querySelector('.horse-label-number');
  if(raceNumber){ // reset gate-only inline sizing, then let the large-P CSS apply
   raceNumber.style.width='';raceNumber.style.height='';raceNumber.style.fontSize='';
  }
  label.style.height=labelHeight+'px';
  runner.root.updateWorldMatrix(true,false);
  // 3D visibility is tested on the HORSE, not on a badge anchor.
  // Thus neither a runner behind the camera nor an off-screen runner
  // receives an edge-clamped name tag.
  const worldMatrix=runner.root.matrixWorld;
  // A badge is permitted only when the horse's TORSO is on the screen,
  // not when a stray hoof or a tiny distant speck happens to be projected.
  const torsoNdc=new THREE.Vector3(0,1.45,0).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const visibleTorso=Number.isFinite(torsoNdc.x)&&Number.isFinite(torsoNdc.y)&&Number.isFinite(torsoNdc.z)&&
   torsoNdc.z>=-1&&torsoNdc.z<=1&&Math.abs(torsoNdc.x)<.95&&Math.abs(torsoNdc.y)<.91;
  const muzzle=new THREE.Vector3(0,1.8,2.0).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const rump=new THREE.Vector3(0,1.45,-1.35).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const foot=new THREE.Vector3(.30,.22,.5).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const head=new THREE.Vector3(0,2.55,.65).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const horsePixels=Math.max(Math.hypot((muzzle.x-rump.x)*w*.5,(muzzle.y-rump.y)*h*.5),
    Math.hypot((foot.x-head.x)*w*.5,(foot.y-head.y)*h*.5));
  // If the body is smaller than 14 pixels it cannot really be distinguished
  // on a phone, so do not leave a name floating in empty grass.
  // The badge must never appear on its own while mobile Chrome is still
  // decoding the embedded runner atlas. The image plane is the real horse.
  if(!runner.spriteArt?.hasRendered){label.style.display='none';continue;}
  const minHorsePixels=shotForLabels==='aerial'?13:14;
  const centeredEnough=Math.abs(torsoNdc.x)<.92&&Math.abs(torsoNdc.y)<.89;
  if(!visibleTorso||!centeredEnough||!Number.isFinite(horsePixels)||horsePixels<minHorsePixels){label.style.display='none';continue;}
  const projected=new THREE.Vector3(0,2.45,0).applyMatrix4(worldMatrix).project(camera);
  const x=(projected.x+1)*w*.5;
  const y=(1-projected.y)*h*.5;
   measureContext.font=`900 ${nameFont.toFixed(2)}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
   const actualTextWidth=measureContext.measureText(fullName).width;
   const width=Math.min(w-8,Math.max(30,Math.ceil(labelPrefix+actualTextWidth-Math.max(0,nameChars-1)*.6+5)));
  const startX=clamp(x-width*.5,4,Math.max(4,w-width-4));
   const startY=clamp(y-40,upper,bottom-labelHeight); // Ver.132: 13px above Ver.131
  // Stay close to the horse; do not 'solve' overlaps by putting a label
  // somewhere else on the track where there is no visible runner.
  let best=null,bestScore=Infinity;
  const options=[];
   for(const dy of [0,-17,-34,-51,-68,-85]){ // favor above the rider and prior labels
    for(const dx of [0,-20,20,-40,40,-65,65]){
    options.push([clamp(startX+dx,4,Math.max(4,w-width-4)),clamp(startY+dy,upper,bottom-labelHeight)]);
   }
  }
  for(const [cx,cy] of options){
   const rect={x:cx,y:cy,w:width,h:labelHeight};
   let overlap=0;
   for(const q of placements){
    const ix=Math.max(0,Math.min(rect.x+rect.w+2,q.x+q.w+2)-Math.max(rect.x-2,q.x-2));
    const iy=Math.max(0,Math.min(rect.y+rect.h+2,q.y+q.h+2)-Math.max(rect.y-2,q.y-2));
    overlap+=ix*iy;
   }
    const score=overlap*280+Math.abs(cx-startX)*.22+Math.abs(cy-startY)*.48;
   if(score<bestScore){bestScore=score;best=rect}
   if(score===0)break;
  }
  if(!best)best={x:startX,y:startY,w:width,h:labelHeight};
  placements.push(best);
  label.style.left=best.x+'px';label.style.top=best.y+'px';
  label.style.width=best.w+'px';label.style.display='flex';
  label.style.opacity='1';
  label.removeAttribute('data-edge');
 }
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 23_race_commentary.js | 文字実況の更新 =====
// Ver.74: text-only TV-style race call. Game time is used for cadence, so the
// user can still adjust 1x/2x/4x replay speed. No speech engine is used.
// Ver.106: caption-only race commentary; no secondary announcer panel.
// Commentary uses real wall time so text is readable even at 2x/4x replay.
let raceNarration={nextAtMs:0,pending:null,focusNo:null,focusUntil:0,lastLeader:null,previous:new Map(),line:0,df150LastEventAt:-1};
function resetRaceNarration(){
 raceNarration={nextAtMs:0,pending:null,focusNo:null,focusUntil:0,lastLeader:null,previous:new Map(),line:0,df150LastEventAt:-1};
 const caption=document.getElementById('df103LiveCaption');if(caption)caption.hidden=true;
 df112CancelCaption();
 df114CaptionHoldUntil=0;
}
function df103HorseCall(h){
 return h?`${h.no}番 ${raceDisplayHorseName(h.name)}`:'出走馬';
}
// Updated: one complete two-line caption per call; pause after final glyph.
let df112CaptionTimer=0,df112CaptionToken=0,df114CaptionHoldUntil=0;
const df114GlyphMs=88,df114CaptionPauseMs=5200;
// Keep camera and subtitle pacing synchronized with the actual replay clock.
function df128PresentationRate(){
 return Math.max(.25,Math.min(4,(Number(speed)||1)*(Number(dfV59PlaybackScale)||1)));
}
function df112CancelCaption(){
 df112CaptionToken++;
 if(df112CaptionTimer){clearTimeout(df112CaptionTimer);df112CaptionTimer=0;}
}
function df114WrapRows(message){
 const label=document.getElementById('df103LiveCaptionText');
 const panel=document.getElementById('df103LiveCaption');
 const vp=document.getElementById('viewport');
 const css=panel?getComputedStyle(panel):null;
 const fontPx=Math.max(15,parseFloat(css?.fontSize)||22);
 // The hidden caption has clientWidth=0. Use viewport dimensions as a reliable fallback.
 const available=Math.max(115,(label?.clientWidth||((vp?.clientWidth||window.innerWidth)-40))-8);
 const canvas=df114WrapRows.canvas||(df114WrapRows.canvas=document.createElement('canvas'));
 const ctx=canvas.getContext?.('2d');
 if(ctx)ctx.font=`900 ${fontPx}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
 const rows=[''];
 for(const ch of Array.from(String(message??'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim())){
  if(ch==='\n'){if(rows.length>=2)return null;rows.push('');continue;}
  const line=rows[rows.length-1];
  const next=line+ch;
  const pixels=ctx?ctx.measureText(next).width:next.length*fontPx;
  if(pixels<=available){rows[rows.length-1]=next;continue;}
  if(rows.length>=2)return null;
  rows.push(ch===' '? '':ch);
  if(ctx&&ctx.measureText(ch).width>available)return null;
 }
 return rows;
}
function df114FitCommentary(msg,subject){
 const full=String(msg??'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
 const sentence=full.match(/^(.+?[。！？!?])/u)?.[1]||'';
 const named=subject?df103HorseCall(subject):'';
 // Each candidate is a COMPLETE, meaningful sentence, never an unfinished slice.
 const lead=sentence&&named&&!sentence.includes(named)?`${sentence.replace(/[。！？!?]$/u,'')}！ ${named}が動きます。`:'';
 const candidates=[full,lead,
  named?`${named}が仕掛けます！`:'',
  sentence,
  named?`${named}をカメラが追います。`:'',
  subject?`${subject.no}番が前へ出ます！`:'',
  'レースは続いています。'];
 for(const candidate of candidates){
  if(!candidate)continue;
  const rows=df114WrapRows(candidate);
  if(rows&&rows.length<=2)return rows.join('\n');
 }
 return 'レース進行中';
}
function df112SubtitleDuration(msg){
 const count=Array.from(String(msg??'')).length;
 return (Math.max(0,count-1)*df114GlyphMs+df114CaptionPauseMs)/df128PresentationRate();
}
function df103Subtitle(msg){
 const wrap=document.getElementById('df103LiveCaption');
 const label=document.getElementById('df103LiveCaptionText');
 if(!wrap||!label)return;
 df112CancelCaption();
 const fitted=df114FitCommentary(msg,null);
 const chars=Array.from(fitted),token=df112CaptionToken;
 wrap.hidden=false;
 label.textContent='';
 wrap.classList.remove('df103-caption-flash');
 // The hold starts only AFTER the final character has appeared.
 df114CaptionHoldUntil=performance.now()+df112SubtitleDuration(fitted);
 let index=0;
 const advance=()=>{
  if(token!==df112CaptionToken||!label.isConnected)return;
  if(index<chars.length){
   label.textContent+=chars[index++];
   if(index<chars.length)df112CaptionTimer=setTimeout(advance,df114GlyphMs/df128PresentationRate());
   else df112CaptionTimer=0;
  }
 };
 advance();
}
function df106FeaturedHorseOnCamera(h){
 if(!h||!h.root||!camera)return false;
 // Actual camera projection: no horse name until its horse has moved into view.
 const p=h.root.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,2.1,0)).project(camera);
 return Number.isFinite(p.x)&&Number.isFinite(p.y)&&Number.isFinite(p.z)&&
  p.z>=-1&&p.z<=1&&Math.abs(p.x)<.70&&p.y>-.56&&p.y<.72;
}
const df140LeadDuels={previous:[],until:0,cooldown:0,nos:[]};
function df140ObserveDuel(order){
 if(race!=='running'||!order.length)return;
 const current=order.slice(0,5).map(h=>h.no),prev=df140LeadDuels.previous;
 const now=performance.now();
 if(now>=df140LeadDuels.cooldown&&TOTAL-order[0].dist>70){
  for(let i=0;i<current.length;i++){
   const moved=current[i],previousRank=prev.indexOf(moved);
   if(previousRank<=i||previousRank<0)continue;
   const overtaken=prev[i],a=order.find(h=>h.no===moved),b=order.find(h=>h.no===overtaken);
   if(a&&b&&current.indexOf(overtaken)>=0&&Math.abs(a.dist-b.dist)<5){
    df140LeadDuels.nos=[moved,overtaken];
    df140LeadDuels.until=now+1700;
    df140LeadDuels.cooldown=now+6500;
    break;
   }
  }
 }
 df140LeadDuels.previous=current;
}
function updateRaceNarration(order){
 if(race!=='running'||!order.length)return;
 const n=raceNarration,now=performance.now(),leader=order[0],second=order[1]||leader;
 const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-leader.dist);
 // Step 2: wait for continuous camera travel, THEN introduce the horse by name.
 if(n.pending){
  const call=n.pending;
  const target=order.find(h=>h.no===call.no);
  n.focusNo=call.no;
  n.focusUntil=elapsed+19;
  if(now>=call.readyAtMs&&now>=df114CaptionHoldUntil&&df106FeaturedHorseOnCamera(target)){
   df103Subtitle(call.message);
   n.pending=null;
   // Do not queue the next announcement immediately as the previous one
   // finishes. Leave quiet time for the slower camera to settle naturally.
   n.nextAtMs=Math.max(now,df114CaptionHoldUntil+2400/df128PresentationRate());
   n.line++;
  }
  // During the fixed finish-line camera no cutaway is allowed. Keep the
  // preceding caption if the target cannot be filmed, never announce it unseen.
  if(remaining<=190)n.pending=null;
  return;
 }
 if(now<n.nextAtMs||remaining<=190)return;
 // Convert a displayed gap (meters) to familiar horse-racing margin terms.
// Distances used for running physics remain in meters.
function df141MarginInLengths(meters){
 const lengths=Math.max(0,Number(meters)||0)/2.4;
 if(lengths<.12)return 'ハナ差';
 if(lengths<.25)return 'アタマ差';
 if(lengths<.48)return 'クビ差';
 if(lengths<.76)return '半馬身差';
 if(lengths>=10)return '大差';
 const rounded=Math.max(1,Math.round(lengths*2)/2);
 return rounded%1===0?`${rounded}馬身差`:`${Math.floor(rounded)}馬身半差`.replace(/^0馬身半差$/,'半馬身差');
}
const last=order[order.length-1],gap=Math.max(0,leader.dist-second.dist);
 const advances=order.map((h,i)=>({h,rank:i,delta:(n.previous.get(h.no)??i)-i}));
 const mover=advances.filter(x=>x.delta>=2&&x.rank<=5)
  .sort((a,b)=>b.delta-a.delta||a.rank-b.rank)[0];
 const closing=order.slice(1,Math.min(6,order.length)).filter(h=>
  (h.tactic==='差し'||h.tactic==='追込')&&leader.dist-h.dist<18);
 const favorites=dfV59PopularHorses(order).slice(0,3);
  const favorite=favorites[n.line%Math.max(1,favorites.length)]||leader;
 const leadChanged=n.lastLeader!==null&&n.lastLeader!==leader.no;
 let subject=leader,message='';
 const df150Call=df150NewestCall(order);
 if(df150Call){subject=df150Call.h;message=df150Call.message;}else if(elapsed<5){
  subject=leader;
  message=`${df103HorseCall(subject)}が先頭に立った！ 先頭争いが始まります。`;
 }else if(leadChanged){
  subject=leader;
  message=`先頭交代！ ${df103HorseCall(subject)}が前へ出ました。`;
 }else if(remaining<=320&&closing.length){
  subject=closing[0];
  message=`直線勝負！ ${df103HorseCall(subject)}が猛追します！`;
}else if(mover){
   subject=mover.h;
   message=`${df103HorseCall(subject)}が一気に${mover.delta}頭を抜き、${mover.rank+1}番手へ上がります！`;
  }else if(remaining<=480){
   subject=order[Math.min(1,order.length-1)];
  message=`${df103HorseCall(subject)}が${order.indexOf(subject)+1}番手。いよいよ勝負！`;
}else if(remaining<=800){
  subject=second;
  message=`残り約${Math.ceil(remaining/100)*100}m。${df103HorseCall(subject)}が追う！`;
 }else if(n.line%4===1){
  subject=favorite;
  message=`注目は${df103HorseCall(subject)}。現在${order.indexOf(subject)+1}番手です。`;
}else{
  subject=leader;
  message=`先頭は${df103HorseCall(subject)}。後続とは${df141MarginInLengths(gap)}。`;
 }
 // Keep the goal-side one-take finish and front-five coverage intact.
 // Limit late commentary to horses actually within the leading TV pack.
 if(remaining<=800&&order.indexOf(subject)>4){
  subject=leader;
  message=`先頭${df103HorseCall(subject)}、後続が迫ります！`;
 }
 n.previous=new Map(order.map((h,i)=>[h.no,i]));
 n.lastLeader=leader.no;
 // Step 1: assign target now; camera moves smoothly before anything is said.
 n.focusNo=subject.no;
 n.focusUntil=elapsed+19;
 n.pending={no:subject.no,message:df114FitCommentary(message,subject),readyAtMs:now+2000/df128PresentationRate()};
}


// ===== Ver.192: stable progress-based race position tracker =====
// Use actual course DISTANCE (not world x/z) for front/back order.  The compact
// 2-D pack is a schematic: badges can separate slightly for readability, but
// their horizontal order always agrees with the real race order.
function df192LayoutTracker(horses,width,height,dotSize,range,frontRight,previous){
 const pad=Math.max(3,dotSize/2+1);
 const usable=Math.max(1,width-pad*2);
 const ordered=[...horses].sort((a,b)=>a.behind-b.behind||Number(a.no)-Number(b.no));
 const lastBehind=Math.max(0,...ordered.map(h=>h.behind));
 const viewRange=Math.max(30,Number(range)||0,lastBehind+9);
 const rankStep=ordered.length>1?Math.min(dotSize*.42,usable/((ordered.length-1)*1.34)):0;
 const distanceWidth=Math.max(0,usable-rankStep*Math.max(0,ordered.length-1));
 const frontX=frontRight?width-pad:pad;
 const sign=frontRight?-1:1;
 // Logical lane orientation remains the same through all corners.
 const laneHalf=Math.max(1,(Number(STARTERS)||horses.length)-1)/2;
 const vertical=Math.max(0,height/2-pad);
 const anchors=ordered.map((h,i)=>({
  no:h.no,
  x:Math.max(pad,Math.min(width-pad,frontX+sign*(i*rankStep+
   Math.min(1,Math.max(0,h.behind)/viewRange)*distanceWidth))),
  y:Math.max(pad,Math.min(height-pad,height/2-
   Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,(Number(h.lane)||0)/laneHalf))*vertical))
 }));
 // Rearrange only vertically to ease collisions; NEVER let the collision solver
 // move a horse past another in the displayed front/back direction.
 const placed=[];const byNo=new Map();
 const verticalCandidates=a=>{
  const last=previous?.get(a.no);
  const vals=[a.y];
  if(Number.isFinite(last?.y))vals.unshift(Math.max(pad,Math.min(height-pad,last.y)));
  for(let step=1;step<=Math.ceil(height/2);step+=2){
   vals.push(Math.max(pad,Math.min(height-pad,a.y-step)));
   vals.push(Math.max(pad,Math.min(height-pad,a.y+step)));
  }
  return vals;
 };
 for(const a of [...anchors].sort((u,v)=>Number(u.no)-Number(v.no))){
  const last=previous?.get(a.no);
  let bestY=a.y,bestCost=Infinity;
  for(const y of verticalCandidates(a)){
   let overlap=0;
   for(const q of placed){
    const gap=Math.max(0,dotSize+0.8-Math.hypot(q.x-a.x,q.y-y));
    overlap+=gap*gap*12;
   }
   const cost=overlap+(y-a.y)**2*.08+
    (Number.isFinite(last?.y)?(y-last.y)**2*.22:0);
   if(cost<bestCost-1e-7){bestCost=cost;bestY=y;}
  }
  const pt={no:a.no,x:a.x,y:bestY,anchorX:a.x,anchorY:a.y};
  placed.push(pt);byNo.set(a.no,pt);
 }
 return {positions:horses.map(h=>byNo.get(h.no)),
  center:{frontX,sign,distanceWidth,viewRange,pad}};
}
// ===== Ver.195: restore course-heading rotation without reverting Ver.192's
// progress-based ranking and collision stabilization. =====
function df195RotateTrackerLayout(layout,width,height,dotSize,angle,frontRight){
 const pad=Math.max(3,dotSize/2+1);
 const cx=width/2,cy=height/2;
 // Ver.192 lays out the race on a stable signed horizontal distance axis.
 // Rotate that axis into the CURRENT map heading, keeping distance order intact.
 const delta=angle-(frontRight?0:Math.PI);
 const cos=Math.cos(delta),sin=Math.sin(delta);
 const raw=(x,y)=>({x:(x-cx)*cos-(y-cy)*sin,
                    y:(x-cx)*sin+(y-cy)*cos});
 const offsets=layout.positions.map(p=>raw(p.x,p.y));
 const maxX=Math.max(1,...offsets.map(p=>Math.abs(p.x)));
 const maxY=Math.max(1,...offsets.map(p=>Math.abs(p.y)));
 // A uniform fit prevents cropping on the narrow TV strip during turns.
 // The same fit is applied to all horses and the distance marker.
 const fit=Math.min(1,Math.max(1,width/2-pad)/maxX,
                    Math.max(1,height/2-pad)/maxY);
 const project=(x,y)=>{const p=raw(x,y);return {x:cx+p.x*fit,y:cy+p.y*fit};};
 return {positions:layout.positions.map(p=>({...p,...project(p.x,p.y)})),project};
}
// Spread crowded badges sideways, PERPENDICULAR to travel.  This keeps the
// distance ranking exact even when the direction points up/down in the short
// tracker strip, where rotating a long horizontal line would stack 18 dots.
function df195SpreadTrackerBadges(positions,width,height,dotSize,angle,previous){
 const pad=Math.max(3,dotSize/2+1),sideX=-Math.sin(angle),sideY=Math.cos(angle);
 const placed=[];
 const clamp=(x,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
 const step=Math.max(6,dotSize*1.02);
 for(const a of [...positions].sort((u,v)=>Number(u.no)-Number(v.no))){
  let low=-Infinity,high=Infinity;
  for(const [point,axis,limit] of [[a.x,sideX,width],[a.y,sideY,height]]){
   if(Math.abs(axis)<1e-8)continue;
   const one=(pad-point)/axis,two=(limit-pad-point)/axis;
   low=Math.max(low,Math.min(one,two));high=Math.min(high,Math.max(one,two));
  }
  if(low>high){placed.push(a);continue;}
  const prior=previous?.get(a.no);
  const priorT=prior?(prior.x-a.x)*sideX+(prior.y-a.y)*sideY:null;
  const candidates=[0];
  if(Number.isFinite(priorT))candidates.push(clamp(priorT,low,high));
  for(let n=1;n<=Math.ceil(Math.max(width,height)/step);n++){
   candidates.push(n*step,-n*step);
  }
  let best=null,bestCost=Infinity;
  for(const t of candidates){
   if(t<low-1e-6||t>high+1e-6)continue;
   const x=a.x+sideX*t,y=a.y+sideY*t;
   let overlap=0;
   for(const b of placed){
    const gap=Math.max(0,dotSize+1-Math.hypot(x-b.x,y-b.y));
    overlap+=gap*gap*40;
   }
   const cost=overlap+t*t*.006+
    (Number.isFinite(priorT)?(t-priorT)**2*.016:0);
   if(cost<bestCost){bestCost=cost;best={...a,x,y};}
  }
  placed.push(best||a);
 }
 const byNo=new Map(placed.map(pt=>[pt.no,pt]));
 return positions.map(pt=>byNo.get(pt.no));
}
function df140IsPlayerOwned(h){
 if(!h?.owner||dfV30VsActive||!h.ownId)return false;
 return (stableState?.horses||[]).some(owned=>String(owned.id)===String(h.ownId));
}

    dot.className='df109-horse-dot';dot.dataset.owned=df140IsPlayerOwned(h)?'true':'false';dot.textContent=df140IsPlayerOwned(h)?'P':h.no;
   dot.style.background=h.frameColor||h.helmet||h.silk||'#666';
   dot.style.color=frameTextColor(h.no);
   field.appendChild(dot);panel._df109Dots.set(h.no,dot);
  }
 }
 const boxW=field.clientWidth,boxH=field.clientHeight;
 if(boxW<35||boxH<20)return;
 const now=performance.now();
 // Repaint the badges at ~15 Hz, letting CSS interpolate between samples.
 // Keep telemetry updated every frame and freeze position correctly on pause.
 if(panel._df111LastT && now-panel._df111LastT<65)return;
 const dt=panel._df111LastT?Math.min(300,now-panel._df111LastT):100;
 panel._df111LastT=now;
 const dotSize=boxW<150?16:18;
 // Keep Ver.192's original distance-axis sign, but rotate its positions
 // with the CURRENT course heading so the pack follows bends continuously.
 if(typeof panel._df192FrontRight!=='boolean'){
