  const rad=initial?.angle??0;
  panel._df192FrontRight=Math.abs(Math.cos(rad))>.38?Math.cos(rad)>=0:Math.sin(rad)>=0;
 }
 const frontRight=panel._df192FrontRight;
 const angle=dfV75Minimap.headingAt(leadDist)?.angle??(frontRight?0:Math.PI);
 const cos=Math.cos(angle),sin=Math.sin(angle);
 const frontText=document.getElementById('df110FrontText');
 const backText=document.getElementById('df110BackText');
 if(frontText&&backText){
  if(Math.abs(cos)>.38){
   const frontLeft=cos<0;
   frontText.textContent=frontLeft?'◀先頭':'◀後方';
   backText.textContent=frontLeft?'後方▶':'先頭▶';
  }else{
   frontText.textContent=sin<0?'↑先頭':'↑後方';
   backText.textContent=sin<0?'後方↓':'先頭↓';
  }
 }
 const visual=order.map(h=>({
  no:h.no,behind:Math.max(0,leadDist-Math.max(0,Math.min(TOTAL,Number(h.dist)||0))),
  lane:Number(h.lane)||0
 }));
 const requiredRange=Math.max(30,...visual.map(h=>h.behind+9));
 // Zoom decreases gradually, but never exclude a suddenly trailing horse.
 if(!Number.isFinite(panel._df184Range)||
   (Number.isFinite(panel._df184LastDist)&&leadDist+35<panel._df184LastDist)){
  panel._df184Range=requiredRange;
  panel._df184Prior=new Map();
 }else if(requiredRange>panel._df184Range){
  panel._df184Range=requiredRange;
 }else{
  panel._df184Range+=(requiredRange-panel._df184Range)*Math.min(.38,dt/950);
 }
 panel._df184LastDist=leadDist;
 const layout=df192LayoutTracker(visual,boxW,boxH,dotSize,panel._df184Range,
  frontRight,panel._df184Prior);
 // Store pre-rotation lane positions; turning the course must not feed
 // rotated coordinates back into the lane collision stabilizer.
 panel._df184Prior=new Map(layout.positions.map(pt=>[pt.no,{y:pt.y}]));
 const rotated=df195RotateTrackerLayout(layout,boxW,boxH,dotSize,angle,frontRight);
 const spread=df195SpreadTrackerBadges(rotated.positions,boxW,boxH,dotSize,angle,panel._df195Prior);
 panel._df195Prior=new Map(spread.map(pt=>[pt.no,{x:pt.x,y:pt.y}]));
 const dots=panel._df109Dots;
 for(let i=0;i<spread.length;i++){
  const pt=spread[i],h=order[i],dot=dots?.get(h.no);
  if(!dot)continue;
  dot.style.transform=`translate3d(${(pt.x-dotSize/2).toFixed(1)}px,${(pt.y-dotSize/2).toFixed(1)}px,0)`;
  dot.classList.toggle('df109-leader',i===0);
  dot.title=`${i+1}番手・${h.no}番 ${raceDisplayHorseName(h.name)}`;
  dot.setAttribute('aria-label',dot.title);
 }
 // Distance posts use the SAME signed race-progress axis as the horse dots.
 const marker=document.getElementById('df109DistanceMarker');
 if(marker){
  const atPost=Math.min(TOTAL,Math.max(0,Math.round(leadDist/200)*200));
  const dx=(atPost-leadDist)/layout.center.viewRange*layout.center.distanceWidth;
  const postX=layout.center.frontX+(frontRight?dx:-dx);
  const post=rotated.project(postX,boxH/2);
  const shown=post.x>=layout.center.pad&&post.x<=boxW-layout.center.pad&&
              post.y>=layout.center.pad&&post.y<=boxH-layout.center.pad;
  marker.hidden=!shown;
  if(shown){
   marker.style.left=post.x.toFixed(1)+'px';marker.style.top=post.y.toFixed(1)+'px';
   marker.style.transform=`translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(${angle.toFixed(4)}rad)`;
  }
  marker.textContent=atPost>=TOTAL?'GOAL':Math.max(0,TOTAL-atPost)+'m';
  marker.dataset.position=atPost.toFixed(0);
 }
 // A moving traveled section and position dot on the EXISTING course sketch.
 if(mini&&dfV47World&&dfV75Minimap?.transform){
  const coursePath=document.getElementById('dfV75MapPath');
  if(coursePath){
   let progress=document.getElementById('df110MapProgress');
   if(!progress){
    progress=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','path');
    progress.id='df110MapProgress';progress.setAttribute('fill','none');
    progress.setAttribute('stroke','#f5c94a');progress.setAttribute('stroke-width','3');
    progress.setAttribute('stroke-linecap','round');progress.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin','round');
    coursePath.after(progress);
   }
   const startDist=0,steps=Math.max(2,Math.min(160,Math.ceil(leadDist/14)));
   const trace=[];
   for(let i=0;i<=steps;i++){
    const d=startDist+(leadDist-startDist)*i/steps;
    const xy=dfV75Minimap.transform(dfV47World.centerAt(d));
    trace.push((i?'L':'M')+xy[0].toFixed(1)+','+xy[1].toFixed(1));
   }
   progress.setAttribute('d',trace.join(' '));
  }
 }
}

 syncPauseButton();
 updateHUD();

// Ver.59: slow-motion immediately after the actual gates open. This slows the
// same existing simulation clock (like a fractional 1x/2x/4x replay setting).
// After the leader passes 55m, smoothly return to full selected replay speed
// by 105m. The starter's 3.4-second PRE-start approach is unaffected.
function dfV59StartSpeedScale(){
 if((race!=='running'&&race!=='runout')||!runners.length)return 1;
 const distance=ranks()[0].dist;
 // Ver.63: effective speed is 30% of normal 1x, a little faster than Ver.62,
 // regardless of the speed selector. Smooth recovery still ends by 130m.
 const slowStart=.82/Math.max(1,speed); // Ver.132: a little quicker gate break
if(distance<=34)return slowStart;
  if(distance<112){
   const t=(distance-34)/78,s=t*t*(3-2*t);
  return slowStart+(1-slowStart)*s;
 }
 // Ver.69: finish presentation is ~15% faster (72% -> 82.8% at 1x).
 // Only playback timing changes; horse physics and finishing order do not.
 const remaining=Math.max(0,TOTAL-distance),slowFinish=.94/Math.max(1,speed); // V78: slightly lighter finish slow motion
  if(remaining>20)return 1; // Ver.132: no finish slow motion before last 20 m
  const t=clamp((20-remaining)/5,0,1),s=t*t*(3-2*t);
  return 1+(slowFinish-1)*s;
}
let dfV59PlaybackScale=1;
let renderDeltaSeconds=1/60,labelLast=0;
// ===== Ver.90 source section: 25_animation_loop.js | 描画ループ・タイマー =====
/* DBF_OFFICIAL_VS_RECORD_REPLAY_V1: record VS motion, export JSON, replay without simulation. */
function dfOfficialVSAllowedDistance(distance, officialNewspaper=false){
  return [1200,1600,2000,2400,3000].includes(distance) ||
    (!!officialNewspaper && Number.isInteger(distance) &&
     GRADED_RACES_V78.some(card=>card.distance===distance));
}
const dfOfficialVSRecorder = (() => {
  const DATABASE = 'df_official_vs_replays_v1', STORE = 'races';
  let active = null, startMs = 0, lastSample = -100, databasePromise = null;
  let lastRecord = null;
  const copy = value => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const horseState = h => ({
    no: Number(h.no), name: String(raceDisplayHorseName(h.name)||'').slice(0,40),
    frameNo: Number(h.frameNo)||0, frameColor: String(h.frameColor||''),
    coatType: String(h.coatType||''), tactic: String(h.tactic||''), age: Number(h.age)||0,
    dist: Number(h.dist)||0, lane: Number(h.lane)||0,
    velocity: Number(h.velocity)||0, runoutDist: Number(h.runoutDist)||0,
    finishedAt: h.finishedAt == null ? null : Number(h.finishedAt)
  });
  function db(){
    if (!('indexedDB' in window)) return Promise.resolve(null);
    if (!databasePromise) databasePromise = new Promise(resolve => {
      try {
        const request = indexedDB.open(DATABASE, 1);
        request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
          const instance = request.result;
          if (!instance.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE)) instance.createObjectStore(STORE, {keyPath:'raceId'});
        };
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => resolve(null);
        request.onblocked = () => resolve(null);
      } catch (_) { resolve(null); }
    });
    return databasePromise;
  }
  async function persist(record){
    const instance = await db();
    if (!instance) return false;
    return new Promise(resolve => {
      try {
        const transaction = instance.transaction(STORE,'readwrite');
        transaction.objectStore(STORE).put(record);
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(true);
        transaction.onerror = () => resolve(false);
        transaction.onabort = () => resolve(false);
      } catch (_) {resolve(false);}
    });
  }
  async function get(id){
    if (!id || typeof id !== 'string') return null;
    const instance = await db(); if(!instance)return null;
    return new Promise(resolve=>{
      try {
        const request=instance.transaction(STORE,'readonly').objectStore(STORE).get(id);
        request.onsuccess=()=>resolve(request.result||null);
        request.onerror=()=>resolve(null);
      } catch (_){resolve(null);}
    });
  }
  async function latest(){
    if(lastRecord)return lastRecord;
    let id='';
    try{id=localStorage.getItem('df_official_vs_replay_last_id')||'';}catch(_){}
    return id?get(id):null;
  }
  function begin(options={}){
    if (!dfV30VsActive || dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared() ||
        !Array.isArray(runners) || !runners.length) return false;
    startMs = options.simulated ? 0 : performance.now(); lastSample=-100;
    if(active?.status==='newspaper_saved'){
      active.status='recording';
    }else active = {
      schema:'derby-fantasy-official-vs-replay',version:2,
      raceId:'dfvs-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10),
      createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),status:'recording',
      race:{name:String(currentRace?.name||'VS対戦レース'),venue:String(currentRace?.venue||'東京'),
        surface:String(currentRace?.surface||'芝'),distance:Number(currentRace?.distance)||TOTAL,
        going:String(currentGoing||'良'),weather:String(currentWeather||'晴れ')},
      field:copy(dfV136VsField||[]),
      starters:runners.map(horseState),
      odds:copy(currentPreRaceOdds),
      cameraMode:String(camMode||'auto'),frames:[],results:null
    };
    sample(startMs,true);
    return true;
  }
  // Save the frozen newspaper BEFORE calculating the race. An incomplete
  // production cannot be mistaken for a completed replay.
  async function stageNewspaper(){
    if(!begin({simulated:true}))throw Error('レース記録の準備ができません。');
    active.newspaper=dfOfficialVSSnapshotCapture();
    active.status='newspaper_saved';active.frames=[];
    const record=active;
    if(!await persist(record)){
      active=null;
      throw Error('競馬新聞のIndexedDB保存に失敗しました。');
    }
    return {raceId:record.raceId};
  }
  function sample(ts,force=false){
    if(!active)return;
    const t=Math.max(0,Math.round(ts-startMs));
    if(!force && t-lastSample<100)return;
    lastSample=t;
    active.frames.push({t,horses:runners.map(horseState)});
  }
  async function finish(atMs){
    if(!active)return null;
    sample(Number.isFinite(atMs)?atMs:performance.now(),true);
    const record=active;active=null;
    record.status='complete'; record.completedAt=new Date().toISOString();
    record.durationMs=record.frames.at(-1)?.t||0;
    record.results=finished.map((h,i)=>({place:i+1,no:Number(h.no),
      name:String(raceDisplayHorseName(h.name)||'').slice(0,40),
      timeSeconds:Number(h.finishedAt)||0,frameNo:Number(h.frameNo)||0,
      margin:i?finishMargin(finished[i-1],h):'―'}));
    lastRecord=record;
    const saved=await persist(record);
    if(saved){try{localStorage.setItem('df_official_vs_replay_last_id',record.raceId);}catch(_){}}
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('df-official-vs-replay-ready',{
      detail:{raceId:record.raceId,saved,frameCount:record.frames.length,resultCount:record.results.length,record}
    }));
    if(window.parent!==window){
      try{window.parent.postMessage({channel:'df-official-vs-replay-ready',record},location.origin);}catch(_){}
    }
    return {raceId:record.raceId,saved};
  }
  function cancel(){active=null;}
  async function downloadLast(){
    const record=await latest(); if(!record)return false;
    const json=JSON.stringify(record);
    const blob=new Blob([json],{type:'application/json'});
    const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const anchor=document.createElement('a');anchor.href=url;
    anchor.download=record.raceId+'.json';document.body.appendChild(anchor);
    anchor.click();anchor.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),3000);
    return true;
  }
  return Object.freeze({begin,stageNewspaper,sample,finish,cancel,get,latest,downloadLast});
})();

const dfOfficialVSPlayback = (() => {
  let current=null, positionMs=0, frameIndex=0, arming=false, frameClock=0;
  const finite = value => typeof value==='number' && Number.isFinite(value);
  function validate(value){
    if(!value || value.schema!=='derby-fantasy-official-vs-replay' || value.version!==2 ||
       value.status!=='complete')throw Error('公式VSレース記録（ver.2）ではありません。');
    const n=value.field?.length;
    if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>18 ||
       !Array.isArray(value.results)||value.results.length!==n ||
       !Array.isArray(value.frames)||value.frames.length<2||value.frames.length>100000)
      throw Error('出走馬・走行記録・結果の数が正しくありません。');
    if(!dfOfficialVSAllowedDistance(value.race?.distance,!!value.newspaper) ||
       !['良','稍重','重','不良'].includes(value.race?.going))
      throw Error('競走条件が正しくありません。');
    const nos=new Set(value.results.map(h=>h.no));
    if(nos.size!==n||[...nos].some(no=>!Number.isInteger(no)||no<1||no>n)||
       value.results.some((h,i)=>h.place!==i+1||!finite(h.timeSeconds)||h.timeSeconds<0))
      throw Error('確定着順または走破タイムが不正です。');
    let previous=-1;
    for(const f of value.frames){
      if(!finite(f.t)||f.t<previous||f.t<0||f.t>3600000 ||
         !Array.isArray(f.horses)||f.horses.length!==n)
        throw Error('走行記録に欠損があります。');
      previous=f.t;
      const frameNos=new Set();
      for(const h of f.horses){
        if(!Number.isInteger(h.no)||h.no<1||h.no>n||frameNos.has(h.no)||
           !finite(h.dist)||!finite(h.lane)||!finite(h.velocity)||!finite(h.runoutDist)||
           (h.finishedAt!==null&&!finite(h.finishedAt)))
          throw Error('記録内の馬の位置が不正です。');
        frameNos.add(h.no);
      }
    }
    if(!finite(value.durationMs)||value.durationMs!==previous)
      throw Error('記録の長さが一致しません。');
    if(value.newspaper && (typeof value.newspaper.heading!=='string' ||
       typeof value.newspaper.entries!=='string'||value.newspaper.entries.length>300000 ||
       String(value.newspaper.umaren||'').length>300000 ||
       String(value.newspaper.wakuren||'').length>300000))
      throw Error('保存された競馬新聞の形式が不正です。');
    return value;
  }
  function clear(){current=null;positionMs=0;frameIndex=0;arming=false;frameClock=0;}
  function isPrepared(){return !!current||arming;}
  function prepare(input){
    const value=validate(input);
    if(!window.__raceReady3D)throw Error('3Dレース画面の読み込みが完了していません。');
    if(window.DFV43CanVS && !window.DFV43CanVS() && !value.newspaper)
      throw Error('VSレースが解放されていません。');
    if(dfV30VsActive){
      if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout')throw Error('レース中には記録を開けません。');
      dfV30VsLeave();
    }
    clear();arming=true;
    let outcome;
    try{outcome=dfV30VsPrepareField(value.field,value.race.distance,value.race.going,false,!!value.newspaper);}
    finally{arming=false;}
    if(!outcome?.ok)throw Error(outcome?.error||'再生画面の準備に失敗しました。');
    current=value;frameIndex=0;positionMs=0;
    if(value.odds && typeof value.odds==='object'){
      // Keep original frozen odds; renderPreRaceGuide() recomputes them.
      currentPreRaceOdds=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value.odds));
      if(!value.newspaper)renderPreRaceGuide();
    }
    if(value.newspaper)dfOfficialVSSnapshotRestore(value.newspaper);
    document.getElementById('dfV28VsOverlay').hidden=true;
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('df-official-vs-playback-prepared',{
      detail:{raceId:value.raceId,count:value.field.length}
    }));
    return {ok:true,raceId:value.raceId};
  }
  function begin(){
    if(!current)return;
    positionMs=0;frameIndex=0;frameClock=performance.now();
    apply(0);
  }
  function apply(ms){
    if(!current || !runners.length)return;
    const frames=current.frames;
    const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(ms,current.durationMs));
    while(frameIndex+1<frames.length && frames[frameIndex+1].t<=t)frameIndex++;
    while(frameIndex>0 && frames[frameIndex].t>t)frameIndex--;
    const before=frames[frameIndex],after=frames[Math.min(frameIndex+1,frames.length-1)];
    const gap=after.t-before.t;
    const blend=gap>0?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-before.t)/gap)):0;
    const afterMap=new Map(after.horses.map(h=>[h.no,h]));
    const beforeMap=new Map(before.horses.map(h=>[h.no,h]));
    const interp=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*blend;
    for(const h of runners){
      const a=beforeMap.get(h.no),b=afterMap.get(h.no);
      if(!a||!b)continue;
      h.dist=interp(a.dist,b.dist);
      h.runoutDist=interp(a.runoutDist,b.runoutDist);
      h.velocity=interp(a.velocity,b.velocity);
      h.lane=interp(a.lane,b.lane);
      h.targetLane=h.lane;
      h.finishedAt=a.finishedAt!=null?a.finishedAt:(blend>=1?b.finishedAt:null);
    }
    elapsed=t/1000;
    positionMs=t;
  }
  function tick(ts){
    if(!current || race!=='running')return false;
    // Wall-time playback: all spectators use the recorded timeline, not local race physics.
    apply(ts-frameClock);
    if(positionMs>=current.durationMs){
      const fixed=new Map(current.results.map(row=>[row.no,row]));
      for(const h of runners){
        const row=fixed.get(h.no);
        h.finishedAt=row.timeSeconds;
        h.dist=TOTAL;
        h.runoutDist=Math.max(TOTAL,h.runoutDist||TOTAL);
      }
      finished=current.results.map(row=>runners.find(h=>h.no===row.no));
      race='runout';
      dfNormalPublishRaceResults(); // Existing results UI, no recalculation or normal-game save.
      return true;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function seek(ms){
    if(!current||!Number.isFinite(ms))return false;
    positionMs=Math.max(0,Math.min(ms,current.durationMs));
    frameClock=performance.now()-positionMs;
    apply(positionMs);
    return true;
  }
  function onPaused(){if(current)positionMs=performance.now()-frameClock;}
  function onResumed(){if(current)frameClock=performance.now()-positionMs;}
  return Object.freeze({prepare,begin,tick,seek,clear,isPrepared,onPaused,onResumed});
})();

window.DFOfficialVSReplay=Object.freeze({
  get:id=>dfOfficialVSRecorder.get(id),
  latest:()=>dfOfficialVSRecorder.latest(),
  downloadLast:()=>dfOfficialVSRecorder.downloadLast(),
  play:record=>dfOfficialVSPlayback.prepare(record),
  seek:ms=>dfOfficialVSPlayback.seek(ms),
  isPlayback:()=>dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared()
});

function animate(ts){
 requestAnimationFrame(animate);
 // Ver.123: the newspaper must not animate/render an invisible 3D world.
 // Race time and betting remain unchanged; this only stops offscreen graphics.
  // Keep the results reveal and bet settlement advancing on the results screen.
  // The 3D race render loop is intentionally skipped when that screen is hidden.
 if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='results')updateResultsReveal(ts);
 if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='race-view' || document.body.classList.contains('barn-mode')){
  last=ts;return;
 }
 if(!renderer||!runners.length)return;
 const dt=Math.min(.05,Math.max(0,(ts-last)/1000||0));last=ts;
 renderDeltaSeconds=dt||1/60;
 dfV59PlaybackScale=dfV59StartSpeedScale();
 const replayDt=dt*speed*dfV59PlaybackScale;
  if(race==='running'&&!dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared())doRace(replayDt);
  if(dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared()&&race==='running')dfOfficialVSPlayback.tick(ts);
  if(!dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared()&&(race==='running'||race==='runout')){
  // First winner has crossed: keep three seconds of live video, then finish
  // any slower runners through the original simulation before showing results.
  if(df140FirstGoalAt&&performance.now()-df140FirstGoalAt>=3000&&race==='running'){
   let guard=0;
   while(race==='running'&&guard++<16000)doRace(Math.max(.008,Math.min(.035,replayDt||.016)));
  }
  advanceRunout(replayDt);
 }
  if(dfV30VsActive&&!dfOfficialVSPlayback.isPrepared()&&(race==='running'||race==='runout'))dfOfficialVSRecorder.sample(ts);
  moveModels(replayDt);
  updateGateAnimation(replayDt);
 // A hidden-to-visible race view can keep an old zero-sized drawing buffer
 // even after CSS has expanded. Resize before painting EACH frame only when
 // sizes disagree (the common steady-state path performs no allocations).
 if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='race-view'){
  const vp=$('viewport');
  const logical=renderer.getSize(new THREE.Vector2());
  if(vp.clientWidth>8&&vp.clientHeight>8&&
    (Math.abs(logical.x-vp.clientWidth)>2||Math.abs(logical.y-vp.clientHeight)>2||
     renderer.domElement.width<8||renderer.domElement.height<8))resize();
 }
 setCam(false);
 dfV75UpdateGoalBoards();
 updateRaceHorseSprites();
 const warning=document.getElementById('dfV64CanvasNotice');
 if(renderer.getContext().isContextLost()){
  if(warning){warning.textContent='3D画面を復旧しています…';warning.hidden=false;}
 }else{
  try{renderer.render(scene,camera);
   if(warning&&!warning.hidden)warning.hidden=true;
  }catch(error){
   console.error('3Dレース描画エラー',error);
   if(warning){warning.textContent='3D描画に失敗しました。レース画面を再表示してください。';warning.hidden=false;}
  }
 }
 // Label layout requires many camera projections and DOM writes.
 // It need not execute at the full graphics frame rate on a phone.
 if(ts-labelLast>(mobileRenderBudget()?55:34)){labelLast=ts;showLabels();}
 updateResultsReveal(ts);
 if(ts-uiLast>160){uiLast=ts;updateHUD();window.df25Sfx?.syncRace(race,runners.length?TOTAL-Math.max(...runners.map(h=>h.dist)):TOTAL,speed);}
}

function removeRunners(){
 for(const h of runners){
  if(h.spriteArt)h.spriteArt.texture.dispose();
  scene.remove(h.root);h.label.remove();
  const geometries=new Set(),materials=new Set();
  h.root.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){if(o.geometry)geometries.add(o.geometry);
   for(const m of (Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material])){if(m)materials.add(m)}
  }});
  geometries.forEach(g=>g.dispose());materials.forEach(m=>m.dispose());
 }
 runners.length=0;
}

const PEDIGREE_INTERNAL_FUNNY_NAMES=window.DFSharedRules.funnyHorseNames;
function displayInbreedAncestor(original){
 // Ancestor names are only shown in the inbreeding diagnosis, never as a pedigree chart.
 if(typeof GAME_NAMES_BY_ORIGINAL!=='undefined' && GAME_NAMES_BY_ORIGINAL[original])return GAME_NAMES_BY_ORIGINAL[original];
 if(PEDIGREE_INTERNAL_FUNNY_NAMES[original])return PEDIGREE_INTERNAL_FUNNY_NAMES[original];
 let hash=2166136261;
 for(const c of String(original)){hash=Math.imul(hash^c.codePointAt(0),16777619)>>>0;}
 const heads=['モグモグ','ニコニコ','ワクワク','ウマウマ','ゴキゲン','パクパク'];
 const tails=['プリン','ギョーザ','カレー','オムライス','コロッケ','ラーメン'];
 return heads[hash%heads.length]+tails[Math.floor(hash/6)%tails.length]+'・'+hash.toString(36).toUpperCase();
}
const PEDIGREE_GENERATIONS=5; // 父・母を第1代として5代まで判定。血統表の画面表示はしない。

/* 221頭の5代(62枠)祖先データ: ゲーム本体の能力・登録馬とは独立した内部参照のみ。 */
const GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN=window.DFSharedRules.pedigree5Gen;

function ancestorAppearances(parentName){
 // 登録済み221頭は、祖先の同名馬の親子関係が衝突しないよう各馬の62枠を直接参照。
 // 配合時の父母は第1代なので、第5代までの判定には祖先データの4代目までを用いる。
 const savedRows=GAME_221_PEDIGREE_5GEN[parentName];
 if(savedRows){
  const found=new Map([[parentName,[1]]]);let missing=0;
  let offset=0;
  for(let g=1;g<PEDIGREE_GENERATIONS;g++){
   for(const ancestor of savedRows.slice(offset,offset+(1<<g))){
    if(!ancestor){missing++;continue;}
    if(!found.has(ancestor))found.set(ancestor,[]);
    found.get(ancestor).push(g+1);
   }
   offset+=(1<<g);
  }
  return {found,missing};
 }
 const found=new Map();let missing=0;
 function trace(name,generation,lineage){
  if(!name||generation>PEDIGREE_GENERATIONS||lineage.has(name))return;
  if(!found.has(name))found.set(name,[]);
  found.get(name).push(generation);
  if(generation===PEDIGREE_GENERATIONS)return;
  const parents=PEDIGREE_PARENT_MAP.get(name);
  if(!parents){missing++;return;}
  const visited=new Set(lineage);visited.add(name);
  trace(parents[0],generation+1,visited);trace(parents[1],generation+1,visited);
 }
 trace(parentName,1,new Set());return {found,missing};
}
// Ver.48: this is the race module, whereas the farm pedigree helpers live
// inside a separate iframe srcdoc. A module cannot resolve iframe functions.
// Rebuild the SAME eight visible pedigree cells from the shared 221-horse
// pedigree source and the race module's parent map, without touching farm data.
const DF48_VISIBLE_PATHS=['','0','00','000','001','01','010','011'];
function df48Canonical(name){return String(name||'').replace(/\((USA|GB|IRE|CAN|FR|ARG|ITY|GER|AUS|JPN)\)/gi,'').replace(/^サラ\s*/,'').trim();}
function df48PedigreeEntries(horseName){
 const name=df48Canonical(horseName);
 const pedigree=window.DFSharedRules?.pedigree5Gen||{};
 const saved=pedigree[horseName]||pedigree[name];
 return DF48_VISIBLE_PATHS.map(path=>{
  let ancestor=horseName;
  if(path){
   if(saved){
    let index=0;for(const bit of path)index=index*2+Number(bit);
    const offset=(1<<path.length)-2;
    ancestor=saved[offset+index]||'';
   }else{
    for(const bit of path){
     const parents=PEDIGREE_PARENT_MAP.get(df48Canonical(ancestor));
     ancestor=parents?.[Number(bit)]||'';
     if(!ancestor)break;
    }
   }
  }
  return {name:ancestor||'',key:df48Canonical(ancestor),depth:path.length+2};
 });
}
function df48VisibleCrosses(sireName,damName){
 const left=df48PedigreeEntries(sireName),right=df48PedigreeEntries(damName);
 const keys=[...new Set(left.map(x=>x.key).filter(Boolean))];
 return keys.flatMap(key=>{
  const a=left.filter(x=>x.key===key),b=right.filter(x=>x.key===key);
  if(!b.length)return [];
  const positions=[...new Set(a.flatMap(x=>b.map(y=>`${x.depth},${y.depth}`)))].map(x=>x.split(',').map(Number));
  positions.sort((x,y)=>x[0]+x[1]-y[0]-y[1]||x[0]-y[0]);
  return [{ancestor:a[0].name,positions}];
 }).sort((x,y)=>x.positions[0][0]+x.positions[0][1]-y.positions[0][0]-y.positions[0][1]);
}
function inspectInbreeding(sireName,damName){
 const crosses=df48VisibleCrosses(sireName,damName);
 const matches=crosses.map(c=>({ancestor:c.ancestor,
  patterns:c.positions.map(([a,b])=>`${a}×${b}`),
  nearest:Math.min(...c.positions.map(([a,b])=>a+b))}));
 const [a,b]=[df48PedigreeEntries(sireName),df48PedigreeEntries(damName)];
 return {count:matches.length,matches,complete:a.every(x=>!!x.key)&&b.every(x=>!!x.key),
  missingBranches:[...a,...b].filter(x=>!x.key).length};
}
function compactInbreeding(scan){
 if(!scan)return '血統未判定';
 if(!scan.count)return scan.complete?'インブリードなし（表示祖先内）':'インブリード未判定（祖先データ不足・確認できた範囲では未検出）';
 const names=scan.matches.map(m=>`${displayInbreedAncestor(m.ancestor)} ${m.patterns.join('・')}`).join('、');
 return `インブリード${scan.count}件：${names}${scan.complete?'':'（一部の祖先データは未登録）'}。濃いほど健康・気性のリスクが増します。`;
}
function inbreedingBirthEffects(scan){
 if(!scan?.matches?.length)return {uniqueGain:0,healthLoss:0,temperLoss:0};
 const profile=window.DFBreedingEffects.profile(scan.matches);
 const random=()=>stableRandom(0,1);
 return {uniqueGain:profile.bonus,
  healthLoss:window.DFBreedingEffects.healthLoss(profile,random),
  temperLoss:window.DFBreedingEffects.temperLoss(profile,random)};
}
function selectedInbreeding(){
 const sire=$('stableSire')?.value,dam=$('stableDam')?.value;
 return sire&&dam?inspectInbreeding(sire,dam):null;
}
function renderInbreedingPreview(){
 const area=$('stableInbreeding');if(!area)return;
 const scan=selectedInbreeding();
 area.textContent=scan?compactInbreeding(scan):'父馬と母馬を選ぶと、確認できた祖先からインブリードを判定します。';
}

const HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS=['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'];
const HORSE_ABILITY_NAMES={sp:'スピード',sta:'スタミナ',kick:'瞬発力',early:'先行力',sustain:'持続力',grit:'勝負根性',stability:'安定性'};
const STABLE_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.stable';
try{const backupKey='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.stable_backup';if(!localStorage.getItem(backupKey)){const prior=localStorage.getItem(STABLE_KEY);if(prior)localStorage.setItem(backupKey,prior);}}catch(_){}
const BREEDING_PRICE=0;
const STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS=2; // Player horses: at most two starts per month
const stableBound=(n,lo,hi)=>Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,n));
const stableRandom=(lo,hi)=>lo+(hi-lo)*Math.random();
const stableEscape=t=>String(t??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const stableDateId=()=>`${calendarYear}-${calendarMonth}`;
/* Ver.30: own-horse form cycle. The first 95-100 is age 2 June/July
   (early), age 2 October-December (normal), age 3 March/April (late).
   Persistent (持続) keeps its Ver.28 age 3 January target. Month variations
   are based on the horse's fixed ID, never rerolled on load. Race engine
   stability/performanceFactor remains independent of form/100. */
function df28Serial(year,month){return Number(year)*12+Number(month);}
function df30FormSeed(h){return horseGoingHash(String(h.id||h.name||'owner')+'|'+String(h.birthGameYear||1)+'|'+String(h.growth||'普通'));}
function df28FirstPeakSerial(h){
 const debut=(Number(h.birthGameYear)||1)+2; // Age 2 by both farm and race: birth year counts as 0
 const type=h.growth||'普通',seed=df30FormSeed(h);
 if(type==='早熟')return df28Serial(debut,6+seed%2);
 if(type==='晩成')return df28Serial(debut+1,3+seed%2);
 if(type==='持続')return df28Serial(debut+1,1); // Preserve prior setting
 return df28Serial(debut,10+seed%3);
}
function df30EnterPeak(h,form){
 h.form=Math.round(stableBound(form,90,100));
 h.df28FormPhase='peak';h.df28HighStarts=0;
 h.df30PeakCycle=(Number(h.df30PeakCycle)||0)+1;
}
function df28EnsureFormCycle(h){
 const current=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth),first=df28FirstPeakSerial(h);
 const oldForm=Number(h.form);
 h.form=Math.round(stableBound(Number.isFinite(oldForm)?oldForm:75,40,100));
 if(!['build','peak','slump'].includes(h.df28FormPhase)){
  h.df28FormPhase=current<first?'build':h.form>=90?'peak':'slump';
  h.df28HighStarts=0;h.df28SlumpMonths=0;
 }
 if(!Number.isFinite(Number(h.df28HighStarts)))h.df28HighStarts=0;
 if(!Number.isFinite(Number(h.df28SlumpMonths)))h.df28SlumpMonths=0;
 if(!Number.isInteger(h.df28FormLastSerial))h.df28FormLastSerial=current;
 // This function is also called when switching farm/race screens and when
 // a farm snapshot is imported.  It must not change a VALID saved form value
 // or start a peak just because the screen was opened.  Only the monthly and
 // post-race handlers below are allowed to change established form.
 return h;
}
function df28EffectiveForm(h){
 const value=Number(h?.form);
 return Math.round(stableBound(Number.isFinite(value)?value:75,40,100));
}
function df28HighRaceLimit(h){
 const health=Number(h.health)||70;
 if(health>=82)return 4;
 if(health>=65)return 3;
 // Low health can end a good spell after only two races; alternate per spell.
 return (horseGoingHash(String(h.id||h.name||'owner'))+(Number(h.df30PeakCycle)||0))%2===0?2:3;
}
// Ver.148: health is a permanent inherited trait; only condition changes after racing.
// A horse that falls to 60 can recover to 65 at most in the FIRST following month.
function df148MonthlyRecoveryStep(h){
 const health=Number.isFinite(Number(h.health))?Number(h.health):70;
 return health>=85?15:health>=65?11:health>=40?8:6;
}
function df148DropForm(h,value){
 df28EnsureFormCycle(h);h.form=value;h.df28FormPhase='slump';
 h.df28SlumpMonths=0;h.df28HighStarts=0;h.df28FormLastSerial=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth);
}
function df28DropToSixty(h){df148DropForm(h,60);}
// Count actual distinct race months, not visits to the newspaper or race selection.
// Works across December -> January and with saves from older versions.
function df148PreviousConsecutiveRaceMonths(h){
 const now=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth);
 const months=new Set((Array.isArray(h.monthlyHistory)?h.monthlyHistory:[])
  .filter(r=>Number.isInteger(Number(r.year))&&Number.isInteger(Number(r.month)))
  .map(r=>df28Serial(Number(r.year),Number(r.month))));
 let count=0;
 while(count<3&&months.has(now-(count+1)))count++;
 return count;
}
// Ver.174: an independent, persisted race-load counter for condition management.
// Never alter the lifetime record or the "starts this month" entry limit.
// Older saves reconstruct the counter from genuine race history, not from a random value.
function df174EnsureRaceLoad(h){
 const now=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth);
 if(Number.isInteger(h.df174RaceLoad)&&h.df174RaceLoad>=0&&Number.isInteger(h.df174LoadSerial)){
  if(!Number.isInteger(h.df174BoostSerial))h.df174BoostSerial=0;
  return;
 }
 const months=new Map();
 for(const r of Array.isArray(h.monthlyHistory)?h.monthlyHistory:[]){
  const y=Number(r?.year),m=Number(r?.month);
  if(!Number.isInteger(y)||y<1||!Number.isInteger(m)||m<1||m>12)continue;
  const serial=df28Serial(y,m);
  if(serial<=now)months.set(serial,(months.get(serial)||0)+1);
 }
 let count=0;
 if(months.size){
  const first=Math.min(...months.keys());
  for(let serial=first;serial<=now;serial++){
   const raced=months.get(serial)||0;
   count=raced?count+raced:Math.max(0,count-1);
  }
 }
 h.df174RaceLoad=count;
 h.df174LoadSerial=now;
 h.df174BoostSerial=0; // Do not retrospectively invent a future boost for old saves.
}
function df174RegisterRace(h){
 df174EnsureRaceLoad(h);
 const now=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth);
 // A month-advance handler normally synchronizes this; tolerate resumed older saves.
 if(h.df174LoadSerial<now){
  for(let serial=h.df174LoadSerial+1;serial<=now;serial++)df174EnterMonth(h,serial);
 }
 if(h.df174RaceLoad===0)h.df174BoostSerial=now+1;
 h.df174RaceLoad+=1;
}
function df174EnterMonth(h,serial){
 df174EnsureRaceLoad(h);
 if(h.df174LoadSerial>=serial)return;
 for(let month=h.df174LoadSerial+1;month<=serial;month++){
  const previous=month-1;
  const raced=(Array.isArray(h.monthlyHistory)?h.monthlyHistory:[]).some(r=>
   Number.isInteger(Number(r?.year))&&Number.isInteger(Number(r?.month))&&
   df28Serial(Number(r.year),Number(r.month))===previous);
  if(!raced)h.df174RaceLoad=Math.max(0,h.df174RaceLoad-1);
 }
 h.df174LoadSerial=serial;
}
function df174ApplyNextMonthBoost(h,serial){
 if(!h.df174BoostSerial||h.df174BoostSerial>serial)return;
 if(h.df174BoostSerial===serial){
  // Extra 25 form points ON TOP of the ordinary monthly calculation.
  // Unlike the standard first month after a form slump, a rested runner
  // is eligible for this explicit bonus even when the normal ceiling is 65.
  h.form=Math.round(stableBound(Number(h.form)+25,40,100));
  if(h.form>=90&&h.df28FormPhase!=='peak')df30EnterPeak(h,h.form);
 }
 h.df174BoostSerial=0; // One-time, including when multiple months are skipped.
}
function df28FormOnMonth(h){
 df28EnsureFormCycle(h);
 df174EnsureRaceLoad(h);
 const now=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth),first=df28FirstPeakSerial(h);
 if(h.df28FormLastSerial>=now)return;
 // Consecutive monthly advances are applied once per distinct month.
 for(let serial=h.df28FormLastSerial+1;serial<=now;serial++){
  df174EnterMonth(h,serial);
  if(h.df28FormPhase==='build'){
   if(serial>=first){df30EnterPeak(h,95+df30FormSeed(h)%6);}
   else{
    const remaining=Math.max(1,first-serial+1);
    h.form=Math.round(stableBound(h.form+(80-h.form)/remaining,50,80));
   }
  }else if(h.df28FormPhase==='slump'){
   h.df28SlumpMonths++;
    const previous=Math.round(stableBound(Number(h.form)||60,40,100));
    const step=Math.round(((h.df28SlumpMonths===1&&previous===60)?5:df148MonthlyRecoveryStep(h))*df153FormRecoveryMultiplier(h));
    // Only the first recovery month after a 60-point drop is capped at 65.
    const ceiling=h.df28SlumpMonths===1&&previous===60?65:100;
    h.form=Math.round(stableBound(previous+step,40,ceiling));
    if(h.form>=90){
     df30EnterPeak(h,h.form);
    }
  }else if(h.df28FormPhase==='peak'){
   // High-health horses retain the top end of the 90-100 window longer.
   h.form=Math.round(stableBound(100-(h.df28HighStarts*(Number(h.health)>=82?1:2))-(serial%3),90,100));
  }
  df174ApplyNextMonthBoost(h,serial);
 }
 h.df28FormLastSerial=now;
}
function df28FormOnRace(h,startsBefore){
 df28EnsureFormCycle(h);
 df174RegisterRace(h);
 // Two races in one month OR the fourth consecutive race month causes a severe slump.
 if(startsBefore>=1||df148PreviousConsecutiveRaceMonths(h)>=3){df148DropForm(h,40);return;}
 if(h.df28FormPhase==='peak'&&df28EffectiveForm(h)>=90){
  h.df28HighStarts++;
  if(h.df28HighStarts>=df28HighRaceLimit(h))df28DropToSixty(h);
  else h.form=Math.round(stableBound(h.form-(Number(h.health)>=82?1:2),90,100));
 }
}

const stableInitial={version:1,nextId:1,pregnancies:[],horses:[],rivalConditions:{},messages:[],selectedHorseId:'',barnHorseId:''};
function readStable(){
 try{
  const o=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STABLE_KEY)||'null');
  if(!o||o.version!==1||!Array.isArray(o.horses)||!Array.isArray(o.pregnancies))return structuredClone(stableInitial);
  return {version:1,nextId:Number(o.nextId)||1,pregnancies:o.pregnancies.slice(0,150),horses:o.horses.slice(0,500),rivalConditions:o.rivalConditions||{},messages:Array.isArray(o.messages)?o.messages.slice(0,20):[],selectedHorseId:String(o.selectedHorseId||''),barnHorseId:String(o.barnHorseId||'')};
 }catch(err){console.warn('厩舎データを読み込めません',err);return structuredClone(stableInitial);}
}
let stableState=readStable();
let migratedOwnedLuck=false;
for(const saved of stableState.horses){
 if(!Number.isFinite(Number(saved.prize))||Number(saved.prize)<0)saved.prize=0;
 if(!Array.isArray(saved.prizeClaims))saved.prizeClaims=[];
 df28EnsureFormCycle(saved);df174EnsureRaceLoad(saved);migratedOwnedLuck=true;
 inheritedUniquePoints(saved);
 if(!Number.isFinite(saved.earnedBonus))saved.earnedBonus=0; // Ver.94 bonus remains included in intrinsicPoints.
 normalizeSkillRewards(saved); // Migrate old save files without rerolling a horse.
 if(!Number.isInteger(saved.luck)||saved.luck<1||saved.luck>99){
  saved.luck=calculateHorseLuck(Object.fromEntries(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.map(k=>[k,Number(saved.baseMaximum?.[k]||0)+Number(saved.uniquePts?.[k]||0)])),horseLuckVariation(saved.id));
  migratedOwnedLuck=true;
 }
}
function persistStable(){try{localStorage.setItem(STABLE_KEY,JSON.stringify(stableState));}catch(e){console.warn('厩舎の保存に失敗しました',e);}}

// Ver.170: race journal is kept apart from exported saves to survive a restore.
// Persist the start BEFORE leaving the newspaper. At the finish line freeze
// the actual order immediately; never wait for the result UI or app shutdown.
const DF170_RACE_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.v6.race_journal_v170';
function df170ReadJournal(){
 const raw=localStorage.getItem(DF170_RACE_KEY);
 if(!raw)return null;
 try{const r=JSON.parse(raw);return r&&r.schema===1&&typeof r.raceId==='string'?r:null;}
 catch(e){throw Error('レース開始記録を読み取れません。保存データを保護しました。');}
}
function df170WriteJournal(r){
 localStorage.setItem(DF170_RACE_KEY,JSON.stringify(r));
 const proof=df170ReadJournal();
 if(!proof||proof.state!==r.state||proof.raceId!==r.raceId)throw Error('レース記録の保存に失敗しました');
 return proof;
}
function df170StartFromNewspaper(){
 if(dfV30VsActive||!activeCalendarCard)return true; // VS mode is not a monthly owned-horse start.
 if(!df201RecoverInterruptedRace())throw Error('中断レースの確定処理が完了していません: '+df201PenaltyError);
 if(calendarCompleted.has(String(activeCalendarCard.calendarId)))throw Error('このレースは既に確定しています。レース選択画面から別のレースを選んでください。');
 const prior=df170ReadJournal();
 if(prior&&['started','result'].includes(prior.state)&&!calendarCompleted.has(prior.raceId))
  throw Error('未確定のレース記録が残っています。アプリを再起動して保存状態をご確認ください。');
 const card=activeCalendarCard;
 const row={schema:1,state:'started',raceId:String(card.calendarId),raceName:String(card.name),
  year:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth,fieldSize:runners.length,
  distance:card.distance,grade:card.grade,surface:card.surface||'芝',
  owned:runners.filter(h=>h.owner).map(h=>({id:String(h.ownId||''),name:String(h.name||'')})),
  startedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
 df170WriteJournal(row);return true;
}
function df170ResultAtGoal(){
 if(dfV30VsActive||!activeCalendarCard)return true;
 const row=df170ReadJournal();
 if(!row||!['started','settled'].includes(row.state)||row.raceId!==String(activeCalendarCard.calendarId))
  throw Error('開始済みレースの記録がないため、結果を確定できません。');
 if(row.state==='settled')return true;
 const placements=finished.map((h,i)=>({name:h.name,no:h.no,place:i+1,finishedAt:h.finishedAt}));
 // Keep the existing career/horse/award transaction in its original order.
 // It now runs synchronously at the actual goal, not after the result button.
 if(!calendarCompleted.has(row.raceId))recordCalendarFinish();
 if(!calendarCompleted.has(row.raceId))throw Error('レース戦績が保存されませんでした');
 const storedCalendar=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALENDAR_KEY)||'null');
 if(!Array.isArray(storedCalendar?.completed)||!storedCalendar.completed.includes(row.raceId))
  throw Error('レース戦績の永続保存を確認できませんでした');
 settleTickets();
 // Record real ranks only after the existing saved game state is committed.
 // A process kill during the tiny synchronous commit gap cannot replay a
 // completed calendar race; the startup path checks calendarCompleted.
 df170WriteJournal({...row,state:'settled',resultAt:new Date().toISOString(),
  places:placements,settledAt:new Date().toISOString()});
 return true;
}
// Ver.151: restoring a pre-race newspaper is a forfeiture, not a new random draw.
// Run once for the restored current state; a second restoration is another restoration of
// the old snapshot and receives the same (not cumulative) last-place record.
// DF201: reconcile interrupted races without leaving a permanent "started" lock.
// The forfeit is committed before clearing the pending marker; if a write fails,
// retain the marker for a later retry instead of silently disabling the game.
const DF201_PENDING_RACE_KEY='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.v6.df151_pending_newspaper_loss';
let df201PenaltyError='';
function df151ApplyRestoredNewspaperPenalty(){
 const key=DF201_PENDING_RACE_KEY;
 const j=df170ReadJournal();
 if(j?.state==='started'&&!localStorage.getItem(key))localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(j));
 const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);
 if(!raw){df201PenaltyError='';return true;}
 let p;
 try{p=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(e){throw Error('中断レースの記録を読み取れません。データを保護しました。');}
 if(!p||typeof p.raceId!=='string'||!p.raceId||!Array.isArray(p.owned)||
    !Number.isInteger(Number(p.year))||!Number.isInteger(Number(p.month)))
    throw Error('中断レースの記録が不正です。データを保護しました。');
 const currentMonth=Number(p.year)===calendarYear&&Number(p.month)===calendarMonth;
 // A previously completed race is trusted only when the completed ID was
 // actually persisted, not merely added to an in-memory Set before a failed write.
 const savedCalendar=(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALENDAR_KEY)||'null');}catch(_){return null;}})();
 const storedBefore=(()=>{try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STABLE_KEY)||'null');}catch(_){return null;}})();
 const ownersSaved=p.owned.every(row=>{
   const live=stableState.horses.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(row.id)&&h.name===row.name);
   if(!live)return true; // already retired/removed from active stable
   const saved=storedBefore?.horses?.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(row.id)&&h.name===row.name);
   return Array.isArray(saved?.monthlyHistory)&&saved.monthlyHistory.some(r=>
     Number(r.year)===Number(p.year)&&Number(r.month)===Number(p.month)&&
     r.name===p.raceName&&Number(r.place)>0);
 });
 const alreadyCompleted=currentMonth&&calendarCompleted.has(p.raceId)&&ownersSaved&&
   Number(savedCalendar?.year)===calendarYear&&Number(savedCalendar?.month)===calendarMonth&&
   Array.isArray(savedCalendar?.completed)&&savedCalendar.completed.includes(p.raceId);
 const alreadyForfeited=(stableState.horses||[]).some(h=>Array.isArray(h.monthlyHistory)&&
   h.monthlyHistory.some(r=>r?.df151Forfeit&&r.df201RaceId===p.raceId&&
     Number(r.year)===Number(p.year)&&Number(r.month)===Number(p.month)));
 if(!alreadyCompleted){
  const place=Math.max(2,Math.min(18,Number(p.fieldSize)||18));
  for(const row of p.owned){
   const own=stableState.horses.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(row.id)&&h.name===row.name);
   if(!own)continue;
   if(!Array.isArray(own.monthlyHistory))own.monthlyHistory=[];
   // A crash after saving the horse but before settling the journal must not
   // apply the forfeit a second time. Legacy records without an ID are checked
   // by month, name and forfeit marker as a compatibility fallback.
   if(own.monthlyHistory.some(r=>r?.df151Forfeit&&Number(r.year)===Number(p.year)&&
      Number(r.month)===Number(p.month)&&
      (r.df201RaceId===p.raceId||(!r.df201RaceId&&r.name===p.raceName))))continue;
   const career=calendarCareers.get(own.name)||{starts:Number(own.totalStarts)||0,wins:Number(own.totalWins)||0};
   career.starts=(Number(career.starts)||0)+1;calendarCareers.set(own.name,career);
   const startsBefore=Number(own.startsMonth)||0;
   // Apply the same lost-race fatigue and condition as before. For a journal
   // from an older month, do not consume a start in the new/current month.
   df28FormOnRace(own,startsBefore);
   own.fatigue=Math.round(stableBound((Number(own.fatigue)||0)+9+(Number(p.distance)||1600)/200,0,100));
   if(currentMonth){own.startsMonth=startsBefore+1;own.lastStartDate=stableDateId();}
   own.totalStarts=(Number(own.totalStarts)||0)+1;
   if(['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(String(p.grade||'')))df37G1Record(own,{name:p.raceName,grade:p.grade,calendarId:p.raceId},place-1);
   own.monthlyHistory.push({year:Number(p.year),month:Number(p.month),name:p.raceName,
       place,prize:0,surface:p.surface,distance:p.distance,
       popularity:null,df151Forfeit:true,df201RaceId:p.raceId});
   own.monthlyHistory=own.monthlyHistory.slice(-300);
   HORSE_BY_NAME.set(own.name,ownerToRunner(own));
  }
  if(currentMonth&&monthlyRaceCards(calendarMonth,calendarYear).some(c=>c.calendarId===p.raceId))calendarCompleted.add(p.raceId);
  saveCalendarData();persistStable();
  // Do not settle the journal if the game failed to persist the penalty.
  if(currentMonth){
   const check=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALENDAR_KEY)||'null');
   if(!Array.isArray(check?.completed)||!check.completed.includes(p.raceId))
    throw Error('中断レースの出走記録を保存できませんでした。');
  }
  const savedStable=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STABLE_KEY)||'null');
  for(const row of p.owned){
   const live=stableState.horses.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(row.id)&&h.name===row.name);
   if(!live)continue;
   const stored=savedStable?.horses?.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(row.id)&&h.name===row.name);
   if(!stored||!Array.isArray(stored.monthlyHistory)||!stored.monthlyHistory.some(r=>
      r?.df151Forfeit&&Number(r.year)===Number(p.year)&&Number(r.month)===Number(p.month)&&
      (r.df201RaceId===p.raceId||(!r.df201RaceId&&r.name===p.raceName))))
    throw Error('中断レースの所有馬記録を保存できませんでした。');
  }
 }
 // Settle the journal first, then remove the pending marker. A past-month
 // journal is also forfeited rather than leaving a permanent startup lock.
 const fresh=df170ReadJournal();
 if(fresh?.state==='started'&&fresh.raceId===p.raceId)
  df170WriteJournal({...fresh,state:alreadyCompleted?'settled':'forfeit',reviewedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
 localStorage.removeItem(key);
 df201PenaltyError='';
 if(!alreadyCompleted&&!alreadyForfeited)
  window.__df151RestoredLossMessage='中断したレースは最下位として記録されました。再出走はできません。';
 return true;
}
function df201RecoverInterruptedRace(){
 try{return df151ApplyRestoredNewspaperPenalty();}
 catch(e){df201PenaltyError=String(e?.message||e);console.error('DF201: 中断レースの確定処理に失敗',e);return false;}
}

window.DF201RecoverInterruptedRace=function(){
 const recovered=df201RecoverInterruptedRace();
 if(recovered && !dfV30VsActive && ['running','paused','runout'].includes(race)){
  const journal=df170ReadJournal();
  if(journal && ['forfeit','settled'].includes(journal.state)){
   race='idle';raceLineupCommitted=false;
   try{window.df25Sfx?.stopRace?.();}catch(_){}
   updateGameScreenNav();
  }
 }
 return recovered;
};
df201RecoverInterruptedRace();

// Ver.168: repair the currently displayed monthly starts from races ALREADY
// recorded in this horse's saved history. Do not invent unfinished race results,
// mutate older months, or lower an existing count. This also covers a Ver.167
// save whose race results were recorded while startsMonth stayed at zero.
function df168RepairCurrentMonthStarts(){
 let repaired=false;
 for(const own of stableState.horses){
  if(!Array.isArray(own.monthlyHistory))continue;
  const recorded=own.monthlyHistory.filter(r=>r&&Number(r.year)===calendarYear&&
   Number(r.month)===calendarMonth&&Number.isInteger(Number(r.place))&&Number(r.place)>0).length;
  const existing=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(own.startsMonth)||0));
  const expected=Math.min(STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS,recorded);
  if(expected>existing){
   own.startsMonth=expected;
   own.lastStartDate=stableDateId();
   repaired=true;
  }
 }
 if(repaired)persistStable();
 return repaired;
}
df168RepairCurrentMonthStarts();

function stableNotice(text){stableState.messages.unshift(`${calendarYear}年目${calendarMonth}月：${text}`);stableState.messages.length=Math.min(stableState.messages.length,16);persistStable();}
function stableGenetics(parent){
 const seed=horseGoingHash(parent.originalName||parent.name);
 return {constitution:stableBound(Math.round((parent.health||83)*.58+20+((seed>>>3)%17)-8),40,100),
  recovery:stableBound(Math.round((parent.stability||85)*.58+22+((seed>>>8)%19)-9),40,100),
  formStability:stableBound(Math.round((parent.temperament||82)*.56+22+((seed>>>15)%19)-9),40,100)};
}

// Ver.10: allow the self-contained farm to inherit the real registered parents'
// race aptitudes instead of replacing them with neutral defaults.
window.DFGetBreedingParent=name=>{
 const p=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===name);
 if(!p)return null;
 const genetic=stableGenetics(p);
 return {surface:p.surface,tactic:p.tactic,bestDistance:p.bestDistance,
  goingAptitude:{...p.goingAptitude},temperament:p.temperament,health:p.health,
  ...genetic};
};
function stableBreedTrait(a,b,stat){
 const mixed=a[stat]*.4+b[stat]*.4+stableRandom(45,98)*.2;
 const variation=stableRandom(-8,8)+(Math.random()<.05?stableRandom(-9,12):0);
 return Math.round(stableBound(mixed+variation,35,100));
}
// Match parents separately for every ability; reproducible migration of older saves.
function pointSeed(h,key){
 let v=2166136261;for(const c of String(h.id||h.name||'')+':'+key){v=Math.imul(v^c.charCodeAt(0),16777619)>>>0;}return v/4294967296;
}
function ensureHorsePointSets(h){
 const hasUnique=h.uniquePts&&HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.every(k=>Number.isFinite(Number(h.uniquePts[k])));
 if(!hasUnique){
  const old=Number.isFinite(Number(h.intrinsicPoints))?Number(h.intrinsicPoints):0;
  const bonuses=normalizeSkillRewards(h);
  h.uniquePts={};
  for(const k of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
   const legacyBase=stableBound(16+old*.44+(Number(h.stats?.[k]||85)-84)*.50+(pointSeed(h,k)-.5)*22,0,50);
   h.uniquePts[k]=Math.round(legacyBase)+(Number(bonuses[k])||0);
  }
  // Migration only: past elite rewards are already included in the new unique values.
  h.eliteSkillBonuses=freshSkillRewards();
 }
 if(!h.baseInitial||!h.baseMaximum){
  h.baseInitial={};h.baseMaximum={};
  for(const k of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
   const s=Number(h.stats?.[k]??85),bias=(pointSeed(h,k+'base')-.5)*15;
   h.baseInitial[k]=Math.round(stableBound(50+(s-88)*.60+bias,30,70));
   h.baseMaximum[k]=Math.round(stableBound(90+(s-88)*.85+bias,70,110));
  }
 }
 return h;
}
/* Ver.35: use the standalone farm's exact base-Pt growth curve.
   Both views now read the same birth year, month and growth phases.
   This changes no base endpoints, unique points, or historical horses. */
function baseGrowthFraction(h){
 return window.DFSharedRules.growthFraction(h,calendarYear,calendarMonth);
}
function growingBaseStat(h,key){
 ensureHorsePointSets(h);
 const first=Number(h.baseInitial[key]);const last=Number(h.baseMaximum[key]);
 return Math.round(first+(last-first)*baseGrowthFraction(h));
}
function currentAbilityStat(h,key){ensureHorsePointSets(h);return growingBaseStat(h,key)+Number(h.uniquePts[key]||0);}
function inheritedUniquePoints(h){ensureHorsePointSets(h);return Math.round(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.reduce((sum,k)=>sum+Number(h.uniquePts[k]||0),0)/HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.length);}
function ownedTotalPoints(h){return Math.round(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.reduce((sum,k)=>sum+currentAbilityStat(h,k),0)/HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.length);}
function awardHorseUnique(h,key,n,reason){
 if(!HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.includes(key)||!Number.isFinite(n)||n<=0)return false;
 ensureHorsePointSets(h);
 for(const stat of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS)h.uniquePts[stat]=Number(h.uniquePts[stat]||0)+Math.round(n);
 if(h.named)HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,ownerToRunner(h));
 persistStable();
 // The farm owns the canonical saved Pt for imported horses; copy awarded
 // points to it immediately, not only to the race-side mirrored record.
 if(String(h.id||'').startsWith(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX))
   syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({uniqueWinnerIds:[h.id]});
 return true;
}
function stableHorseAtBirth(pregnancy){
 const sire=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===pregnancy.sire),dam=HORSE_DB.find(h=>h.originalName===pregnancy.dam);
 if(!sire||!dam)return null;
 // Recompute legacy, non-frozen stable pregnancies from the current canonical pedigree; old saved scans may contain pre-fix generation numbers.
 const inbreeding=inspectInbreeding(sire.originalName,dam.originalName);
 const crossEffects=inbreedingBirthEffects(inbreeding);
 const stableNicks=window.DF75NicksDetails(sire.originalName,dam.originalName);
 if(stableNicks.unverified)throw new Error('厩舎のニックス判定に必要な血統データが不足しています');
 const gs=stableGenetics(sire),gd=stableGenetics(dam);
 const stats={};for(const key of ['sp','sta','kick','early','sustain','grit','stability'])stats[key]=stableBreedTrait(sire,dam,key);
 const potential=stats.sp*.30+stats.sta*.13+stats.kick*.21+stats.early*.08+stats.sustain*.14+stats.grit*.14;
 const intrinsicPoints=0; // deprecated scalar kept for old save compatibility
 // Ver.8: same breeding source and points scale as the playable farm.
 // Ver.91: keep the fallback stable birth path in sync with the farm.
 const crossing=inbreeding?.matches||[];
 const close=crossing.some(c=>(c.patterns||[]).some(p=>Math.min(...p.split('×').map(Number))<=2));
 const thin=crossing.some(c=>(c.patterns||[]).some(p=>Math.min(...p.split('×').map(Number))>=4));
 const pointSets=window.DFSharedRules.balancedPointSets(
   window.DFSharedRules.breedingParentPoints(sire.originalName,sire.originalName),
   window.DFSharedRules.breedingParentPoints(dam.originalName,dam.originalName),
   {nick:stableNicks.count>0,close,thin});
 const {uniquePts,baseInitial,baseMaximum}=pointSets;
 window.DFBreedingEffects.awardNick(pointSets,stableNicks,HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS);
 window.DFBreedingEffects.awardInbreed(pointSets,
   window.DFBreedingEffects.profile(inbreeding?.matches||[]),HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS);
 const ancestorEffects=window.DFBreedingEffects.awardAncestorEffects(pointSets,inbreeding.matches,HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS);
 const baseDistance=(sire.bestDistance+dam.bestDistance)/2;
 const desiredDistance=baseDistance+stableRandom(-280,280);
 const bestDistance=RACE_DISTANCES.reduce((best,v)=>Math.abs(v-desiredDistance)<Math.abs(best-desiredDistance)?v:best,1800);
 const inheritedTraits=window.DFSharedRules.inheritRaceTraits({...sire,...gs},{...dam,...gd},[Math.max(600,Math.round(bestDistance-500)),Math.min(4000,Math.round(bestDistance+500))]);
 const surface=inheritedTraits.surface;
 const tactic=inheritedTraits.tactic;
 const growth=Math.random()<.45?sire.growth:Math.random()<.80?dam.growth:GROWTH_TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random()*GROWTH_TYPES.length)];
 const {constitution,recovery,formStability,goingAptitude}=inheritedTraits;
 const spread=Math.round(stableRandom(360,650));
 // Determine luck ONCE at mating, from inherited final-potential stats.
 const luck=calculateHorseLuck(Object.fromEntries(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.map(k=>[k,Number(baseMaximum[k])+Number(uniquePts[k])])),stableRandom(-10,10));
  return {id:`B${stableState.nextId++}`,birthSalePrice:window.DFSharedRules.foalSalePrice({baseMaximum,uniquePts}),birthPairEffects:[
   `インブリード：${compactInbreeding(inbreeding)}`,
   `基本能力上限：各+${crossEffects.uniqueGain}Pt`,
   ...ancestorEffects.entries.map(e=>`祖先固有：${displayInbreedAncestor(e.ancestor)}（${e.traits.map(k=>HORSE_ABILITY_NAMES[k]).join('・')}）`),
   `健康：-${crossEffects.healthLoss}Pt`,
   `気性：-${crossEffects.temperLoss}Pt`,
   stableNicks.unverified?'ニックス：未判定（牧場を開いて再確認）':stableNicks.count?`ニックス：${stableNicks.label}（固有Pt各+${stableNicks.uniqueGain}）`:'ニックス：なし'
  ],sire:sire.originalName,dam:dam.originalName,owner:true,sex:Math.random()<.5?'牡':'牝',birthGameYear:pregnancy.birthYear,birthMonth:3,
  name:'',named:false,stats,potential,luck,intrinsicPoints,uniquePts,baseInitial,baseMaximum,inbreeding,inbreedingEffects:crossEffects,earnedBonus:0,eliteSkillBonuses:freshSkillRewards(),bestDistance,aptMin:Math.max(600,bestDistance-spread),aptMax:Math.min(3600,bestDistance+spread),surface,tactic,growth,
  coatType:Math.random()<.5?sire.coatType:dam.coatType,goingAptitude,
  constitution,recovery,formStability,temperament:Math.round(stableBound(inheritedTraits.temperament-crossEffects.temperLoss,35,100)),health:Math.round(stableBound(inheritedTraits.health-crossEffects.healthLoss,35,100)),
  fatigue:Math.round(stableRandom(0,8)),form:Math.round(stableRandom(68,80)),df28FormPhase:'build',df28HighStarts:0,df28SlumpMonths:0,df28FormLastSerial:df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth),df174RaceLoad:0,df174LoadSerial:df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth),df174BoostSerial:0,startsMonth:0,lastStartDate:'',totalStarts:0,totalWins:0,prize:0,monthlyHistory:[],tendency:stableRandom(-1,1)};
}
function ownedRaceHorses(){return stableState.horses.filter(h=>h.named&&calendarHorseAge(h)>=2&&calendarHorseAge(h)<=window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h)).map(ownerToRunner);}
// Race/odds snapshot only: add current growth-based basic Pt and unique Pt to
// the temporary runner. No basic/unique points are written back to the horse.
// Discarding this runner after the race also discards the temporary addition.
function df153BonusForOwner(ownerId,key){
 const id=String(ownerId||'').replace(/^farm-linked:/,'');
 return (df153FarmCache?.df153Items||[]).reduce((v,x)=>v+(x.holderType==='owner'&&x.holderId===id?Number(x.bonus?.[key])||0:0),0);
}
// A golden horseshoe increases effective race condition without altering saved condition.
function df160OwnedRaceForm(h){
 if(!h)return 0;
 return Math.min(100,df28EffectiveForm(h)+df153BonusForOwner(h.id,'form'));
}
function df153FormRecoveryMultiplier(h){
 const id=String(h?.id||'').replace(/^farm-linked:/,'');
 return (df153FarmCache?.df153Items||[]).reduce((v,x)=>x.holderType==='owner'&&x.holderId===id?v*(Number(x.bonus?.formRecoveryMultiplier)||1):v,1);
}
function ownerToRunner(h){
 ensureHorsePointSets(h);
 const raceBase=Object.fromEntries(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.map(k=>[k,growingBaseStat(h,k)]));
 const effective=Object.fromEntries(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.map(k=>[k,raceBase[k]+Number(h.uniquePts[k]||0)+df153BonusForOwner(h.id,k)]));
 return {name:h.name,originalName:h.name,sex:h.sex,tactic:h.df160PendingTactic||h.tactic,...effective,
 bestDistance:h.bestDistance,aptMin:h.aptMin,aptMax:h.aptMax,coreMin:h.aptMin,coreMax:h.aptMax,
 surface:h.surface,growth:h.growth,coatType:h.coatType,goingAptitude:h.goingAptitude,
 startAge:1,birthGameYear:h.birthGameYear,owner:true,ownId:h.id,temperament:h.temperament,health:h.health,
 uniquePts:{...h.uniquePts},luck:h.luck,overallScore:h.potential,overallRank:h.overallRank||'B',abilityPoints:Math.round(HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.reduce((sum,k)=>sum+effective[k],0)/HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.length),eliteSkillBonuses:freshSkillRewards(),g1Wins:Number(h.g1Wins)||0,g1AverageTimeGap:null,g1AverageMarginMeasured:null,g1AverageMarginForGame:0,masterV2:null};
}
// Ver.144: 0..69 form is an absolute ordinary-race entry prohibition.
// Keep farm/race form sources aligned; the parent owns the mirrored saved state.
function df144OwnedFormAllowed(owner){return !!owner&&df160OwnedRaceForm(owner)>=70;}
function df144BlockedOwnerInLineup(){
 if(dfV30VsActive)return null; // VS has its own registration-time snapshot and eligibility.
 for(const runner of DEF){
  if(!runner?.owner)continue;
  const owner=stableState.horses.find(o=>String(o.id)===String(runner.ownId));
  if(!owner||!df144OwnedFormAllowed(owner))return {name:owner?.name||runner.name,form:owner?df160OwnedRaceForm(owner):null};
 }
 return null;
}
function df144CheckLineupForm(){
 const blocked=df144BlockedOwnerInLineup();
 if(!blocked)return true;
 const message=blocked.form==null
  ?`${blocked.name}はすでに所有馬ではありません。出走馬を選び直してください。`
  :`${blocked.name}は調子${blocked.form}のため出走できません（70未満は出走不可）。出走馬を選び直してください。`;
 df103Subtitle(message);
 window.alert(message);
 return false;
}
function ownedRaceEligibility(h,card){
 const o=stableState.horses.find(x=>x.id===h.ownId);if(!o||!o.named||!df144OwnedFormAllowed(o))return false;
 const age=calendarHorseAge(h);
 if(age<2||age>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(o)||age===2&&calendarMonth<6||o.startsMonth>=STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS)return false;
 // Race-entry eligible horses must progress from new/maiden through class races.
 const career=careerOf(h);
 if(card.classType==='graded'){
  if(age===2||age===3)return career.wins>=1;
  if(card.grade==='GⅠ'||card.grade==='GⅡ')return career.wins>=2;
  return career.wins>=1;
 }
 return true;
}
function refreshStableEntryPicker(card){
 const select=$('stableRaceEntry');if(!select)return;
 const old=stableState.selectedHorseId||'';
 select.replaceChildren();select.add(new Option('出走しない（ライバルだけ）',''));
 for(const h of ownedRaceHorses()){
  if(!card||!calendarRaceEligible(h,card))continue;
  const o=stableState.horses.find(x=>x.id===h.ownId);
  select.add(new Option(`${o.name}（${calendarHorseAge(h)}歳・疲労${o.fatigue}・調子${o.form}・今月${o.startsMonth}/2走）`,o.id));
 }
 select.value=[...select.options].some(o=>o.value===old)?old:'';
 $('ownerEntryInfo').textContent=select.options.length>1?'自分の馬を選び「レースへ」を押してください。':'今選択中のレースに出走できる所有馬がいません。';
}
function selectedOwnedHorseFor(card){
 const id=$('stableRaceEntry')?.value||'';if(!id)return null;
 const horse=ownedRaceHorses().find(h=>h.ownId===id);

function balancedRivalFor(h,card){
 if(h.owner||card.classType==='graded')return h;
 const bands={new:[53,72],maiden:[56,75],class1:[65,80],class2:[72,85],class3:[77,90],open:[83,95]};
 const [lo,hi]=bands[card.classType]||[80,98];
 const seed=horseGoingHash(`${h.originalName}-${card.calendarId}`);
 const target=lo+(hi-lo)*(seed%1000)/999;
 // Keep distance, personality and inherited race talents; scale all runners through the
 // same powerMultiplier in the engine instead of weakening stats *twice*.
 return {...h,abilityPoints:Math.round(target),gameClassAdjusted:true,g1Wins:0,overallRank:'B'};
}
function conditionRecord(h){
 if(dfV30VsActive&&h?.dfV30VsHorse)return {form:h.vsForm??75,fatigue:h.vsFatigue??0,
  constitution:100,recovery:100,formStability:100,startsMonth:0};
 if(isSpecial125(h))return {fatigue:0,form:100,constitution:100,recovery:100,formStability:100,startsMonth:0};
 if(h.owner){const o=stableState.horses.find(x=>x.id===h.ownId);return o?{...o,form:df160OwnedRaceForm(o)}:null;}
 const key=h.name;
 let c=stableState.rivalConditions[key];
 if(!c){
  const g=stableGenetics(h),seed=horseGoingHash(key);
  c={fatigue:seed%13,form:67+(seed%26),constitution:g.constitution,recovery:g.recovery,
  formStability:g.formStability,startsMonth:0,lastStartDate:'',tendency:((seed>>>8)%41-20)/20};
  stableState.rivalConditions[key]=c;
 }
 return c;
}
function conditionRaceMultiplier(h){if(isSpecial125(h))return 1;const c=conditionRecord(h);if(!c)return 1;
 const fatigue=stableBound(Number(c.fatigue)||0,0,100),formValue=Number(c.form),form=stableBound(c.form==null||!Number.isFinite(formValue)?75:formValue,0,100);
 // Same form/fatigue scale for owned and COM horses.  The former owner-only
 // form/100 multiplier was far stronger than the COM adjustment.
 if(dfV30VsActive&&h?.dfV30VsHorse)return stableBound(1+(form-75)*.0019-fatigue*.00165,.76,1.06);
 return h.owner?stableBound(1-fatigue*.00165,.76,1):stableBound(1+(form-75)*.0019-fatigue*.00165,.76,1.06);
}
function df28RaceFormFactor(h){
 // VS uses the same form/fatigue multiplier for owner and COM; never apply owner form/100 again.
 if(dfV30VsActive&&h?.dfV30VsHorse)return 1;
 if(!h.owner)return 1;
 const c=conditionRecord(h);
 return c?df28EffectiveForm(c)/100:1;
}
function stableBeforeMonthAdvance(targetYear=calendarYear){
 // DF198: also retire horses whose last December was skipped by a coalesced
 // farm snapshot. A horse remains active throughout its final December.
 const retired=stableState.horses.filter(h=>
  (calendarMonth===12&&calendarHorseAge(h)>=window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h))||
  (targetYear-Number(h.birthGameYear)>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h)));
 if(retired.length){
  // Ver.137: automatic age retirement must take the SAME path as manual retirement.
  // Move qualifying 3+ G1 winners into independently saved breeding stock first.
  const farmBridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  for(const h of retired){
   const career=calendarCareers.get(h.name)||{};
   // The race engine prefixes imported farm IDs; the Farm bridge expects the original ID.
   const farmId=String(h.id).startsWith(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX)?String(h.id).slice(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX.length):(h.ownId||h.id);
   if(farmBridge?.retireOwnedHorse){
    try{farmBridge.retireOwnedHorse(farmId,{...career,starts:career.starts??h.totalStarts,wins:career.wins??h.totalWins,monthlyHistory:career.monthlyHistory??h.monthlyHistory??[],fullRaceHorse:h});}
    catch(e){console.error('自動引退時の繁殖馬登録に失敗',e);}
   }
  }
  stableState.horses=stableState.horses.filter(h=>!retired.includes(h));
  for(const h of retired){calendarCareers.delete(h.name);HORSE_BY_NAME.delete(h.name);}
  stableState.selectedHorseId='';
  stableNotice(`現役年齢の満了により引退：${retired.map(h=>`${h.name}（${calendarHorseAge(h)}歳）`).join('、')}`);
 }
 return {retired:retired.map(h=>h.name)};
}
function stableAfterMonthAdvance(ev){
 const newFoals=[];
 for(const p of [...stableState.pregnancies]){
  if(calendarYear>=p.birthYear&&calendarMonth>=3 || calendarYear>p.birthYear){
   if(stableState.horses.length>=5)continue;
   // Ver.164: use the foal sealed at mating. Older pregnancies keep the old birth path.
   const foal=p.frozenFoal&&typeof p.frozenFoal==='object'&&p.frozenFoal.id
     ?structuredClone(p.frozenFoal):stableHorseAtBirth(p);
   if(foal){
    foal.df28FormLastSerial=df28Serial(calendarYear,calendarMonth);
    stableState.horses.push(foal);newFoals.push(foal);
    stableState.pregnancies.splice(stableState.pregnancies.indexOf(p),1);
   }
  }
 }
 for(const o of stableState.horses){
  o.startsMonth=0;
  if(o.named){
   const recovery=7+(o.recovery||70)*.23+stableRandom(-4,4);
   o.fatigue=Math.round(stableBound((o.fatigue||0)-recovery,0,100));
   df28FormOnMonth(o);
  }
 }
 for(const c of Object.values(stableState.rivalConditions)){
  c.startsMonth=0;
  c.fatigue=Math.round(stableBound((c.fatigue||0)-(7+(c.recovery||70)*.23+stableRandom(-5,5)),0,100));
  const formSwing=stableRandom(-1,1)*(16-(c.formStability||70)*.10);
  const formTarget=70+(c.formStability||70)*.09+Math.sin(calendarYear*12+calendarMonth+(c.tendency||0))*5;
  c.form=Math.round(stableBound((c.form||75)+(formTarget-(c.form||75))*.24+formSwing,38,100));
 }
 if(newFoals.length)stableNotice(`${newFoals.length}頭の仔馬が3月に誕生しました。厩舎で売却または命名・育成を選べます。`);
 persistStable();
 syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({forms:true});
 renderStable();
 if(ev.retired.length)alert(`現役期間を終えて引退しました：\n${ev.retired.join('、')}`);
 if(newFoals.length)alert(`${newFoals.length}頭の仔馬が誕生しました！\n厩舎ページで売却か命名・育成を選んでください。`);
}

const DF128_G1_FIRST_PRIZES_2026=Object.freeze({
 'ジャパンカップ':500000000,'有馬記念':500000000,
 '日本ダービー':300000000,'大阪杯':300000000,

function stableRaceWinnings(card,position){
 const ratios=[1,.4,.25,.15,.10];
 if(!Number.isInteger(position)||position<0||position>=ratios.length)return 0;
 const grade=String(card.grade||'');
 const age=String(card.ages||'');
 const is2=age==='2';
 const is3=age==='3';
 let principal;
 if(card.classType==='graded'){
  if(grade==='GⅠ'||grade==='GI'||grade==='G1'){
   principal=DF128_G1_FIRST_PRIZES_2026[card.name]||(is2?80000000:150000000);
  }else if(grade==='GⅡ'||grade==='GII'||grade==='G2'){
   principal=is2?40000000:is3?54000000:67000000;
  }else{
   principal=is2?37000000:43000000;
  }
 }else{
  // The game's ordinary class races are general races, not named stakes.
  principal=({
   open:is2?12500000:is3?14500000:21000000,
   class3:18100000,
   class2:is3?11100000:11900000,
   class1:8200000,
   maiden:is3&&Number(card.month)>=6?5800000:5900000,
   new:is2?7800000:6500000
  })[card.classType]||5900000;
 }
 return Math.round(principal*ratios[position]);
}
function specialHorseReward(){
 const winner=finished[0],second=finished[1];
 if(!winner)return;
 const runnerByName=new Map(runners.map(h=>[h.name,h]));
 const championPlaces=finished.map(r=>runnerByName.get(r.name)).filter(isSpecial125);
 if(!championPlaces.length)return;
 const firstOwner=runnerByName.get(winner.name);
 let awarded=null,champion=null,points=0;
 if(firstOwner?.owner){
  awarded=firstOwner;
  // Multiple elite horses may appear in the mandatory Classic; only one award per race.
  champion=championPlaces[0];
  points=3;
 }else if(second){
  const runnerUp=runnerByName.get(second.name);
  const firstChampion=runnerByName.get(winner.name);
  if(runnerUp?.owner&&isSpecial125(firstChampion)){
   const seconds=Math.max(0,second.finishedAt-winner.finishedAt);
   const speed=Math.max(10,Math.min(23,(firstChampion.velocity+runnerUp.velocity)/2));
   if(seconds*speed/2.4<=2){awarded=runnerUp;champion=firstChampion;points=1;}
  }
 }
 if(!awarded||!champion||!points)return;
 const ownerHorse=stableState.horses.find(h=>h.id===awarded.ownId);
 const skill=SPECIAL_SKILL_REWARDS[champion.originalName];
 if(!ownerHorse||!skill)return;
   ensureHorsePointSets(ownerHorse);
  if(!Array.isArray(ownerHorse.eliteRewardHistory))ownerHorse.eliteRewardHistory=[];
  const raceKey=`${calendarYear}-${calendarMonth}:${currentRace?.name||'レース'}:${champion.originalName}`;
  if(ownerHorse.eliteRewardHistory.includes(raceKey))return;
  ownerHorse.eliteRewardHistory.push(raceKey);
  awardHorseUnique(ownerHorse,skill.key,points,'クラシック強豪');
  stableNotice(`${ownerHorse.name}が${champion.originalName}との対戦で7能力の固有Ptがそれぞれ＋${points}！`);
}
/* Ver.27: mirror earned prize on the farm-owned horse before the owner retires.
   The race engine remains the sole place that awards cash; this only copies totals. */
/* Ver.37: one transactional pasture update replaces separate prize/form/stability
   scans and independent setState calls. Only changed fields are written. */
function syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({forms=false,prizes=false,stabilityWinnerIds=[],temperamentWinnerIds=[],g1WinnerIds=[],uniqueWinnerIds=[],achievementWinnerIds=[],g1HistoryIds=[],legacyTraits=false}={}){
  const winnerIds=new Set(stabilityWinnerIds),temperIds=new Set(temperamentWinnerIds),
    g1Ids=new Set(g1WinnerIds),uniqueIds=new Set(uniqueWinnerIds),
    titleIds=new Set(achievementWinnerIds),historyIds=new Set(g1HistoryIds);
  if(!forms&&!prizes&&!winnerIds.size&&!temperIds.size&&!g1Ids.size&&!uniqueIds.size&&!titleIds.size&&!historyIds.size&&!legacyTraits)return false;
 try{
  const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  if(!bridge?.getState||!bridge?.setState)return false;
  const farm=bridge.getState();
  if(!Array.isArray(farm?.horses))return false;
  const owners=new Map(stableState.horses.map(h=>[h.id,h]));
  let changed=false;
  const horses=farm.horses.map(fh=>{
   const ownerId=FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(fh.id);
   const own=owners.get(ownerId);
   if(!own)return fh;
   let revised=null;
   if(forms){
    const form=df28EffectiveForm(own);
    if(Number(fh.form)!==form)revised={...(revised||fh),form};
   }
   if(prizes){
    const earned=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(own.prize)||0));
    if(earned>Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(fh.prize)||0)))
     revised={...(revised||fh),prize:earned};
   }
    // Only a newly earned racing bonus is written to the source of truth.
    if(uniqueIds.has(ownerId)&&JSON.stringify(fh.uniquePts)!==JSON.stringify(own.uniquePts))
      revised={...(revised||fh),uniquePts:{...own.uniquePts}};
   if(winnerIds.has(ownerId)&&
      (JSON.stringify(fh.baseInitial)!==JSON.stringify(own.baseInitial)||
       JSON.stringify(fh.baseMaximum)!==JSON.stringify(own.baseMaximum))){
    revised={...(revised||fh),
      baseInitial:{...own.baseInitial},baseMaximum:{...own.baseMaximum}};
   }
   // Older farm saves did not store this field. One-time migration preserves
   // temperament already earned on the race-side, then makes farm authoritative.
   if(legacyTraits&&fh.v10RacingTraitsStored!==true){
     revised={...(revised||fh),v10RacingTraitsStored:true,
       temperament:Number(own.temperament??fh.temperament??80)};
   }
   if(temperIds.has(ownerId)&&Number(fh.temperament)!==Number(own.temperament))
     revised={...(revised||fh),temperament:Number(own.temperament)};
   if(g1Ids.has(ownerId)&&Number(fh.g1Wins??0)!==Number(own.g1Wins??0))
     revised={...(revised||fh),g1Wins:Number(own.g1Wins||0)};
   if((titleIds.has(ownerId)||historyIds.has(ownerId))&&
      JSON.stringify(fh.df37G1History||[])!==JSON.stringify(own.df37G1History||[]))
     revised={...(revised||fh),df37G1History:own.df37G1History.map(r=>({...r}))};
   if(titleIds.has(ownerId))
     revised={...(revised||fh),df37Titles:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(own.df37Titles)),
       uniquePts:{...own.uniquePts}};
   if(revised){changed=true;return revised;}
   return fh;
  });
  if(changed)bridge.setState({horses});
  return changed;
 }catch(err){console.warn('レース側データの牧場同期に失敗しました',err);return false;}
}

function df27ShowRacePrizes(){
 const box=$('df27RacePrizeResult');if(!box)return;
 box.hidden=!df27LastRacePrizes.length;
 box.textContent=df27LastRacePrizes.map(row=>`${row.name}が${row.place}着。賞金 ${cashText(row.prize)} 獲得しました！`).join('　');
}
/* Ver.40: each owned-horse victory adds the existing fixed +2 basic Pt
   to ALL seven stats. Apply to both endpoints, preserving the growth curve. */
function df31AwardWinBasePoints(own,card){
 const winId=`${calendarYear}:${calendarMonth}:${card.calendarId||card.name}`;
 if(!Array.isArray(own.winBaseClaims))own.winBaseClaims=[];
 if(own.winBaseClaims.includes(winId))return null;
 ensureHorsePointSets(own);
 for(const key of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
  own.baseInitial[key]=Number(own.baseInitial[key]||0)+2;
  own.baseMaximum[key]=Number(own.baseMaximum[key]||0)+2;
 }
 own.winBaseClaims.push(winId);
 HORSE_BY_NAME.set(own.name,ownerToRunner(own));
 stableNotice(`${own.name}が勝利！7能力の基本Ptがそれぞれ＋2。`);
 return 'all';
}
/* Synchronize only a winning imported horse's stability basic points back
   to its source farm.  The farm has no independent temperament field. */
/* Ver.40: honor awards remain secret. Each earned title independently rolls
   1..3 innate Pt for each of the seven stats, exactly once per award. */
const DF37_TITLES=Object.freeze({
 junior:'2歳G1全制覇',colt:'クラシック三冠馬',filly:'牝馬三冠馬',
 autumn:'古馬秋G1三連勝',grandprix:'グランプリ連勝',tenno:'天皇賞春秋連勝',
 arima:'有馬記念2年連覇',spring:'天皇賞春2年連覇',fall:'天皇賞秋2年連覇',
 japan:'ジャパンカップ2年連覇',five:'G1・5連勝',fiveage:'三歳五冠馬'
});
const DF37_G1_NAMES=new Set([...ALL_GRADED_RACES_V79,...JUNIOR_GRADED]
 .filter(r=>['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(String(r.grade))).map(r=>r.name));
function df37G1Record(own,card,place){
 const isG1=['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(String(card?.grade||''));
 if(!isG1)return false;
 const name=String(card.name||'');
 const key=`${calendarYear}:${calendarMonth}:${card.calendarId||name}`;
 if(!Array.isArray(own.df37G1History)||(!own.df37G1History.length&&Array.isArray(own.monthlyHistory)&&own.monthlyHistory.length)){
  // Upgrade older saves using their actual race history; never invent wins.
  own.df37G1History=(Array.isArray(own.monthlyHistory)?own.monthlyHistory:[])
   .filter(r=>DF37_G1_NAMES.has(String(r.name||'')))
   .map(r=>({key:`${r.year}:${r.month}:${r.name}`,year:Number(r.year),month:Number(r.month),
     name:String(r.name),place:Number(r.place),age:Number(r.year)-Number(own.birthGameYear)}));
 }
 if(!own.df37G1History.some(r=>r.key===key||(r.year===calendarYear&&r.name===name&&r.month===calendarMonth)))
  own.df37G1History.push({key,year:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth,name,place:place+1,
   age:calendarHorseAge(ownerToRunner(own))});
 if(!own.df37Titles||typeof own.df37Titles!=='object'||Array.isArray(own.df37Titles))own.df37Titles={};
 const wins=own.df37G1History.filter(r=>r.place===1&&Number.isFinite(r.year));
 const last=own.df37G1History[own.df37G1History.length-1];
 if(last?.key!==key||place!==0)return false;
 const year=calendarYear;
 const won=(race,yr=year)=>wins.some(r=>r.year===yr&&r.name===race);
 const wonAll=(names,yr=year)=>names.every(name=>won(name,yr));
 const age=calendarHorseAge(ownerToRunner(own));
 const achieved=[];
 // In this calendar, all three junior G1s run in December and an owned horse
 // can enter only two races per month. Use the two G1s of its sex's division.
 if(age===2&&wonAll(own.sex==='牝'
    ?['阪神ジュベナイルフィリーズ','ホープフルステークス']
    :['朝日杯フューチュリティステークス','ホープフルステークス']))achieved.push('junior');
 if(age===3&&wonAll(['皐月賞','日本ダービー','菊花賞']))achieved.push('colt');
 if(age===3&&wonAll(['皐月賞','日本ダービー','菊花賞','ジャパンカップ','有馬記念']))achieved.push('fiveage');
 if(age===3&&own.sex==='牝'&&wonAll(['桜花賞','オークス','秋華賞']))achieved.push('filly');
 if(age>=4&&wonAll(['天皇賞（秋）','ジャパンカップ','有馬記念']))achieved.push('autumn');
 // Same-season Takarazuka + Arima wins, even if other races intervene.
 if(name==='有馬記念'&&wonAll(['宝塚記念','有馬記念'],year))achieved.push('grandprix');
 if(wonAll(['天皇賞（春）','天皇賞（秋）']))achieved.push('tenno');
 for(const [race,title] of [
   ['有馬記念','arima'],['天皇賞（春）','spring'],
   ['天皇賞（秋）','fall'],['ジャパンカップ','japan']]){
  if(name===race&&won(race,year-1))achieved.push(title);
 }
 if(own.df37G1History.slice(-5).length===5&&
    own.df37G1History.slice(-5).every(r=>r.place===1))achieved.push('five');
 let changed=false;
 const newlyEarned=[];
 for(const title of achieved){
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(own.df37Titles,title))continue;
  newlyEarned.push(title);
  ensureHorsePointSets(own);
  const bonusPoints={};
  for(const key of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
   const points=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
   own.uniquePts[key]=Number(own.uniquePts[key]||0)+points;
   bonusPoints[key]=points;
  }
  own.df37Titles[title]={name:DF37_TITLES[title],year,month:calendarMonth,bonusPoints};
  changed=true;
 }
 if(changed){
  HORSE_BY_NAME.set(own.name,ownerToRunner(own));
  stableNotice(`${own.name}が${newlyEarned.map(id=>DF37_TITLES[id]).join('・')}の称号を獲得！`);
  window.DF38AwardUI?.enqueue(own.name,newlyEarned.map(id=>({id,name:DF37_TITLES[id]})));
 }
 return changed;
}
