function df153HandleRaceReward(card){
 if(dfV30VsActive||!card)return;
 const first=finished[0];
 if(!first?.owner||!stableState.horses.some(x=>x.id===first.ownId))return;
 const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
 if(!bridge)return;
 const beforeState=bridge.getState?.()||{};
 const activeBefore=beforeState.df153BlackMode===true&&beforeState.df155SelectedMode!=='normal';
 let unlocked=false,unlocked2=false,guaranteedItems=[];
 if(card.grade==='GⅠ'){
  const result=bridge.df153RegisterWin?.(card.name,DF153_G1_REQUIRED);
  unlocked=!!result?.justUnlocked;unlocked2=!!result?.justUnlocked2;
  // A complete BLACK MODE 2 G1 collection awards gold once, when the final win is saved.
  guaranteedItems=Array.isArray(result?.guaranteedItems)?result.guaranteedItems:[];
  if(unlocked){window.__df153BlackOn=true;window.__df155ActiveMultiplier=1.10;df153ShowUnlock();}
  if(unlocked2){window.__df153BlackOn=true;window.__df155ActiveMultiplier=1.10*1.15;df155ShowSecondUnlock();}
 }
 if(!activeBefore)return; // the initial unlock race itself does not award an item
 const beatSS=runners.some(h=>!h.owner&&['ディープインパクト','アーモンドアイ','イクイノックス'].includes(h.originalName));
 const raceId=[calendarYear,calendarMonth,card.calendarId||card.name].join(':');
 const result=bridge.df153ClaimDrop?.({raceId,grade:card.grade,raceName:card.name,beatSS,
    modeAtStart:beforeState.df155SelectedMode,black2GoldAwarded:guaranteedItems.length>0});
  const awardedItems=[...guaranteedItems,...(Array.isArray(result?.items)&&result.items.length
    ?result.items:(result?.item?[result.item]:[]))];
  if(awardedItems.length){
    // Show the saved reward contents; keep the original text notice as a fallback.
    const shown=window.DF160ShowItemReward?.(awardedItems)===true;
    if(!shown)stableNotice(`アイテム「${awardedItems.map(it=>it.name).join('」と「')}」を獲得！ 所有馬画面のアイテム倉庫へ`);
  }

}

function stableAfterRaceFinish(card){
 const dfV19FirstStarters=[];
  const dfV20RaceFinishes=[];
 df27LastRacePrizes=[];
 const df31StabilityWinners=[],df10TemperamentWinners=[],df10G1Winners=[],df37AwardWinners=[],df37G1HistoryIds=[],df42UniqueWinners=[];
 const df17PrizeMode=(()=>{
  if(dfV30VsActive)return false;
  const st=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge?.getState?.();
  return st?.df153BlackMode===true&&['black','black2'].includes(st.df155SelectedMode);
 })();
 const entries=runners.map(h=>({h,model:HORSE_BY_NAME.get(h.name)}));
 for(const {h,model} of entries){
  if(!model||isSpecial125(model))continue;
  const c=conditionRecord(model);if(!c)continue;
 const health=Number.isFinite(Number(c.health))?Number(c.health):80;
   const ownerHealthFatigue=model.owner?(80-health)*.10:0;
   const effort=9+card.distance/200+(100-(c.constitution||75))*.12+ownerHealthFatigue+stableRandom(-3,4);
   c.fatigue=Math.round(stableBound((c.fatigue||0)+effort,0,100));
  if(!model.owner)c.form=Math.round(stableBound((c.form||75)+stableRandom(-9,8)-(c.fatigue||0)*.035,25,100));
  const startsBefore=c.startsMonth||0;
  c.startsMonth=startsBefore+1;c.lastStartDate=stableDateId();
  if(model.owner){
   const own=stableState.horses.find(x=>x.id===model.ownId);if(!own)continue;
   df28FormOnRace(own,startsBefore);
   // Ver.168: conditionRecord() deliberately returns a COPY for owned runners
   // (so form overrides do not mutate the saved horse).  Writing startsMonth
   // and lastStartDate to that copy did not update the actual race-home counter.
   own.startsMonth=c.startsMonth;
   own.lastStartDate=c.lastStartDate;
   own.totalStarts++;
   if(String(own.id).startsWith('farm-linked:'))dfV20RaceFinishes.push({horseId:String(own.id).slice('farm-linked:'.length),starts:own.totalStarts});
   if(own.totalStarts===1&&String(own.id).startsWith('farm-linked:'))dfV19FirstStarters.push(String(own.id).slice('farm-linked:'.length));
   const pos=finished.findIndex(r=>r.name===h.name);
    if(pos===0){
     // Ver.42: only horses with exactly one victory BEFORE this race qualify.
     // Races are completed and careers updated before this handler executes.
     const df42HadOneWin=Number(own.totalWins)===1;
     own.totalWins++;
     const winningTrait=df31AwardWinBasePoints(own,card);
     const df42Grade=String(card.grade||'').replace(/[ⅠI]/g,'1').replace(/[Ⅱ]/g,'2').replace(/[Ⅲ]/g,'3');
     const df42Age=calendarHorseAge(model);
     if(df42HadOneWin&&(df42Age===2||df42Age===3)&&/^G[123]$/.test(df42Grade)){
      const rewardId=`${calendarYear}:${calendarMonth}:${card.calendarId||card.name}`;
      if(!Array.isArray(own.df42OneWinGradedClaims))own.df42OneWinGradedClaims=[];
      if(!own.df42OneWinGradedClaims.includes(rewardId)){
       ensureHorsePointSets(own);
       for(const stat of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS)own.uniquePts[stat]=Number(own.uniquePts[stat]||0)+1+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
       own.df42OneWinGradedClaims.push(rewardId);
       HORSE_BY_NAME.set(own.name,ownerToRunner(own));
       df42UniqueWinners.push(own.id);
      }
     }
    if(winningTrait==='all')df31StabilityWinners.push(own.id);
    if(winningTrait==='temperament')df10TemperamentWinners.push(own.id);
    // GⅠ wins are race history, not a random birth characteristic.
    if(['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(String(card.grade||''))){
      const awardId=`${calendarYear}:${calendarMonth}:${card.calendarId||card.name}`;
      if(!Array.isArray(own.df10G1Claims))own.df10G1Claims=[];
      if(!own.df10G1Claims.includes(awardId)){
        own.df10G1Claims.push(awardId);
        own.g1Wins=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(own.g1Wins)||0))+1;
        df10G1Winners.push(own.id);
      }
    }
   }
   if(['GⅠ','GI','G1'].includes(String(card.grade||'')))df37G1HistoryIds.push(own.id);
   if(df37G1Record(own,card,pos))df37AwardWinners.push(own.id);
   let dfV18EarnedRacePrize=0;
   if(pos>=0&&pos<5){
    const awardId=`${calendarYear}:${calendarMonth}:${card.calendarId||card.name}`;
    if(!Array.isArray(own.prizeClaims))own.prizeClaims=[];
    if(!own.prizeClaims.includes(awardId)){
     const prize=stableRaceWinnings(card,pos)*(df17PrizeMode?2:1);
     if(prize>0){
      dfV18EarnedRacePrize=prize;
      walletCash+=prize;
      own.prize=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(own.prize)||0))+prize;
      df27LastRacePrizes.push({name:own.name,place:pos+1,prize});
      stableNotice(`${own.name}が${card.name}で${pos+1}着。賞金${cashText(prize)}を獲得。`);
     }
     own.prizeClaims.push(awardId);
    }
   }
   // Capture the same pre-race popularity order used by the result panel.
   const popularOrder=(currentPreRaceOdds.horse||[]).findIndex(entry=>entry.no===h.no);
   own.monthlyHistory.push({year:calendarYear,month:calendarMonth,name:card.name,
    place:pos+1,prize:dfV18EarnedRacePrize,surface:card.surface,distance:card.distance,
    popularity:popularOrder>=0?popularOrder+1:null});
   own.monthlyHistory=own.monthlyHistory.slice(-300);
  }
 }
 specialHorseReward();
  persistCash();persistStable();syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({forms:true,prizes:true,stabilityWinnerIds:df31StabilityWinners,
   temperamentWinnerIds:df10TemperamentWinners,g1WinnerIds:df10G1Winners,
   achievementWinnerIds:df37AwardWinners,g1HistoryIds:df37G1HistoryIds,
     uniqueWinnerIds:df42UniqueWinners});
   df153HandleRaceReward(card);
   if(!dfV30VsActive){
     const finishedOwnerTactics=runners.filter(h=>h.owner&&h.ownId).map(h=>({id:String(h.ownId),tactic:h.tactic}));
     $('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge?.df160FinishRaceConsumables?.(finishedOwnerTactics);
   }
   if(dfV19FirstStarters.length){
  const farmWindow=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow;
  farmWindow?.postMessage({channel:'df-v19-first-start',horseIds:dfV19FirstStarters},'*');
 }
 if(dfV20RaceFinishes.length){
  $('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.postMessage({channel:'df-v20-race-finished',horses:dfV20RaceFinishes},'*');
 }
 updateTicketDisplay();refreshStableCash();renderStable();
}

function stableMate(){
 const e=$('stableMateInfo');
 if(calendarMonth!==4){e.textContent='種付けできるのは毎年4月だけです。';return;}
 const sire=HORSE_DB.find(x=>x.originalName===$('stableSire').value&&x.sex==='牡');
 const dam=HORSE_DB.find(x=>x.originalName===$('stableDam').value&&x.sex==='牝');
 if(!sire||!dam){e.textContent='父馬と母馬を選んでください。';return;}
 if(walletCash<BREEDING_PRICE){e.textContent='資金が不足しています。';return;}
 const inbreeding=inspectInbreeding(sire.originalName,dam.originalName);
 if(!confirm(`${sire.originalName} × ${dam.originalName}\n${compactInbreeding(inbreeding)}\n種付け料は無料です。種付けしますか？`))return;
 // Ver.164: independently calculate the legacy stable foal once at mating.
 // If the calculation cannot complete, do not charge or record a pregnancy.
 const pregnancy={sire:sire.originalName,dam:dam.originalName,year:calendarYear,
  birthYear:calendarYear+1,inbreeding};
 let frozenFoal;
 try{frozenFoal=stableHorseAtBirth(pregnancy);}
 catch(err){console.error('厩舎の仔馬能力確定に失敗',err);e.textContent='種付けの能力計算に失敗しました。';return;}
 if(!frozenFoal){e.textContent='種付けの能力計算に失敗しました。';return;}
 walletCash-=BREEDING_PRICE;
 stableState.pregnancies.push({...pregnancy,frozenFoal,pedigreeRuleVersion:33,visibleInbreedCrosses:inbreeding.matches.map(c=>({ancestor:c.ancestor,positions:c.patterns.map(p=>p.split("×").map(Number))}))});
 stableNotice(`${sire.originalName} × ${dam.originalName} の種付け完了。${calendarYear+1}年目3月出産予定。`);
 persistCash();persistStable();updateTicketDisplay();refreshStableCash();renderStable();e.textContent='種付けが完了しました。';
  df176ShowMatingSuccess();
}
function stableSellNewborn(id){
 const h=stableState.horses.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id)&&!x.named);
 if(!h)return;
 const price=window.DFSharedRules.foalSalePrice(h);
 const info=$('stableMateInfo');
 if(price===null){if(info)info.textContent='売却価格を算定できません。';return;}
 if(!Number.isSafeInteger(walletCash+price)||walletCash+price>10000000000000){
  if(info)info.textContent='所持金の保存上限を超えるため売却できません。';return;
 }
 if(!confirm(`この仔馬を${fundsText(price)}で売却しますか？\n売却した仔馬は育成できません。`))return;
 stableState.horses.splice(stableState.horses.indexOf(h),1);
 walletCash+=price;
 stableNotice(`仔馬を${fundsText(price)}で売却しました。`);
 persistCash();persistStable();refreshStableCash();renderStable();
}
function stableRegisterName(id,input){

 if(!o)return;
 const name=input.trim();
 if(!name||[...name].length>9){e.textContent='馬名は1〜9文字以内で入力してください。';return;}
 if(/[<>"'&]/.test(name)){e.textContent='使用できない記号が含まれています。';return;}
 if(HORSE_BY_NAME.has(name)||stableState.horses.some(h=>h!==o&&h.name===name)){
  e.textContent='同じ名前の馬がすでに登録されています。別の名前を付けてください。';return;
 }
 o.name=name;o.named=true;const runner=ownerToRunner(o);HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,runner);calendarCareers.set(name,{wins:0,starts:0});
 stableNotice(`${name} と命名しました。2歳の6月から出走できます。`);

}
// Ver.98: shared column definitions ensure the desktop and phone screens expose the same complete values.
function stableAbilityEntries(h){
 ensureHorsePointSets(h);
 const age=calendarHorseAge(h);
 const career=calendarCareers.get(h.name)||{starts:h.totalStarts||0,wins:h.totalWins||0};
 const num=v=>v==null||!Number.isFinite(Number(v))?'—':String(Math.round(v));
 const apt=h.goingAptitude||{};
 const abilities=[];
 for(const k of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
  const name=HORSE_ABILITY_NAMES[k];
  abilities.push([`${name} 基本Pt`,num(growingBaseStat(h,k))],
   [`${name} 基本Pt最終`,num(h.baseMaximum[k])],
   [`${name} 固有Pt`,num(h.uniquePts[k])],
   [`${name} 実力`,num(currentAbilityStat(h,k))]);
 }
 return [
  ['年齢',`${age}歳`],['性別',h.sex||'—'],['生年',`${h.birthGameYear}年目`],['成長型',h.growth||'—'],['毛色',h.coatType||'—'],
  ...abilities,
  ['運',num(h.luck)],['気性',num(h.temperament)],['健康',num(h.health)],['体質',num(h.constitution)],
  ['回復力',num(h.recovery)],['調子安定性',num(h.formStability)],['素質評価',num(h.potential)],
  ['疲労',num(h.fatigue)],['調子',num(h.form)],
  ['得意距離',h.bestDistance==null?'—':`${num(h.bestDistance)}m`],['距離下限',h.aptMin==null?'—':`${num(h.aptMin)}m`],
  ['距離上限',h.aptMax==null?'—':`${num(h.aptMax)}m`],['馬場',h.surface||'—'],['脚質',h.tactic||'—'],
  ['良馬場適性',num(apt['良'])],['稍重適性',num(apt['稍重'])],['重馬場適性',num(apt['重'])],['不良馬場適性',num(apt['不良'])],
  ['今月の出走',`${num(h.startsMonth)}/2`],['通算出走',num(career.starts)],['通算勝利',num(career.wins)],
  ['獲得賞金',cashText(h.prize||0)],['父',h.sire||'—'],['母',h.dam||'—'],
  ['インブリード',compactInbreeding(inspectInbreeding(h.sire,h.dam))],
  ['総合実力Pt',num(ownedTotalPoints(h))]
 ];
}

 const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.textContent='出走レースを選ぶ';
 btn.disabled=(Number(h.startsMonth)||0)>=STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS||age===2&&calendarMonth<6;

  stableState.selectedHorseId=h.id;persistStable();showStablePage(false);drawCalendar();
  const selector=$('calendarRaceSelect');if(selector)selector.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'smooth'});
 });
 return btn;
}
function renderStableAbilities(){

  const desktopAction=stableHorseEntryAction(h);if(desktopAction){desktopAction.classList.add('stable-row-action');nameCell.append(desktopAction);}

  const card=document.createElement('article');card.className='stable-horse stable-ability-card';

  if(mobileAction){const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='stable-actions';actions.append(mobileAction);card.append(actions);}
  mobile.append(card);
 }

}

 if(!$('stableDate'))return;

  wrap.append(lab,offer,sell,inp,btn);naming.append(wrap);
 }
 renderStableAbilities();
 if(document.body.classList.contains('barn-mode'))renderBarn();
 $('stableNews').textContent=stableState.messages.length?stableState.messages.join('\n'):'厩舎が開設されました。';
}

  showStablePage(true);
 });
 const si=$('stableSire'),da=$('stableDam');

 renderInbreedingPreview();

 }
 bindBarnUI();
 // Existing saves started without an owner's stable. Don't re-run births of a past season.
 renderStable();
}

/* ===== V104: TRUE THREE.JS FARM ENGINE =====
   Uses Quaternius/Poly Pizza CC0 animated Horse.glb when reachable,
   and a 3D-mesh fallback if blocked. Scene has real depth, lighting and orbit.
*/
let farmRenderer3D=null,farmScene3D=null,farmCamera3D=null,farmHorse3D=null,farmHorseRoot3D=null;
let farmHorseMixer3D=null,farm3DStarted=false,farmHorseLoading=false,farmCurrentCoat='';
let farmHead3D=null,farmTail3D=null,farmMouth3D=null,farmEars3D=[],farmEyes3D=[];
let farmClock3D=null,farmYawTime=0,farmUserAzimuth=0,farmPointerX=null,farmPreview=false;
const FARM_GLTF_URL='https://static.poly.pizza/d37dbc87-ca61-4b2c-a2da-d2f0c4240bef.glb';
function farmMesh(geom,color,roughness=.88){return new THREE.Mesh(geom,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,metalness:0}))}
function farmEllipsoid(group,w,h,d,x,y,z,color){const mesh=farmMesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,20,13),color);mesh.position.set(x,y,z);mesh.scale.set(w,h,d);group.add(mesh);return mesh;}
function farmCylinder(a,b,r1,r2,material,segments=12){
 const v1=new THREE.Vector3(...a),v2=new THREE.Vector3(...b);const dir=v2.clone().sub(v1);
 const obj=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,dir.length(),segments),material);
 obj.position.copy(v1).add(v2).multiplyScalar(.5);obj.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),dir.normalize());return obj;
}
function farmMakeFallbackHorse(){
 const horse=new THREE.Group(),coat=farmMesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1),0xb17a4b).material,
 dark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x573626,roughness:.99}),hoof=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x312b28,roughness:1});
 farmEllipsoid(horse,.61,.69,1.20,0,1.55,0.03,coat.color);
 farmEllipsoid(horse,.51,.71,.64,0,1.60,.79,coat.color);
 farmEllipsoid(horse,.54,.65,.60,0,1.64,-.78,coat.color);
 for(const z of [-.84,.79])for(const x of [-.36,.36]){
  const hind=z<0,knee=hind?x*.9:x;
  horse.add(farmCylinder([x,1.3,z],[knee,.75,z+(hind?-.16:.09)],.23,.135,coat));
  horse.add(farmCylinder([knee,.75,z+(hind?-.16:.09)],[x,.17,z+(hind?-.1:.04)],.135,.09,coat));
  const h=farmEllipsoid(horse,.15,.115,.19,x,.12,z+(hind?-.1:.08),hoof.color);
 }
 // Neck rises toward the head (+Z is forward).
 horse.add(farmCylinder([0,1.60,.66],[0,2.56,1.06],.39,.26,coat));
 farmEllipsoid(horse,.34,.49,.33,0,2.29,.96,coat.color);
 const head=new THREE.Group();head.position.set(0,2.55,1.10);horse.add(head);
 farmEllipsoid(head,.27,.45,.39,0,.13,.18,coat.color);
 farmEllipsoid(head,.28,.21,.32,0,-.16,.45,0xbda18b);
 farmEllipsoid(head,.29,.22,.37,0,.30,.11,coat.color);
 // facial blaze
 farmEllipsoid(head,.055,.23,.04,0,.20,.48,0xf6e9ca);
 for(const x of [-.24,.24]){
  const ear=new THREE.Group();ear.position.set(x*.81,.54,.07);head.add(ear);
  const cone=farmMesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.12,.32,8),dark.color);cone.position.y=.13;ear.add(cone);farmEars3D.push(ear);
  const eye=farmEllipsoid(head,.08,.08,.026,x*.94,.19,.43,0x160c0a);farmEyes3D.push(eye);
  farmEllipsoid(head,.032,.028,.016,x*.95,.205,.45,0xffffff);
  farmEllipsoid(head,.052,.029,.016,x*.67,-.2,.76,0x4f3a32);
 }
 farmMouth3D=farmEllipsoid(head,.17,.01,.012,0,-.28,.73,0x33211d);
 // Mane along neck made from tapered spikes
 for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const spike=farmMesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.12,.23,6),dark.color);spike.position.set(0,2.0+i*.053,.60+i*.05);spike.rotation.x=1.0;horse.add(spike);}
 farmTail3D=new THREE.Group();farmTail3D.position.set(0,1.82,-1.03);horse.add(farmTail3D);
 farmTail3D.add(farmCylinder([0,0,0],[0,-.70,-.26],.13,.03,dark));
 farmHead3D=head;horse.userData.isFallback=true;return horse;
}
function farmWoodPost(x,z,height=1.5){
 const mat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xf8faf3,roughness:1});
 const post=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.16,height,.14),mat);post.position.set(x,height/2,z);post.castShadow=true;farmScene3D.add(post);
}
function farmDecorateWorld(){
 const ground=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(140,140,28,28),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x83b64e,roughness:1}));ground.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;ground.receiveShadow=true;farmScene3D.add(ground);
 const path=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(11,8.1),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xa98151,roughness:1}));path.rotation.x=-Math.PI/2;path.position.set(0,.013,1.5);farmScene3D.add(path);
 const hillmat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x80b951,roughness:1});
 for(const [x,z,rx,ry,rz] of [[-13,-26,20,9,9],[9,-31,24,11,9],[-28,-35,18,8,12]]){const hill=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,18,12),hillmat);hill.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);hill.position.set(x,-2.6,z);farmScene3D.add(hill)}
 // L-shaped white paddock fence behind the horse.
 const railMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xffffff,roughness:.7});
 for(let i=-12;i<=12;i++)farmWoodPost(i*1.05,-5.5,1.6);
 for(const y of [.72,1.29]){const rail=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(25.5,.14,.13),railMat);rail.position.set(0,y,-5.5);farmScene3D.add(rail)}
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++)farmWoodPost(12.6,-5.5+i*1.07,1.6);
 for(const y of [.72,1.29]){const rail=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.15,.14,8.4),railMat);rail.position.set(12.6,y,-1.7);farmScene3D.add(rail)}
 // Cherry blossom trees: spatial clusters cast real shadows.
 const bark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x805638,roughness:1}),leafPink=[0xfcb0d4,0xffc1dc,0xef90c2,0xf1abd0].map(c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:1}));
 const leafGreen=[0x4f9d46,0x60b84d,0x87bb57].map(c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:1}));
 const seedRand=(n)=>{let a=(n*69069+1)|0;return()=>{a=(a*1664525+1013904223)|0;return ((a>>>0)%10000)/10000}};
 function addTree(x,z,height,pink,seed){
  const rnd=seedRand(seed),top=height*.45;
  const trunk=farmCylinder([x,0,z],[x+.12,height*.67,z],.18*height/4,.115*height/4,bark);trunk.castShadow=true;farmScene3D.add(trunk);
  const mats=pink?leafPink:leafGreen;
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const a=rnd()*Math.PI*2,rad=.17+rnd()*height*.20,ball=farmMesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1,1),0xffffff);ball.material=mats[i%mats.length];ball.scale.set(.48+rnd()*.34,.45+rnd()*.32,.47+rnd()*.38);ball.scale.multiplyScalar(height/3.9);ball.position.set(x+Math.cos(a)*rad,top+.7+rnd()*height*.23,z+Math.sin(a)*rad);ball.castShadow=true;farmScene3D.add(ball)}
 }
 addTree(-8,-9,5.9,true,6);addTree(-15,-16,4.9,true,8);addTree(12,-13,6.0,false,15);addTree(16,-23,5.3,true,4);addTree(-20,-26,5,false,9);
 // Flowers and sunflowers in 3D clumps, actual meshes not painted icons.
 const petalColors=[0xffca46,0xe47fc9,0xfe9940,0xffffff,0xaa72e8];
 const flowerHeads=petalColors.map(c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,roughness:.9,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
 const stemMat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x58904b,roughness:1});
 const flowerStemGeom=new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.014,.018,.23,5);
 for(let i=0;i<160;i++){
  const a=(i*2.39996),r=5.1+Math.sqrt(i)*.58,x=Math.cos(a)*r,z=Math.sin(a)*r-1;
  if(Math.abs(x)<5&&z>-2&&z<6)continue;
  const stem=new THREE.Mesh(flowerStemGeom,stemMat);stem.position.set(x,.11,z);farmScene3D.add(stem);
  const petal=farmMesh(new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(.105,0),0xffffff);petal.material=flowerHeads[i%5];petal.position.set(x,.24,z);farmScene3D.add(petal);
 }
 // Tractor and hay crates on the left, farm props in volumetric 3D.
 const tractor=new THREE.Group();tractor.position.set(-9,0,-5);farmScene3D.add(tractor);
 const blue=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x3989bb,roughness:.75}),dark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x393c3a,roughness:1});
 const chassis=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2,.75,1.3),blue);chassis.position.y=.62;tractor.add(chassis);
 const cab=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(.9,1,1.12),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x9fcfda,roughness:.3}));cab.position.set(.15,1.27,0);tractor.add(cab);
 for(const xx of [-.67,.68])for(const zz of [-.72,.72]){const wheel=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.46,.46,.18,12),dark);wheel.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;wheel.position.set(xx,.42,zz);tractor.add(wheel)}
 const haymat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd4aa59,roughness:1});
 for(const [xx,zz,rot] of [[-7,-5,0],[-7.9,-6.1,.13],[-6.8,-6.2,-.2]]){const hay=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.15,.75,.78),haymat);hay.position.set(xx,.4,zz);hay.rotation.y=rot;farmScene3D.add(hay)}
 const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0cb,3.15);sun.position.set(-7,19,11);sun.castShadow=true;sun.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);sun.shadow.camera.left=-24;sun.shadow.camera.right=24;sun.shadow.camera.top=22;sun.shadow.camera.bottom=-22;sun.shadow.bias=-.0004;farmScene3D.add(sun);
 farmScene3D.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xe1f7ff,0x638b4a,2.0));
 farmScene3D.fog=new THREE.Fog(0xc8edc1,27,64);
 farmScene3D.background=new THREE.Color(0xb9ebff);
}

async function farm3DLoadModel(){
 if(farmHorseLoading)return;farmHorseLoading=true;
 try{
  const {GLTFLoader}=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js');
  let gltf;
  try{gltf=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>new GLTFLoader().load(FARM_GLTF_URL,resolve,undefined,reject));}
  catch(primaryError){console.warn('CC0 horse CDN failed; trying alternate 3D horse.',primaryError);
   gltf=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>new GLTFLoader().load('https://threejs.org/examples/models/gltf/Horse.glb',resolve,undefined,reject));
  }
  const model=gltf.scene;
  model.traverse(obj=>{if(obj.isMesh){obj.castShadow=true;obj.receiveShadow=true;}});
  const bounds=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(model);const sz=bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
  model.scale.setScalar(2.75/Math.max(sz.y,.05));
  bounds.setFromObject(model);const center=bounds.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
  model.position.set(-center.x,-bounds.min.y,-center.z);
  // Orient asset local forward so horse is seen in 3/4 view.
  model.rotation.y=Math.PI*.5;
  farmHorseRoot3D.remove(farmHorse3D);farmHorse3D=model;farmHorseRoot3D.add(model);
  farmHead3D=null;farmTail3D=null;farmMouth3D=null;farmEars3D=[];farmEyes3D=[];
  if(gltf.animations.length){
    const idleClip=gltf.animations.find(a=>/idle|stand|rest|wait/i.test(a.name));
    if(idleClip){farmHorseMixer3D=new THREE.AnimationMixer(model);farmHorseMixer3D.clipAction(idleClip).play();farmHorseMixer3D._farmIdle=true;}
  }
  const selected=barnOwnedHorses().find(h=>String(h.id)===String(stableState.barnHorseId))||barnOwnedHorses()[0];
  if(selected)setFarmHorse(selected);
  $('farmAssetNote').textContent='3D馬を表示中。画面を指で左右に動かすと視点を変更できます。';
 }catch(error){console.warn('Model download failed; mesh horse fallback active.',error);$('farmAssetNote').textContent='3D馬モデルの通信に失敗したため、内蔵の3D馬を表示しています。';}
}
function setFarmHorse(h){
 if(!farm3DStarted||!farmHorseRoot3D)return;
 farmHorseRoot3D.visible=!!h;
 if(!h)return;
 const palette=getCoatPalette(h.coatType||'鹿毛');
 // For the original animated horse, preserve its materials and details, tint subtly for different coats.
 if(farmHorse3D&&!farmHorse3D.userData.isFallback){
  const chosen=new THREE.Color(palette.body);
  farmHorse3D.traverse(obj=>{if(!obj.isMesh||!obj.material)return;const mats=Array.isArray(obj.material)?obj.material:[obj.material];for(const m of mats){if(m.color&&!m.userData._farmOriginalColor)m.userData._farmOriginalColor=m.color.clone();if(m.color&&m.userData._farmOriginalColor){m.color.copy(m.userData._farmOriginalColor).lerp(chosen,.18);}}});
 }else if(farmHorse3D){
  const target=new THREE.Color(palette.body);
  farmHorse3D.traverse(obj=>{if(obj.isMesh&&obj.material&&obj.material.color){const curr=obj.material.color;if(curr.r>.24&&curr.g>.15){curr.lerp(target,.20);}}});
 }
}

 const palette=getCoatPalette(coatType),base=new THREE.Color(palette.body),highlight=base.clone().lerp(new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),.20);
 const art=$('barnArt');
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-coat',palette.body);
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-shade',palette.shade);
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-light','#'+highlight.getHexString());
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-mane',palette.mane);
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-muzzle',palette.muzzle);
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-mark',palette.mark);
 art.style.setProperty('--horse-hoof',palette.hoof);
}

}

const FARM_GESTURES={
 blink:{label:'まばたき',desc:'安心しているみたい'},
 ear:{label:'耳ピク',desc:'こちらに興味があるみたい'},
 tail:{label:'しっぽパタパタ',desc:'ちょっと落ち着かないみたい'},
 graze:{label:'草を食べる',desc:'食欲がありそう'},
 yawn:{label:'あくび',desc:'少し疲れているみたい'},
 shake:{label:'顔を左右にブルブル',desc:'元気に体をほぐしている'},
 nod:{label:'首振り',desc:'気分がよさそう'}
};
let farmSignalType='nod',farmSignalNonce=0,farmLastSignalTime=0,farmAnimationReady=false;
let farmCanvasTime=0,farmCanvasPainted='',farmCanvasTask=null;
function farmSelectedHorse(){const hs=barnOwnedHorses();return hs.find(h=>String(h.id)===String(stableState.barnHorseId))||hs[0]||null;}
function farmCanvasDraw(sheet,index,tag){
 const canvas=$('farmCareCanvas'),ctx=canvas?.getContext('2d');if(!ctx||!sheet?.naturalWidth||farmCanvasPainted===tag)return;
 const W=543,H=724,cols=6;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.drawImage(sheet,(index%cols)*W,Math.floor(index/cols)*H,W,H,0,0,W,H);farmCanvasPainted=tag;
}
function farmCanvasTick(ms){
 if(!farmCanvasTime)farmCanvasTime=ms;
 // The full-screen farm iframe hides this parent-only canvas completely.
 // Preserve the animation clock; draw normally whenever the parent farm view is used.
 if(document.body.classList.contains('barn-mode')&&document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='farm'){
  const sheet=$('farmCareAtlas'),shake=$('farmCareShakeAtlas');
  if(farmSignalType==='shake'&&ms-farmLastSignalTime<1700){
    const f=Math.min(29,Math.floor((ms-farmLastSignalTime)/1700*30));farmCanvasDraw(shake,Math.max(0,f),'shake'+f);
  }else{
    const f=Math.floor((ms-farmCanvasTime)/68)%36;farmCanvasDraw(sheet,f,'normal'+f);
  }
 }
 farmCanvasTask=requestAnimationFrame(farmCanvasTick);
}
function farmSignalNext(type=null){
 if(!farmSelectedHorse())return;
 const choices=Object.keys(FARM_GESTURES);
 farmSignalType=type||choices[Math.floor(Math.random()*choices.length)];
 farmSignalNonce++;farmLastSignalTime=performance.now();
 const gesture=FARM_GESTURES[farmSignalType],box=$('farmCareHorse');
 if(box){for(const cls of [...box.classList])if(cls.startsWith('gesture-'))box.classList.remove(cls);
  void box.offsetWidth;box.classList.add('gesture-'+farmSignalType);}
 $('farmSignal').textContent=`🐴 ${gesture.label}：${gesture.desc}`;
}
function farmAnimationStart(){
 if(farmAnimationReady)return;farmAnimationReady=true;
 farmCanvasTask=requestAnimationFrame(farmCanvasTick);
 setInterval(()=>{
  if(!document.body.classList.contains('barn-mode')||document.visibilityState!=='visible'||!farmSelectedHorse())return;
  if(performance.now()-farmLastSignalTime>6500)farmSignalNext();
 },1200);
}
function barnYawn(){
 if(!document.body.classList.contains('barn-mode')||!barnOwnedHorses().length)return;
 const art=$('barnArt');if(art.classList.contains('yawning'))return;
 art.classList.remove('petted');art.classList.add('yawning');triggerFarmYawn();barnSay('ふぁ〜あ… 💤');
 clearTimeout(barnEffectTimer);barnEffectTimer=setTimeout(()=>art.classList.remove('yawning'),2050);
}

// Manual race entrant choice: inspect existing stats, replace one selected entry.

let pendingManualField=null;

function manualRegisteredHorses(){
 if(dfV136OpFullRoster)return [...new Map([...DEF,...dfRegisteredHorseList()].filter(h=>h?.name).map(h=>[h.name,h])).values()];
 if(df131NonGraded(currentRace))return [...new Map([...ownedRaceHorses().filter(h=>calendarRaceEligible(h,currentRace)),...DEF.filter(h=>h.df131FictionalCom)].map(h=>[h.name,h])).values()];
 const entries=typeof calendarPool==='function'?calendarPool():HORSE_DB;
 const unique=new Map();for(const h of entries)if(h?.name&&calendarRaceEligible(h,currentRace)&&!unique.has(h.name))unique.set(h.name,h);
 // Existing eligible starters stay selectable/inspectable.
 for(const h of DEF)if(h?.name&&calendarRaceEligible(h,currentRace)&&!unique.has(h.name))unique.set(h.name,h);
 return [...unique.values()];
}
function manualRaceStats(h){
 const o=h.owner?stableState.horses.find(x=>x.id===h.ownId):null;
 const apt=h.goingAptitude||{};
 const points=h.owner?ownedTotalPoints(o||h):racePointRating(h);
 const values=[
  h.sp,h.sta,h.kick,h.early,h.sustain,h.grit,h.stability,
  h.temperament,h.health,h.luck??o?.luck??null,h.overallScore??o?.potential,
  h.growth,h.bestDistance,h.aptMin,h.aptMax,h.surface,
  apt['良'],apt['稍重'],apt['重'],apt['不良'],h.g1Wins,h.coatType,
  o?.constitution,o?.recovery,o?.formStability,o?.potential,o?.fatigue,o?.form,
  ...HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS.map(k=>o?.uniquePts?.[k]),points
 ];
  const labels=["スピード","スタミナ","瞬発力","先行力","持続力","勝負根性","安定性","気性","健康","運","総合評価","成長型","得意距離m","距離下限m","距離上限m","馬場","良適性","稍重適性","重適性","不良適性","GⅠ勝数","毛色","体質","回復力","調子安定性","素質","疲労","調子","固有Pt(速)","固有Pt(持久)","固有Pt(瞬)","固有Pt(先行)","固有Pt(持続)","固有Pt(根性)","固有Pt(安定)","総合実力Pt"];

}

function renderManualRunnerPicker(){

 horseSelect.replaceChildren();
 const pool=manualRegisteredHorses();
 for(const h of pool)horseSelect.add(new Option(`${paperHorseName(h)}［${h.overallRank||'―'}／${h.tactic||'―'}］${earnedPriorityFor(h,currentRace)?'★優先出走権':''}${h.owner?'（所有馬）':''}${entryDistancePerfect(h,currentRace)?'':'・距離注意'}`,h.name));

function manualReplaceRaceHorse(requestedSlot=null,requestedName=null){
 if(race!=='idle'||!currentRace)return {ok:false,error:'レース開始前のみ変更できます。'};
 // Explicit OP selection takes priority; the other pre-race form must not override it.
 const slot=Number(Number.isInteger(requestedSlot)?requestedSlot:$('manualRunnerSlot')?.value);
 const name=typeof requestedName==='string'?requestedName:$('manualRunnerHorse')?.value;
 const h=manualRegisteredHorses().find(h=>h.name===name);
 const errorMessage=message=>{$('manualRunnerMessage').textContent=message;return {ok:false,error:message};};
 if(!Number.isInteger(slot)||slot<0||slot>=DEF.length||!h)return errorMessage('出走枠または馬を選び直してください。');
 if(!dfV136OpFullRoster&&!calendarRaceEligible(h,currentRace))return errorMessage('このレースの距離・性別・馬齢・出走資格を満たしていません。');
 const already=DEF.findIndex((x,i)=>i!==slot&&(x.name===name||x.originalName===h.originalName));
 if(already>=0)return errorMessage(`${already+1}番にも同じ馬がいます。別の馬を選択してください。`);
 if(DEF[slot].name===h.name)return errorMessage('この枠はすでに選択した馬です。');
 if(raceTickets.length&&!confirm('馬を入れ替えると、発走前の購入済み馬券は返金されます。変更しますか？'))return errorMessage('変更をキャンセルしました。');
  // OP may edit VS races as well as normal races, using the same picker.
  if(dfV30VsActive){
   const result=window.DFV30SharedRace?.replace?.(slot,h);
   if(!result?.ok)return errorMessage(result?.error||'VS出走馬を変更できませんでした。');
  }else{
   const chosen=DEF.slice();chosen[slot]=h;
   pendingManualField={cardId:currentRace.calendarId,horseList:chosen,opBypass:dfV136OpFullRoster};
   prepareNewRace({raceCard:currentRace});
  }
 $('manualRunnerSlot').value=String(slot);
 manualPickSlot();
 $('manualRunnerMessage').textContent=`${slot+1}番を${h.name}に変更しました。レース開始を押すとこの出走馬で走ります。`;
 return {ok:true,horse:DEF[slot],slot};
}

 $('manualRunnerHorse')?.addEventListener('change',manualShowHorsePreview);
 $('manualRunnerApply')?.addEventListener('click',manualReplaceRaceHorse);
}

// ===== Ver.90 source section: 26_new_race_selection.js | 次レース・状態初期化 =====
function prepareNewRace({first=false,raceCard=null,restoredLineup=null}={}){
 const manualEdit=pendingManualField&&raceCard&&pendingManualField.cardId===raceCard.calendarId?pendingManualField:null;
 const manualField=manualEdit?.horseList||null;
 pendingManualField=null;
 if(!first)discardRaceTickets();
 camMode='auto';
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-camera]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.camera==='auto'));
 const card=raceCard||chooseMonthlyRace();
 if(!card){$('start').disabled=true;drawCalendar();throw new Error('開催レース情報を取得できませんでした。');}
 const restore=restoredLineup?.preRaceReady&&restoredLineup.raceCard?.calendarId===card?.calendarId?restoredLineup:null;
 STARTERS=restore?restore.field.length:(dfGateGradedMinimum(card)===fieldSizeLimit(card)&&dfGateGradedMinimum(card)>0?fieldSizeLimit(card):Math.min(fieldSizeLimit(card),Math.max(dfGateGradedMinimum(card),df131NonGraded(card)?Math.max(10,manualField?.length||8+Math.floor(Math.random()*11)):(manualField?.length||8+Math.floor(Math.random()*11)))));
 if(renderer)renderer.setPixelRatio(renderPixelRatio());
 activeCalendarCard=card;
 $('calendarRaceSelect').value=card.calendarId;
 currentRace=card;
 TOTAL=currentRace.distance;
 currentGoing=restore?restore.going:drawRaceGoing();
 currentWeather=restore?restore.weather:drawRaceWeather();
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='コース形状の設定';
 updateTrackShape();
 // Ver.123: free old race GPU resources before building the next course.
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='前レースの3Dモデル解放';
 removeRunners();
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='3Dシーンの初期化';
 if(!scene||!renderer||!camera)setup();
 if(!scene||!renderer||!camera)throw new Error('3Dシーンを初期化できませんでした。');
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='コースの生成';
 rebuildCourse();
 if(restore)for(const h of restore.field){if(h.df131FictionalCom)HORSE_BY_NAME.set(h.name,h);}
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='出走馬の選出';
 const chosen=restore?restore.field:(manualField&&manualField.length>= Math.max(dfGateGradedMinimum(currentRace),df131NonGraded(currentRace)?10:1)&&
     (manualEdit?.opBypass||manualField.every(h=>(!df131NonGraded(currentRace)||h.owner||h.df131FictionalCom)&&calendarRaceEligible(h,currentRace)))?manualField:fieldForRace(currentRace,STARTERS));
 // Always use the same fixed field for paper, odds, race footage and results.
 if(chosen.length<STARTERS)STARTERS=chosen.length;
 if(!restore)assignRaceRiders(chosen,currentRace);
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='出走馬データの生成';
 DEF=chosen.map((h,i)=>({...makeStarter(h.name,i,h),age:ageForRace(h,currentRace),weight:weightForRace(h,currentRace,ageForRace(h,currentRace)),jockey:h.jockey,jockeyHistory:h.jockeyHistory,jockeySkills:h.jockeySkills}));
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='競走馬3Dモデルの生成';
 for(let i=0;i<DEF.length;i++){
  const h=DEF[i],model=makeHorse(null,h,i+1);
  runners.push({...h,...model,age:h.age,weight:h.weight,jockey:h.jockey,jockeyHistory:h.jockeyHistory,jockeySkills:h.jockeySkills,no:i+1,dist:0,velocity:0,lane:i-(STARTERS-1)/2,targetLane:i-(STARTERS-1)/2,stamina:1,finishedAt:null,phase:0,variant:0,decision:0});
 }
 $('courseInfo').textContent=`${currentRace.venue}競馬場｜${currentRace.surface}${TOTAL}m｜${currentCourse.straightOnly?'直線':currentCourse.direction+'回り・'+(currentRace.layout==='本'?'本コース':currentRace.layout+'回り')}｜馬場：${currentGoing}｜天候：${currentWeather}｜${STARTERS}頭｜${currentRace.weightRule}`;
 document.querySelector('.race-title').firstChild.textContent=`${currentRace.venue}競馬場　${currentRace.name} `;
 document.querySelector('.race-title .g1').textContent=currentRace.grade;
 if(restore)raceNo=restore.raceNo-1; // Seed increments once; keep the original newspaper number.
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='競馬新聞とレース状態の初期化';
 seedRace();
 renderPreRaceGuide();
 configureRaceVolatility();
 if(restore?.runnerDraws?.length===runners.length){
   // Reuse the already-drawn pre-start fluctuations instead of changing the
   // outcome merely because the player briefly opened VS mode.
   raceVolatility={...restore.raceVolatility};
   runners.forEach((h,i)=>{
     const draw=restore.runnerDraws[i];
     for(const key of ['phase','gaitCycle','decision','variant','upsetDrive','paceCollapse'])
       if(Number.isFinite(draw[key]))h[key]=draw[key];
     if(draw.masterRace)h.masterRace={...draw.masterRace};
     if(h.mixer&&Number.isFinite(h.phase))h.mixer.setTime(h.phase*.1);
   });
 }
 const classicLine=chosen.filter(h=>h.classicSeasonYear===calendarYear).map(h=>h.originalName);
 df103Subtitle(`${currentRace.venue}の${currentRace.name}（${currentRace.grade}）。${calendarAgeLabel(currentRace.ages)}${currentRace.female?"・牝馬限定":""}、馬場は${currentGoing}、天候は${currentWeather}、${STARTERS}頭立て。${classicLine.length?'クラシック世代注目馬：'+classicLine.join('、')+'。':''}レース開始を押してください。`);
 applyWeather();
 updateRaceOverlay();
 drawCalendar({preferred:card.calendarId});
 renderManualRunnerPicker();
 updateGameScreenNav();
 window.dfRacePrepareStage='完了';
}

// Five independent screen surfaces; legacy stable management remains reachable.

// Ver.2: both the existing and replacement screens actually change opacity.
let dfV2Busy=false,dfV2FallbackTimer=0;
function dfV2Switch(action,quietPaperToRace=false){
  const opening=document.getElementById('derbyOpening');
  if(dfV2Busy||(!opening?.hidden)||document.hidden){return action();}
  if(window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches){return action();}
  dfV2Busy=true;
  if(quietPaperToRace){
    document.documentElement.classList.add('df-v147-paper-to-race');
  }else{
    window.dfV2SparkStart?.();
  }
  const finish=()=>{
    if(quietPaperToRace)document.documentElement.classList.remove('df-v147-paper-to-race');
    else window.dfV2SparkStop?.();
    dfV2Busy=false;
  };
  if(typeof document.startViewTransition==='function'){
    try{
      const transition=document.startViewTransition(()=>action());
      transition.finished.catch(()=>{}).finally(finish);
    }catch(_){finish();action();}
    return;
  }
  // Older WebViews: switch directly rather than exposing the blue background
  // while fading out the newspaper without a retained snapshot.
  if(quietPaperToRace){
    try{action();}finally{finish();}
    return;
  }
  document.body.classList.add('df-v2-fade-out');
  dfV2FallbackTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
    try{action();}finally{
      document.body.classList.remove('df-v2-fade-out');
      document.body.classList.add('df-v2-fade-in');
      dfV2FallbackTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
        document.body.classList.remove('df-v2-fade-in');
        finish();
      },1150);
    }
  },720);
}

  df197ConfirmedNavigation=false;

  if(!alreadyConfirmed)return false;
  raceLineupCommitted=false;
  try {
   prepareNewRace({raceCard:card});
   if(runners.length<2){
    throw new Error('出走馬が'+runners.length+'頭しか生成されませんでした。');
   }
   raceLineupCommitted=true;
   $('paperDetails').open=true;
   $('newspaperRaceStart').disabled=false;
   return true;
  } catch(error) {
   raceLineupCommitted=false;
   $('newspaperRaceStart').disabled=true;
   console.error('DBF-RACE-PREPARE', {raceId:card.calendarId, raceName:card.name, error});
   // Race preparation diagnostics: selectable text and a copy button, without
   // modifying the race field, calculations, or existing save data.
   const diagnostic=[
     'DBF レース準備エラー',
     '段階: '+String(window.dfRacePrepareStage||'開始前'),
     'レース: '+String(card.name||'不明'),
     'レースID: '+String(card.calendarId||'不明'),
     '日時: '+new Date().toISOString(),
     'エラー: '+String(error?.message||error),
     '詳細: '+String(error?.stack||'スタック情報なし')
   ].join('\n');
   document.getElementById('dfRaceDiagnosticPanel')?.remove();
   const panel=document.createElement('div');
   panel.id='dfRaceDiagnosticPanel';
   panel.setAttribute('role','alertdialog');
   panel.setAttribute('aria-label','レース準備エラー詳細');
   panel.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:8% 4%;z-index:2147483647;background:#fff;color:#111;padding:14px;border:3px solid #b42318;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 0 0 9999px #0009;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font:16px sans-serif;';
   const heading=document.createElement('strong');heading.textContent='レース準備エラー（内容をコピーして送ってください）';panel.appendChild(heading);
   const detail=document.createElement('textarea');detail.readOnly=true;detail.value=diagnostic;detail.style.cssText='width:100%;flex:1;min-height:120px;font:13px monospace;box-sizing:border-box;';panel.appendChild(detail);
   const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;';
   const copy=document.createElement('button');copy.textContent='エラー内容をコピー';copy.type='button';copy.onclick=()=>{detail.focus();detail.select();if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText)navigator.clipboard.writeText(diagnostic).catch(()=>{});};actions.appendChild(copy);
   const close=document.createElement('button');close.textContent='閉じる';close.type='button';close.onclick=()=>panel.remove();actions.appendChild(close);
   panel.appendChild(actions);document.body.appendChild(panel);
   return false;
  }
 }

   borderRadius:'12px',textAlign:'center',fontSize:'15px',pointerEvents:'none'});

 }

function dfEscape(x){return String(x??'―').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));}
function dfValue(x){
 if(x===null||x===undefined||x==='')return '―';
 if(typeof x==='number')return Number.isFinite(x)?(Number.isInteger(x)?String(x):String(Math.round(x*1000)/1000)):'―';
 if(typeof x==='boolean')return x?'あり':'なし';
 if(Array.isArray(x))return x.slice(0,15).map(dfValue).join(' / ');
 if(typeof x==='object')return Object.entries(x).slice(0,30).map(([k,v])=>`${k}:${dfValue(v)}`).join(' / ');
 return String(x);
}

// Ver.89: once-only password gate for the actual hidden-command entry points.
// This is game UI protection, not a cryptographic security boundary (the game
// is a standalone HTML file). Keep the authorization outside the v1 save
// namespace so `rsp` never makes a returning player re-enter the code.
const dfV89HiddenAuthKey='derby_fantasy.v89.hidden_command_authorized';
let dfV89HiddenAuthThisPage=false;
function dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand(){
 if(dfV89HiddenAuthThisPage)return true;
 try{
  if(localStorage.getItem(dfV89HiddenAuthKey)==='1'){
   dfV89HiddenAuthThisPage=true;return true;
  }
 }catch(_){/* Private browsing may block persistent storage. */}
 let entered;
 try{entered=window.prompt('隠しコマンドの初回認証\n5桁のパスワードを入力してください。','');}
 catch(_){return false;}
 if(entered===null)return false;
 const code=String(entered).trim().replace(/[０-９]/g,c=>String(c.charCodeAt(0)-65296));
 if(!/^\d{5}$/.test(code)||code!=='43178'){
  window.alert('パスワードが違います。隠しコマンドは実行されません。');
  return false;
 }
 dfV89HiddenAuthThisPage=true;
 try{localStorage.setItem(dfV89HiddenAuthKey,'1');}
 catch(_){/* Authorization still works for this open page. */}
 return true;
}
window.dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand=dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand;

      return;
    }
    if(command==='rsp'){
      if(!dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand()){
       stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;refreshBetQuote();return;
      }
      stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;
      if(!confirm('このコピー版のオーナー名・秘書名・所有馬・引退記録・所持金・レース記録をすべて初期化します。元には戻せません。初期化しますか？')){
        refreshBetQuote();return;
      }
      try{
        // Only this copy's namespaced saves. Never clear the browser's other apps or original game.
        const prefix='derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.';
        const keys=[];
        for(let i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){
          const key=localStorage.key(i);
          if(key&&key.startsWith(prefix))keys.push(key);
        }
        for(const key of keys)localStorage.removeItem(key);
        if(keys.some(key=>localStorage.getItem(key)!==null))throw new Error('save removal incomplete');
        // Seed a clean game, not the farm demo defaults (which would restore sample owned horses).
        // All other copy-namespaced saves were removed above: careers, bets, names,
        // monthly operating charges, foals, sales purchases and retirement archives.
        localStorage.setItem('derby_fantasy_new_html_v1.farm',JSON.stringify({
          calendarYear:1,calendarMonth:1,walletCash:INITIAL_CASH,
          ownerName:'',ownerGender:'',secretaryName:'',barnHorseId:'',
          horses:[],pregnancies:[],lastOperatingFeeMonth:'',
          breeding:{stallions:[],mare:null,selectedSire:'',bredYears:[],birthCount:0}
        }));
        window.location.reload();
      }catch(e){
        console.error('初期化できませんでした',e);
        $('betMessage').textContent='保存データの削除に失敗しました。ブラウザの保存設定を確認してください。';
      }
      return;
    }
    if(command==='ho'){
      if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='newspaper')return;
      if(!dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand()){
       stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;refreshBetQuote();return;
      }
      stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;
      refreshBetQuote();
      showBarnPage();
      return;
    }
    if(command!=='op'){
      if(/^\d+$/.test(stake.value))stakeBeforeOp=stake.value;
      return;
    }
    // Preserve the existing 'op' horse-ability shortcut.
    if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='newspaper'||!raceLineupCommitted)return;
    if(!dfV89AuthorizeHiddenCommand()){
     stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;refreshBetQuote();return;
    }
     stake.value=stakeBeforeOp;
     dfV136OpFullRoster=true;
     setGameScreen('all-stats');
  };
 stake.addEventListener('input',handle);
 stake.addEventListener('change',handle);
 back.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    dfV136OpFullRoster=false;
    setGameScreen('newspaper');
    document.getElementById('betStake').value=stakeBeforeOp;
   refreshBetQuote();
 });
}

function bindGameScreenNav(){
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-screen-go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>goGameScreen(b.dataset.screenGo)));
 $('resultToRaceHome').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(dfV30VsActive){window.DFV28VS?.returnToSelection?.();return;}goGameScreen('race-home');});
  $('newspaperRaceStart').addEventListener('click',()=>{
   if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='newspaper'||!raceLineupCommitted||race!=='idle'||runners.length<(dfV30VsActive?1:2))return;
   if(!df144CheckLineupForm())return;
   
   try{if(!df170StartFromNewspaper())return;}catch(e){alert('レース開始記録を保存できません: '+e.message);return;}
   goGameScreen('race-view');
   const raceStartButton=$('start');
   const intro=dfV57GateIntro;
   const serial=++intro.serial;
   const requestedAt=performance.now();
   let entered=false,completed=false;
   // dfV2Switch changes screens asynchronously (View Transitions or a 720ms
   // fallback fade). Ver.57 aborted on the very next animation frame, before
   // the newspaper was actually replaced. Begin the gate timer ONLY when the
   // race-view screen is mounted, not when its transition is requested.
   intro.active=false;intro.progress=0;intro.begun=0;
   raceStartButton.disabled=true;
   raceStartButton.textContent='スタートゲートへ接近中…';
   df103Subtitle('スタートゲートの馬と騎手を映しています。まもなく発走です！');
   const cancelIntro=()=>{
    if(completed)return;
    completed=true;intro.active=false;
    raceStartButton.disabled=false;
    if(race==='idle')raceStartButton.textContent='▶ レース開始';
   };
   const finishIntro=()=>{
    if(completed||intro.serial!==serial)return;
    // Never start while the player is elsewhere or a new race has replaced us.
    if(race!=='idle'){cancelIntro();return;}
    if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='newspaper')dfV2SetGameScreenNow('race-view');
    if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='race-view'){cancelIntro();return;}
    completed=true;intro.progress=1;intro.active=false;
    raceStartButton.disabled=false;
    raceStartButton.click(); // invoke the ORIGINAL race-start event; no duplicate physics
   };
   const showGateApproach=(now)=>{
    if(completed||intro.serial!==serial)return;
    if(race!=='idle'){cancelIntro();return;}
    const screen=document.body.dataset.gameScreen;
    if(!entered){
     if(screen!=='race-view'){
      if(screen!=='newspaper'){cancelIntro();return;}
      // Only repair a genuinely stalled transition; ordinarily preserve its fade.
      if(now-requestedAt<1800){requestAnimationFrame(showGateApproach);return;}
      dfV2SetGameScreenNow('race-view');
      if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen!=='race-view'){cancelIntro();return;}
     }
     entered=true;intro.active=true;intro.begun=now;intro.progress=0;
     try{
      resize(); // The newspaper's hidden 0x0 canvas is now visible.
      setCam(true);
      if(renderer&&!renderer.getContext().isContextLost())renderer.render(scene,camera);
     }catch(err){console.warn('ゲート映像の初期化を継続します',err);}
    }else if(screen!=='race-view'){
     cancelIntro();return;
    }
    intro.progress=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(now-intro.begun)/intro.durationMs));
    if(intro.progress>=1){finishIntro();return;}
    requestAnimationFrame(showGateApproach);
   };
   requestAnimationFrame(showGateApproach);
   // Independent watchdog: even if a WebGL frame or animation callback fails,
   // the camera presentation cannot keep the real race in 'idle' indefinitely.
   setTimeout(()=>{
    if(intro.serial!==serial||completed||race!=='idle')return;
    if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='newspaper')dfV2SetGameScreenNow('race-view');
    if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='race-view')finishIntro();
    else cancelIntro();
   },Math.max(6000,intro.durationMs+2600));
  });
}


// 牧場ホーム iframe がレース本体とは別セーブを使うため、実際の所有馬を取り込む。
// 既存の競走馬DBや保存済み厩舎データは上書きしない。
function dfSyncGameCalendarFromFarm(snapshot){
 const year=Number(snapshot?.calendarYear),month=Number(snapshot?.calendarMonth);
 if(!Number.isInteger(year)||year<1||year>9999||!Number.isInteger(month)||month<1||month>12)return;
 if(year===calendarYear&&month===calendarMonth)return;
 const oldSerial=calendarYear*12+calendarMonth;
 const newSerial=year*12+month;
 const oneStep=newSerial===oldSerial+1;
 // DF198: retirement must run on *every* forward calendar sync, not only
 // one-month snapshots. The farm can deliver a jump of several months.
 const forward=newSerial>oldSerial;
 const before=forward?stableBeforeMonthAdvance(year):null;
 calendarYear=year;calendarMonth=month;
 df133ResetMonthlyRivals();
 calendarCompleted.clear();
 df202EnsurePlans();
 if(oneStep)stableAfterMonthAdvance(before);
 else if(newSerial>oldSerial){
  // Multiple monthly snapshots may be coalesced while the farm fast-forwards.
  // Catch up condition deterministically, one distinct month at a time;
  // do not apply an additional random reroll for each screen redraw.
  for(const h of stableState.horses){
   if(h.named){h.startsMonth=0;df28FormOnMonth(h);}
  }
  // Fast-forwarded months must clear rival monthly counts as well.
  for(const rival of Object.values(stableState.rivalConditions))rival.startsMonth=0;
  persistStable();
  syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({forms:true});
  if(before.retired.length)alert(`現役期間を終えて引退しました：\n${before.retired.join('、')}`);
 }
 saveCalendarData();
 populateCalendarCohorts();
 // Refresh every date-bearing race, stable and newspaper view after synchronization.
 drawCalendar();
 if($('stableDate'))$('stableDate').textContent=`${calendarYear}年目 ${calendarMonth}月`;
 if(document.body.classList.contains('stable-mode'))renderStable();
 if(typeof highlightOwnedRaceChoices==='function')highlightOwnedRaceChoices();
 raceLineupCommitted=false;
 const entry=$('newspaperRaceStart');if(entry)entry.disabled=true;
}
const FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX='farm-linked:';
let farmObserved=null;
let df153FarmCache=null;
function importFarmHomeState(snapshot){
 if(!snapshot||!Array.isArray(snapshot.horses))return false;
 window.__df153BlackOn=!!snapshot.df153BlackMode&&snapshot.df155SelectedMode!=='normal';
 window.__df155ActiveMultiplier=snapshot.df155Black2Unlocked&&snapshot.df155SelectedMode==='black2'?1.10*1.15:window.__df153BlackOn?1.10:1;
 // DF198: queued farm events can arrive after the farm has already moved
 // several months. Prefer the live authoritative calendar over a stale event.
 try{
  const current=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge?.getState?.();
  if(current&&Array.isArray(current.horses)&&Number.isInteger(Number(current.calendarYear))&&
     Number.isInteger(Number(current.calendarMonth))&&Number(current.calendarMonth)>=1&&Number(current.calendarMonth)<=12&&
     (Number(current.calendarYear)!==Number(snapshot.calendarYear)||Number(current.calendarMonth)!==Number(snapshot.calendarMonth)))
    snapshot=current;
 }catch(err){console.warn('DF198: 最新の牧場月情報を取得できませんでした',err);}
 dfSyncGameCalendarFromFarm(snapshot);
 // DF198: a save may already be in January with a horse that missed its
 // retirement, even when no calendar change occurs during this import.
 // Retire such horses in the authoritative farm, through the same bridge
 // used by manual retirement (preserves 3+ GI breeding promotion and items).
 // Read the live farm after any retirement triggered by calendar sync: an
 // older queued snapshot must not re-import a horse just retired above.
 try{
  const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  const live=bridge?.getState?.();
  if(live&&Array.isArray(live.horses)&&
     Number(live.calendarYear)===Number(snapshot.calendarYear)&&
     Number(live.calendarMonth)===Number(snapshot.calendarMonth)){
   const expired=live.horses.filter(h=>h&&Number.isInteger(Number(h.birthGameYear))&&
     Number(live.calendarYear)-Number(h.birthGameYear)>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h));
   const newlyRetired=[];
   for(const fh of expired){
    const mirror=stableState.horses.find(h=>String(h.id)===FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(fh.id));
    const career=mirror?(calendarCareers.get(mirror.name)||{}):{};
    const fullRaceHorse=mirror||fh;
    const result=bridge.retireOwnedHorse?.(fh.id,{
     ...career,starts:career.starts??fullRaceHorse.totalStarts,
     wins:career.wins??fullRaceHorse.totalWins,
     prize:career.prize??fullRaceHorse.prize,
     monthlyHistory:career.monthlyHistory??fullRaceHorse.monthlyHistory??[],fullRaceHorse});
    if(result?.ok)newlyRetired.push(fh.name||String(fh.id));
   }
   if(newlyRetired.length){
    stableNotice(`現役年齢の満了により引退：${newlyRetired.join('、')}`);
    alert(`現役期間を終えて引退しました：\n${newlyRetired.join('、')}`);
   }
   // Use the current farm snapshot, not the earlier queued snapshot.
   // In particular, never recreate a just-retired horse in race-side data.
   snapshot=bridge.getState();
  }
 }catch(err){console.warn('DF198: 引退済み馬の牧場同期を再確認できませんでした',err);}
 df153FarmCache=snapshot;
 const sharedCash=Math.floor(Number(snapshot.walletCash));
 if(Number.isFinite(sharedCash)&&sharedCash>=0&&sharedCash!==walletCash){
  walletCash=sharedCash;persistCash(false);
  if($('walletBalance'))updateTicketDisplay();
  if($('stableCash'))refreshStableCash();
  if($('barnCash'))$('barnCash').textContent=`${fundsText(walletCash)}`;
 }
 const incoming=snapshot.horses.slice(0,120);
 let changed=false;
 const df39RecoveredHonorIds=[];
 for(const fh of incoming){
  if(!fh||!fh.named||!String(fh.name||'').trim()||!String(fh.id||'').trim())continue;
  const id=FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(fh.id).slice(0,80);
  const prior=stableState.horses.find(h=>h.id===id);
  const name=String(fh.name).slice(0,30);
  // Do not shadow a different pre-existing horse with the same name.
  if(!prior&&stableState.horses.some(h=>h.id!==id&&h.name===name))continue;
  const ability={};
  for(const k of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
    ability[k]=Number.isFinite(Number(fh.baseInitial?.[k]))?Number(fh.baseInitial[k]):55;
  }
  const maxAbility={};const special={};
  for(const k of HORSE_ABILITY_KEYS){
   maxAbility[k]=Number.isFinite(Number(fh.baseMaximum?.[k]))?Number(fh.baseMaximum[k]):Math.max(85,ability[k]);
   special[k]=Number.isFinite(Number(fh.uniquePts?.[k]))?Number(fh.uniquePts[k]):0;
  }
  const imported={id,name,named:true,owner:true,
   sex:['牡','牝','騸'].includes(fh.sex)?fh.sex:'牡',
   birthGameYear:Number.isInteger(Number(fh.birthGameYear))?Number(fh.birthGameYear):calendarYear-1,
   growth:['早熟','普通','持続','晩成'].includes(fh.growth)?fh.growth:'普通',
   growthRevealed:fh.growthRevealed===true,
   v20RevealStage:Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Math.floor(Number(fh.v20RevealStage)||0))),
   coatType:fh.coatType||'鹿毛',
   sire:fh.sire||'',dam:fh.dam||'',
   // Ver.10: the farm owns racing traits. Older saves contain the same
   // neutral values as the Ver.9 race-side compatibility fallback.
   surface:fh.surface||'芝',tactic:fh.tactic||'先行',
    df160PendingTactic:['逃げ','先行','差し','追込'].includes(fh.df160PendingTactic)?fh.df160PendingTactic:'',
   bestDistance:Number(fh.bestDistance??1800),
   aptMin:Number(fh.aptMin??600),aptMax:Number(fh.aptMax??3600),
   goingAptitude:{...fh.goingAptitude},
   baseInitial:ability,baseMaximum:maxAbility,uniquePts:special,
   dfPtMergeUnique:fh.dfPtMergeUnique===true,
   luck:Number.isFinite(Number(fh.luck))?Number(fh.luck):50,
   health:Number.isFinite(Number(fh.health))?Number(fh.health):80,
   form:Number.isFinite(Number(fh.form))?Number(fh.form):75,
   fatigue:Number.isFinite(Number(fh.fatigue))?Number(fh.fatigue):0,
   constitution:Number(fh.constitution??80),recovery:Number(fh.recovery??80),
   formStability:Number(fh.formStability??80),temperament:Number(fh.temperament??80),
   startsMonth:0,lastStartDate:'',totalStarts:0,totalWins:0,prize:0,prizeClaims:[],monthlyHistory:[],
   eliteSkillBonuses:freshSkillRewards(),earnedBonus:0,
   potential:Number(fh.potential??80),overallRank:fh.overallRank||'B',g1Wins:Number(fh.g1Wins??0),
   df37G1History:Array.isArray(fh.df37G1History)?fh.df37G1History.map(r=>({...r})):[],
   df37Titles:fh.df37Titles&&typeof fh.df37Titles==='object'?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(fh.df37Titles)):{}};
  // On first upgrade preserve race-earned temperament from Ver.9's mirror.
  if(prior&&fh.v10RacingTraitsStored!==true && Number.isFinite(Number(prior.temperament)))
    imported.temperament=Number(prior.temperament);
  df28EnsureFormCycle(imported);
  df174EnsureRaceLoad(imported);
  // Farm snapshot updates can refresh ability without erasing race progress.
  if(!prior){
   stableState.horses.push(imported);
   HORSE_BY_NAME.set(name,ownerToRunner(imported));
   if(!calendarCareers.has(name))calendarCareers.set(name,{starts:0,wins:0});
   changed=true;
  }else{
   const prev=farmObserved?.horses?.find(h=>FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(h.id)===id);
   let abilityChanged=false;
   for(const k of ['baseInitial','baseMaximum','uniquePts','dfPtMergeUnique','surface','tactic','df160PendingTactic',
     'growthRevealed','v20RevealStage','bestDistance','aptMin','aptMax','goingAptitude','constitution','recovery',
     'formStability','temperament','potential','overallRank','g1Wins','df37G1History','df37Titles']){
    // Re-sync directly from the canonical pasture save, not the older mirror.
    if((k==='df37Titles'||k==='df37G1History')&&
      !Object.keys(imported[k]||{}).length&&Object.keys(prior[k]||{}).length){
      if(k==='df37Titles')df39RecoveredHonorIds.push(id);
      continue;
    }
    if(JSON.stringify(prior[k])!==JSON.stringify(imported[k])){
      prior[k]=imported[k];abilityChanged=true;
    }
   }
   const pastureChanged=!!prev&&JSON.stringify(prev)!==JSON.stringify(fh);
   if(pastureChanged){
    for(const k of ['name','coatType','health','form','fatigue']){
     if(prev[k]!==fh[k])prior[k]=imported[k];
    }
   }
   if(abilityChanged||pastureChanged){
    HORSE_BY_NAME.set(prior.name,ownerToRunner(prior));
    changed=true;
   }
  }
 }
 // Ver.196: the farm is the source of truth for farm-linked active horses.
 // Age-based automatic retirement can omit the manual df-v9-retired event;
 // remove race-side mirrors absent from the current complete farm snapshot.
 const farmLiveIds=new Set(snapshot.horses.filter(h=>h&&h.id!=null)
  .map(h=>FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(h.id).slice(0,80)));
 const retiredMirrors=stableState.horses.filter(h=>
  String(h.id||'').startsWith(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX)&&!farmLiveIds.has(String(h.id)));
 if(retiredMirrors.length){
  const retiredIds=new Set(retiredMirrors.map(h=>h.id));
  // Match the existing manual-retirement safety check for a prepared paper.
  if(race==='idle'&&!dfV30VsActive&&DEF.some(h=>h.owner&&retiredIds.has(h.ownId))){
   discardRaceTickets();
   raceLineupCommitted=false;
   $('newspaperRaceStart').disabled=true;
   $('start').disabled=true;
   if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='newspaper')setGameScreen('race-home');
  }
  stableState.horses=stableState.horses.filter(h=>!retiredIds.has(h.id));
  if(retiredIds.has(stableState.selectedHorseId))stableState.selectedHorseId='';
  for(const h of retiredMirrors){
   HORSE_BY_NAME.delete(h.name);
   calendarCareers.delete(h.name);
  }
  changed=true;
 }
 farmObserved=snapshot;
 // Passive farm snapshots (screen changes, horse selection) must never write
 // the race-side form back into the pasture: the snapshot may be from an
 // earlier queued message during a fast 38-month advance.  Form is mirrored
 // only by the actual month/race transition handlers, not by navigation.
 syncRaceHorseFieldsToFarm({prizes:true,legacyTraits:true,achievementWinnerIds:df39RecoveredHonorIds});
 if(document.body.dataset.gameScreen==='race-home')df25RefreshRaceHome();
 if(changed){
  if(!stableState.selectedHorseId&&snapshot.barnHorseId){
   const selected=stableState.horses.find(h=>h.id===FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX+String(snapshot.barnHorseId));
   if(selected)stableState.selectedHorseId=selected.id;
  }
  persistStable();
  // Owned horses are known to calendar choices immediately; never rebuild a running race.
  if(race==='idle'||race==='finished'){
   drawCalendar();
   highlightOwnedRaceChoices();
  }
 }
 return changed;
}
