/* Copy Ver.25: race-home presentation only; existing race eligibility and entry flow stay authoritative. */
let df25ExpandedHorse='',df130HistoryHorse='',df134SelectedOwner='';
function df25Escape(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));}
function df25HorseClass(h){
 if(!h?.named)return '未命名';
 const wins=Math.max(0,Number(careerOf(ownerToRunner(h)).wins)||0);
 const starts=Math.max(0,Number(careerOf(ownerToRunner(h)).starts)||0);
 return wins===0?(starts?'未勝利':'新馬'):wins===1?'1勝クラス':wins===2?'2勝クラス':wins===3?'3勝クラス':'オープン';
}
function df25RaceText(card){
 const reward=stableRaceWinnings(card,0);
 const trial=(CLASSIC_TRIAL_RIGHTS[card.name]||[]).map(([target,place])=>`${target}トライアル・1〜${place}着まで優先出走権`).join('／');
 return `${card.name}（${card.grade}）｜${card.venue} 芝${card.distance}m${trial?'｜'+trial:''}｜1着賞金 ${cashText(reward)}`;
}
// Explain why an owned horse has no available race; never silently disable its name.
// Eligibility checks and the actual race-entry rules are unchanged.
function df25UnavailableReason(h,runner,cards){
 const age=calendarHorseAge(h);
 if(!h.named)return '馬名が未登録のため出走できません。';
 if(!df144OwnedFormAllowed(h))return `調子${df160OwnedRaceForm(h)}のため出走できません。調子70以上になるまで出走できません。`;
 if(age<2)return '2歳になるまで出走できません。';
 if(age>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h))return `この馬は${window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h)}歳12月までが現役期間です。`;
 if(age===2&&calendarMonth<6)return '2歳馬のレースは6月から始まります。';
 if(Number(h.startsMonth)>=STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS)return `今月は${STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS}走済みです。翌月から出走できます。`;
 if(!cards.length)return '今月のレースはすべて終了しています。翌月へ進んでください。';
 return '今月は勝利数・レース区分・年齢などの出走条件に合うレースがありません。';
}
// Display only: respect the farm's existing discovery milestones.
// First run reveals growth; sixth run reveals distance, never reveal early.
function df25OwnerKnownTraits(h){
 const stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Number(h.v20RevealStage)||0));
 const hasGrowth=stage>=1||h.growthRevealed===true;
 const hasDistance=stage>=6;
 const growth=hasGrowth&&['早熟','普通','持続','晩成'].includes(h.growth)?h.growth:'？？？';
 const lo=Number(h.aptMin),hi=Number(h.aptMax);
 const distance=hasDistance&&Number.isFinite(lo)&&Number.isFinite(hi)&&lo<=hi
  ?`${lo}〜${hi}m`:'？？？';
 return `<div class="df129-known-traits"><span>成長タイプ <strong>${df25Escape(growth)}</strong> <small class="df135-retirement">${hasGrowth?window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h)+'歳まで現役可能':'現役年齢は成長タイプ判明後'}</small></span><span>距離適性 <strong>${df25Escape(distance)}</strong></span></div>`;
}
// Ver.130: read ability/reveal information from the authoritative farm snapshot.
// The race-home revealed figures show full race-effective ability:
// growing base Pt + 100% unique Pt. The farm itself displays basic Pt only.
function df130FarmView(){
 try{
  const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
  if(!bridge?.getState)return {bridge:null,horses:new Map()};
  const state=bridge.getState();
  return {bridge,horses:new Map((state?.horses||[]).map(h=>[String(h.id),h]))};
 }catch(_){return {bridge:null,horses:new Map()};}
}
function df130FourAbilities(h,farmView){
 const farmId=String(h.id||'').startsWith(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX)?String(h.id).slice(FARM_IMPORT_PREFIX.length):'';
 const source=farmView.horses.get(farmId)||h;
 const stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(6,Math.floor(Number(source.v20RevealStage)||0)));
 const order=Array.isArray(source.v20RevealOrder)?source.v20RevealOrder:[];
 let powers=[];
 if(farmId&&farmView.bridge?.getOpHorseAbilities){
  try{powers=farmView.bridge.getOpHorseAbilities(farmId)||[];}catch(_){}
 }
 const byKey=new Map(powers.map(v=>[v.key,v]));
 const keys=[['sp','スピード'],['sta','スタミナ'],['kick','瞬発力'],['grit','勝負根性']];
 return '<div class="df130-four-abilities" aria-label="判明した4能力と健康">'+keys.map(([key,label])=>{
  const index=order.indexOf(key);
  const revealed=index>=0&&stage>=index+2;
  let value='？？？';
  if(revealed){
   const v=byKey.get(key);
   if(v&&Number.isFinite(Number(v.base))&&Number.isFinite(Number(v.unique))){
    value=(Math.round((Number(v.base)+Number(v.unique))*10)/10).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
   }else if(source.baseInitial&&source.baseMaximum&&source.uniquePts&&window.DFSharedRules?.growthFraction){
    const f=window.DFSharedRules.growthFraction(source,calendarYear,calendarMonth);
    const base=Math.round(Number(source.baseInitial[key])+(Number(source.baseMaximum[key])-Number(source.baseInitial[key]))*f);
    value=(Math.round((base+Number(source.uniquePts[key]))*10)/10).toLocaleString('ja-JP',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
   }else value='—';
  }
  return `<span class="df130-ability"><span>${label}</span><strong>${df25Escape(value)}</strong></span>`;
 }).join('')+`<span class="df130-ability"><span>健康</span><strong>${df25Escape(Number.isFinite(Number(source.health))?Math.round(Number(source.health)):'—')} / 100</strong></span>`+'</div>';
}
function df130HistoryBubble(h){
 if(df130HistoryHorse!==h.id)return '';
 const history=Array.isArray(h.monthlyHistory)?h.monthlyHistory:[];
 const starts=Math.max(history.length,Number(h.totalStarts)||0);
 const wins=Math.max(0,Number(h.totalWins)||0);
 const rows=history.length?history.slice().reverse().map(r=>{
  const year=Number(r.year),month=Number(r.month),place=Number(r.place);
  const when=Number.isFinite(year)&&Number.isFinite(month)?`${year}年目${month}月`:'年月不明';
  const pos=Number.isFinite(place)&&place>0?`${place}着`:'—';
  const prize=Number.isFinite(Number(r.prize))&&r.prize!==undefined?cashText(r.prize):'—';
  const dist=Number.isFinite(Number(r.distance))&&Number(r.distance)>0
   ?`${r.surface==='ダート'?'ダート':'芝'}${Math.floor(Number(r.distance))}m`:'距離記録なし';
  const popularity=Number.isInteger(Number(r.popularity))&&Number(r.popularity)>0
   ?`${Math.floor(Number(r.popularity))}番人気`:'人気記録なし';
  return `<div class="df130-history-row"><span>${df25Escape(when)}　${df25Escape(r.name||'レース')}<small class="df134-history-meta">${df25Escape(dist)} ・ ${df25Escape(popularity)}</small></span><strong>${df25Escape(pos)}</strong><small>${df25Escape(prize)}</small></div>`;
 }).join(''):'<p class="df130-no-history">出走記録はまだありません。</p>';
 return `<section class="df130-history-bubble" aria-label="${df25Escape(h.name)}の戦歴" role="region">
  <div class="df130-history-head"><strong>${df25Escape(h.name)}　${starts}戦${wins}勝</strong><button type="button" data-df130-close="1" aria-label="戦歴を閉じる">×</button></div>
  <div class="df130-history-scroll">${rows}</div></section>`;
}
function df137RaceGradeOrder(c){
 const g=String(c.grade||'').toUpperCase();
 const klass=String(c.classType||'');
 if(klass==='new')return -1;
 if(/未勝利/.test(c.name||'')||/maiden|unraced|unwon/.test(klass))return 0;
 if(/1勝|１勝/.test(c.name||'')||/1win/.test(klass))return 1;
 if(/2勝|２勝/.test(c.name||'')||/2win/.test(klass))return 2;
 if(/3勝|３勝/.test(c.name||'')||/3win/.test(klass))return 3;
 if(g==='GⅢ'||g==='G3')return 5;
 if(g==='GⅡ'||g==='G2')return 6;
 if(g==='GⅠ'||g==='G1')return 7;
 if(g==='OP'||/オープン|OPEN|OP/.test(String(c.name||'').toUpperCase()))return 4;
 return 4;
}
function df137SortRaceCards(cards){return cards.map((c,i)=>({c,i})).sort((a,b)=>df137RaceGradeOrder(a.c)-df137RaceGradeOrder(b.c)||a.i-b.i).map(x=>x.c);}
function df25RefreshRaceHome(){
 const root=$('dfV25RaceHome');if(!root)return;
 $('df25Money').textContent=fundsText(walletCash);
 $('df25Date').textContent=`${calendarMonth}月`;
 const cards=df137SortRaceCards(eligibleMonthlyRaceCards());
 // Ver.196: never show an already retired horse in the race-home tabs,
 // even before the next authoritative farm snapshot has been received.
 const owners=(stableState.horses||[]).filter(h=>calendarHorseAge(h)<=window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(h));
 const farmView=df130FarmView();
 const runnersById=new Map(ownedRaceHorses().map(h=>[h.ownId,h]));
 const canEnter=new Map(owners.map(h=>[h.id,cards.filter(c=>runnersById.has(h.id)&&calendarRaceEligible(runnersById.get(h.id),c))]));
 if(!owners.some(h=>String(h.id)===df134SelectedOwner)){
  df134SelectedOwner=owners.length?String(owners[0].id):'';
  df25ExpandedHorse=df134SelectedOwner;
  df130HistoryHorse='';
 }
 $('df134HorseTabs').innerHTML=owners.map(h=>{
  const ready=(canEnter.get(h.id)||[]).length>0;
  const selected=String(h.id)===df134SelectedOwner;
  return `<button type="button" data-df134-horse-tab="${df25Escape(h.id)}" class="${df28EffectiveForm(h)>=80?'df135-ready':''}" aria-pressed="${selected}"><strong>${df25Escape(h.name||'未命名')}</strong><small>${ready?'出走可':'出走不可'}・調子${df160OwnedRaceForm(h)}</small></button>`;
 }).join('');
 const visibleOwners=owners.filter(h=>String(h.id)===df134SelectedOwner);
 const rows=visibleOwners.map(h=>{
  const list=canEnter.get(h.id)||[];
  const age=calendarHorseAge(h);
  const expandable=list.length>0;
  return `<article class="df25-horse ${df25ExpandedHorse===h.id?'is-selected':''}">
    <div class="df25-horse-main"><div class="df15-horse-title-row"><strong class="df25-horse-name df135-name-label">${df25Escape(h.name||'未命名の馬')}</strong><span class="df15-month-starts">今月 <strong>${Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(h.startsMonth)||0))}/${STABLE_MAX_MONTHLY_STARTS}回</strong></span></div>
      <div class="df19-owner-meta"><span class="df27-horse-sex">${df25Escape(h.sex||'—')}</span><span class="df25-horse-age">${age}歳</span><span class="df19-horse-form">調子 <strong>${df160OwnedRaceForm(h)}</strong></span><span class="df25-horse-class">${df25HorseClass(h)}</span></div><span class="df25-eligibility ${expandable?'yes':'no'}">${expandable?'出走可能':'出走なし'}</span></div>
    ${df130FourAbilities(h,farmView)}
    <div class="df27-earned-prize"><span>獲得賞金 <strong>${df25Escape(cashText(h.prize||0))}</strong></span><span class="df130-form-actions"><button type="button" class="df130-history-button" data-df130-history="${df25Escape(h.id)}" aria-expanded="${df130HistoryHorse===h.id}">戦歴</button></span></div>
    ${df25OwnerKnownTraits(farmView.horses.get(String(h.id).replace(/^farm-linked:/,''))||h)}
    ${df130HistoryBubble(h)}</article>`;
 }).join('');
 $('df25HorseList').innerHTML=rows||`<div class="df25-empty">${owners.length?'このタブに該当する所有馬はいません。':'現在、所有馬はいません。'}</div>`;
 const chosenHorse=owners.find(h=>String(h.id)===df25ExpandedHorse&&String(h.id)===df134SelectedOwner);
 const races=chosenHorse?canEnter.get(df25ExpandedHorse)||[]:[];
 const choices=$('df25HorseChoices');choices.hidden=!chosenHorse;
 if(chosenHorse){
  $('df25ChoicesTitle').textContent=`${chosenHorse.name} の出走可能レース`;
  $('df25ChoiceList').innerHTML=races.length
   ?races.map(c=>`<div class="df25-race-line"><span>${df25Escape(df25RaceText(c))}</span><button type="button" data-df25-choose="${df25Escape(c.calendarId)}">選択</button></div>`).join('')
   :`<div class="df25-empty">${df25Escape(df25UnavailableReason(chosenHorse,runnersById.get(chosenHorse.id),cards))}</div>`;
 }else{$('df25ChoiceList').innerHTML='';}
 const fallback=$('df25Fallback');fallback.hidden=false;
 const gradedRaces=cards.filter(c=>df137RaceGradeOrder(c)>=5&&df137RaceGradeOrder(c)<=7);
 $('df25FallbackList').innerHTML=gradedRaces.length?gradedRaces.map(c=>`<div class="df25-race-line"><span>${df25Escape(df25RaceText(c))}</span><button type="button" class="df25-race-btn" data-df25-open="${df25Escape(c.calendarId)}">レース ›</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="df25-empty">今月の開催レースは終了しています。牧場で翌月へ進んでください。</div>';
}
// DF197: one confirmation step for owned races, and a separate no-entry confirmation.
let df197PendingRace=null,df197PreviousFocus=null,df197HighlightedRaceLine=null;
let df197ConfirmedNavigation=false;
function df197CloseRaceConfirm(){
 const box=$('df197RaceConfirm');if(box)box.hidden=true;
 df197PendingRace=null;
 df197HighlightedRaceLine?.classList.remove('df197-awaiting');
 df197HighlightedRaceLine=null;
 if(df197PreviousFocus?.isConnected)df197PreviousFocus.focus();
 df197PreviousFocus=null;
}
function df197ShowRaceConfirm(card,horse=null){
 const box=$('df197RaceConfirm');
 if(!box||!card){df6RaceSelectionIssue('確認画面の部品またはレース情報がありません。',{boxFound:!!box,cardFound:!!card});return;}
 // DBF7: a stale visible dialog must never permanently block race selection.
 if(!box.hidden)df197CloseRaceConfirm();
 const isOwned=!!horse;
 if(isOwned){
  const runner=ownedRaceHorses().find(h=>String(h.ownId)===String(horse.id));
  if(!runner||!calendarRaceEligible(runner,card)){df6RaceSelectionIssue('所有馬の出走条件を再確認したところ不一致でした。',{runnerFound:!!runner,horseId:horse.id,raceId:card.calendarId});return;}
 }
 df197PendingRace={raceId:card.calendarId,horseId:isOwned?String(horse.id):''};
 df197PreviousFocus=document.activeElement;
 $('df197ConfirmTitle').textContent=isOwned?'出走確認':'開催レースの確認';
 $('df197ConfirmMessage').textContent=isOwned
  ?`${horse.name||'未命名の馬'}　${calendarHorseAge(horse)}歳　${horse.sex||'—'}
${card.name}に今月${Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(horse.startsMonth)||0))+1}回目の出走をさせてよいですか？`
  :'出走無しで開催レースへ移動します。良いですか？';
 $('df197ConfirmYes').textContent=isOwned?'出走する':'はい';
 $('df197ConfirmNo').textContent=isOwned?'キャンセル':'いいえ';
 box.hidden=false;
 $('df197ConfirmNo').focus();
}
function df6RaceSelectionIssue(message,details={}){
  const report='DBF6-RACE-SELECT: '+message+' '+JSON.stringify(details);
  console.error(report);
  try{window.flutter_inappwebview?.callHandler?.('consoleLog',report);}catch(_){}
  let box=document.getElementById('df6RaceIssue');
  if(!box){box=document.createElement('div');box.id='df6RaceIssue';box.setAttribute('role','alert');
   Object.assign(box.style,{position:'fixed',bottom:'18px',left:'12px',right:'12px',zIndex:'2147483640',background:'#69262a',color:'white',padding:'14px',borderRadius:'10px',fontSize:'16px',boxShadow:'0 2px 12px #0008'});
   document.body.appendChild(box);}
  box.textContent=message+'（診断: DBF6）';
}
function df197RequestOwnedRace(raceId,horseId,button=null){
 if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout'){
   df6RaceSelectionIssue('レース状態が「'+race+'」のままです。', {raceId,horseId});return;
  }
  const card=eligibleMonthlyRaceCards().find(c=>String(c.calendarId)===String(raceId));
  const horse=(stableState.horses||[]).find(h=>String(h.id)===String(horseId));
  if(!card||!horse){df6RaceSelectionIssue('レースまたは所有馬が見つかりません。',{raceId,horseId,cardFound:!!card,horseFound:!!horse});return;}
  if(calendarHorseAge(horse)>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(horse)){
   df6RaceSelectionIssue('出走年齢の条件を満たしていません。',{raceId,horseId});return;
  }
  df197ShowRaceConfirm(card,horse);
  if($('df197RaceConfirm')?.hidden){
   const runner=ownedRaceHorses().find(h=>String(h.ownId)===String(horse.id));
   df6RaceSelectionIssue('出走確認画面を開けません。',{raceId,horseId,runnerFound:!!runner,eligible:!!runner&&calendarRaceEligible(runner,card)});
  }
 if(!$('df197RaceConfirm').hidden&&button){
  df197HighlightedRaceLine=button.closest('.df25-race-line');
  df197HighlightedRaceLine?.classList.add('df197-awaiting');
 }
}
function df197RequestFallbackRace(raceId){
 if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout')return;
 const card=eligibleMonthlyRaceCards().find(c=>String(c.calendarId)===String(raceId));
 if(card)df197ShowRaceConfirm(card);
}
function df197BindRaceConfirm(){
 // DBF7: initialize dialog to a known closed state on each app launch.
 df197CloseRaceConfirm();
 $('df197ConfirmNo')?.addEventListener('click',df197CloseRaceConfirm);
 $('df197ConfirmYes')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const pending=df197PendingRace;
  if(!pending)return;
  // Recheck the authoritative eligibility and month at the point of confirmation.
  const card=eligibleMonthlyRaceCards().find(c=>String(c.calendarId)===String(pending.raceId));
  if(!card){df197CloseRaceConfirm();return;}
  if(pending.horseId){
   const horse=(stableState.horses||[]).find(h=>String(h.id)===String(pending.horseId));
   const runner=ownedRaceHorses().find(h=>String(h.ownId)===String(pending.horseId));
   if(!horse||!runner||calendarHorseAge(horse)>window.DFSharedRules.lastActiveAge(horse)||!calendarRaceEligible(runner,card)){
    df197CloseRaceConfirm();df25RefreshRaceHome();return;
   }
  }
  const {raceId,horseId}=pending;
  df197CloseRaceConfirm();
  df197ConfirmedNavigation=true;
  df25OpenSelectedRace(raceId,horseId);
 });
 $('df197RaceConfirm')?.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
  if(event.key==='Escape'){event.preventDefault();df197CloseRaceConfirm();}
  if(event.key==='Tab'){
   const yes=$('df197ConfirmYes'),no=$('df197ConfirmNo');
   if(event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===no){event.preventDefault();yes.focus();}
   else if(!event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===yes){event.preventDefault();no.focus();}
  }
 });
}
function df25OpenSelectedRace(raceId,horseId=''){
 const card=eligibleMonthlyRaceCards().find(c=>String(c.calendarId)===String(raceId));if(!card){df197ConfirmedNavigation=false;return;}
 if(race==='running'||race==='paused'||race==='runout'){df197ConfirmedNavigation=false;return;}
 if(horseId){
  const h=ownedRaceHorses().find(h=>String(h.ownId)===String(horseId));
  if(!h||!calendarRaceEligible(h,card)){df197ConfirmedNavigation=false;return;}
 }
 $('calendarRaceSelect').value=card.calendarId;
 refreshStableEntryPicker(card);
 // The existing engine reads both its hidden race and owner selectors.
 stableState.selectedHorseId=horseId;
 $('stableRaceEntry').value=horseId;
 persistStable();
 goGameScreen('newspaper');
}
// Only three farm secretary events require leaving the race selection screen:
// first sale month notice, breeding month notice and an actual new foal birth.
function df130AdvanceFromRaceHome(){
 if(!window.confirm('翌月へ進めますか？'))return;
 const bridge=$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow?.FarmHomeBridge;
 let before=null;
 try{before=bridge?.getState?.()||null;}catch(_){}
 let movedBefore=false;
 if(before&&bridge?.advanceMonth&&race!=='running'&&race!=='paused'&&race!=='runout'){
  const nextMonth=Number(before.calendarMonth)%12+1;
  const nextYear=Number(before.calendarYear)+(nextMonth===1?1:0);
  const notices=new Set(before.v43SeasonNotices||[]);
  const sale=nextMonth===12&&!notices.has(`${nextYear}-${nextMonth}-sale`);
  const breeding=nextMonth===4&&!notices.has(`${nextYear}-${nextMonth}-breed`);
  // The farm can give birth only if a due pregnancy exists and a stable slot is free.
  const due=(before.pregnancies||[]).some(p=>p.sireId&&p.damId&&
   (Number(p.birthYear)*12+Number(p.birthMonth||3))<=nextYear*12+nextMonth);
  const birth=due&&(before.horses||[]).length<5;
  // The authoritative month function may ask another question when unpaid tickets
  // remain; don't navigate to the farm until that extra question is accepted.
  if((sale||breeding||birth)&&!(race==='idle'&&raceTickets.length)){
   dfV2ShowBarnPageNow(); // Display the farm before the secretary/event fires.
   movedBefore=true;
  }
 }
 advanceGameMonth(); // Existing month, fee, breeding, foal and save logic.
 if(!before)return;
 let after=null;
 try{after=bridge?.getState?.()||null;}catch(_){}
 if(!after||(before.calendarYear===after.calendarYear&&before.calendarMonth===after.calendarMonth))return;
 const year=Number(after.calendarYear),month=Number(after.calendarMonth);
 const previousNotices=new Set(before.v43SeasonNotices||[]);
 const newNotices=new Set(after.v43SeasonNotices||[]);
 const sale=month===12&&newNotices.has(`${year}-${month}-sale`)&&!previousNotices.has(`${year}-${month}-sale`);
 const breeding=month===4&&newNotices.has(`${year}-${month}-breed`)&&!previousNotices.has(`${year}-${month}-breed`);
 const oldIds=new Set((before.horses||[]).map(h=>String(h.id)));
 const newborn=(after.horses||[]).some(h=>!oldIds.has(String(h.id)));
 if((sale||breeding||newborn)&&!movedBefore)dfV2ShowBarnPageNow();
 else if(!movedBefore)df25RefreshRaceHome();
}

// Read-only racing calendar: one independent page. The game month is never changed.
let df134CalendarMonth=1;
function df134RenderCalendar(){
 const month=df134CalendarMonth;
 $('df134CalendarTitle').textContent=`${calendarYear}年目 ${month}月`;
 const cards=monthlyRaceCards(month,calendarYear);
 const list=$('df134CalendarRaces');
 list.innerHTML=cards.map(card=>{
  const done=month===calendarMonth&&calendarCompleted.has(card.calendarId);
  const details=`${card.venue}競馬場 ・ ${card.surface||'芝'}${card.distance}m`;
  return `<div class="df134-calendar-race"><span><strong>${df25Escape(card.name)}</strong><small>${df25Escape(details)}</small></span><span class="df134-calendar-grade">${df25Escape(card.grade)}${done?'・出走済':''}</span></div>`;
 }).join('')||'<p>この月のレース予定はありません。</p>';
}
function df134OpenCalendar(){
 $('df134RacingCalendar').hidden=false;
 df134CalendarMonth=calendarMonth;
 df134RenderCalendar();
 setGameScreen('racing-calendar');
}
function df25BindRaceHome(){
 df197BindRaceConfirm();
 $('df25ToFarm')?.addEventListener('click',()=>goGameScreen('farm'));
 $('df134OpenCalendar')?.addEventListener('click',df134OpenCalendar);
 $('df134CalendarBack')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{setGameScreen('race-home');$('df134RacingCalendar').hidden=true;});
 $('df134PrevMonth')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{df134CalendarMonth=df134CalendarMonth===1?12:df134CalendarMonth-1;df134RenderCalendar();});
 $('df134NextMonth')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{df134CalendarMonth=df134CalendarMonth===12?1:df134CalendarMonth+1;df134RenderCalendar();});
 // Use the exact same authoritative farm/month advance as the existing calendar button.
 $('df25NextMonth')?.addEventListener('click',df130AdvanceFromRaceHome);
 $('dfV25RaceHome')?.addEventListener('click',event=>{
  const b=event.target.closest('button');if(!b||b.disabled)return;
  if(b.hasAttribute('data-df134-horse-tab')){const id=b.dataset.df134HorseTab;if(!(stableState.horses||[]).some(h=>String(h.id)===id))return;df134SelectedOwner=id;df25ExpandedHorse=id;df130HistoryHorse='';df25RefreshRaceHome();return;}
  if(b.hasAttribute('data-df130-close')){df130HistoryHorse='';df25RefreshRaceHome();return;}
  if(b.hasAttribute('data-df130-history')){const id=b.dataset.df130History;df130HistoryHorse=df130HistoryHorse===id?'':id;df25RefreshRaceHome();return;}
  if(b.hasAttribute('data-df25-choose')){df197RequestOwnedRace(b.dataset.df25Choose,df25ExpandedHorse,b);return;}
  if(b.hasAttribute('data-df25-open')){df197RequestFallbackRace(b.dataset.df25Open);return;}
 });
 df25RefreshRaceHome();
}

function bind(){
 df25BindRaceHome();
 $('ownerFindRace')?.addEventListener('click',chooseOwnedRace);
 window.__keibaSyncFarmHome=importFarmHomeState;
 // One trusted listener routes farm snapshots, career requests and retirements.
 window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
  if(event.source!==$('standaloneFarmV62Frame')?.contentWindow)return;
  const data=event.data||{};
  if(data.channel==='farm-v62-state'){importFarmHomeState(data.state);return;}
  // Copy Ver.9: snapshot race history before deletion and remove retired horses from race eligibility.
  if(data.channel==='df-v9-career-request'){
